Step‑by‑Step GATE COAP 2026 Registration Process

items: Visit the COAP 2026 portal Open your browser and go to the official COAP 2026 website (coap2026.iitr.ac.in/coap2026/).
Click on “Register” / “New User Registration” On the home page, click the registration button for new candidates.
Enter GATE details Fill in your GATE Registration/Enrollment ID, GATE paper code, year of exam, and GATE score as printed on the scorecard.
Fill personal information Enter your name, date of birth, category, email ID, and mobile number exactly as per your GATE records to avoid mismatch issues.
Create login credentials Set a strong password, confirm it, and enter the captcha/security code shown on screen.
Submit and verify Submit the registration form. Note down the COAP 2026 Registration ID displayed on screen and sent to your email/mobile.
Login to COAP account Use your COAP Registration ID and password to log in, verify your details, and keep the credentials safely for use during every round.

content.text: You can also add a note: “There is usually no separate fee for COAP registration; any fee you pay is for the individual IIT application forms, not for COAP itself.”

sections.heading: What to Do After GATE COAP 2026 Registration

content.text: Many students are confused after registering, so this section adds real value.
Two Parallel Steps for IIT M.Tech Admission

items: Step 1: Register on COAP (this portal). This is required only once and creates your central offer‑view account.

Step 2: Apply to individual IITs separately. Visit each participating IIT’s admission website (IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Madras, IIT Roorkee, etc.), fill their M.Tech/M.Plan/M.Des application forms, pay the institute‑specific fee, and mention your GATE details and COAP registration where asked.

content.text: COAP will show offers only from those institutes and programmes where you have already applied directly and been considered based on GATE.
Using COAP 2026 in Every Round

items: During each active round window, log in to the COAP portal with your Registration ID and password.
Check all the offers displayed from different IITs and programmes (if any).

For each round, choose one of the decision options provided on the portal, commonly: Accept & Freeze - Accept one offer and exit further COAP rounds for that programme. Retain & Wait - Keep your current best offer but remain eligible for upgrade in later rounds. Reject & Wait - Reject the current offer(s) and wait for potential new/ better offers in the next rounds.

detail.short_info: IIM Calcutta MBA Admission 2027-29 policy released. Check CAT 2026 minimum cut-offs, eligibility, PI and WAT weightage, and selection criteria.

content.text: The Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Calcutta has released its admission policy for the two-year full-time MBA programme for the 2027-29 batch. Admission will be based on CAT 2026, scheduled for 29 November 2026, followed by shortlisting, a Personal Interview (PI) and a Writing Ability Test (WAT). The minimum overall CAT percentile for Open category candidates is 85, along with the prescribed sectional cut-offs.

sections.heading: IIM Calcutta MBA Admission 2027-29 - Overview

content.text: Register for Job Alerts

sections.heading: IIM Calcutta MBA Admission 2027-29 Important Dates
IIM Calcutta CAT 2026 Cut Off for MBA Admission 2027-29
How to Apply for IIM Calcutta MBA Admission 2027-29?

content.text: Domestic candidates seeking admission to the two-year full-time MBA programme are considered through CAT 2026. IIM Calcutta does not conduct a separate entrance examination for this admission route.

items: Register for CAT 2026 through the official CAT admission process within the prescribed registration period.
Indicate IIM Calcutta and its MBA programme in the applicable CAT registration preferences.
Appear for CAT 2026 on 29 November 2026.
Check the CAT result and verify the minimum sectional and overall percentile requirements.
Check the IIM Calcutta website for the PI-WAT shortlist.
Complete the additional application and document requirements communicated to shortlisted candidates.
Attend the Personal Interview and Writing Ability Test on the allotted schedule.
Check the final admission decision and follow the institute's admission instructions if selected.

sections.heading: Important Instructions

items: CAT 2026 is your entry exam. The route is CAT 2026 on 29 November 2026, and there is no separate application before then. You are also asked to register for CAT with the IIM Calcutta details in your profile, since the institute uses CAT data.

Selection has three stages. The 2027 process has three stages. One report says CAT carries 56 points in shortlisting and the personal interview (PI) carries 48% of the final selection. Another says PI gets 48% and the CAT score 30% in the final composite. Don’t rely on either figure until you’ve read the official policy.

Minimum CAT percentile and graduation marks apply. Stage I has a minimum CAT percentile for the 2027-29 batch (CAT 2026 score), and graduation marks thresholds also apply. Meeting the minimum doesn’t guarantee a shortlist.
Final-year students can apply, with a deadline. The final-year degree certificate submission deadline is 30 June 2027. If you’re still in your final year, plan your result timing around it.

Overseas applicants have a separate GMAT route. It needs a GMAT total of at least 735 with at least 89 in Verbal, Quantitative and Data Insights; the application fee is USD 150 and the last date is 1 February 2027. Shortlists are expected in the first week of January 2027, so watch your registered email.

sections.heading: CSAB 2026 Mock Seat Allotment - Allotment Process

items: Candidates register and fill/reorder institute-branch preferences on the CSAB portal.
The mock seat allotment is generated based on current preferences, JEE Main 2026 rank, category, and available seats - this shows candidates their probable allotment.
Candidates can review the mock result and revise their preference order during the editing window.
Once satisfied, candidates must lock their final choices by August 5, 2026 (2 PM); choice locking requires OTP verification sent to the registered mobile number and email ID.
After locking, no further edits are permitted for Round 1.
CSAB Special Round 1 seat allotment result will be declared on August 6, 2026, based on the final locked preferences, merit rank, category, and seat availability.
CSAB special rounds process vacant Home State quota seats first; unfilled Home State quota seats convert to Other State quota seats as per standard CSAB rules.
Candidates who already hold a JoSAA seat and opt into CSAB will retain that JoSAA seat unless a higher-preference option is allotted in CSAB Special Round 1.

sections.heading: How to Check CSAB 2026 Mock Seat Allotment Result

items: Visit the official CSAB candidate login portal: CSAB 2026 Mock Seat Allotment Login Link.
Enter your JEE Main 2026 application number and password.
Log in to access the candidate dashboard.
Check the mock seat allotment status, including the probable allotted institute and programme.
Download or save the mock allotment details for future reference.
If not satisfied with the result, go to the "Choice Filling & Display" section and use the "Move Up," "Move Down," or "Swap" options to reorder preferences.
Save every change made before logging out.
Lock the final preference list before August 5, 2026 (2 PM), using OTP verification.

sections.heading: CSAB 2026 Mock Seat Allotment: Important Instructions

items: Checking the mock allotment is entirely online; CSAB will not send email or SMS reminders about the result release.
If dissatisfied with the mock result, reorder preferences by comparing them against last year's college-wise closing ranks relative to your CRL/category rank.
Build a combined preference list covering highly preferred, moderate, and safe institute options.
If already allotted a desired seat, keep the preference sequence unchanged.
Do not remove ambitious/dream college choices just because they weren't allotted in the mock round - the final round may still offer them depending on vacancy movement.
Placing a college higher in the list does not reduce chances of getting a lower-preference seat if higher options remain unavailable.
Avoid listing any institute/branch you are unwilling to join, since accepting an allotted seat is governed by CSAB rules and may involve forfeiting the seat acceptance fee if declined improperly.
Do not log in from multiple devices/tabs simultaneously, as this may cause session timeouts and unsaved changes.
Female candidates should review both Gender-Neutral and Female-Only (supernumerary) seat options, which remain active in CSAB Special Rounds.
Candidates opting for GFTIs should check institute-specific tuition and hostel fee details on csab.nic.in before final locking.
Choice locking requires OTP verification; ensure your registered mobile number is active.
Once locked, choices cannot be edited for Round 1 under any circumstances.
CSAB counselling is conducted exclusively through csab.nic.in - never share login credentials or OTPs on third-party sites or forums.

sections.heading: Reservation Policy and Category-wise Rules

items: OBC candidates must belong to the Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) to be eligible as reserved category candidates; otherwise, they will be treated as Unreserved (UR)/General.
OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must be issued in the appropriate format on or after 01.04.2026, as per current Govt. of West Bengal guidelines.
PwD seats are filled on a horizontal basis within the respective category.

Reservation for SC/ST/EWS/PwD follows extant West Bengal Government rules; OBC reservation follows Kolkata Gazette Notification Nos. 944-BCW/MR-23/2026 and 945-BCW/MR-23/2026 (both dated 18.05.2026), and Labr/85-Emp/EC/1M-01/2025 dated 25.05.2026.
Domicile certificates issued by elected people's representatives (municipal commissioner, councilor, panchayat member, GTA, MLA, or MP) are not acceptable as domicile proof.

If a domicile certificate under Proforma b or e-District shows the parent's domicile, two original ID proofs of the parent (Voter ID, Aadhaar Card, or Passport) showing a West Bengal residential address must be produced during document verification.

sections.heading: Important Instructions

items: The Provisional Merit List has been prepared strictly as per merit.
Provisional seat allotment will be made serially from the merit list until seats in the respective categories are filled.
All admissions are provisional; if a candidate is found ineligible, or is found to have suppressed material information or submitted false information/documents, the admission will stand cancelled.
OBC candidates must submit an updated NCL certificate on the day of counselling, failing which they will be treated as UR/General.
Vacant SC seats will be filled by ST candidates and vice versa.
Reservation rules follow extant West Bengal Government policy for SC/ST/EWS/PwD and specified Gazette notifications for OBC.
A Domicile Certificate in the prescribed format is mandatory; certain issuing authorities are not accepted (see Reservation Policy section above).
Participation in counselling does not guarantee admission; the admission committee's decision is final.
The university reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of seats without assigning any reason.
Selected candidates must submit the downloaded online Anti-Ragging affidavit at first registration and each subsequent year, through www.antiragging.in and www.amanmovement.org.

sections.heading: How to Check and Download RBU Result 2026

content.text: RBU publishes results as direct subject-wise PDF links on its examination notice page rather than through a roll-number login portal. Follow these steps to download your result.

items: Visit the official RBU examination page at rbu.ac.in/home/examinations.
Look for the result notice matching your course, semester, and subject (for example, "Result of B.A. (Arts) 6th Sem. Exam, 2026 in English").
Click on the relevant notice title to open the PDF.

Locate your roll number or registration number in the PDF to check your result.
Download and save the PDF, or take a printout for future reference.

sections.heading: Details Mentioned in the RBU Result PDF

content.text: Based on the format of RBU's official result notices, each PDF is expected to contain student-wise results for the listed subject and semester. Education-HI), and B.A. (Arts)/B.A. (Fine Arts) 3rd Semester, 2025 examinations. A review result is typically issued after a candidate's answer script has been re-checked following an official review application. Specific details of the review process, applicable fee, or the window during which review applications were accepted are not available in the examination notice and should be confirmed with the RBU Controller of Examinations office.

sections.heading: Important Instructions for Candidates

items: Always download results from the official RBU website (www.rbu.ac.in) to avoid misinformation.
Keep a downloaded copy or printout of your result PDF for admission, verification, or further academic use.
If your roll number does not appear in the released PDF, contact the RBU examination department directly.
For queries related to marksheets, migration certificates, or original documents, refer to the "Registration and Migration" section on the official website.
Details on when official/original marksheets will be issued are not available in this notification.

content.text: The West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education (WBCHSE) conducts the Higher Secondary (Class 12) Semester III examination for students who have cleared Class 11 under the board's semester system. For the 2027 academic cycle, WBCHSE has already released the exam routine, and the Semester III admit card will be issued to schools ahead of the examination. Students should note that WBCHSE does not provide an individual student login to download the admit card directly - schools are responsible for downloading and distributing it.

sections.heading: How Is the WBCHSE Semester 3 Admit Card 2027 Issued?

content.text: Unlike some other board exams, WBCHSE does not allow individual students to log in and download their own Semester III admit card. Instead, the process works as follows:

items: WBCHSE uploads the admit cards on its official portal for registered schools.
The Head of Institution (HOI) of each school logs in using the school's official credentials on wbchse.wb.gov.in or the designated school portal.
The HOI downloads and takes a printout of the admit cards for all registered students of that school.
Schools verify the details and distribute the admit cards to students, usually after getting them signed and stamped by the Principal/HOI.
Students collect their admit card from their respective school before the exam date.

sections.heading: Details Mentioned on the WBCHSE HS Semester 3 Admit Card

content.text: Based on the pattern followed in previous WBCHSE semester admit cards, the hall ticket typically includes:

items: Student's name and roll number
Registration number
School name and code
Date of birth
Subject codes/combination
Examination centre name and address
Exam dates and reporting time
Candidate's photograph and signature

sections.heading: Important Instructions for WBCHSE Semester 3 Examinees

items: Carry the school-issued admit card to the examination centre on every exam day - no student is allowed to sit for the exam without it.
Reach the examination centre well before the reporting time to complete verification procedures.
Verify all personal and subject details on the admit card before the exam begins.
Follow all examination guidelines issued by WBCHSE, including restrictions on prohibited items.
The exam is conducted in MCQ/ OMR format, so carrying a proper ink pen is essential.

content_sections.heading: About DMIL
content_sections.text: Delhi Metro International Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC). It was set up to take on international metro rail projects and national projects within India, covering operations and maintenance, consultancy, design, planning and project development in the metro and allied urban transport sectors. Under this notice, DMIL is hiring staff for the O&M work of Chennai Metro Rail Limited Phase-II.

content_sections.heading: DMIL Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be 18 to 33 years old as on 1 October 2026. Reserved category candidates get the usual relaxation under the Tamil Nadu Government Rules. Your ITI aggregate must be at least 60%. Your ITI must be from a Government ITI or Govt aided ITI of Tamil Nadu. Candidates who passed from a private ITI will not be considered. Candidates who have had lasik surgery are not suitable for the post of Technician. For the trade-wise eligibility of each discipline, check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Electrician, Fitter and Ref. & AC Mechanic Trade from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI

Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Electronic Mechanic, Information communication Technology System Maintenance, Information Technology, Computer Hardware and Network Maintenance, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Power Electronics System from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI
Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Plumbers, Welders and Carpenters from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI

content_sections.heading: Pay and Benefits
content_sections.text: CTC of Rs. 28165/- (Rupees Twenty Eight Thousand, One Hundred Sixty Five only) per month, with no claim of regularisation in the future. The consolidated pay includes all other benefits, such as accommodation, transport, medical, LTA, canteen and insurance. Taxes are deducted from it. Any allowances over and above the fixed pay will be paid as per the Rules of the Corporation. Minimum PF under the Code on Social Security, 2020 will be deducted from your salary, and DMIL will make a matching contribution. The accumulated amount is paid when the contract ends. Leave: 08 days Casual Leave on a pro-rata basis and 18 days Earned Leave (1.5 EL for each completed month of service).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on a merit-cum-reservation basis. Document Verification and Screening, including a Tamil language Reading, Writing and Speaking Proficiency Test that is qualifying only. Candidates who studied Tamil as a subject in the 10th standard do not have to take this test. Candidates found suitable are put on a panel for 02 years from the date the Competent Authority approves it. The panel is used strictly as vacancies arise. Pre-engagement medical examination: empanelled candidates must meet the Corporation's medical standards, which are available on www.delhimetrorail.com . The Corporation pays for the first medical examination. If you ask for a re-medical, you pay for it yourself. Character and antecedents verification before engagement.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Engagement is contractual, initially for 03 (three) years. It can be cut short or renewed, depending on satisfactory service. Training cost bond: you must serve for at least three years, not counting leave without pay. If you leave within 03 years, the position-wise training cost is recovered on a pro-rata basis. You must give one month's notice before resigning. DMIL can end the engagement without giving reasons by giving 30 days' notice. If you resign, you must give 30 days' advance notice or pay in lieu of notice. Being selected, shortlisted or empanelled gives you no right to engagement. Your candidature stays provisional and can be cancelled at any stage if any information you gave turns out to be false.

content_sections.heading: Screening Schedule and Venues
content_sections.text: The schedule covers all trades: Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, RAC, Information communication Technology System Maintenance, Information Technology, Computer Hardware and Network Maintenance, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Power Electronics System, Plumbers, Welders and Carpenters.

Other items on the application form also count towards merit. These are a non-employment certificate for the family
widow
divorced
destitute or single woman status
single daughter or orphan status
and a training certificate of at least 6 months related to the post. The weightage table in the official notification gives their marks.
Candidates are called for evaluation and screening in a ratio of 1:10 for the first post

and 1:5 for each further post. The date of document evaluation and verification will be sent to you by post and also put on the department's website. You must bring all original certificates to verification. If you do not
your candidature will be cancelled.
how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from the department's official website. You can also collect it from the Office of the Commandant General, Home Guards, Civil Defence & Fire Services, US Club, Himachal Pradesh, Shimla-1.

Fill in the form completely. It asks for your type of disability, name, father's or husband's name, date of birth, percentage of disability, issuing authority, category, educational details, permanent and correspondence addresses, email and mobile number.
Paste a recent self-attested passport-size colour photograph in the space provided.

content_sections.heading: HP Home Guards Junior Office Assistant (IT) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be at least 18 and no more than 45 years old on the last date for receiving applications. The upper age limit can be relaxed by up to 5 years, as per the instructions of the Himachal Pradesh government. Only Orthopedically Handicapped (OH) candidates can apply. You need a permanent disability of at least 40%. This must be shown on a Disability Certificate issued by the competent Medical Board, which means the District Medical Board. If you are selected, the certificate will be checked by the competent authority. You must be a bona fide resident of Himachal Pradesh, certified by the Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), Tehsildar or Naib-Tehsildar. You must have passed the 10+2 Examination from a recognized Board of School Education or University. OR Matriculation from a recognized Board of School Education with a one or two year Diploma or Certificate from an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) in Information Technology (IT) Enabled Sectors (ITES), as notified by the Director General of Employment & Training (Govt. of India) from time to time. Another option is a three-year Diploma in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or IT from a Polytechnic approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Computer typing speed of 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi. Differently abled candidates who are otherwise qualified for a clerical post, and whom the Medical Board certifies as unable to type, may be excused from the typing test. This applies only where a physical disability or deformity permanently prevents the person from typing. The same exemption also covers the Skill Test Norms on Computers. Eligibility for the essential qualification is judged as on the last date for applications. Knowledge of the customs, manners and dialects of Himachal Pradesh, and suitability for appointment in the peculiar conditions prevailing in HP. The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written exam. Selection is based only on the documents you send with your application form. The department awards weightage marks for these documents under the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, HP letter No. SJE-B-B(15)-03/2014-1 dated 28 August 2017. These are the criteria the notice prints clearly: Other items on the application form also count towards merit. These are a non-employment certificate for the family, widow, divorced, destitute or single woman status, single daughter or orphan status, and a training certificate of at least 6 months related to the post. The weightage table in the official notification gives their marks. Candidates are called for evaluation and screening in a ratio of 1:10 for the first post, and 1:5 for each further post. The date of document evaluation and verification will be sent to you by post and also put on the department's website. You must bring all original certificates to verification. If you do not, your candidature will be cancelled.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 must possess the required educational qualifications for their respective posts. The eligibility requirements vary depending on the position. Superintendent: First Class Bachelor's Degree or equivalent from a recognized University or Institute in any discipline OR Master's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Knowledge of computer applications, including word processing and spreadsheets, is required. Technical Assistant: First Class Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree, or Diploma in the relevant discipline as per the specific department requirements mentioned in the notification. Senior Assistant: Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with a minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute and proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheets. Senior Technician: Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science, including Chemistry as one of the subjects, from a government-recognized board with at least 60% marks. Technician: Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science, ITI, or Diploma in Engineering from a government-recognized Polytechnic, Institute, or Board, depending on the specific department requirements. Office Attendant: Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board. Important: As clarified in the official extension notice, candidates must satisfy the prescribed qualifications, experience, and other eligibility criteria as on 30 October 2026 . The extension of the application deadline does not change this cut-off date.

content_sections.text: Every candidate pays a One Time Registration (OTR) fee of Rs. 590/- on the ICSIL website. The fee is non-refundable. ICSIL asks applicants to pay it one day before the walk-in interview and will not be responsible if a late payment is not received or updated in time.

content_sections.text: Shortlisting: ICSIL checks your documents for age, qualification, experience and other criteria. Interaction/interview with the department for the candidates found eligible. Attending the walk-in does not guarantee selection, and ICSIL does not guarantee that every shortlisted candidate will be deployed.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The job is purely contractual/outsourced. It lasts for a fixed period, until the contract ends, or until regular staff join the posts. The contract is valid initially up to 28 December 2026. The job does not give any claim to a regular appointment. Selected candidates will be engaged under a specific project or scheme as the department requires, and statutory compliances will apply. You can be deployed anywhere in Delhi/NCR and may work in shifts or on a rotational basis. ICSIL pays no extra conveyance. Fifteen (15) days' salary is deducted as security: 50% in the first month and 50% in the second. It is refunded with savings bank interest after the client department issues a No Dues certificate and you complete your contractual obligations with ICSIL under the appointment letter.

content_sections.heading: Kalakshetra Professor (Bharatanatyam) (Group A) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these responsibilities for the Professor (Bharatanatyam) in RDCFA: To handle Diploma and Post-Diploma practical classes, including theory To complete the entire curriculum within the specified time To assess the learning quality of each student and accordingly supplement additional instructions, if any, as required To hold regular meetings with parents and guardians and apprise them about the regularity in attendance, ability to learn, progress made in learning and any other relevant information about the child To take part in Kalakshetra productions To conduct rehearsals for all the dance dramas To assist in organising art festivals and other functions throughout the year To accompany artists in the performances conducted at Kalakshetra and abroad To choreograph dance dramas To provide guidance for the Costume Department in designing costumes for dance dramas To coordinate with the Dance section in organising art festivals and other celebrations at Kalakshetra To conduct rehearsals for all dance-dramas in co-ordination with the dance section To perform such other duties as may be prescribed by the principal or by the administration of the Kalakshetra Foundation

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection starts with a scrutiny of applications. Candidates who fulfil the Essential Qualifications in all respects, as per the parameters of the notice, will be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates may be called for a skill test, if necessary.

Affix a recent passport size photograph, then sign the form and add the place and date. Attach the documents listed in the notice's checklist (see the next section). Serving officials must make sure that the cadre clearance, the vigilance clearance and copies of their APARs for the last five years are sent through proper channel, together with the employer's certificate in Annexure II. Put the application in a cover superscribed "Application for the Post of Professor (Bharatanatyam), Rukmini Devi College of Fine Arts". Send it to Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai 600041 so that it reaches by 5.30 p.m. on 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required

content_sections.heading: Kalakshetra Foundation Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities attached with the post of Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) in RDCFA are as follows: To handle Diploma and Post-Diploma practical classes including theory; To complete entire curriculum within the specified time; To assess the learning quality of each student and accordingly supplement additional instructions, if any, as required; To hold regular meetings with parents and guardians and apprise them about the regularity in attendance, ability to learn, progress made in learning and any other relevant information about the child; and To take part in Kalakshetra productions To conduct rehearsals for all the dance dramas To assist in organizing art festivals and other functions throughout the year; To accompany artists in the performances conducted at Kalakshetra and abroad To choreograph dance dramas To provide guidance for Costume Department in designing costumes for dance dramas To coordinate with Dance section in organizing art festivals and other celebrations at Kalakshetra; To conduct rehearsals for all dance-dramas in co-ordination with dance section; To perform such other duties as may be prescribed by the Principal or by the administration of the Kalakshetra Foundation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Laboratory Technician: Rs 28000 + HRA, with increments as admissible as per DST Norms. HRA, if admissible under the funding agency's guidelines, will be paid at the rate for Rajkot city (Class 'Y'). Multi-tasking Staff: Rs. 18000, consolidated without any allowances. He or she is not entitled to any other financial or non-financial benefits or facilities, or to any special allowances, beyond the fixed consolidated emoluments prescribed by the funding agency. The posts are purely on contract for an externally funded research project. The person engaged will have no claim at any time to a regular post at AIIMS Rajkot, or to continued service in the same or any other project. The assignment is purely temporary for 11 months. It can be extended depending on the candidate's performance, continuation of the scheme and the budget grant from the funding agency. faq.answer: The essential qualification is High School /Matric / equivalent from a recognized board. Previous work experience in a molecular lab set-up and basic computer knowledge are desirable.

faq.question: What is the age limit for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 35 years for both posts, counted on the last date of application, 30 November 2026. SC/ST candidates get up to 5 years of relaxation and OBC candidates up to 3 years. PwBD candidates get 10, 13 or 15 years (General, OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: What is the salary of the AIIMS Rajkot Laboratory Technician and Multi-tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The Laboratory Technician gets Rs 28000 + HRA, with increments as admissible as per DST Norms. The Multi-tasking Staff gets Rs. 18000, consolidated without any allowances.

faq.question: Is HRA paid on top of the pay at AIIMS Rajkot?
faq.answer: HRA is paid only to the Laboratory Technician. It is paid if admissible under the funding agency's guidelines, at the rate for Rajkot city (Class 'Y'). The Multi-tasking Staff pay of Rs. 18000 is consolidated without any allowances.

faq.question: How do I apply for AIIMS Rajkot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in and sign the application form printed in the notice. Then submit its scanned copy, with scanned documents, through the Google Form by 30 November 2026, 5 PM. Bring the form and the original documents to the written test and interview.

faq.question: What is the selection process and when is the interview?
faq.answer: Applications are screened first. Then comes an MCQ-based written test, and up to six candidates per post are called for an interview. The final merit uses 80% written test and 20% interview weightage. The written test and interview are on 10 December 2026 at 9 AM at Research Cell, Academic block, 3rd Floor, AIIMS Rajkot.

faq.question: Is the AIIMS Rajkot project post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely on contract for 11 months in an externally funded research project and can be extended. The person engaged has no claim to any regular post at AIIMS Rajkot.

content_sections.heading: About JPPO Dumka फसल रक्षक
content_sections.text: The Office of the Junior Plant Protection Officer (JPPO), Dumka, is on Bhagalpur Road in Dumka, Jharkhand. It is a district office of the Agriculture Division of the Jharkhand Government's Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative. The notice says the Crop Protectors are hired under the Crop Protection Programme scheme (फसल सुरक्षा कार्यक्रम योजना) for the financial year 2026-27. The aim is to run crop protection and plant protection work well at the local level.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application only by registered post to this address, exactly as printed: कार्यालय, कनीय पौधा संरक्षण पदाधिकारी, दुमका (भागलपुर रोड– दुमका, नियर टाटा शोरूम, दुमका, पिन कोड– 814101). In English, this is the Office of the Junior Plant Protection Officer, Dumka, Bhagalpur Road, Dumka, Near Tata Showroom, Dumka, PIN 814101. Get the application form (आवेदन-पत्र). It is printed with the notice and can also be seen on the Dumka district website, dumka.nic.in, and on the notice board of the JPPO Dumka office. Fill in every column clearly and completely. The form asks for your names in Hindi and English, parents' names, gender, date of birth and age as on 30 September 2026. It also asks for your category (UR/ST/EWS), whether you claim reservation, and the district and block on your local certificate. Fill in your Matric, Intermediate/10+2 and graduation marks and the details of your compulsory 5-day training and any extra training. Then answer whether you can ride a bicycle and climb trees, and add your Aadhaar number, mobile, email and addresses. Paste a recent passport-size photograph that you have signed yourself (self-attested), then sign the declaration with the place and date. Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed under Enclosures. Send it by registered post so that it reaches the office between 26 October 2026 and 14 November 2026. For more information, call 9304866088. The office email is [email protected] . FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one Crop Protector post at each of 11 Plant Protection Centres: Dumka, Saraiyahat, Ramgarh, Jama, Jarmundi, Masalia, Shikaripara, Kathikund, Gopikandar, Raneshwar and Nonihat. The category-wise split follows the model reservation roster for Dumka district. You can apply only for the centre in your own block: Dumka centre: local residents of Dumka block Saraiyahat centre: local residents of Saraiyahat block Ramgarh centre: local residents of Ramgarh block Jama centre: local residents of Jama block Nonihat centre: local residents of Jarmundi block Jarmundi centre: local residents of Jarmundi block Masalia centre: local residents of Masalia block Shikaripara centre: local residents of Shikaripara block Kathikund centre: local residents of Kathikund block Gopikandar centre: local residents of Gopikandar block Raneshwar centre: local residents of Raneshwar block At least Matric/Secondary (10th) pass from a recognised educational institution. At least one 5-day training from the Directorate of Agriculture or Horticulture under the Department of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Cooperative. Knowledge of the local language. Ability to ride a bicycle and climb trees. You must be a local resident of the block whose centre you are applying for. Age is counted as on 30 September 2026. Only the date of birth on your Matric marksheet or certificate is accepted. The minimum age is 18 years for every category. The Crop Protector gets a monthly honorarium of Rs. 11851/-. The appointment is for 11 months, or until a regular appointment is made, whichever comes first. The post is paid fully by honorarium or remuneration. It gives no claim to a regular appointment or to permanency in future, and no automatic right to the service benefits of regular government staff. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: JPPO Dumka फसल रक्षक Job Description
content_sections.text: Spraying pesticides. Raising awareness among farmers and training them. Other work given by the office from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: You must attach self-attested photocopies of the documents below. If any are missing, the application will be treated as incomplete. Matric/10th certificate and marksheet (compulsory) Intermediate/10+2 certificate and marksheet, if available Graduation certificate and marksheet, if available Certificate for training of at least 05 days Local language certificate, if available (the form also lists an additional language certificate, if any) Valid local certificate issued by the competent authority Caste certificate, where applicable Local resident certificate for Dumka district EWS certificate, where applicable Matric certificate as proof of date of birth Identity card Copy of Aadhaar card (clearly readable) Anyone claiming reservation must attach a caste or category certificate issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format. You do not need to send a character certificate with the application. You must produce it at final selection, document verification or joining, in the format set by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications are first checked for eligibility and required documents. An application is rejected if details are missing, required certificates are not attached, the essential qualification is not met, or the information is false or misleading. Valid applications are then scored out of 100 marks. If your marks are in CGPA or grades, they are turned into a percentage using the conversion formula set by your board or university. No extra marks are given for a postgraduate or higher qualification. No extra marks are given for more than one degree or qualification at the same level. Training length is counted by the full training days written on the certificate. Only training certificates from these bodies are accepted: the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture under the Agriculture Department, the Krishi Vigyan Kendras of Birsa Agricultural University, and the ATMA office. If the selection committee thinks it is needed, it may hold a practical test of bicycle riding and tree climbing after the provisional merit list. Original certificates of selected or provisionally selected candidates will be checked before final selection, on a date to be fixed later. The merit list will be prepared category-wise under the reservation rules. The final list will be published on dumka.nic.in and on the office notice board. Centres are allotted first by the block on your local residence certificate and then by the preferences in your form. The final decision rests with JPPO Dumka based on administrative needs, and the allotment may be changed later. Selected candidates must join on the terms set by JPPO Dumka. If you do not join in the given time, your selection ends on its own and the post may be filled from the waiting list.

faq.question: Q1. How many Crop Protector vacancies are in JPPO Dumka Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: 05 UR, 05 ST and 01 EWS. There is one post at each of 11 Plant Protection Centres in Dumka district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Dumka Fasal Rakshak application?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted from 26 October 2026 to 14 November 2026. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Crop Protector?
faq.answer: You need at least Matric/Secondary (10th) pass from a recognised institution and at least one 5-day training from the Directorate of Agriculture or Horticulture. You also need knowledge of the local language and the ability to ride a bicycle and climb trees.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for JPPO Dumka Crop Protector?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum is 35 years for UR and EWS and 40 years for ST, counted as on 30 September 2026 from the date of birth on the Matric certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Crop Protector in Dumka?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is Rs. 11851/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Dumka Fasal Rakshak post?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form, attach self-attested copies of the required documents, and send it by registered post. The address is the Office of the Junior Plant Protection Officer, Dumka, Bhagalpur Road, Dumka, Near Tata Showroom, Dumka, PIN 814101.

faq.question: Q7. How will Crop Protectors be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by a merit list out of 100 marks: up to 60 for academic marks, 10 for being a local resident of the block, and up to 30 for training. Original documents are checked before final selection. A practical test of bicycle riding and tree climbing may be held.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for a centre outside my block?
faq.answer: No. Only local residents of a block can apply for that block's centre. Residents of Jarmundi block are eligible for both the Jarmundi and Nonihat centres.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Crop Protector job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary job paid by honorarium, for 11 months or until a regular appointment is made, whichever comes first. It gives no claim to a regular appointment or to permanency.

faq.question: Q10. Which training certificates are accepted for Crop Protector?
faq.answer: Only certificates from the Directorate of Agriculture and Horticulture under the Agriculture Department, the Krishi Vigyan Kendras of Birsa Agricultural University, and the ATMA office are accepted.

content_sections.heading: RRC SER Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: South Eastern Railway has 54 posts under the Sports Quota for 2026-27: 05 (Five) Group 'C' Level-4/Level-5, 16 (Sixteen) Group 'C' Level-2/Level-3 and 33 (Thirty three) Group 'D' Level-1. Each post is any post of that level in any of the units of South Eastern Railway. For Level-1, the notice refers to Annexure-A of RBE No 79/2026, which is available in the public domain. No post is reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities. Candidates with the required performance or achievement in the sports discipline will be selected on overall merit, whatever their community. Candidates may still upload the community they belong to, as required by chapter 13 of the brochure published by the Govt. of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievance of Pensions, Deptt. of Personnel Training, New Delhi. For SC/ST/OBC, the caste certificate must be issued by a Competent Authority not below the rank of Tehsildar. OBC candidates must also upload an OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the Central Govt. format, issued not before than 01 year by the competent authority.

content_sections.text: Applications are open only to Indian nationals. Candidates must have both the academic qualification and the minimum sports norms for the level they apply for. Candidates who are appearing in, or waiting for the results of, final examinations are not eligible. The educational qualification must be from a recognised institution. Level-2/Level-3 qualification, as printed: Passed class 12th (10+2 stage) or its equivalent examination. The qualification must be from a Govt. recognized Board / Council / Institutions etc. OR Passed Matriculation from a recognized Board plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship OR Passed class 10th from a Govt. recognized Board / Council / Institutions etc. plus ITI passed OR its equivalent examination OR National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT. The minimum educational qualification should be as applicable to the post offered. Notes on qualification: For a Group-C appointment against the Sports Quota in Technician-III, the minimum educational qualification is 10th pass. The training period for these appointees will follow RBE no. 92/2024, based on the selected candidate's educational qualification. No relaxation in the minimum educational qualification is allowed. Candidates must submit photocopies of the documents for their educational qualification with the application form. They must also produce the original certificate on the day of the trials. (a) Represented the country in Olympic Games (Senior Category) OR (b) At least 3rd Position in any of the Championships/events in the World Cup (Junior/Youth/Senior Category) / World Championships (Junior/ Senior Category)/ Asian Games (Senior Category)/ Commonwealth Games (Senior Category), Youth Olympics, Davis Cup (Tennis), Champions Trophy (Hockey), Thomas/Uber Cup (Badminton). content_sections.heading: RRC SER Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid online through Internet Banking or a Debit or Credit Card. Candidates bear the service charges for the payment. Fees paid in Cash, by Cheque, Money Order, Central Recruitment Fee Stamps or Demand Draft are not accepted, and such applications will be rejected. Rs. 400 for UR/OBC and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Persons with Disabilities (PWDs), Women, Minorities and Economically Backward Classes will be refunded to eligible candidates who actually appear in the trial. Bank charges are deducted from the refund. In the application, candidates choose whether the refund goes to the account used for payment. If not, they give a beneficiary account: beneficiary name, account number, name of the bank and IFSC code. Candidates seeking a fee exemption as Economically Backward Classes must have Annexure-III filled in and certified by the proper authority. Economically Backward Classes are candidates whose family income is less than Rs 50,000 per annum. Minority candidates must make a self-declaration in the Annexure-V format to claim the fee waiver. They must also furnish a Minority Community declaration affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.10/-, sworn before an Executive Magistrate. The notice lists the minorities as Muslim/Sikh/Christian/Buddhist/Parsis.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is determined as of 31 August 2026 . Eligible meritorious sportspersons can receive upper-age relaxation of up to 5 years under Government of India instructions. For eligible SC/ST sportspersons, the relaxation may extend up to 10 years . Age relaxation is available only to candidates satisfying the prescribed sports eligibility and other recruitment requirements.

content_sections.heading: Income Tax Delhi Sports Quota Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notified posts carry the following 7th Central Pay Commission pay levels. The above pay ranges correspond to the notified pay levels under the Central Government pay matrix. Applicable allowances and service conditions will be governed by relevant government rules.

content_sections.heading: Sports Eligibility for Income Tax Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must have recognized sporting achievements in the events and competitions prescribed by the notification. Sports performance achieved between 1 January 2020 and 15 October 2026 will be considered. The notification establishes the following order of preference for eligible sportspersons: Candidates representing India in recognized international competitions, with the required sports-authority clearance. Candidates representing a State or Union Territory in recognized Senior or Junior National Championships and securing the prescribed medal or position. Candidates representing a university in Inter-University competitions and securing the prescribed position. Candidates representing a State or Union Territory in eligible Khelo India Games competitions. Candidates representing State Schools in recognized National School Games competitions and securing the prescribed position. Candidates representing a State, Union Territory, University or State School team at the specified competition level without winning a medal or position. Important: Sporting achievement certificates must be issued by the competent authorities and submitted in the prescribed formats. Participation or achievement outside the recognized competition categories does not automatically establish eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Sports Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: The notification specifies authorized certificate-issuing authorities for different categories of sports competitions. Candidates must use the relevant certificate forms prescribed in Annexure-II of the notification. Sports certificates issued in formats not prescribed by the notification will not be accepted.

Selected sportspersons may be required to represent the department in tournaments and sports activities in accordance with departmental conditions. The notification also contains provisions concerning minimum service obligations and inter-charge transfers.

content_sections.heading: CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates who do not possess the prescribed educational qualification as on 11 November 2026 are not eligible to apply. Educational and sports qualification certificates other than from a Central/State Board must be accompanied by a Government notification declaring the equivalence of that qualification for Central Government service. Represented the country in a recognized International Competition/Meet, with clearance from the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Represented a State/UT in the National Games/Championship organized by a National Sports Federation recognized by the Department of Sports, or in National Games organized by the Indian Olympic Association, with a medal or position up to 3rd place. Secured 1st or 2nd position in an individual event in Inter-University Tournaments (for team events, the team must have reached the finals) conducted by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU)/Inter University Sports Board. Won Gold or Silver medal in an individual/team event at Junior National level Games/Championship/Meet organized by a recognized National Sports Federation. Represented a State in Senior/Junior National level Games/Championships organized by a recognized National Sports Federation. Represented a State School Team in National Sports/Games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation of India (SGFI), with a medal or position up to 3rd place. Represented a State/UT in Khelo India University Games/Khelo India Youth Games/Khelo India Winter Games, with a medal or position up to 3rd place. Represented their University in Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards, in any sport/game.

content_sections.heading: CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection proceeds through Identity Check, Documentation, Physical Standard Test (PST), Sports Trial Test, and Detailed/Review Medical Examination, in sequence. All candidates undergo document verification, producing original documents/certificates relating to age, education, sports achievement, domicile and category. Candidates unable to produce the prescribed originals are eliminated at this stage; those qualified proceed to the PST. Marks are awarded for the single highest medal/position achieved during the eligible window (30 September 2024 to 30 September 2026); if a candidate has more than one medal, only the highest-scoring one counts. Sample marking tiers: Height/chest relaxations are available for several categories, including Scheduled Tribes (162.5/150 cm), ST candidates of North-Eastern States (157/147.5 cm), ST candidates of Left-Wing Extremism-affected districts (160/147.5 cm), Garhwalis/Kumaonis/Dogras/Marathas and candidates from Assam, Himachal Pradesh, J&K and Ladakh (165/155 cm), candidates from the North-Eastern States of Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura (162.5/152.5 cm), and candidates from the Gorkha Territorial Administration area of Darjeeling district (157/152.5 cm), with corresponding chest relaxations for male candidates in several of these categories. Candidates who qualify the PST undergo the Sports Trial Test, conducted by a Board of Officers. This test is purely qualifying (pass/fail) – no marks are awarded, and total marks for the merit list come only from the achievement marking scheme above. Candidates may be subjected to a Dope Test on the day of the trial; no appeal for re-conduct of the trial test is entertained. Conducted per the Uniform Guidelines for Recruitment Medical Examination for GOs and NGOs in CAPFs and AR (MHA U.O. No. A.VI-1/2014-Rectt(SSB) dated 20.05.2015 and MHA OM No. E.32012/ADG(Med)/DME/RME/DA-1/2020(Part file)/1166 dated 31.05.2021, as amended). Minimum distance vision required is 6/6 and 6/9 in both eyes without correction; colour-blind candidates are not eligible; candidates must not have knock knee, flat foot, varicose veins or squint. Tattoos are restricted in content (secular/religious symbols only, as per Indian Army norms), location (left forearm inner aspect or dorsum of hands only) and size (less than ¼ of that body part). Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo RME. Where marks are comparable, preference follows this order: (a) International representation with Department of Sports clearance; (b) Senior/Junior National Championship representation with a medal (Senior preferred over Junior); (c) Inter-University/Khelo India University Games medal; (d) Khelo India Youth/Winter Games medal; (e) School National Games medal; (f) participation at levels (b)–(e) without a medal, in the same order.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRPF Sportsperson Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit rect.crpf.gov.in and read the instructions carefully before filling the application. Create your profile and upload a copy of the certificate/document for your sports discipline, in support of your highest medal/position or highest level of participation, before applying – applications without this upload will be rejected during scrutiny. Fill the online application form and pay the application fee (where applicable) through the website only. Submit the application before 11 November 2026, 23:59 hrs . Use the correction window (12–14 November 2026) if you need to modify your submitted application. Important: The application must be submitted ONLINE only; no offline application is accepted, and candidature of anyone submitting offline will be summarily rejected. Candidates serving in Government/Semi-Government departments must submit their application through their employer along with a No Objection Certificate (as per Annexure-A format) – applications without an NOC will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (Original, at Document Verification)
content_sections.text: Educational certificates, Sports certificates, Domicile and Caste certificates, etc. Matriculation/10th class certificate, for verification of Date of Birth OBC (NCL) Certificate (Annexure-F), SC/ST Certificate (Annexure-G), or EWS Certificate valid for 2026-27 (Annexure-H), as applicable – certificates in any other format are not accepted Undertaking for OBC (NCL) reservation claim, as per Annexure-F No Objection Certificate (Annexure-B), for candidates serving in Government service, produced at the time of physical document verification Certificate for claiming height/chest relaxation (Annexure-I), if applicable Four latest passport-size photographs, matching the one submitted with the application form

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Application Fee: Male candidates belonging to UR/OBC/EWS pay Rs. 100/- through the recruitment website; the fee is exempted for all female candidates and for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates. The fee is neither refunded nor adjusted against any other recruitment process, under any circumstances. Selected candidates must submit a bond to serve the Force for a minimum of 3 years (or a specific period as prescribed), backed by an undertaking bond of Rs. 1,00,000/-, to promote sports in the Force, before they can resign for better employment elsewhere or on any other ground. Posts carry All India service liability; selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or abroad, and will be governed by the CRPF Act 1949 and Rules 1955. CRPF reserves the right to modify, cancel, postpone, or reschedule any stage of the recruitment process, and to change the sequence of the recruitment procedure, without assigning any reason. Submitting fabricated documents, or documents that have been tampered with, will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including at the time of document verification or later. The Board of Officers may also recommend cases of Outstanding Sportspersons who show excellent trial performance but require some relaxation in height/chest/weight for their sport, subject to approval by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has CRPF advertised under the Sports Quota?
faq.answer: 521 posts – 182 Head Constable (GD) and 339 Constable (GD) – across 22 sports disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: 11 November 2026, till 23:59 hrs; the application window opened on 12 October 2026 at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Meritorious male/female sportspersons who have represented the country, a State/UT, their University, or their School in recognized competitions at specified levels, within the last two years, and who meet the age and educational qualification for the post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18 to 23 years as on the cut-off date of 1 August 2026, with age relaxation of 5 to 13 years depending on category and Ex-Servicemen status.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based on a merit list built from sports achievement marks, followed by a Physical Standard Test, a qualifying Sports Trial Test, and a medical examination – there is no written test or interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 100/- for male UR/OBC/EWS candidates; exempted for all female candidates and for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: Head Constable (GD): Level 4, Rs. 25,500–81,100. Constable (GD): Level 3, Rs. 21,700–69,100.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a service bond?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must execute a Rs. 1,00,000/- bond committing to serve the Force for at least 3 years.

selection_process: Stage Details
1. Scrutiny of applications Applications are scrutinized and suitable applicants are shortlisted

3. Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test For shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar
4. Medical fitness Medical fitness of candidates will be ascertained before their formal appointment
Subject to fulfilling the educational qualification

the applications will be scrutinized and suitable applicants will be shortlisted for the further selection procedure. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Tax Assistant will be called for a data entry speed test. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar will be called for the Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test.
The Data Entry test and the Physical Efficiency/Physical Standard test will be held in Lucknow. Shortlisted candidates must appear at their own expenses
and the date
time and venue will be communicated in due course. Success in the test confers no right to appointment unless the Department is satisfied
after such enquiry as may be considered necessary
that the applicant is suitable in all respects for appointment to the post.
The merit of sportspersons who fulfil the eligibility conditions will be considered/decided in the following order of preference:
First preference to those candidates who have represented the country in an International Competition with the clearance of the Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/U.T. in the Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by the National Sports Federations recognized by Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports or National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Between the candidates participating in Senior and Junior National Championships/games

the candidates having participated and won a medal in Senior National Championship should be given preference. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board or Khelo India University Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) or Khelo India Winter Games or Khelo India Para Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented the State Schools in the National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Next preference may be given to those who represented a State/Union Territory/University/State Schools Teams at the level mentioned in categories 2 to 5 above but could not win a medal or position
in the same order of preference.
Note 1: In the event of a tie

those who have secured a higher position or won more than one medal may be given the preference. Note 2: Participation in individual and team event/item may be given the same preference. Note 3: No preference may be given for winning more than one medal/position. Note 4: In case of any doubt about the status of a tournament
the matter will be decided by the Department of Personnel & Training in consultation with the Department of Sports
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
how_to_apply: The notification does not provide an online application link. Eligible applicants may send their applications in the prescribed proforma either by post or by hand. Candidates should check https://www.cbic.gov.in and https://ccolkozone.gov.in regularly for updates.
Read the notification, eligibility criteria, instructions to candidates, vacancy positions and other conditions carefully before filling up the application form.
Fill in the application form as per Annexure-A in black ink in capital letters, with all required details.
Affix a recent colour passport size photograph in the space provided on the application form.
Indicate the post applied for (Tax Assistant, Havaldar or Both). If applying for both posts in a single application form, mention the first and second preference of the posts.
Enclose self-attested copies of all the required documents and the relevant sports certificate forms (Form-1 to Form-5, whichever is applicable).
Sign the declaration and put the application in a closed cover superscribed with the words “Application for Meritorious Sportsperson in CGST & Central Excise Lucknow Zone 2026”.

Send the cover by post or by hand so that it reaches the address below by 23.11.2026 (17:00 hrs). Applicants domiciled in North Eastern states, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh get another ten (10) days.
The application form in Annexure-A asks for the following details:
Post applied for (Tax Assistant, Havaldar or Both) and the preference for the post, if applied for both
Full name in Hindi and in English; father’s name; gender (Male/Female/Third gender)
Permanent residential address and address for communication
Date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY) and age as on 23.11.2026
Category (UR/OBC/SC/ST) and whether a PwBD candidate (Yes/No; if yes, the category)
Educational qualification; sports event/game

Level of representation in games/sports (International, National, Inter-University, Khelo India, any other event) with the number of medals awarded and the position earned/represented, along with the latest performance in sports
Documents submitted (self-attested) – tick the enclosed documents
Telephone/mobile number, e-mail ID (if any), Aadhaar number and details of the present employer, if any

The form also carries a declaration that all statements are true, complete and correct, that no other application has been submitted for the post, that there is no ongoing investigation regarding doping or unfair means in any sporting event, and that the applicant fulfils the age, educational qualification and sports eligibility conditions. It must be signed by the applicant with place, date and full name.
important_instructions: The applicant must possess the requisite educational qualification for the post on the closing date of submission of the application form. The Chief Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise, Lucknow Zone (CCA) has the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Any form of canvassing by a candidate will render the candidature liable to be rejected summarily at any stage of the recruitment process. If at any stage the candidate is found to have furnished any wrong information, statement or declaration, or falsified/misrepresented any facts, the candidature/appointment will be liable for cancellation. content_sections.heading: CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Selection Process
content_sections.text: Subject to fulfilling the educational qualification, the applications will be scrutinized and suitable applicants will be shortlisted for the further selection procedure. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Tax Assistant will be called for a data entry speed test. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar will be called for the Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test. The Data Entry test and the Physical Efficiency/Physical Standard test will be held in Lucknow. Shortlisted candidates must appear at their own expenses, and the date, time and venue will be communicated in due course. Success in the test confers no right to appointment unless the Department is satisfied, after such enquiry as may be considered necessary, that the applicant is suitable in all respects for appointment to the post. The merit of sportspersons who fulfil the eligibility conditions will be considered/decided in the following order of preference: First preference to those candidates who have represented the country in an International Competition with the clearance of the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/U.T. in the Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by the National Sports Federations recognized by Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports or National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Between the candidates participating in Senior and Junior National Championships/games, the candidates having participated and won a medal in Senior National Championship should be given preference. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board or Khelo India University Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) or Khelo India Winter Games or Khelo India Para Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented the State Schools in the National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Next preference may be given to those who represented a State/Union Territory/University/State Schools Teams at the level mentioned in categories 2 to 5 above but could not win a medal or position, in the same order of preference. Note 1: In the event of a tie, those who have secured a higher position or won more than one medal may be given the preference. Note 2: Participation in individu

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification does not provide an online application link. Eligible applicants may send their applications in the prescribed proforma either by post or by hand. Candidates should check https://www.cbic.gov.in and https://ccolkozone.gov.in regularly for updates. Read the notification, eligibility criteria, instructions to candidates, vacancy positions and other conditions carefully before filling up the application form. Fill in the application form as per Annexure-A in black ink in capital letters, with all required details. Affix a recent colour passport size photograph in the space provided on the application form. Indicate the post applied for (Tax Assistant, Havaldar or Both). If applying for both posts in a single application form, mention the first and second preference of the posts. Enclose self-attested copies of all the required documents and the relevant sports certificate forms (Form-1 to Form-5, whichever is applicable). Sign the declaration and put the application in a closed cover superscribed with the words “Application for Meritorious Sportsperson in CGST & Central Excise Lucknow Zone 2026”. Send the cover by post or by hand so that it reaches the address below by 23.11.2026 (17:00 hrs). Applicants domiciled in North Eastern states, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh get another ten (10) days. The application form in Annexure-A asks for the following details: Post applied for (Tax Assistant, Havaldar or Both) and the preference for the post, if applied for both Full name in Hindi and in English; father’s name; gender (Male/Female/Third gender) Permanent residential address and address for communication Date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY) and age as on 23.11.2026 Category (UR/OBC/SC/ST) and whether a PwBD candidate (Yes/No; if yes, the category) Educational qualification; sports event/game Level of representation in games/sports (International, National, Inter-University, Khelo India, any other event) with the number of medals awarded and the position earned/represented, along with the latest performance in sports Documents submitted (self-attested) – tick the enclosed documents Telephone/mobile number, e-mail ID (if any), Aadhaar number and details of the present employer, if any The form also carries a declaration that all statements are true, complete and correct, that no other application has been submitted for the post, that there is no ongoing investigation regarding doping or unfair means in any sporting event, and that the applicant fulfils the age, educational qualification and sports eligibility conditions. It must be signed by the applicant with place, date and full name.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Applicants
content_sections.text: The applicant must possess the requisite educational qualification for the post on the closing date of submission of the application form. The cut-off date for determining age and other eligibility criteria is 23.11.2026. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere under the jurisdiction of Cadre Control Authority Lucknow (Lucknow Zone and Meerut Zone, spread over Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand). Selected candidates will be under probation for 2 years or such period as per the extant instructions of the Government of India. They will be required to represent the Central GST, Central Excise and Customs, Lucknow Zone including Meerut Zone, in the tournaments/meets as decided by the office. In the event of any tie, the decision of the appointing authority will be final. The Chief Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise, Lucknow Zone (CCA) has the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Any form of canvassing by a candidate will render the candidature liable to be rejected summarily at any stage of the recruitment process. If at any stage the candidate is found to have furnished any wrong information, statement or declaration, or falsified/misrepresented any facts, the candidature/appointment will be liable for cancellation. The recruitment is subject to applicable rules for recruitment of meritorious sportspersons issued by the Government of India from time to time. Candidates with good oral communication skills in Hindi, Marathi and preferably English will be given preference. Physical Stamina: Ability to stand, bend and lift heavy items (like mattresses or laundry bags) for long hours. Interpersonal Skills: A polite, friendly manner, because hostels involve frequent, direct interaction with international and young travellers. Time Management: Ability to prioritize and clean several rooms or floors efficiently within check-out and check-in windows. Attention to Detail: Spotting maintenance issues (like broken lights or leaking pipes) and reporting them to management immediately. content_sections.text: Selection for the combined SMKV Bastar non-teaching vacancies includes an OMR-based written examination, skill or practical examination and preparation of a final merit list. content_sections.heading: SMKV Bastar Skill Test and Final Merit Calculation 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must secure at least 30% marks in the written examination. Based on written-test merit, up to 10 candidates per vacancy will be shortlisted for the skill or practical examination. The practical examination carries 30 marks, and candidates must obtain at least 50% of those marks to qualify. For Technical and Clerical Posts: Written merit marks = (Marks obtained out of 120 / 120) × 60. For Peon: Written merit marks = (Marks obtained out of 100 / 100) × 60. The 10 experience marks are specifically for eligible daily-wage work experience at SMKV Bastar under the prescribed recruitment rules. They are not automatically awarded for general experience at other institutions.

faq.question: Q9. What must I send with the DLSA Palamau Driver application?
faq.answer: Send 2 recent passport-size photographs, self-attested copies of your educational certificate and driving licence, and your experience certificate if you have one. Also include a self-addressed envelope with ₹55 of postage stamps.

faq.question: How many vacancies are there in DLSA Palamau Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy. The District Legal Services Authority, Palamau needs one Driver for its Mahindra Bolero MUV vehicle.

faq.question: What is the last date for the DLSA Palamau Driver application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the office by 20 November 2026. Applications received after this date will not be accepted under any circumstances.

faq.question: What qualification do I need for the DLSA Palamau Driver post?
faq.answer: You must have passed Matric (10th), hold a valid LMV/Transport driving licence and have enough driving experience. You must also be an Indian citizen, of good character and physically able to do the work.

faq.question: What is the age limit for the DLSA Palamau Driver post?
faq.answer: You must be at least 18 years old and no older than 35 years on the date of application.

faq.question: What is the salary of the DLSA Palamau Driver?
faq.answer: The Driver gets the daily wage fixed by the State Government from time to time, plus a meal allowance of ₹100 for each day.

faq.question: How do I apply for the DLSA Palamau Driver post?
faq.answer: Fill in the form (Performa) from https://palamu.dcourts.gov.in and attach self-attested copies of your documents. Send it by Speed Post/Courier to the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Palamau, PIN - 822101.
