Desirable: (i) Sound knowledge of industrial equipment used for fabrication of components and assembly of systems; (ii) good interpersonal and communication skills with multi-tasking ability. Job requirement: Attached to one of the Centres/Sections to assist Scientific and Technical staff in operation and maintenance of R&D equipment and instruments including SOPs and Safety Protocols; maintain cleanliness and upkeep of laboratory facilities. Selected candidates may be assigned to any non-technical Centre/Section depending on work requirements and shall be willing to undertake any duties assigned, including work of a non-technical nature. Notes: This is an entry-level post in the technician category. Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as Diploma/B.Sc. or equivalent degree OR M.Sc./B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in any subject or discipline as on the crucial date of eligibility will not be considered, nor will candidates with branches other than those specified. Appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated, and legal action may be initiated, if the selected candidate does not fulfil the essential qualifications, possesses higher qualifications, or any claim/certificate/document is found forged/invalid/fraudulent or information is suppressed. Experience includes Apprenticeship training/trainee experience and/or experience in Government Departments/Academic/Scientific Institutions/Autonomous Bodies/Research laboratories/Registered companies/Industries/Societies/MNCs/Private limited companies etc., and shall be supported by NPS/EPF & ESI membership. Without proper experience certificate, or with an experience certificate from unregistered companies/industries and/or individuals, experience will not be accepted. Part-time experience will not be considered for calculating years of experience. | Essential: (i) Pass in 10th/SSC or equivalent from a recognized Board; (ii) valid driving license to drive light and heavy vehicles; (iii) knowledge of motor mechanism (able to identify and rectify minor defects in vehicles); (iv) experience of driving light vehicles for at least three (3) years and heavy vehicles for at least six (6) years; (v) knowledge to maintain vehicle logbooks, journey records, fuel consumption details and other related documents. Desirable: (i) Sound knowledge of traffic rules, road safety regulations, vehicle documents and safe driving practices; (ii) capable of operating material-handling equipment such as forklifts and battery-operated trucks; (iii) basic knowledge of vehicle maintenance and troubleshooting of brakes, clutch, tyres, batteries and engine performance and other essential components; (iv) responsible for upkeep and cleanliness of vehicles operated by the Motor Transport Section; (v) attend official duties on holidays/during odd hours as and when required; (vi) good interpersonal and communication skills (in Hindi/Telugu) with multi-tasking ability. Job description: Attached to the Motor Transport Section; drive staff car, bus and other vehicles as assigned; ensure safe and timely transportation of officers, staff, research students, guests and materials; maintain upkeep, cleanliness and roadworthiness of vehicles and logbooks, journey records and fuel consumption details; promptly report vehicle defects and maintenance requirements; perform other duties assigned. Notes: Total prescribed experience should be after obtaining a valid LMV and HMV license. Experience certificates should only be from Army/Navy/Airforce (for Ex-servicemen)/Government Departments/Academic/Scientific Institutions/Autonomous Bodies/Research laboratories/State Road Transport Corporations/Registered Companies/Industries/Societies/Trusts/MNCs/Private limited companies etc., supported by NPS/EPF & ESI membership. Certificates without proper details or from unregistered companies/industries and/or individuals, and part-time experience, will not be accepted. | The crucial date of eligibility (cut-off date for qualification, experience and age) is not specified in the provided notification pages.

content_sections.heading: ARCI Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection begins with preliminary screening/short-listing of applications by a Committee constituted by the Competent Authority, ARCI. The Committee considers academic performance, relevance of experience for the post applied, number of years of relevant experience (based on data in the online application) and other parameters as deemed necessary. Screened-in candidates undergo a Computer Based Competitive Written Examination (CWE), followed by Personal Interview/Trade/Skill test (as applicable). ARCI may also administer any other selection method/tool/test at the sole discretion of the Competent Authority. For Officer "B", shortlisted candidates make a crisp presentation highlighting achievements across the broad spectrum of the work experience mentioned for the post, followed by a personal interview at ARCI, Hyderabad. The examination centre for CWE is Hyderabad only for all posts.

content_sections.heading: Dredging Corporation of India Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for DCI Recruitment 2026 depends on the position. Trainee Marine Engineer and Trainee Electrical Officer posts require relevant engineering qualifications, while NCV Trainee requires 10th pass and approved pre-sea GP Rating training. Fleet Personnel applicants must possess the prescribed maritime competency certificates or relevant professional experience. Candidates must have completed a four-year Degree in Marine Engineering from an IMU-affiliated, DG Shipping-approved or otherwise recognized institute as specified in the notification. Alternatively, candidates who have completed Graduate Marine Engineering from a recognized university after a four-year engineering degree may apply. Candidates who have already acquired or are about to obtain an MEO Class IV Certificate of Competency are not eligible for the Trainee Marine Engineer position. Candidates must have completed a four-year engineering degree in one of the following disciplines: Electrical Engineering Electronics Engineering Electrical and Electronics Engineering Electronics and Telecommunication / Communication Engineering Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering Applicants must also have completed the four-month Electro Technical Officer (ETO) course from a DG Shipping-approved institution. The notification additionally refers to completion of basic STCW courses. NCV Trainee applicants must have passed SSC / 10th Class from a recognized education board, completed an approved pre-sea GP Rating course and passed the DG Shipping-approved Exit Examination with at least 60% aggregate marks. Candidates must carefully check the exact competency alternatives and minimum experience requirements in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Dredging Corporation of India Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: DCI Recruitment 2026 selection varies between Fleet Personnel and Trainee posts. Fleet Personnel are assessed through an interview, while Trainee Marine Engineers and Trainee Electrical Officers are assessed using qualification marks and interview performance. NCV Trainee selection is based on academic and GP Rating Exit Examination marks. Fleet Personnel candidates will be selected based on interview performance. The minimum qualifying score is 50 marks out of 100. For General and OBC candidates, the minimum required marks are 40 out of 80 in the qualification component and 10 out of 20 in the interview. For SC and ST candidates, the minimum required marks are 36 out of 80 in the qualification component and 9 out of 20 in the interview. NCV Trainee selection is based on the prescribed qualification marks, with 50% weightage for SSC / 10th Class marks and 50% weightage for GP Rating Exit Examination marks.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-1, "Bio-Data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma") printed with the circular. Applicants do not send it themselves. Submit the application to your parent department. The Competent Authority there routes it to AFT Kolkata. The employer or cadre controlling authority completes Part 4, "Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority", and countersigns it with its seal. The department forwards the application with the No Objection Certificate, vigilance clearance certificate, a certificate that no disciplinary action or inquiry is pending or contemplated, and photocopies of the ACRs for the last five years. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The circular does not set out one selection procedure for all posts. It names these post-specific tests: Staff Car Driver: appointment is on the results of a driving test that judges suitability against the standards of competence essential for staff car drivers. Data Entry Operator: the competent authority will judge the speed of 8000 key depressions per hour by a speed test on Electronic Data Processing (EDP) machine(s). Stenographer Grade-II: the skill test norms are on computer, with dictation of 10 minutes at 80 words per minute and transcription of 50 minutes (English) or 65 minutes (Hindi). Lower Division Clerk: the typing speed is 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi on computer, with 10 minutes allowed. The declaration in Annexure-1 states that the Selection Committee will assess the information in the CV, together with the supporting documents on essential qualification and work experience, at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-1), signed, with the latest photograph Self-certified photocopies of all educational and other testimonials and certificates Photocopies of the Annual Confidential Reports for the last five years No Objection Certificate Vigilance clearance certificate Certificate that no disciplinary action or inquiry is pending or contemplated against the official Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority (Part 4 of the proforma), countersigned with seal. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AFT Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies across 10 posts. The Upper Division Clerk, Lower Division Clerk, Data Entry Operator and Stenographer Grade-II posts have 3 vacancies each, Tribunal Master and Staff Car Driver have 2 each, and the other four posts have 1 each. The number of vacancies may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AFT Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application, forwarded by the parent department, must reach the Registrar-in-Charge, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Kolkata by 9 December 2026 (Wednesday). Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the AFT Kolkata deputation posts?
faq.answer: The qualification depends on the post. Most posts need regular service in an analogous or feeder post. Lower Division Clerk, Data Entry Operator and Stenographer Grade-II also need 12th Class pass, Staff Car Driver needs 10th standard pass, and Junior Accounts Officer and Junior Accountant need a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AFT Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For appointment by deputation or absorption, the age must not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. This limit applies to every post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the posts in AFT Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The pay ranges from Pay Matrix Level 2 (Rs.19900-63200) for Lower Division Clerk, Staff Car Driver and Data Entry Operator up to Level 11 (Rs.67700-208700) for Principal Private Secretary. For deputationists, pay and allowances follow DoP&T Office Memorandum No 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AFT Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-1 proforma and submit it through your parent department. The department forwards it with the No Objection Certificate, vigilance clearance, the no-disciplinary-action certificate and the last five years' ACRs to the Registrar-in-Charge, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, O-6, Clyde Row, Hastings, Kolkata 700 022.

faq.question: Q7. Is the AFT Kolkata appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled on deputation or absorption for a period of three years. The deputation period, including any deputation in another ex-cadre post held just before, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a test for the Staff Car Driver post at AFT Kolkata?
faq.answer: Yes. Staff Car Drivers are appointed on the results of a driving test that judges suitability against the standards of competence essential for staff car drivers.

faq.question: Q9. Can Armed Forces personnel apply for AFT Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Lower Division Clerk, Staff Car Driver, Data Entry Operator and Stenographer Grade-II posts. basic_details.job_title: Naval Dockyard Karwar Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 210 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Navy has invited applications for 210 apprenticeship seats for the training year 2027–28/29: 180 at Naval Dockyard, Naval Base, Karwar (Karnataka) across 27 trades and 30 at Naval Aircraft Yard (Goa), Dabolim across 13 trades. ITI certificate holders receive a stipend of Rs. 9,600 per month; three non-ITI trades are open to 10th pass candidates and one (Rigger) to 8th pass, on lower stipend slabs. There is no upper age limit and no fee.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 30 days of publication: by 9 November 2026
important_dates.exam_date: January 2027 at Karwar (e-admit card by email)

qualification.details: Where the school board awarded grades or CGPA, the equivalent percentage as per that board's norms must be stated; without it the candidature is not considered. Candidates with a grade-point system must get the conversion done by the appropriate authority before applying. | There is no upper age limit (MSDE O.M. dated 20 December 2021). The minimum age is reckoned on the training commencement date of 12 April 2027: 14 years for non-hazardous trades (born on or before 12 April 2013) and 18 years for hazardous trades (born on or before 12 April 2009). The notice adds a caution: the Recruitment Rules for Tradesman Skilled posts in naval establishments do carry an upper age limit, which will apply to ex-apprentices of the Dockyard Apprentice School who later apply for those posts. | Anyone currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, or in the three-month waiting period after terminating a contract (no waiting period applies to women). Anyone who has already completed two apprenticeships; a second apprenticeship must be in a different trade, and the Central Government's stipend share is paid only for first-time training. Candidates with 100% disability are advised not to apply; the notice says such applications will be rejected because competent instructors and facilities are not available. | SC, ST and OBC seats are reserved under Sections 3A and 3B of the Apprentices Act. Unfilled reserved seats are not carried forward; they are filled from other categories in the same year. PwBD: 3% of overall seats, horizontal, for candidates with at least 40% disability holding a valid medical-board certificate from a government hospital. Children of Armed Forces personnel / ex-servicemen and ex-servicemen: 3% of overall seats, horizontal. If fewer candidates qualify than the seats in a trade, those seats are re-appropriated to other trades on overall merit, up to 25% above the trade's published number.

salary_details.details: These are the minimum rates under Rule 11 of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. Selected candidates sign the apprenticeship contract online through the NAPS portal. The notice states clearly that neither establishment nor any government agency is obliged to offer employment after training.

how_to_apply: Application has two parts: online registration on the national apprenticeship portal, then a printed profile sent by post. Both are required.

Before you start, make sure your name, date of birth and father's name on your Aadhaar card match your 10th certificate (8th certificate for Rigger). If they differ, correct Aadhaar first; mismatches are a listed ground for rejection.
Open apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, choose Candidate Login/Register, fill in personal and contact details and submit. Activate your profile from the email you receive.
Log in with your registered email; an OTP goes to your mobile.

Complete the profile: date of birth (upload only the 10th mark sheet or a birth certificate from a competent authority as proof), father's and mother's names, address, educational qualifications (10th and ITI only), trade preference, bank account details, and validate your Aadhaar number.

Open Apprenticeship Opportunities from the top-right dropdown, enter "Naval Dockyard, Karwar" under Search by Establishment Name, click Apply against your eligible trade, select "Uttara Kannada", and click OK.
Download and print the Candidate Profile from the portal.
Attach self-attested copies of: 10th mark sheet (8th for Rigger); ITI mark sheets, semester-wise and consolidated; category certificate (OBC/SC/ST); disability certificate (PwBD); Aadhaar card.

Add the certificate of undertaking in the notice's proforma, stating whether you are applying for Naval Dockyard, Karwar or Naval Aircraft Yard (Goa), Dabolim. Tick one and strike out the other; sign with date and place.
Send by speed post or registered post to: The Officer-in-Charge, Dockyard Apprentice School, Naval Dockyard, Naval Base, Karwar, Karnataka – 581 308
It must reach within 30 days of the 10 October 2026 publication. Allow for transit time; post by the first days of November at the latest.
One application only. Double or multiple applications are rejected, and the establishment choice is made once in the undertaking. Separate merit lists are drawn for Karwar and Goa.
Apply only for a trade your ITI certificate matches; irrelevance between the applied trade and the ITI trade is a listed rejection ground.
No money is payable to anyone. Report any tout or agent demanding payment to [email protected] with proof; the notice promises confidentiality.
Give a valid mobile number and email; all notices, the admit card and the joining letter come only by email.

how_to_apply: Candidates can apply online for KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026 through the official Karnataka Forest Department website. The steps below are based on the application instructions in the notification.
Visit the official website of the Karnataka Forest Department: https://aranya.gov.in/.
Open the "Nemakati" (Recruitment) section at the bottom of the home page, where the notification is published.
Read the notification, the instructions and the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules 2019 carefully, and confirm that you meet the eligibility conditions.
Fill in the online application with the required details, using your own Aadhaar (UID) number.
Scan and upload the required certificates, such as the SSLC marks card, the caste certificate and the reservation certificates, as applicable.
Submit the application and pay the application fee online (UPI, NEFT, credit card, debit card or internet banking) or by cash challan at the notified bank branches.
Take a printout of the submitted online application and the fee receipt and keep them for future reference. Do not send a hard copy to the department.
The last date to apply online is 30.10.2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline.

content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: KFD Forest Observer Vacancy 2026 stands at 750 posts. Of these, 700 are in the original cadre (Non-HK) and 50 are in the Kalyana Karnataka (HK) region. The posts are spread across 13 circles, and the circle-wise numbers are given below. The notification also lists vacancies for each division, wildlife unit and research or working plan circle. The unit names below are English renderings of the Kannada names in the notification. The vacancies are filled as per the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules 2019 (Government notification No. FEE 203 FEG 2015 dated 06.08.2019) and the reservation rules in force. The category-wise reservation breakup of the 750 posts is not given in the provided documents, because the circle-level notification format is left blank for each circle to fill. The PCCF letter states that, because of the interim order of the Hon'ble High Court, the Scheduled Caste reservation has been temporarily limited from 17% to 15%. The 400-point roster issued by the Social Welfare Department (Government order No. SAKA 515 PAKAVI 2026 dated 08.05.2026) is to be followed. In the circles of Bengaluru, Chamarajanagar, Chikkamagaluru, Kanara, Kodagu, Mangaluru, Mysuru and Shivamogga, 50% of the Forest Observer posts in the notified wildlife divisions and tiger reserves are reserved for Local Forest Dwelling Tribes candidates (see the reservation section below). The PCCF letter dated 30.06.2026 refers to 25 backlog posts left unfilled from an earlier direct recruitment (310 Forest Watcher posts), taking the total to 775 (750 vacancies + 25 backlog). The backlog table in the provided PDF is rotated and not clearly legible, and the circle-level notification format and the extension letter refer to the 750 vacancies. content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible for KFD Forest Observer Recruitment 2026, candidates must meet all the conditions below, along with the qualification and age limit given in the next sections. The candidate must be a citizen of India. A male candidate with more than one living wife, or a female candidate married to a man who already has a wife, is not eligible for appointment without prior permission of the Government. The candidate must be mentally and physically healthy and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties. The candidate must meet the physical standards and pass the physical endurance and physical efficiency tests described below. The recruiting authority may reject a candidate as physically unfit on the advice of a medical board, and the Government's discretion is not limited by these rules. Applying online does not by itself make a candidate eligible for appointment. A candidate is considered to have accepted all the Acts, rules and regulations of the Government on applying.

content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Qualification
content_sections.text: The educational qualification for KFD Forest Observer is SSLC. The candidate must hold the SSLC examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, or an equivalent qualification, on the last date to apply. As per Government circular No. CASUE 81 SENENI 2017 dated 27.02.2018, the following are treated as equivalent to SSLC: Class 10 examination conducted by CBSE and ICSE boards, or Class 10 examination conducted by other State Government examination boards, or Secondary-level course conducted by the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS), or Secondary-level course conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board (KOS). Candidates who have not received the result of the prescribed qualification, or who do not hold the marks card, as on the last date to apply are not eligible. No other qualification is considered in place of the above. If a candidate is found to lack the prescribed qualification at any stage, the candidature is cancelled, and the decision of the recruiting authority is final.

content_sections.heading: KFD Forest Observer Reservation Details
content_sections.text: Reservation is applied as per the Karnataka Civil Services (Direct Recruitment) (General) Rules 2021 and the Karnataka Forest Department Services (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules 2019. The notification includes the following reservation provisions. Caste and category reservation: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Category-I, IIA, IIB, IIIA and IIIB. Certificates must be in the prescribed formats: Form D for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe, Form E for Category-I, and Form F for Category IIA, IIB, IIIA and IIIB, obtained from the Tahsildar and valid on the last date to apply. Backward class certificates are valid for 5 years. Ex-servicemen: Candidates with the prescribed discharge and no-objection documents. BSF, CRPF and CISF personnel are not treated as ex-servicemen. Persons with disabilities: For this post (Forest Watcher – Group D), only the categories LC (Leprosy Cured), AAV (Acid Attack Victims) and MI (Mental Illness) are eligible under the disability reservation, as per Government notification No. WCD 111 PHP 2022 dated 19.08.2023. Candidates must have at least 40% disability and must not have any other disability. Project-displaced families: Candidates from families displaced by projects, with the prescribed Tahsildar certificate (Form-3). Families displaced more than 25 years before the date of the rules do not qualify. Kannada medium: Candidates who studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in Kannada medium, with the prescribed certificate. Rural candidates: Candidates who studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in a rural area, with the Form-2 certificate. General candidates claiming rural reservation must also have Form-1 (non-creamy layer) and Form-2. Candidates of reserved categories whose caste certificate is rejected and who lack a Non-Creamy Layer certificate are not eligible for rural reservation. Third gender candidates: A certificate issued by the District Magistrate under the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Rules 2020. Local Forest Dwelling Tribes (ST-LFDT): Fifty percent of the vacancies in the following wildlife divisions and tiger reserves are filled from local forest dwelling Scheduled Tribe candidates: Bandipur Tiger Reserve; Nagarahole Tiger Reserve; BRT Tiger Reserve, Chamarajanagar; Cauvery Wildlife Division, Kanakapura; Bhadra Tiger Reserve, Chikkamagaluru; Kudremukh Wildlife Division, Karkala; Madikeri Wildlife Division, Madikeri; MM Hills Wildlife Division, Kollegal; Bannerughatta Wildlife Division, Bengaluru; Kali Tiger Reserve, Dandeli; and Shivamogga Wildlife Division, Shivamogga. The tribes named for this reservation are Jenu Kuruba, Kadu Kuruba, Hakkipikki, Soliga, Soligaru, Yerava, Gowdlu, Irular, Iruliga, Koraga, Melakudi, Malaikudi, Maleru, Meda and Thoda. content_sections.heading: Training, Probation and Posting
content_sections.text: After appointment as a Forest Observer, the candidate must serve in the department for at least 3 years from the date of appointment. Otherwise, the full cost of training must be paid to the Government as per the prescribed norms. The candidate must execute a bond on Rs. 100 stamp paper, agreeing to serve at any place in Karnataka State specified by the Government. Candidates who successfully complete the induction training are posted as per the Karnataka State Civil Services (Regulation of Transfers of Officers and Staff) Act 2016 and the 2019 rules. Physical tests for all notified circles are conducted at the same time.

Any attempt to bring outside pressure on the recruiting authority results in cancellation of candidature. If a candidate does not attend the recruitment process on the dates notified, the candidature is cancelled automatically. The recruiting authority may change the number of posts or the reservation classification if needed. Any change is published on aranya.gov.in under "Nemakati" (Recruitment). The authority also has the power to revise the list in case of a court order, Government direction or circular. The decision of the recruiting authority is final, and all legal disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Karnataka State judiciary.

content_sections.text: A total of 86 vacancies are notified across four posts. The Typist notification includes 2 backlog vacancies and 6 new vacancies. If such candidates are not available, other candidates of the same category will be considered as per the Government Order dated 08-03-2023. The Scheduled Caste (Category-C) vacancy is reserved for candidates of the 59 most backward castes in that category. If such candidates are not available, other eligible Category-C candidates will be considered as per the Government Order dated 13-05-2026. Horizontal reservations (women, rural, ex-servicemen, Kannada medium, project-displaced persons, persons with disabilities and transgender) are also applicable within the vacancies as per the notifications. Posts reserved for persons with disabilities: 1 in Typist-Copyist (blindness/low vision), 2 in Process Server (blindness/low vision) and 1 in Peon (locomotor disability).

Passed the typewriting examination in Kannada and English conducted by the Department of Public Instruction (Junior grade for Typist-Copyist and Senior grade for Typist), OR equivalent qualification. content_sections.text: The following categories of candidates are not eligible to apply under this scheme: Graduates/Postgraduates from IITs, IIMs, National Law Universities, IISER, NIDs, IIITs, and IISc. Boarding and lodging will not be provided by CSL during the internship period.

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates will be based on the percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed qualification applicable to the respective trade/discipline. In case two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, relative merit will be decided based on seniority in age. Shortlisted candidates will be issued an offer of Internship Training through the PMIS portal and must appear for certificate verification on the date mentioned in the offer letter. Certificate verification requires original certificates for proof of age, qualification, caste, and disability (if any), along with self-attested copies of the same. On successful completion of certificate verification, candidates will be provisionally inducted for internship training, subject to medical fitness.

content_sections.heading: CSL PMIS Internship 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original certificates as proof of age Original educational qualification certificates relevant to the applied category Original caste certificate (if applicable) Original disability certificate (if applicable) Self-attested copies of all the above documents Equivalency Certificate, if the candidate holds a qualification equivalent to the prescribed qualification, issued by the competent authority

faq.question: Q2. How many seats are available under CSL PMIS Internship 2026?

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: No fixed last date has been specified. CSL will post vacancies through the PMIS portal from time to time, and candidates are advised to check the portal periodically.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by category - from a pass in Xth standard with ITI (NTC) for ITI Trades, up to MA Hindi/MA Hindi with Translation for the Post Graduation category. Refer to the eligibility table for category-specific requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 25 years, applicable uniformly across all categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee. The notification states "Application Fee: Nil."

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply only through the official PMIS Portal at https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/ after going through the Candidate User Manual available on the portal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting by percentage of marks in the prescribed qualification, followed by certificate verification, and provisional induction subject to medical fitness.

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend for CSL PMIS Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The stipend is ₹11,000 per month for ITI Trades, SSLC, and HSE/ITI categories, and ₹13,000 per month for Diploma, Graduation, and Post Graduation categories, including Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) by the Government of India.

faq.question: Q10. Does the CSL PMIS Internship guarantee a job at Cochin Shipyard after completion?
faq.answer: No. As per the notification, CSL has no obligation to offer employment upon completion of the internship, and an intern cannot claim any right to employment on the grounds of completing the internship.

basic_details.post_name: Personal Assistant in the cadre of Schedule A and Schedule B English Stenographer (Basic Grade)
basic_details.selection_process_brief: General English, Dictation and Transcription, and Computer Typing Examination
basic_details.short_information: Register for Job Alerts Important Eligibility Notice: Applicants must possess the required Madhyamik qualification, elementary knowledge of computer operation and English typing speed of 30 words per minute. Knowledge of Bengali is required except for candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali. The age eligibility date is 1 January 2025, even though applications are being accepted in October-November 2026.

application_fee.details: The prescribed fee must be paid online, where applicable. The Commission will not entertain requests for fee refunds or adjustment against another examination.

age_limit.age_details: Ability to Read, Write and Speak Bengali; Exemption for Candidates Whose Mother Tongue is Nepali
age_limit.details: The prescribed age limit is 18 to 44 years as of 1 January 2025. | The date of birth recorded in the Madhyamik or equivalent certificate will be accepted for determining age eligibility. | Candidates claiming age relaxation must satisfy the respective category and certificate requirements.

qualification.education_qualification: Madhyamik Examination or Equivalent
qualification.details: Candidates must meet the prescribed educational qualification, computer typing requirement, language eligibility and age conditions. | Applicants must have passed the Madhyamik Examination conducted by the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education or an equivalent examination. | Candidates must be capable of typing in English on a computer at the prescribed speed. | Candidates must have the ability to read, write and speak Bengali. This requirement does not apply to applicants whose mother tongue is Nepali. | For candidates whose mother tongue is neither Bengali nor Nepali, knowledge of Bengali will be tested during the computer typing test. Poor performance in this language assessment may lead to cancellation of candidature. | Applicants must be Indian citizens or belong to another nationality declared eligible by the Government of India, subject to the prescribed certificate-of-eligibility requirements.

salary_details.details: Both Schedule A and Schedule B English Stenographer (Basic Grade) posts carry Pay Level 9 under WBS (ROPA) Rules, 2019.

selection_process: The recruitment examination consists of three papers carrying a combined maximum of 600 marks.

Paper I: General English examination. Paper II: Dictation and Transcription examination. Paper III: Computer Typing examination. Final merit preparation using the combined marks obtained in all three papers
subject to qualifying criteria. Medical fitness examination and verification of antecedents before appointment.
The Commission will first conduct Paper I. Based on Paper I results
a limited number of candidates will be admitted to Paper II and Paper III.
Final Merit Rule: The final merit list will be prepared using the combined marks in Paper I
Paper II and Paper III. Paper I is not merely a qualifying screening examination; its marks also contribute to final merit.

exam_pattern.details: The Commission has specified the following category-wise minimum aggregate qualifying marks across the three papers. | Important: The aggregate qualifying marks do not replace the separate qualifying standards that the Commission may prescribe for individual papers. WBPSC also reserves the discretion to relax qualifying marks under the advertised conditions. | If candidates obtain equal aggregate marks, the Commission will apply the following preference order: | Higher marks in the Dictation and Transcription paper. Higher marks in the Computer Typing paper. Higher accuracy marks in the typing paper. Higher marks for typing speed. Higher age of the candidate.

Locate Advertisement No. 04/2025 for the English Stenographer (Basic Grade) in Schedule A and B Recruitment Examination, 2025.

Enter the prescribed personal, educational qualification, age and contact information.
Provide the required reservation and category details, if applicable.
Declare the necessary computer typing and language eligibility particulars as requested by the portal.
Complete the required photo identity and supporting information.
Review the application carefully before submission.
Pay the prescribed Rs. 160 application fee and applicable service charges, unless exempt.
Submit the application by 7 November 2026 at 3:30 PM.
Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC English Stenographer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment examination consists of three papers carrying a combined maximum of 600 marks . Paper I: General English examination. Paper II: Dictation and Transcription examination. Paper III: Computer Typing examination. Final merit preparation using the combined marks obtained in all three papers, subject to qualifying criteria. Medical fitness examination and verification of antecedents before appointment. The Commission will first conduct Paper I. Based on Paper I results, a limited number of candidates will be admitted to Paper II and Paper III. Final Merit Rule: The final merit list will be prepared using the combined marks in Paper I, Paper II and Paper III. Paper I is not merely a qualifying screening examination; its marks also contribute to final merit.

Open the portal www.dssrbkargil.in and click the "New User Registration" link for one-time registration. Use your own mobile number and a valid, active personal e-mail ID, and keep both active during the recruitment cycle.

Fill in the basic and contact details and upload a scanned passport-size photograph and signature in JPEG format. The notice's application section allows 20 KB to 100 KB, while its instructions to candidates say 20 KB to 50 KB. The photograph should be about 3.5 cm (width) x 4.5 cm (height) and no more than three months old, with the face covering about 40% of the area (samples in Annexure-XV(A)).
Log in with the user ID and password sent to your registered e-mail. Check the advertisements and click "Apply Now" against the post.

Fill in the application. Write your name, father's name and date of birth exactly as in the Matriculation/Secondary certificate. Apply separately for each category of post, and submit only one application per category of post.
Pay the fee online (₹250 Unreserved, ₹200 other categories) by 27 November 2026.
Read the declaration at the end of the form, then submit. The application is then accepted provisionally, and no corrections are allowed after final submission.
Print the application form. You do not send it to the Board. A duly signed printed copy must be produced, with self-attested documents, at the scrutiny or Document Verification stage.

content_sections.text: The Kargil Subordinate Service Recruitment Board works under the Office of the Secretary, Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council, Kargil, in the Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh. content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Department
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 181 posts across 20 items in six departments. Category-wise, there are 4 UR, 155 ST, 1 SC, 6 ALC and 15 EWS posts. The horizontal reservation is 5 posts for PwD, 8 for ESM and 5 for OSP. Most of the posts are in the School Education Department (107 posts, 70 of them Class-IV). The Ladakh Power Development Department has the next largest share (47 posts, 45 of them Technician-III). The other departments have 13 posts (Animal Husbandry), 8 (Rural Development Department & PR), 5 (PHE/I&FC) and 1 (Handicraft). Vertical reservation is for Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Actual Line of Control (ALC) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS). Horizontal reservation is 6% for Ex-Servicemen (ESM), 4% for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) and 4% for Outstanding Sportsperson (OSP), vide S.O 247 dated 18.08.2026. The Indenting Departments decide and communicate where it applies. Reservation follows the Reservation Rules notified vide S.O 77 dated 27-06-2025 of the Social & Tribal Welfare Department, read with the Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Regulation, 2025. A candidate eligible under more than one category (ST and ALC, ALC and EWS, or SC and ALC) must choose only ONE category in the online form, as per section-19 of the J&K Reservation Act, 2004. The choice cannot be changed after submission. Only candidates with a benchmark disability count as PwD. Their selection depends on the posts being identified as suitable for their category and on the vacancies the departments report. Sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen get no age relaxation or reservation and should not mark themselves as ex-servicemen. The number of vacancies comes from the departments. The Board is not responsible if a department withdraws or changes them.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a resident of Kargil District, read as "Erstwhile District Kargil". This covers the whole area of Kargil district as it existed immediately before Notification S.O.180 dated 27-04-2026. The candidate must also hold a Domicile Certificate in the Annexure-V format (Form-B), issued by a Competent Authority under the Union territory of Ladakh Grant of Domicile Certificate under the Ladakh Civil Services Decentralization and Recruitment-Grant of Domicile Certificate (Procedure) Rules, 2025, and S.O 76 dated 27-06-2025. The certificate format lists these domicile categories: Ladakh Resident Certificate (L.R.C.) holders or those eligible for an L.R.C., and children of persons mentioned in section 3A(1)(a) of the Regulation Children of Ladakh residents who lived outside the Union territory for employment, business or other professional or vocational reasons A person who has lived in the Union territory of Ladakh for fifteen years from 31 October 2019 onward, or the children of such a person A person who has studied in the Union territory of Ladakh for seven years from 31 October 2019 onward and appeared in the class 10th or 12th examination at an institution there Children of Central Government officers, officials of Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous Bodies of the Central Government, Public Sector Banks, Central Universities and recognised Central Government research institutions who have served in the Union territory of Ladakh for a total of ten years from 31 October 2019 onward Each post's essential qualification is given below exactly as the notice prints it, with the level of the written examination for that post. The essential qualification must be held by the crucial date of eligibility, 27 November 2026. Candidates still awaiting the result of the final examination on that date are NOT eligible and should not apply. Selection follows the Recruitment Rules of each post. Equivalency is not allowed unless the prescribed essential qualification mentions it. content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. It is paid online by credit card, debit card, net banking or UPI by 27 November 2026, and the candidate bears all bank service charges. The fee is not refunded if the application is incomplete or rejected, and it cannot be adjusted against any other examination. A separate fee is paid for each category of post applied for. Apart from this fee, LAHDC-KSSRB does not ask for any payment at any stage of selection.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected in this order: A CBT, TBT or OMR-based written examination of objective multiple-choice questions A skill test of qualifying nature, where one (such as a Physical Efficiency Test) is prescribed in the essential qualification Document Verification Recommendation to the department Selection is done as per Rule 7 of the Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Rules, 2025. LAHDC-KSSRB will decide whether the exam is CBT, TBT or OMR-based and will inform candidates. The exam is held at three levels (Matric, 10+2 and Graduate), matching the level printed for each post. Each question carries 1 mark, with negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. The exam is in English. The minimum qualifying mark is 20%. Candidates scoring less are not considered for Document Verification. The Board may fix a minimum qualifying score based on category-wise vacancies and the number of candidates in each category. Exam centres will be in Kargil, Drass, Zanskar and Sankoo districts only. LAHDC-KSSRB may move a candidate to another centre and will not accept requests to change the city, centre or date. Tentative answer keys will be placed on the website after the exam. Candidates may object online within the time limit, on payment of ₹100 per question. The Board's decision on the objections is final. The syllabus matches the essential qualification of the post. The notice gives an indicative syllabus for each level: Matriculation level: non-verbal General Intelligence (similarities and differences, space visualisation, problem solving, figure classification, arithmetical number series); General Awareness (current events, India and its neighbouring countries, sports, history, culture, geography, economic scene, polity including the Indian Constitution, scientific research); Quantitative Aptitude (number systems, decimals and fractions, percentages, ratio and proportion, averages, interest, profit and loss, discount, tables and graphs, mensuration, time and distance, time and work); English (vocabulary, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms and correct usage). 10+2 (Higher Secondary) level: verbal and non-verbal General Intelligence (analogies, classification, Venn diagrams, coding-decoding, series, figural patterns); General Awareness; Quantitative Aptitude (arithmetic, algebra, geometry, mensuration, trigonometry, statistical charts); English (spot the error, fill in the blanks, idioms, one-word substitution, active/passive voice, direct/indirect narration, cloze and comprehension passages). Graduate level: Part-A General Intelligence (verbal and non-verbal, including syllogistic reasoning, statement conclusion, indexing, address matching); Part-B General Awareness; Part-C Quantitative Aptitude (arithmetic, algebra, geometry, mensuration, trigonometry, data charts); Part-D English comprehension and writing ability. Parts A, B and D are set at graduation level and Part C at 10th standard level. Candidates who reach the minimum qualifying

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only through the LAHDC-KSSRB online portal from 27 October 2026 to 27 November 2026. Applications sent by post, by hand, by mail or by any other means will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: A printed admit card, downloaded from the website (admit cards will not be sent by post) Two recent passport-size colour photographs A valid original photo ID, such as an Aadhaar Card or e-Aadhaar printout, Driving License, Voter Card, PAN Card, an identity card issued by a University/College/Government, an Employer ID Card, or any photo ID issued by the Central/State Government An additional original certificate proving date of birth, if the photo ID does not show it A signed printout of the online application form Self-attested copies of supporting documents, and original certificates A Domicile Certificate (Annexure-V), issued by the Tehsildar An SC certificate (Annexure-III), ST certificate (Annexure-IV) or ALC certificate (Annexure-XV), issued by the Tehsildar. The ALC certificate is valid for five years from the date of issue. An EWS Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure-XIII), issued by the District Magistrate/Additional District Magistrate/Sub-Divisional Magistrate/Tehsildar. It requires gross annual family income below Rs. 8 lakh. The family must not own 5 acres or more of agricultural land, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, a residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities, or 200 sq. yards or more elsewhere. A PwD certificate (Annexure-VI to IX), from the Members/Chairperson of the Medical Board and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital. It must be issued under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and the Union Territory of Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Regulation, 2025. An Ex-Serviceman certificate (Annexure-X), from the Zila Sainik Welfare Officer/Commanding Officer OSP certificates (Annexure-A, B, C, D and E: Forms 1 to 5 for international, national, inter-university, national school and Khelo India competitions). They must be issued by the authorities specified in paragraph A.V of DoPT O.M. No. 14034/1/2020-Pers. Policy (D)Pt. Vol.II dated 4 March 2024. For government employees: a No Objection Certificate (Annexure-XI) through proper channel from the Head of Department, and a declaration (Annexure-XII) signed by the applicant. Without the NOC, the candidature is liable to be cancelled. For equivalent or distance-mode qualifications: the equivalence order or letter, or the UGC/distance education bureau approval Reservation and age-relaxation claims are considered only if the certificates are in the prescribed format and are submitted when LAHDC-KSSRB asks for them.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: A candidate whose date of birth differs from the Matriculation/Secondary certificate will not be allowed to appear in the exam. If the name or date of birth differs at Document Verification, the candidature will be cancelled. Candidates who apply for one category of post more than once will have all their applications for that post rejected and their candidature cancelled. Applications are not scrutinised in detail before the exam, so candidature is provisional. It will be cancelled at any stage if a claim is found unsubstantiated. No entry is allowed after the exam begins, and no one may leave before the allotted time ends. An admit card does not mean the candidature has been accepted. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant. A candidate or cyber cafe making a fake application using a dignitary's name or photo is liable to legal action under the cyber/IT act. LAHDC-KSSRB's decision on eligibility, mode of selection, exam centres, the merit list and post allotment is final. Disputes fall under the courts/tribunals with jurisdiction over Kargil District. An incomplete application, or signatures that do not match across the application printout and other documents An unclear photograph (miniature, side-facing, with goggles or a cap, missing or blurred) or an illegible signature Non-payment of the fee, or the fee not paid as per instructions Being under-aged or over-aged, or not holding the essential qualification as on 27-11-2026 and the age as on 01-01-2026 Incorrect information, misrepresentation or suppression of material facts Carrying prohibited items into the exam hall, or being found in an inebriated condition there Not producing original certificates at Document Verification Indulging in the listed malpractices, or any other irregularity A candidate caught in any of these malpractices has their candidature cancelled and is debarred from the Board's exams for the period shown:

rows.malpractice: Taking away exam material such as OMR sheets, rough sheets or answer sheets, or passing them to unauthorised persons; leaving the venue uninformed during the exam

Misbehaving with, intimidating or threatening exam staff; obstructing the exam or instigating others not to take it; false statements or fabricated documents; seeking support by improper means; possessing a mobile phone ("switched on" or "switched off")
Damaging exam infrastructure; using a forged admit card or ID proof; possessing firearms or weapons

Assault on exam staff; threatening them with weapons; copying or other unfair means; possessing Bluetooth devices, spy cameras or other electronic gadgets; impersonation; photographing or filming question papers or exam material

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 181 vacancies across 20 post items in six departments. They include Class-IV (70), Technician-III (45), Laboratory Assistant (31), Attendant (9) and Library Assistant (5).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and to pay the fee online is 27 November 2026. Applications open on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for LAHDC-KSSRB posts?
faq.answer: It depends on the post. Class-IV, Mirab, Store Khalasi and Attendant need Matriculation/Std. X pass. Junior Assistant needs graduation with a 200-hour or 6-month computer course and a typing speed of 35 words per minute. Technician-III needs a two-year NTC/STC in the relevant trade from NCVT/SCVT.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18-40 years as on 1 January 2026. The upper limit is 45 years for SC/ST/ALC, 50 years for PwBD and 55 years for PwBD who are also SC/ST/ALC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for LAHDC-KSSRB posts?
faq.answer: The notice gives pay levels, not amounts. Junior Assistant, Receptionist, Veterinary Pharmacist and other L-4 posts are at Level L-4. Laboratory Assistant, Technician-III and other L-2 posts are at Level L-2. Class-IV, Mirab, Bearer, Store Khalasi and Attendant are at Level SL-1.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹250 for Unreserved candidates and ₹200 for other categories. It is paid online by 27 November 2026, separately for each category of post, and is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register through "New User Registration" on www.dssrbkargil.in and log in with the ID sent to your e-mail. Then click "Apply Now" against the post and pay the fee online. Applications by post, by hand or by mail are rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for LAHDC-KSSRB posts?
faq.answer: Selection is through a CBT/TBT/OMR objective exam of 100 questions, with 0.25 negative marking and 20% minimum qualifying marks. Shortlisted candidates then go to Document Verification. A qualifying skill test is held where the essential qualification prescribes one.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only residents of Kargil District (Erstwhile District Kargil) who hold a Domicile Certificate in the Annexure-V format can apply.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the LAHDC-KSSRB exam be held?
faq.answer: Exam centres will be in Kargil, Drass, Zanskar and Sankoo districts only. The exam date will be announced on the LAHDC-KSSRB website, and admit cards are expected there tentatively one week before the exam.

application_fee.details: The NWR Act Apprentice application fee is Rs. 100 for all candidates except those exempted. SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Women candidates do not have to pay any fee. The fee is non-refundable. | The fee is paid online through the payment gateway after the online application is complete at www.rrcjaipur.in. After a successful payment, the candidate is redirected to the RRC Jaipur website to complete the application and download the application form. Payment can be made by debit card, credit card or internet banking. Transaction charges for online payment, if any, are borne by the candidate. If the amount is deducted but the application cannot be downloaded, the candidate should click the "Verify Payment" button to reconfirm the payment from the payment gateway. An e-receipt is generated on successful payment and should be printed and retained. If the transaction is not completed, the candidate should log in again and pay online. No change or edit is allowed after the fee payment. RRC/NWR is not responsible for incomplete or pending online fee transactions.

age_limit.details: The NWR Act Apprentice age limit is 15 to 24 years as on 22.11.2026. A candidate should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age on that date. Regardless of community, Ex-Servicemen are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota, if available. If UR vacancies are not available, only Ex-Servicemen of the communities where vacancies are available are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota. | Reservation is also provided for the following, who will be engaged as per the details in the notification: children of deceased/disabled Ex-Servicemen including those killed/disabled during peace time, children of Ex-Servicemen, children of serving jawans, children of serving officers, and Ex-Servicemen. An Ex-Servicemen candidate selected under the reservation is placed in the appropriate category (UR/SC/ST/OBC) to which he belongs.

Those awaiting results of the final exams need not apply. | Candidates must choose only one unit and should check the available training slots against their ITI trade before selecting the unit. Candidates seeking reservation must produce the relevant certificates in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification (see the documents section). salary_details.details: The notification does not state a fixed stipend amount. The training period and stipend will be as per the extant rules and directives issued by the Railway Board from time to time. | No hostel accommodation is provided. Selected candidates have to make their own arrangement during the training, as per the Apprentices Act 1961, and are released on completion of the training. Before the training begins, the selected candidate (or the guardian, if the candidate is a minor) has to enter into a Contract of Apprenticeship with the employer. Training in the Railway does not give any right to absorption in the Railway after completing the training.

selection_process: The NWR Act Apprentice selection process is based on a merit list. The notification does not mention any written examination or interview.
The merit list is prepared for all candidates who apply

on the basis of the percentage of marks in Matriculation (with minimum 50% aggregate marks) and the ITI marks in the trade in which the apprenticeship is to be done. The panel is prepared on the basis of the simple average of the marks in Matriculation and ITI. For the Matriculation percentage
the marks obtained in all subjects are counted
not the marks of any subject or group of subjects. For the ITI percentage
the marks mentioned in the provisional/final certificate are counted. If two candidates have the same marks
the older candidate is preferred. If the dates of birth are also the same
the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier is considered first. The final merit list is prepared division/unit-wise
trade-wise and community-wise
equal to the number of slots
in the descending order of the percentage of marks. No centralized merit list is formed. After the merit list is prepared
it is advised to the respective divisions/units
and Document Verification and Medical Examination are held in the opted divisions/units based on merit
trade and vacancy. Candidates finally enlisted are subject to verification of original testimonials and production of the medical certificate as per Annexure-IV.
how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online only on the RRC Jaipur website. The detailed instructions for filling the online application will be available on the website.

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To meet the NWR Act Apprentice eligibility, candidates must satisfy the qualification and age conditions given below. Before applying, candidates should ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility norms and hold the requisite educational and technical qualifications from a recognized Board/Government University/Institute as on the date of submission of the application. Those awaiting results of the final exams need not apply. Candidates must choose only one unit and should check the available training slots against their ITI trade before selecting the unit. Candidates should hold an Aadhaar Card, as the 12-digit Aadhaar number has to be entered at the time of registration. Candidates seeking reservation must produce the relevant certificates in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification (see the documents section). Candidates who are not Persons with Benchmark Disability of the types mentioned in the notification should not apply as PwBD. The NWR Act Apprentice qualification requires Class 10 and an ITI trade certificate in the notified trade.

rows.details: Passed Class 10 examination or its equivalent (under the 10+2 examination system) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from a recognized Board (no rounding off will be done)
National Trade Certificate in the notified trade issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) / State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT)
ITI Pass in the relevant trade to be eligible for consideration

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice age limit is 15 to 24 years as on 22.11.2026. A candidate should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age on that date. The upper age limit is relaxable as shown below. The Ex-Servicemen relaxation does not apply to Ex-Servicemen who have already joined Government service on the civil side after availing the Ex-Servicemen status. Regardless of community, Ex-Servicemen are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota, if available. If UR vacancies are not available, only Ex-Servicemen of the communities where vacancies are available are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota. Reservation is also provided for the following, who will be engaged as per the details in the notification: children of deceased/disabled Ex-Servicemen including those killed/disabled during peace time, children of Ex-Servicemen, children of serving jawans, children of serving officers, and Ex-Servicemen. An Ex-Servicemen candidate selected under the reservation is placed in the appropriate category (UR/SC/ST/OBC) to which he belongs.

rows.upper_age_relaxation: Up to an additional 10 years, to the extent of service rendered in the Defence Forces plus 3 years, provided they have put in a minimum of 6 months service at a stretch

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Stipend and Training Details
content_sections.text: The notification does not state a fixed stipend amount. The training period and stipend will be as per the extant rules and directives issued by the Railway Board from time to time. No hostel accommodation is provided. Selected candidates have to make their own arrangement during the training, as per the Apprentices Act 1961, and are released on completion of the training. Before the training begins, the selected candidate (or the guardian, if the candidate is a minor) has to enter into a Contract of Apprenticeship with the employer. Training in the Railway does not give any right to absorption in the Railway after completing the training.

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice application fee is Rs. 100 for all candidates except those exempted. SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Women candidates do not have to pay any fee. The fee is non-refundable. The fee is paid online through the payment gateway after the online application is complete at www.rrcjaipur.in. After a successful payment, the candidate is redirected to the RRC Jaipur website to complete the application and download the application form. Payment can be made by debit card, credit card or internet banking. Transaction charges for online payment, if any, are borne by the candidate. If the amount is deducted but the application cannot be downloaded, the candidate should click the "Verify Payment" button to reconfirm the payment from the payment gateway. An e-receipt is generated on successful payment and should be printed and retained. If the transaction is not completed, the candidate should log in again and pay online. No change or edit is allowed after the fee payment. RRC/NWR is not responsible for incomplete or pending online fee transactions.

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice selection process is based on a merit list. The notification does not mention any written examination or interview. The merit list is prepared for all candidates who apply, on the basis of the percentage of marks in Matriculation (with minimum 50% aggregate marks) and the ITI marks in the trade in which the apprenticeship is to be done. The panel is prepared on the basis of the simple average of the marks in Matriculation and ITI. For the Matriculation percentage, the marks obtained in all subjects are counted, not the marks of any subject or group of subjects. For the ITI percentage, the marks mentioned in the provisional/final certificate are counted. If two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate is preferred. If the dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier is considered first. The final merit list is prepared division/unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise, equal to the number of slots, in the descending order of the percentage of marks. No centralized merit list is formed. After the merit list is prepared, it is advised to the respective divisions/units, and Document Verification and Medical Examination are held in the opted divisions/units based on merit, trade and vacancy. Candidates finally enlisted are subject to verification of original testimonials and production of the medical certificate as per Annexure-IV.

content_sections.heading: Standards of Fitness for Persons with Disability
content_sections.text: Locomotor Disability or Cerebral Palsy (LD): Only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible. Hearing Impairment (HI): Loss of 60 decibels or more in the better ear in the conversational range of frequencies. This includes persons who are Deaf, Dumb, Deaf and Dumb. Visually Impaired (VI): For the trades Mechanic (Diesel) and Fitter, low vision means impairment of vision of less than 6/18 to 6/60 with best correction in the better eye, or impairment of field (reduction of fields less than 50 degrees, hemianopia with macular involvement, or altitudinal defect involving lower fields). Multiple Disabilities (MD): PwBD candidates with more than one disability. A PwBD candidate who wants to avail the reservation must produce a disability certificate issued by a competent authority (a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government) in the format of Annexure-V(A), V(B), V(C) or V(D).

content_sections.heading: RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates need to pay a non-refundable application fee online as per their category. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application and separate fee for each post. Candidates covered under horizontal (other category) reservation must pay the fee applicable to their own original category. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: For all posts mentioned in this recruitment, candidates must have attained the age of 18 years and must not have attained the age of 40 years as on the last date of submission of the online application. SC/ST/OBC and other specified categories of Uttar Pradesh: upper age relaxation as specified by the Government, maximum up to 5 years as per relevant Government Orders Permanent government employees with at least 3 years of regular and continuous service in the relevant field: relaxation up to 5 years Physically handicapped candidates (General category): up to 5 years for Group-B posts and 10 years for Group-C posts Physically handicapped candidates (OBC/SC/ST): up to 10 years for Group-B posts and 15 years for Group-C posts Ex-servicemen and dependents of Freedom Fighters: relaxation as per Government of India rules This age relaxation is admissible only to candidates who are domicile of Uttar Pradesh; candidates from other states are eligible to apply only against Unreserved (UR) vacancies

content_sections.heading: RMLIMS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a two-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), conducted bilingually in Hindi and English. Screening Examination: Qualifying in nature, held only to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks from this stage are not carried forward, and only 10 times the number of advertised posts (category-wise) are shortlisted for the Main Exam Main Examination: Final selection is based solely on marks obtained in this exam, prepared category-wise based on merit and reservation norms Exam Pattern: Both Screening and Mains exams carry 100 marks each, of 2 hours' duration, consisting only of Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) — 60 marks on the subject related to the post, 10 marks each on General English, General Knowledge, Reasoning, and Mathematical Aptitude Negative Marking: 1 mark is awarded for each correct answer; 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer Qualifying Marks: 50% for Unreserved and EWS candidates; 40% for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates Skill Test: Conducted after the Main Exam for the Stenographer post (Stenography/Typing Test in English or Hindi, Mangal or Krutidev 10 font). Candidates equal to five times the advertised posts (category-wise) are shortlisted; the Skill Test is qualifying in nature and its marks are not counted in the final merit

Send the application by Speed Post with acknowledgemen to this address: The Registrar, District and Sessions Court, Ahmednagar, Near Nyay Nagar, Behind DSP Office, DSP Chowk, Ahmednagar 414 001 Write (Application for the post of Book Binder) on the envelope. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Book Binder. One candidate will be placed on the selection list and one on the waiting list. The candidate must have passed the Secondary School Certificate (S.S.C.) examination. The candidate must have passed a course in book binding from an Industrial Training Institute or another equivalent government-recognised institution. The candidate must have technical and professional knowledge of book binding. Minimum: not less than 18 years. General category: not more than 38 years. Backward class: not more than 43 years. Under Government Resolution No. एसआरव्ही-१०७७/३५७६/१४३३/१६-अ dated 23 May 1978, the upper age limit for physically handicapped persons is raised to 45 years. This applies only if they are otherwise eligible and able to perform the duties of the post. A birth certificate, school leaving certificate or SSC examination certificate is mandatory as proof of age. The post is in Pay Level S-5 of the revised pay structure under the 7th Pay Commission: Rs. 18,000–56,900, plus allowances admissible as per rules. Candidates already in government service must get written permission from the head of their department or office before applying. They must produce this permission at the interview. They do not need to send the application through their department or office head. In Form A, candidates declare that they may be disqualified at any stage of the selection process if more than two of their children were born after 28 March 2005. An unmarried applicant writes "not applicable" in the relevant places of that declaration. Form A also covers arrests, pending criminal cases and convictions. Candidates who are state or central government employees also declare that no disciplinary inquiry is pending against them and that they have not been found guilty in one. content_sections.heading: Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be appointed or deputed as Book Binder in any court under the Ahmednagar district judiciary. The duties are: binding books in the court library; binding files, registers and similar records kept in the court; doing all necessary work as directed by the officers. The Book Binder post is a single, isolated post and offers no chance of promotion.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application form ends with a numbered list of the documents attached, which the candidate dates and signs. Do not send a Demand Draft, Pay Order, cheque or any other payment with the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Ahmednagar District Court Book Binder selection has two stages: a book binding evaluation test and an oral interview. If a large number of applications are received, the selection committee may first shortlist candidates using suitable criteria. The committee's decision is final, and no objection to the shortlist will be considered. Candidates will take an evaluation test of book binding work worth 20 marks. Selection is strictly by merit, using the combined marks of the evaluation test and the oral interview. The selection committee reserves the right to prepare the shortlist and to make any necessary changes. The names of shortlisted candidates will be published on the District Court, Ahmednagar website and notice board. The identity card format will be uploaded to the website at the same time. Download the identity card format, fill it in properly and paste on it the latest passport-size photograph (the one sent with the application). Sign the identity card in black ink in the space given, submit it to the District Court on the dates given, and collect the admit card. Candidates without the admit card will not be allowed to take the evaluation test or the interview.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Incubator Facility Administrator (on contract basis) reports to the CEO - Innovation, Incubation and Entrepreneurship. Responsible for overall administration and smooth functioning of the incubation facility, including co-working spaces, labs, and common infrastructure. Ensure proper allocation, utilization, and upkeep of workspace, meeting rooms, and shared facilities for incubated startups. Oversee maintenance and servicing of infrastructure, including electrical systems, HVAC, furniture, and utilities. Coordinate with vendors and service providers for facility management, repairs, housekeeping, and security services. Monitor and ensure uninterrupted functioning of internet, communication systems, and access control systems. Maintain asset registers and inventory of all equipment, furniture, and infrastructure within the incubator. Assist in procurement processes related to facility requirements, including vendor identification, quotations, and documentation. Ensure compliance with safety norms, statutory requirements, and institute guidelines within the incubation facility. Support startups and stakeholders by addressing facility-related issues promptly and efficiently. Coordinate logistics and arrangements for meetings, events, workshops, and incubation programs. Maintain documentation and records related to facility usage, maintenance schedules, and service reports. Liaise with IIM Mumbai administration and AIC-NIFIE for operational coordination and reporting. Prepare periodic reports on facility utilization, maintenance status, and operational efficiency. Assist in the day-to-day operations and smooth functioning of the Incubation Centre. Ensure cleanliness, upkeep and proper maintenance of workspaces, meeting rooms and common facilities. Assist startups, visitors and stakeholders with routine facility-related requirements. Coordinate with housekeeping, security, maintenance staff and service providers for day-to-day requirements. Provide logistical support for meetings, workshops, events and incubation programmes. Assist in maintaining inventory, facility records and other administrative documentation. Report facility-related issues and support timely resolution. Perform other duties as assigned by the Facility Administrator/CEO – Innovation, Incubation and Entrepreneurship.

faq.question: Q2. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online registration process commences on 19 October 2026 and concludes on 9 November 2026. Interested and eligible candidates must complete their submissions well before the closing date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Technical Assistant and Technician posts?
faq.answer: For Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Nurse, and Technician posts, the age limit is set between 18 and 35 years as on 9 November 2026, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.answer: The processing fee for post codes 07 to 15 is Rs. 750 for all candidates. Please check the official notification regarding fee refund policies for candidates appearing in the written test.

faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises a Written Test consisting of objective multiple-choice questions, followed by a Skill Test, Physical Efficiency Test, or Detailed Medical Examination depending on the specific post requirements.

faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for multiple posts if they satisfy the respective eligibility criteria, but they must submit separate applications and fees for each individual post code.

faq.answer: Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) positions fall under Level 1 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, with a salary ranging from Rs. 18,000 to Rs. 56,900/- plus admissible allowances.
