content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Undergraduate syllabus for CBT-1 and CBT-2 covers Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, and General Awareness. Both stages have the same broad subjects but different question distributions. Number System, Decimals and Fractions LCM and HCF Ratio and Proportion Percentages Mensuration Time and Work Time and Distance Simple and Compound Interest Profit and Loss Elementary Algebra Geometry and Trigonometry Elementary Statistics Analogies Number and Alphabetical Series Coding and Decoding Mathematical Operations Similarities and Differences Relationships and Analytical Reasoning Syllogism Venn Diagrams Puzzles and Data Sufficiency Statement and Conclusion Decision Making Maps and Graph Interpretation Current Affairs - National and International Indian History and Freedom Struggle Indian and World Geography Indian Polity and Constitution Indian Economy General Science up to Class 10 Level Sports, Art, Culture and Literature Computer Basics and Applications Science and Technology Developments Government Schemes and Programmes Environmental Issues Indian Transport Systems Important National and International Organizations

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Medical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: Each undergraduate post has a prescribed railway medical standard. Candidates must satisfy the required fitness and vision conditions for the post they select. Candidates who have undergone LASIK or another procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for posts requiring A-3 medical standards under this notification. For B-2 and C-2 posts, eligibility is subject to the medical conditions specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit only one online application through the unified official RRB website from 15 October to 13 November 2026. Candidates must carefully choose the RRB and their post preferences because important details cannot be changed later. Visit https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/ . Open the recruitment link for CEN No. 07/2026 - NTPC Undergraduate. Read the detailed notification, Annexure A and RRB-wise vacancy tables in Annexure B. Click Create an Account if you are a new applicant. Candidates who already created an RRB account for earlier CENs should use their existing login credentials. Register using the required personal details, active mobile number and email address. Complete Aadhaar or other permitted identity verification as directed by the application portal. Choose one Railway Recruitment Board. Enter the required personal, educational and reservation details. Select eligible posts, Railway Zones and Production Unit preferences carefully. Complete the live photograph capture as instructed by the portal. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents. Review the information and declaration carefully. Pay the prescribed examination fee using the available online payment method. Submit the application and retain the confirmation details. Important: The selected RRB and details entered during Create an Account cannot be modified later. Candidates must not submit multiple applications.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Photo and Signature Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB application process includes live photograph capture and upload of the candidate's signature. Candidates should follow the exact instructions to avoid application rejection. The candidate's photograph must be captured live through the application system. Do not upload or photograph an existing printed photograph. Follow the portal's instructions for face positioning, lighting and identity matching. The notification also requires eligible SC/ST candidates seeking a free train travel pass to upload the prescribed community certificate in PDF format.

age_limit.details: Principal: minimum 30 years and maximum 45 years, with at least 04 years of teaching experience in Classes 9 to 12. All other posts: minimum 25 years and maximum 45 years. The maximum age for service in the Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas is 60 years.

qualification.details: Principal: minimum 30 years and maximum 45 years, with at least 04 years of teaching experience in Classes 9 to 12. All other posts: minimum 25 years and maximum 45 years. The maximum age for service in the Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas is 60 years. | A teaching qualification (B.Ed) is required. The notice accepts any one of these routes: | Trained (B.Ed) M.A. (Hindi/English) or M.Sc. (Physics/Chemistry/Zoology/Botany/Mathematics/Computer Science) from a recognised university or institution. She also needs at least four years of teaching experience in Classes 9 to 12, or at least four years as a trained graduate headmaster of a junior high school recognised by the department. She must be at least 30 years old. Ten years of teaching experience in intermediate classes in a recognised institution with a first or second division postgraduate degree, or fifteen years of teaching experience with a third division postgraduate degree. A trained (B.Ed) postgraduate diploma holder in science who passed the diploma in first or second division and has 15 or 20 years of commendable service respectively after passing it from a recognised institution. | No separate PGT is appointed for the subject of the selected Principal; the Principal teaches that subject herself. Academic staff of the upgraded schools do not have to stay at the school overnight. | PGT Hindi: M.A. in Hindi and B.A. with Sanskrit, or the Shastri examination of Government Sanskrit College, Varanasi (now Sampurnanand University, Varanasi). PGT English: Postgraduate degree in English from a university of Uttar Pradesh or any other recognised university. Preferred: an L.T. diploma from a training college, or a degree or diploma in Education from a recognised university. PGT Mathematics: M.A. or M.Sc. Mathematics, or B.A. (Hons) or B.Sc. (Hons) with a three-year course in Mathematics. PGT Biology: M.Sc. in Botany or Zoology; or M.Sc. in Agricultural Botany with Zoology in B.Sc.; or M.Sc. in Agricultural Zoology with Botany in B.Sc.; or M.Sc. (Life Sciences) from a UGC-recognised university or degree college; or B.Sc. with the postgraduate diploma in Biology run by the Education Department, U.P., in a university or degree college. PGT Chemistry: M.Sc. Chemistry; or B.Sc. (Hons) with a three-year course in Chemistry; or a postgraduate degree (Biochemistry) from a UGC-recognised university or degree college; or B.Sc. with the postgraduate diploma in Chemistry run by the Education Department, U.P. PGT Physics: M.Sc. (Physics), or B.Sc. with the postgraduate diploma in Physics run by the Education Department, Uttar Pradesh, in a university or degree college. Computer Science: M.Tech (Computer Science); or B.E./B.Tech (Computer Science) from a recognised university; or M.Sc. / M.Sc. (Computer Science) from a recognised university, or DOEACC "B" level; or a postgraduate degree with a PG Diploma in Computer Application from a recognised university; or a postgraduate degree with B.Sc. (computer course making up at least 1/3 of the science courses) from a recognised university; or a postgraduate degree with DOEACC A-level. | Care Taker: Postgraduate and B.Ed. This is a full-time post and she must stay at the school at night. She must have no physical disability and no infectious disease. Office Superintendent / Clerk: (1) Intermediate from the Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad, U.P., or an equivalent examination. (2) One of these: Computer Science as a separate subject in High School or Intermediate (from the U.P. board or any board set up by the Centre or a State); a CCC certificate from DOEACC/NIELIT or an equivalent from a government-recognised institution; or a diploma or degree in Computer Science. (3) Computer typing speed of at least 25 words per minute in Hindi and 30 words per minute in English. Lab Assistant: High School with science and a diploma in laboratory technique, or Intermediate with science from a recognised board. Peon, Chowkidar, Cook: Class 8 pass, with no physical disability and no infectious disease. These are full-time posts and she must stay at the school at night. | Full-time Teacher: Upper primary level TET and a trained (B.Ed) graduate degree. Training includes NCTE-recognised B.Ed or an equivalent such as L.T. For Mathematics: a trained (B.Ed) graduate with the PCM group plus upper primary TET. For Social Science: a trained (B.Ed) graduate with one of Geography, History and Civics, plus upper primary TET. Part-time Teacher - Physical Education: Trained graduate. B.P.Ed, C.P.Ed and D.P.Ed are valid only for teaching physical education, and TET is not required for B.P.Ed, C.P.Ed and D.P.Ed candidates for this post. Part-time Teacher - Art Craft / Home Science / Music: Graduate degree with training (B.Ed). The Home Craft teacher post counts within the Art, Craft and Music post. Part-time Teacher - Computer: A trained (B.Ed) graduate degree is mandatory, including NCTE-recognised B.Ed or an equivalent such as L.T. Desirable: PGDCA, BCA, B.Sc. Computer Science, or graduation with an "O level"/A level diploma from DOEACC or an equivalent institution. Assistant Cook: Class 8 pass, with no physical disability and no infectious disease. This is a full-time post and she must live at the school. | A teaching qualification is mandatory for all academic posts. Anyone dismissed from service, convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, or declared insolvent is not eligible. Check the official notification for the full subject-wise eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: About District Basic Education Officer, Lakhimpur Kheri
content_sections.text: The office of the District Basic Education Officer (Samagra Shiksha) in Lakhimpur Kheri, Uttar Pradesh, runs this recruitment for the Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas in the district. These are residential girls' schools. The notice follows Government Order No. I/570148/2024 file No.68-5099/23/2024-5 dated 28.05.2024 and letter No. 68-5099/23/2024, Section 5 (Basic Education), Lucknow, dated 21.10.2024. It also follows a decision of the district selection committee meeting held on 26.09.2026, with the District Magistrate's permission. The vacancies for Classes 6 to 8 follow Government Order No. 1553/68-5-2020 dated 11 December 2020.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on merit. A candidate's merit score is worked out from her marks as follows: Applicants for Office Superintendent/Clerk take a computer typing test in Hindi and English at NIC. At the time of selection, the certificates of teaching and non-teaching staff are verified with the board or institution that issued them. The honorarium is paid only after this verification.

rows.merit_marks: Percentage of marks in theory and practical x 30/100

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract for the academic session 2026-27. The Care Taker, Peon, Chowkidar, Cook and Assistant Cook posts are full-time, and these staff must stay at the school. The district selection committee may change or correct the notice, or cancel it at any time, and candidates have no claim against this.

faq.question: Q1. Can male candidates apply?
faq.answer: No. All posts in both vacancy tables are reserved for women candidates.

faq.question: Q2. How many Lab Assistant and Cook posts are there?
faq.answer: The upgraded KGBVs have 27 Lab Assistant posts and 25 Cook posts. The KGBVs for Classes 6 to 8 also have 03 Assistant Cook posts, all for EWS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay for PGT and Principal posts?
faq.answer: PGTs get a fixed honorarium of Rs. 22,000 a month and Principals get Rs. 30,000 a month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Principal post?
faq.answer: She must be 30 to 45 years old on 01.04.2026, with at least 04 years of experience teaching Classes 9 to 12.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: She needs Intermediate, a computer qualification (such as CCC, or Computer Science as a subject in High School or Intermediate), and computer typing speeds of 25 wpm in Hindi and 30 wpm in English. The typing test is held at NIC.

faq.question: Q6. Is TET needed for the Physical Education teacher post?
faq.answer: No. Candidates with B.P.Ed, C.P.Ed or D.P.Ed do not need TET for the part-time Physical Education post.

faq.question: Q7. How is the merit list made?
faq.answer: The merit list uses weighted percentages: High School and Intermediate count for 10 each, graduation and postgraduation for 20 each, and training for 30.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for two posts with one form?
faq.answer: No. Each post needs a separate application, and the post name and subject must be written on each envelope.

faq.answer: Yes for the Care Taker, Peon, Chowkidar, Cook and Assistant Cook posts. Academic staff of the upgraded schools do not have to stay overnight.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three posts are temporary contract appointments. Annexure 1 of the notification sets out the service and pay conditions. It says these conditions are indicative only, and that changes decided by the KSRTC SWIFT management from time to time will apply. Monthly pay is Rs. 30,000/- for the Front Office Manager Cum Multi-Tasking-Technical Supervisor, Rs. 15232/- + EPF + ESI for Housekeeping Staff and Rs. 15842/- + ESI + PF for Security Staff. EPF/ESI benefits are applicable to employees. KSRTC SWIFT service conditions apply equally to people selected from outside on a daily-wage basis and to people taken from KSRTC on working arrangement. Staff engaged in KSRTC-SWIFT must be ready to work under service and pay conditions that the Swift governing body revises from time to time. They must sign a contract with KSRTC-SWIFT for this. Staff must work according to company decisions on the duty system, pay and administration, as issued from time to time. KSRTC SWIFT does not have to appoint everyone on the rank list. Appointments from the rank list are subject to conditions, and no one can make a claim against KSRTC SWIFT over them. Staff may wear only the uniform prescribed by the company. Staff must treat passengers as guests and behave politely and courteously. They must look after passengers' safety and put passengers' convenience first in any situation. Staff must give special consideration to passengers who need special attention, such as senior citizens, women travelling alone and differently abled people. An employee is fully responsible if leave taken for flimsy reasons, unnecessary absence or late reporting leads to a cancelled service, a curtailed trip or a late departure. Employees who stay away from work permanently will be removed without notice and will not be re-engaged. Their security deposit will not be refunded. If complaints about an employee's conduct keep turning the public against KSRTC SWIFT services, and an inquiry finds the employee guilty, the caution deposit will not be refunded. If the company's loss is more than the caution deposit, the company will take action, including revenue recovery.

content_sections.heading: KSRTC SWIFT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Visit the KSRTC bus depots where Swift buses are deployed. Submit detailed reports to the officers concerned on complaints and on steps to keep depot premises clean and free of waste. Supervise the repair and maintenance of equipment fitted in Swift buses, such as cameras, entertainment systems and LED destination boards. Monitor the cleaning of Swift buses at the various depots, make sure it is done efficiently and submit a report. Travel on buses as per the schedules given by KSRTC SWIFT, talk to passengers, and note and report any shortcomings or irregularities. After each trip on the buses, prepare an inspection checklist and submit it to the Swift office. Give visitors the guidance they need. Look after the cleanliness, security and basic facilities of the office building. Bring needed repairs to the attention of the section concerned and report to the superior officer. Arrange repairs and servicing so that computers, printers, furniture, air conditioners and other office equipment keep working. Collect these complaints and report them on time to the unit heads or officers concerned: complaints about bus or depot cleanliness; passenger feedback; staff behaviour towards passengers; irregularities in bus schedules; illegal activities against passengers. Handle HR work for Swift employees serving in the various KSRTC units. Bring salary, duty, working-condition and other service issues to the attention of the authorities concerned. Pass management orders and instructions on to employees, and pass employees' views and suggestions on to superiors. Encourage employees who give excellent service, and build their commitment to the company and team spirit. Organise awareness programmes for staff on how to behave with passengers, customer service and road safety. Carry out marketing campaigns, as directed by the department heads, to introduce and promote new transit technology (such as apps or contactless payment) and new schemes to the public. Do any work that KSRTC SWIFT Ltd assigns from time to time. Do all cleaning work. This includes basic daily cleaning, cleaning restrooms and toilets, removing waste, washing and shampooing carpets and mats, and washing and cleaning utensils, walls, glass and windows. Clean these areas at proper intervals throughout the day: office floors, cabins, cubicles, corridors, steps and staircases, both sides of the office building, the parking area, conference halls, the board room, doors, windows, rooms, toilets, mirrors and washbasins. Wipe window glass clean on both the inside and the outside. Sort all waste and collect it in bins in the prescribed way. Hand over inorganic waste to the Haritha Karma Sena at proper intervals, collect and process organic waste, and keep waste-paper baskets and bins clean. Respond to every office need positively, politely and promptly, and do all duties professionally and respectfully. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KSRTC SWIFT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in before 5 pm on 2 November 2026. Applications sent any other way will not be accepted for any reason. The notification asks candidates who are willing to work on a daily wage under the conditions in Annexure 1 to apply online. Self-attested copies of certificates proving educational qualification Self-attested copies of certificates proving work experience Self-attested copies of certificates proving age A passport-size photo Original documents: interview candidates must show these to the committee at certificate verification Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) from the police station where the candidate lives: selected candidates must produce it within 10 days Medical certificate of physical fitness from a medical officer not below the rank of Civil Surgeon: selected candidates must produce it before KSRTC SWIFT Limited at the time of appointment

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be checked closely and a shortlist prepared. For all three posts, shortlisted candidates must pass an interview held by a selection committee set up for the appointment. KSRTC SWIFT Limited reserves the full right to shortlist only a limited number of candidates for a written test, group discussion, proficiency test or interview, as suits the post. Shortlisting is based on marks in the qualifying examination and/or relevant years of work experience. Admission to any stage of the selection process is provisional only. Applications and certificates will be verified in detail before the interview or appointment. If any discrepancy or false information is found, the candidature will be rejected. No travelling allowance or daily allowance (TA/DA) will be paid for attending the written test, proficiency test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications that are unclear or incomplete will be rejected. Any form of canvassing will lead to disqualification. If information given by a candidate is found to be false or fake at any stage, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled without prior notice. KSRTC SWIFT Limited reserves the full right to make, or not make, appointments to the advertised posts. Engagement depends only on vacancies, and no claim can be made against this. People appointed under this notification cannot claim a permanent appointment in KSRTC, KSRTC SWIFT or any other government institution on the strength of this service. These people should not apply: anyone dismissed after a regular appointment in KSRTC SWIFT, and anyone who left the job without authorisation after joining KSRTC SWIFT on contract. The company may remove, without notice, any employee who stays away permanently, breaks discipline or breaches the contract. A removed employee will not be re-engaged. Selected candidates must sign the prescribed agreement with KSRTC SWIFT. The company will take legal action, including removal from the job, against any employee who campaigns through social media or other media to defame the company.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical institute at Dhanwantri Nagar, Puducherry-6. These posts belong to an externally funded research project run by its Department of Emergency Medicine & Trauma. The Project Investigator (PI) is Dr Amaravathi U, Assistant Professor, and the funding agency is ICMR.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: B.Sc. Nursing (four-year course) with minimum second class or equivalent CGPA from a recognised university with registration in the State/Indian Nursing Council. Desirable: Experience in emergency, trauma, critical care or geriatric nursing; experience in clinical research and data collection; fluency in Tamil. Essential: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject/field, OR Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two years' experience in relevant subject. Desirable: Experience in research data management (MS Excel, REDCap/EpiData or similar software); proficiency in Tamil and English. The age limit for each post is counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. For both posts, there is a relaxation of up to 5 years for candidates with experience in a Government research organisation, as per ICMR norms. The qualification and experience must be in a relevant discipline or field and from a reputed institution or organisation. The experience must have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for both posts is a consolidated monthly amount that includes 20% HRA. No other allowances are paid. The notice adds that the consolidated salary may change from time to time. No other allowances or facilities are given apart from the consolidated salary.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Screen adults aged 60 years and above who come to the Emergency Department with trauma to check their eligibility, and assess frailty using the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS). Obtain informed consent from patients or their legally acceptable representatives (LAR) as per the approved protocol, in Tamil and English. Activate and coordinate the frailty-triggered co-management pathway with the emergency, trauma and geriatric teams, and record time-stamped process measures. Perform daily delirium screening (CAM-ICU) and record clinical data in the Case Record Forms. Provide counselling on transitional care before discharge and make warm referrals. Carry out the community contact 7 to 14 days after discharge and the 90-day structured follow-up by telephone and field/home visits. Work in rotational shifts, including nights, Sundays and holidays, as required by the project. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. Data entry, cleaning and management of the study database; maintain Case Record Forms and study records. Extract time-stamped process data from the Hospital Information System; maintain follow-up schedules and tracking logs. Assist with telephone follow-up, report preparation, procurement records and other administrative work for the project. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. For both posts, the duties listed are indicative and not exhaustive. Project staff must carry out any work the PI assigns in the interest of the project, including shift duty, field visits and administrative tasks. Refusing assigned work will be treated as unsatisfactory performance and may lead to termination of the engagement without notice. The application form says the project involves field visits for patient follow-up in Puducherry and neighbouring districts.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted using the details in their application, their CV and the documentary proof they provide. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Final selection will be based on the CV, the application and a written test/interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. If there are a very large number of applications, stricter criteria than those listed may be used to decide eligibility. The Project Investigator's decision will be final. After the application forms are evaluated, the notice lists these stages: The interview may be held in person or by videoconferencing, at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For a video interview, candidates are responsible for having a suitable device (computer, laptop or mobile) with audio and camera and a good internet connection. The date and time of the interview will be announced one week in advance. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The notification prescribes relevant academic qualifications, an NCTE-recognized teaching qualification and a qualifying Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for the upper-primary level. Subject combinations and recognized alternative qualifications vary by post. For the standard academic subjects, the notification generally specifies a Bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks in the relevant subject or a Postgraduate degree with at least 45% marks, along with B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognized course and the prescribed TET qualification. Certain subjects have additional or different conditions. content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Haryana Police Telecommunication Wing has announced engagement of 170 Special Police Officers . content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The attached terms specify 10+2 or equivalent qualification from a recognized board as the minimum educational requirement. Applications are invited from the following categories: Ex-servicemen of the Armed Forces. Ex-servicemen of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs). Former Constables of the disbanded Haryana State Industrial Security Force (HSISF). Former Constables of the disbanded Haryana Armed Police (HAP) Battalions. Preference will be given to candidates experienced in operating and maintaining telecommunication equipment, particularly those who have served in the Signal Corps of the Armed Forces or CAPFs. The attached terms specify the following requirements: A minimum of five years of service in the Armed Forces/CAPFs. Candidates must not have been removed or dismissed from service on grounds of indiscipline, misconduct or medical unfitness. The medical category at the time of discharge should be Category A. The character certificate at discharge should be marked Exemplary or Outstanding. The document does not separately explain how the five-year service requirement applies to former Constables of the disbanded HSISF/HAP Battalions. Those applicants should confirm the applicable conditions with the recruiting authority.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Special Police Officers will receive a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs. 20,000 . The amount will be deposited directly into their bank accounts. The uniform allowance is intended for two sets of uniforms, shoes and other prescribed uniform articles. No travelling or daily allowance will be provided merely for appearing for document submission or interview. The attached terms provide the following compensation benefits under the prescribed circumstances. These benefits are subject to the circumstances and conditions prescribed in the attached engagement terms.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The attached recruitment conditions explicitly state that no written examination or physical test will be conducted for engagement as a Special Police Officer. Eligible candidates will be considered through the prescribed scrutiny and verification process. Submission of application and documents in person. Scrutiny of eligibility and relevant service records. Verification of educational qualifications, age and supporting certificates. Character and antecedent verification by the concerned district police authority. Medical examination before appointment. Issuance of appointment letter to selected candidates. Candidates meeting the prescribed service and telecommunication experience criteria may receive preference under the recruitment conditions. Final engagement will depend on eligibility and verification.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Engagement Duration and Training
content_sections.text: The engagement is for one year or until regular appointments are made, whichever is earlier , according to the attached terms. Selected SPOs will undergo a 15-day orientation course to familiarize themselves with the requirements of the Haryana Police Telecommunication Wing. This engagement does not constitute an appointment to a permanent regular police post.

content_sections.heading: Haryana Police SPO Posting Details
content_sections.text: The attached recruitment conditions state that SPOs will not be posted at their home police stations. Preference may be given for posting in the candidate's home district, subject to vacancy availability. SPOs may be deployed elsewhere in Haryana for short periods during emergencies. Deployment will be governed by the requirements of the Haryana Police Telecommunication Wing.

Important: Candidates must attend personally. Incomplete applications or applications received after the prescribed date for the respective district will not be entertained.

Armed Forces/CAPF/HSISF/HAP service and discharge records, as applicable. Service enlistment and discharge dates. Medical category certificate at discharge. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham for various postdoctoral research fellow, Research Trainee, Robotics Engineer and More positions across multiple engineering disciplines at their Coimbatore campus in Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available in this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 83 vacancies available for various Postdoctoral Research Fellow positions, with one vacancy allocated for each specialization.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for these positions is 31 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the AI in Power and Energy Systems post?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, along with demonstrated expertise in machine learning, deep learning, or data science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification needed for the Hydrology/Water Resources fellowship?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Post-Doctoral Research Fellow in Hydrology/Water Resources must have a Ph.D. degree in Water Resources Engineering, Hydrology, or other closely related fields.

faq.question: Q6. Are there positions available for Civil Engineering specializations?
faq.answer: Yes, vacancies include a Postdoc Position in Construction Materials requiring a Ph.D. in Construction Materials or allied fields, and a Post-Doctoral Research Fellow in Transportation/Pavement Engineering.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these fellowships?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham job portal, and applications can also be submitted by email to the designated address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type and location for these roles?
faq.answer: These positions are offered on a contract job type basis, and the successful candidates will be posted at Coimbatore in the state of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to these Postdoctoral Research Fellow positions at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to submit my application?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham at https://www.amrita.edu to access the portal and complete your online application process.

basic_details.short_information: SCL describes itself as the only Integrated Device Manufacturing Facility in the country providing end-to-end solutions for the development of Application Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs), opto-electronics devices and Micro Electro Mechanical System (MEMS) devices, covering design, fabrication, assembly, packaging, testing and reliability assurance. application_fee.group_a_fee: Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Purchase & Stores Officer
application_fee.details: The examination fee has two parts: a non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 600 for all posts and an application fee. All candidates initially pay the full examination fee (refundable plus non-refundable) for each post. The application fee is refunded only to candidates who appear in the Computer Based Test and are exempted from the application fee, that is, Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen. | The fee must be paid online. The last date for fee payment is 30.11.2026 (17:00 Hrs.). Candidates can pay the fee immediately after submitting the application or on any day before the last date. Refunds are made to the bank account entered in the application, so Bank Name, Branch, Name of Account Holder, Account Number and IFSC must be entered correctly. SCL is not responsible for refund issues caused by incorrect bank details. Applicable service charges, if any, are borne by the applicant. Do not click the REFRESH or BACK button during payment processing, otherwise the session will be aborted. Payment status can be checked, and the receipt printed, on the portal after 24 hours of making or attempting payment. For technical issues with online payment, candidates may write to [email protected]. SCL is not responsible for incomplete, pending or failed fee transactions.

age_limit.details: The age limit is calculated as on the closing date for receipt of online applications (30.11.2026). | Date of Birth filled in the online application and recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate will be accepted for determining age, and no later request for change will be considered. Ex-servicemen who have already secured Group ‘C’ or ‘D’ civil employment on a regular basis after availing the re-employment reservation benefit are not eligible for ESM reservation and fee concession, subject to the exception explained in the notification (OM No. 36034/1/2014-Estt (Res) dated 14.08.2014 of DoP&T). The “Call up Service” period of an ex-serviceman is treated as service rendered for age relaxation. Age relaxation and ESM reservation are not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of ex-servicemen. | A matriculate ex-serviceman with at least 15 years of service is considered eligible for the ESM-reserved Group ‘C’ vacancies. Non-graduate ex-servicemen who have not completed, or will not complete within one year of the closing date, 15 years of service are not eligible, and such ESM candidates are not eligible for Group ‘B’ posts. Serving servicemen must have acquired, or be able to establish by documentary evidence that they will acquire, ex-serviceman status within one year from the closing date.

qualification.details: The essential qualification and experience for each post are given below as per the notification. | Note from the notification: Candidates possessing an MBA degree other than those mentioned above are not eligible to apply. Experience should be in the relevant fields such as Administration/Accounts & Finance/Purchase & Stores activities in a Government office, a public body or a commercial organization of repute. Where supervisory experience is mentioned, it should be at least in Level 6 of the Pay Matrix (pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs. 9300-34800 with Grade Pay of Rs. 4200) or the candidate should have at least a CTC of 10 LPA. Candidates should also possess good communication skills, leadership qualities and familiarity with computers. | For all Technical Assistant posts (SCL 2605-01 to 2605-11), the post qualification experience is 2 years after the qualification in an R&D institute / reputed organization / industry, as per the requirement of the post to be filled. | For every Technician ‘B’ trade (SCL 2606-1 to 2606-12), the essential qualification is either (a) Matriculation/SSLC plus 2 years ITI from recognized NCVT institutions in the relevant trade, OR (b) Matriculation/SSLC plus a course completed as per the National Apprenticeship Certificate / National Trade Certificate in the relevant trade. Candidates with equivalent qualifications must produce an Equivalence Certificate from the authorities concerned. The result of the qualifying examination must have been declared on or before the cut-off date; mere processing of the result by the University/Institute by that date does not satisfy the requirement. | Candidates with higher qualification and/or experience than the minimum may be called for the Written Test / Skill Test / Personal Interview, but this gives them no edge over other adequately qualified candidates. The selection process depends on the post. In every case
the final selection is subject to meeting the advertised eligibility criteria and to merit in the Computer Based Test (CBT) and interview
wherever applicable. A Common Merit List is prepared and offers of appointment are issued in order of merit.
The CBT is objective type (MCQ) with a total duration of 120 minutes
made up of two parts of 60 minutes each. Each right answer carries 1 mark and each wrong answer carries a negative mark of 0.25. Compensatory time is available for eligible PwBD candidates.
Qualifying marks: 50% in Part A and Part B together for the UR category

and 40% in Part A and Part B together for PwBD categories against notified reserved vacancies. Candidates are shortlisted for the interview in the ratio of 1:5 with a minimum of 10 candidates to the category-wise number of vacancies. Qualifying in the written test alone does not automatically entitle a candidate to an interview. Interview qualifying marks: 50% for the UR category and 40% for the PwBD category against notified reserved vacancies. The weightage of CBT marks and interview marks is 60:40 for panel generation. If sufficient PwBD candidates are not available
relaxation in standards of selection is extended as per extant norms
with no relaxation in the qualification norms.
The CBT has a single part (Part A) of 60 minutes with the same four subjects
25 questions and 25 marks each
and the same marking scheme (1 mark for each right answer
minus 0.25 for each wrong answer). Compensatory time is available for PwBD candidates.
Qualifying marks in the CBT: 50% for UR
45% for OBC (NCL)
and 40% for SC/PwBD/ESM against notified reserved vacancies. Selection is based on CBT marks only

subject to qualifying in the skill test. Candidates are shortlisted for the skill test in the ratio of 1:5 with a minimum of 10 candidates to the category-wise number of vacancies. Skill test: a shorthand test of 800 words at 80 words per minute (10 minutes). The passage is to be transcribed on a computer in 50 minutes for English and 65 minutes for Hindi
with compensation time for PwBD candidates. Shorthand must be as per Pitman’s shorthand; long hand is not permitted
failing which the transcript is not evaluated. Full mistakes include every omission
substitution or addition of a word or figure. Half mistakes include wrong spelling (including transposition or omission of letters)
using singular for plural or vice versa

and use of a small letter at the beginning of a sentence. Mis-spelling of proper nouns and unfamiliar names is ignored. Total mistakes in a single word cannot exceed one full mistake. Percentage of errors = (Full Mistakes + Half Mistakes/2) x 100 divided by the number of words in the master passage
rounded off to two decimal places. Maximum mistakes allowed: 10% for the UR category and 12% for reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies.

syllabus.details: The notification gives an indicative syllabus for the CBT. The key topics are summarized below; the full lists are on pages 22 to 28 of the notification. | General Intelligence & Logical Ability: verbal and non-verbal questions such as analogies, classification, series, coding-decoding, problem solving, Venn diagrams, drawing inferences, pattern folding and unfolding, embedded figures, critical thinking, emotional intelligence and social intelligence. General Knowledge / Current Affairs: general awareness of the environment and its application to society, current events, everyday observations in their scientific aspect, and India and its neighbouring countries, especially History, Culture, Geography, Economic Scene, General Policy and Scientific Research. Quantitative Aptitude: whole numbers, decimals, fractions, percentage, ratio and proportion, averages, interest, profit and loss, discount, partnership, mixture and alligation, time and distance, time and work, algebraic identities, geometry (triangles, circles, quadrilaterals, polygons), mensuration, trigonometry, heights and distances, and statistical charts. General English: vocabulary, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms and antonyms, spot the error, fill in the blanks, idioms and phrases, one word substitution, sentence improvement, active/passive voice, direct/indirect narration, sentence shuffling, cloze passage and comprehension passage. | Administrative Officer: Human Resources Management; Office Management; Government Rules (CCS conduct rules, Leave Rules, Pension Rules, TA Rules, LTC Rules, CCS (CCA) Rules 1965, Seniority, Promotion, Quarter Allotment, Pay Fixation, Confirmation and Probation, Counting of Past Services); Constitution of India including Reservations in Govt. Service; Code on Social Security 2020; Industrial Relations Code 2020; Apprentices Act 1961; Code on Wages 2019; Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code 2020; Official Secrets Act 1923; Emotional Intelligence and Managerial Effectiveness; Organizational Structure Design and Change; General Financial Rules 2017; Fundamental Rules & Supplementary Rules; Medical Attendance Rules & CGHS; Provident Fund Rules, NPS; Legal proceedings; Employee Grievance Management System; Right to Information Act 2005; CPGRAMS; Constitution of Internal Complaints Committee: POSH Act 2013. Purchase & Stores Officer: Procurement Process (complete procurement cycle); GeM procedures; Vendor Management; Inventory & Store Management; Import and Export Policy and Procedures; Duties and Taxes (Central and State); Contract Act and Sale of Goods Act; Supply Chain; General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017; Indian Contract Act 1872. Accounts Officer: Financial Accounting; Principles of Auditing; Costing; Management Accounting; Payment and Receipt Rules; Excise & Customs; Tools of Financial Analysis and Planning; Delegation of Financial Power Rules (DFPR); Mercantile Law; Taxation (Direct and Indirect Taxes, GST Act, GST TDS, Income Tax); Civil Contracts payments; Accounting Standards; Basics of Economics; National Pension Scheme, Provident Funds, Old Pension Scheme; Companies Act 2013; Contract Act. | Electrical: Electrical Materials, Electricity and Magnetism, Electrical Engineering Drawing, Estimation & Costing, Electrical Circuit Analysis, Electrical Machines, Electrical Power Engineering, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Electronics & Micro Processor. Mechanical: Applied Mathematics, Engineering Drawing and CAD/CAM/CIM, Solid Mechanics and Machine Design, Fluid Mechanics and Hydraulic Machines, Thermal and Heat Transfer and Refrigeration & Air-conditioning, IC Engines, Engineering Materials, Production Engineering and Industrial Engineering. Electronics: Electrical Machine, Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electrical Power, Electrical Circuit and Analysis, Electronics Component and Device, Digital Electronics, Microcontroller, Microprocessor and Peripheral devices, Control System, Electrical and Electronics Instrumentation and Measurement, Industrial Electronics and Control, Engineering Materials, Maintenance and Repair of Electrical & Electronics Equipment. Instrumentation: Applied/Engineering Mathematics, Electronic components, devices and circuits, Electrical Measurements and calibration, Industrial Instrumentation and Measurement of Process variables, Sensors and transducers, Control System and Process controllers, Analog and Digital Electronics, Micro Processors and Micro controllers, Basics of PLC and DCS, Programming in C Language. Computer Science: Fundamentals of Computer, C/C++ and PHP Programming, Object Oriented Programming Principles, Data Structures and Algorithms, DBMS and SQL Queries, Operating Systems, Software Engineering, Computer System Organisation, Computer Networks, Web Technologies, Python, Digital Electronics/Switching Theory, Logical Devices. content_sections.heading: SCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility depends on the post applied for. The notification lists the following general conditions: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. A candidate cannot apply for more than one post among the Administrative Posts (SCL 2601 to SCL 2604). A candidate can apply for both Technical posts, Technical Assistant (any one of 11 disciplines) and Technician ‘B’ (any one of 12 trades), considering one trade per post. Separate applications must be submitted and a separate examination fee paid for each post. Age and essential qualifications are counted as on the closing date, 30.11.2026. Experience must have been obtained after acquiring the essential educational qualification. The eligibility criteria are the minimum requirement. Meeting them does not automatically make a candidate eligible for the Computer Based Test. The applicant should not have any criminal record or any legal case contemplated against him/her. Candidates with a spouse living, or who have married a person with a living spouse, are disqualified, unless exempted by the Central Government under the conditions stated in the notification.

content_sections.heading: SCL Recruitment 2026 Qualification
content_sections.text: The essential qualification and experience for each post are given below as per the notification. Note from the notification: Candidates possessing an MBA degree other than those mentioned above are not eligible to apply. Experience should be in the relevant fields such as Administration/Accounts & Finance/Purchase & Stores activities in a Government office, a public body or a commercial organization of repute. Where supervisory experience is mentioned, it should be at least in Level 6 of the Pay Matrix (pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs. 9300-34800 with Grade Pay of Rs. 4200) or the candidate should have at least a CTC of 10 LPA. Candidates should also possess good communication skills, leadership qualities and familiarity with computers. For all Technical Assistant posts (SCL 2605-01 to 2605-11), the post qualification experience is 2 years after the qualification in an R&D institute / reputed organization / industry, as per the requirement of the post to be filled. For every Technician ‘B’ trade (SCL 2606-1 to 2606-12), the essential qualification is either (a) Matriculation/SSLC plus 2 years ITI from recognized NCVT institutions in the relevant trade, OR (b) Matriculation/SSLC plus a course completed as per the National Apprenticeship Certificate / National Trade Certificate in the relevant trade. The post qualification experience is 2 years in an R&D institute / reputed organization / industry, as per the requirement of the post to be filled. Candidates holding qualifications from Open and Distance Learning mode must produce the approval of the Distance Education Bureau, UGC for the relevant period at the time of Document Verification. Candidates with equivalent qualifications must produce an Equivalence Certificate from the authorities concerned. The result of the qualifying examination must have been declared on or before the cut-off date; mere processing of the result by the University/Institute by that date does not satisfy the requirement. Candidates with higher qualification and/or experience than the minimum may be called for the Written Test / Skill Test / Personal Interview, but this gives them no edge over other adequately qualified candidates. Candidates must mention their graduation course name clearly, for example B.A. (Honours) or B.Sc.

content_sections.text: The age limit is calculated as on the closing date for receipt of online applications (30.11.2026). The “Call up Service” period of an ex-serviceman is treated as service rendered for age relaxation. Age relaxation and ESM reservation are not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of ex-servicemen. A matriculate ex-serviceman with at least 15 years of service is considered eligible for the ESM-reserved Group ‘C’ vacancies. Non-graduate ex-servicemen who have not completed, or will not complete within one year of the closing date, 15 years of service are not eligible, and such ESM candidates are not eligible for Group ‘B’ posts. Serving servicemen must have acquired, or be able to establish by documentary evidence that they will acquire, ex-serviceman status within one year from the closing date.

content_sections.heading: SCL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The examination fee has two parts: a non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 600 for all posts and an application fee. All candidates initially pay the full examination fee (refundable plus non-refundable) for each post. The application fee is refunded only to candidates who appear in the Computer Based Test and are exempted from the application fee, that is, Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen. The fee must be paid online. The last date for fee payment is 30.11.2026 (17:00 Hrs.). Candidates can pay the fee immediately after submitting the application or on any day before the last date. Refunds are made to the bank account entered in the application, so Bank Name, Branch, Name of Account Holder, Account Number and IFSC must be entered correctly. SCL is not responsible for refund issues caused by incorrect bank details. Applicable service charges, if any, are borne by the applicant. Do not click the REFRESH or BACK button during payment processing, otherwise the session will be aborted. Payment status can be checked, and the receipt printed, on the portal after 24 hours of making or attempting payment. content_sections.heading: SCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process depends on the post. In every case, the final selection is subject to meeting the advertised eligibility criteria and to merit in the Computer Based Test (CBT) and interview, wherever applicable. A Common Merit List is prepared and offers of appointment are issued in order of merit. The CBT is objective type (MCQ) with a total duration of 120 minutes, made up of two parts of 60 minutes each. Each right answer carries 1 mark and each wrong answer carries a negative mark of 0.25. Compensatory time is available for eligible PwBD candidates. Qualifying marks: 50% in Part A and Part B together for the UR category, and 40% in Part A and Part B together for PwBD categories against notified reserved vacancies. Candidates are shortlisted for the interview in the ratio of 1:5 with a minimum of 10 candidates to the category-wise number of vacancies. Qualifying in the written test alone does not automatically entitle a candidate to an interview. Interview qualifying marks: 50% for the UR category and 40% for the PwBD category against notified reserved vacancies. The weightage of CBT marks and interview marks is 60:40 for panel generation. If sufficient PwBD candidates are not available, relaxation in standards of selection is extended as per extant norms, with no relaxation in the qualification norms. The CBT has a single part (Part A) of 60 minutes with the same four subjects, 25 questions and 25 marks each, and the same marking scheme (1 mark for each right answer, minus 0.25 for each wrong answer). Compensatory time is available for PwBD candidates. Qualifying marks in the CBT: 50% for UR, 45% for OBC (NCL), and 40% for SC/PwBD/ESM against notified reserved vacancies. Selection is based on CBT marks only, subject to qualifying in the skill test. Candidates are shortlisted for the skill test in the ratio of 1:5 with a minimum of 10 candidates to the category-wise number of vacancies. Skill test: a shorthand test of 800 words at 80 words per minute (10 minutes). The passage is to be transcribed on a computer in 50 minutes for English and 65 minutes for Hindi, with compensation time for PwBD candidates. Shorthand must be as per Pitman’s shorthand; long hand is not permitted, failing which the transcript is not evaluated. Full mistakes include every omission, substitution or addition of a word or figure. Half mistakes include wrong spelling (including transposition or omission of letters), using singular for plural or vice versa, and use of a small letter at the beginning of a sentence. Mis-spelling of proper nouns and unfamiliar names is ignored. Total mistakes in a single word cannot exceed one full mistake. Percentage of errors = (Full Mistakes + Half Mistakes/2) x 100 divided by the number of words in the master passage, rounded off to two decimal places. Maximum mistakes allowed: 10% for the UR category and 12% for reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies. The CBT has Part A (60 minutes; General English, Quantitative

faq.question: Q1. What is SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SCL Recruitment 2026 is the recruitment drive by Semi-Conductor Laboratory (SCL), under MeitY, Government of India, through Advertisement No. SCL:DR:01/2026. It covers Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Purchase & Stores Officer, Junior Personal Assistant, Technical Assistant and Technician ‘B’ posts on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post-wise tables list 83 vacancies in total: 12 Administrative posts, 30 Technical Assistant posts and 41 Technician ‘B’ posts. The notification does not state a combined total.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the fee is 30.11.2026 (17:00 Hrs.). The application starts on 01.11.2026 (11:00 Hrs.).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It varies by post. Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer and Purchase & Stores Officer need a graduate/post graduate degree (or the specified MBA/CA/ICWA) with supervisory experience. Junior Personal Assistant needs 12th pass with the dictation and transcription speeds mentioned. Technical Assistant needs a first class 3-year diploma or the specified first class B.Sc./BCA degree. Technician ‘B’ needs Matriculation/SSLC with ITI/NCVT or NAC/NTC in the trade. Technical Assistant and Technician ‘B’ also need 2 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit as on 30.11.2026 is not exceeding 35 years for Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer and Purchase & Stores Officer; not exceeding 25 years for Junior Personal Assistant; 18 to 30 years for Technical Assistant; and 18 to 27 years for Technician ‘B’. Relaxation is available for the categories listed in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total examination fee is Rs. 1,500 for Group A posts (Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Purchase & Stores Officer), Rs. 1,300 for Technical Assistant and Rs. 1,200 for Junior Personal Assistant and Technician ‘B’. This includes a non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 600. The application fee is refunded to eligible Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates who appear in the CBT.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Visit www.scl.gov.in/career.html between 01.11.2026 and 30.11.2026, register, fill in the application form, upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and certificates (each up to 50 KB), pay the examination fee online and print the registration confirmation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer and Purchase & Stores Officer are selected through a Computer Based Test and Personal Interview. Junior Personal Assistant is selected through a Computer Based Test and a Stenography Skill Test. Technical Assistant and Technician ‘B’ are selected through a Computer Based Test and a trade-wise Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary in SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The initial basic pay is Rs. 56,100 (Level 10) for Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer and Purchase & Stores Officer, Rs. 25,500 (Level 4) for Junior Personal Assistant, Rs. 44,900 (Level 7) for Technical Assistant and Rs. 21,700 (Level 3) for Technician ‘B’. The approximate total emoluments per month are Rs. 1,06,740, Rs. 48,780, Rs. 83,700 and Rs. 41,940 respectively, as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for SCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The present posting is at SCL, S.A.S. Nagar (Mohali), Punjab. SCL reserves the right to post candidates anywhere in India as per requirement/public interest.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR IARI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), New Delhi-110012, is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR). This recruitment is for its Division of Environmental Sciences. The posts serve the Division's project on the impact assessment and valorisation of iron ore tailing into a mineral-rich, crop-safe soil conditioner for agri-application (Code 79-241).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice offers 7 temporary project positions in two posts. Only candidates who meet the minimum essential qualification will be allowed to appear in the walk-in interview. Essential: B.Sc. (Agriculture), OR BSc. in any discipline of science (medical) with at least six months' research experience after the BSc. Desirable: Experience in field/lab experimentation/microbiology research and data entry. Maximum age: 45 years. Pay: Rs. 30,000 fixed per month. Essential: 12th Pass. Desirable: Work experience on farming and agricultural farm management practices. Maximum age: 45 years. Pay: Rs. 22,000 fixed per month. The desirable qualification is used for scoring only. Candidates who have that experience should bring a certificate of experience. The maximum age limit is 45 years for both posts. The Annexure-I application form asks for the candidate's age as on the interview date (14 December 2026). Eligible candidates get the relaxation only if they provide self-attested documents at the walk-in interview. Both posts carry a fixed monthly payment, Rs. 30,000 for YP-I and Rs. 22,000 for Laboratory cum field Attendant. These are temporary positions under project Code 79-241. The appointment is for one year but may be extended. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. rows.minimum_essential_qualification: B.Sc. (Agriculture) or BSc. (in any discipline of science (medical); with minimum six months' research experience, Post BSc.)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: There is no online or postal application. Candidates bring their application in person to the walk-in interview on 14 December 2026. Fill in the prescribed application form, Annexure-I, printed in the notice. Write the post you are applying for in the "Application for the position of" line. Paste an attested passport size photograph on the form and sign it. Fill in the form's details: name, father's name, date of birth, age as on 14 December 2026, permanent address with PIN code, mobile number, e-mail, sex, marital status and category (SC/ST/OBC/General). Give your educational qualifications from 10th onwards, your work or professional experience, your publications (only published or accepted research papers), your NOC if it applies, and additional information such as a brief note on how you can contribute to the project. Then sign the self-declaration. Fill in the Annexure-II declaration about relatives employed in ICAR/IARI. Candidates whose relative is an ICAR/IARI employee must submit it in advance. All other candidates hand it in at the interview. To apply for both posts, fill in a separate application for each post and mark each one clearly "Application for post of YP-I/Lab cum Field Attendant". Bring the application and your documents to the venue on 14 December 2026 and register between 9.30AM and 11.00AM.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The filled application form in the prescribed Annexure-I format, with photograph and signature The filled Annexure-II declaration form, unless already submitted in advance Self-attested photocopies of the Xth, XIIth, B.Sc, M.Sc and Ph.D mark sheets and degree certificates, as applicable Proof of date of birth Experience certificates, including a certificate of experience for the desirable qualification Proof of training and dissertation, where applicable Original documents for verification A No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your present employer, if you are working elsewhere Self-attested documents for an age relaxation (SC/ST, women, OBC), if you claim one

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration: Registration at the venue is open strictly from 9.30AM to 11.00AM on 14 December 2026. Only applications in the prescribed Annexure-I format are accepted. Document verification: At registration, your self-attested photocopies are checked against the original documents. Eligibility check: Only candidates who meet the minimum essential qualification appear in the interview. Working candidates without an NOC from their present employer will not be registered. Interview: The desirable qualification (experience) is used for scoring only. The decision of the Interview Committee is final and binding on the applicant.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: An application without a photograph and signature is liable to be rejected. Your candidature or appointment may be cancelled or rejected without notice if any information is found false, incorrect or incomplete, or if you are found ineligible at any time before or after the interview or selection (Annexure-I declaration). Your candidature is liable to be cancelled if the Annexure-II information about relatives in ICAR/IARI is found incorrect or you conceal facts.

It is for a likely duration of 1 year and pays a consolidated Rs 33,600 per month, including HRA. important_dates.exam_date: To be notified (one week in advance)

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on the last date of receipt of applications (5 November 2026). The application form asks for your age on that date in years, months and days.

qualification.details: 12th Pass in Science Subjects and BSc Nursing or its equivalent Registered Nurse with any State Nursing Council Fluency (speaking, reading and writing) in Tamil, because the project involves interaction with patients and taking their consent

how_to_apply: Print the application form attached to the notice (REC-03: Application Format) on A4 paper and fill it in block letters with a blue pen.
Affix a recent passport-size photo in the space provided. Do not staple it.

Complete every part of the form: personal details, any SC/ST/OBC status (attach proof), the criminal case or disciplinary action question, Tamil and other language proficiency, educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards, previous employment, a description of your experience in up to 500 words, research experience or publications, willingness to travel, contact details of previous employers, and the signed declaration.
Scan the filled form together with your CV and supporting documents into one PDF.
Name the PDF in the format "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (the notice's example is "James_DEO_2023_application").
Email the PDF to [email protected], with the name of the post applied for (Project Nurse) in the email subject line.
Send the complete application by 5 November 2026, up to 5 pm.
A candidate applying for two or more different posts must fill in a separate application form for each post and send each one, scanned with its enclosures, in a separate email.
All certificates must be self-attested and attached in this order (checklist in the application form):
Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License)
Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent or High School Certificate)
Degrees/Diplomas
Experience certificates
Any others (if relevant; specify)
Proof of prior research experience, if any

The form also asks for self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, proof of SC/ST/OBC status where claimed, PDFs of proof of work for previous employment, and details of any criminal case or enquiry if the answer to that question is yes. You must give the contact details of previous employers, and the notice asks you to tell those people that JIPMER may call them.
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Incomplete applications, and applications from candidates who do not meet the essential criteria, are likely to be summarily rejected. Applications with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Giving wrong or false information at any stage, or canvassing of any kind, will lead to disqualification. If it is found after engagement, it may lead to termination. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the nature of work and responsibilities as: Collection of blood samples, and information from patient records Data collection from patients Data entry in the database Helping in management of inventory of consumables The application form also says the project work involves travel to the field or to other centres for the study. Applicants must state whether they are willing to do this.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Nurse
content_sections.text: Print the application form attached to the notice (REC-03: Application Format) on A4 paper and fill it in block letters with a blue pen. Affix a recent passport-size photo in the space provided. Do not staple it. Complete every part of the form: personal details, any SC/ST/OBC status (attach proof), the criminal case or disciplinary action question, Tamil and other language proficiency, educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards, previous employment, a description of your experience in up to 500 words, research experience or publications, willingness to travel, contact details of previous employers, and the signed declaration. Scan the filled form together with your CV and supporting documents into one PDF. Name the PDF in the format "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (the notice's example is "James_DEO_2023_application"). Email the PDF to [email protected] , with the name of the post applied for (Project Nurse) in the email subject line. Send the complete application by 5 November 2026, up to 5 pm. A candidate applying for two or more different posts must fill in a separate application form for each post and send each one, scanned with its enclosures, in a separate email. All certificates must be self-attested and attached in this order (checklist in the application form): Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent or High School Certificate) Degrees/Diplomas Experience certificates Any others (if relevant; specify) Proof of prior research experience, if any The form also asks for self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, proof of SC/ST/OBC status where claimed, PDFs of proof of work for previous employment, and details of any criminal case or enquiry if the answer to that question is yes. You must give the contact details of previous employers, and the notice asks you to tell those people that JIPMER may call them.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted on the details given in the application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection will be based on the CV, the application and a written test/interview. Evaluation stages: after the application forms are evaluated, the notice lists the recruitment process as a written test, a skill test and an interview. It does not give the areas each stage will cover. Shortlisting: only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. If the number of applications is very large, stricter criteria than those listed may be used to decide eligibility. Interview mode: the interview may be held in person or by videoconferencing, at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For a video interview, each candidate must arrange a suitable device (computer, laptop or mobile) with audio and camera, plus an adequate internet connection. Schedule: the date and time of the written exam and interview will be notified one week in advance. The decision of the Project Investigator will be final.

content_sections.heading: Uttarakhand Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Personnel may be deputed to various forest divisions of Bhagirathi Circle (Narendra Nagar Forest Division, Tehri Forest Division, Uttarkashi Forest Division, Tehri Dam-I Forest Division, Tehri Dam-II Forest Division, and Soil Conservation Forest Division) to provide technical assistance to respective DFOs, SDOs, and field staff. Key duties include: Field visits of proposed ANR, CAT Plans, Eco Restoration Works, and GIM Research Work plots from time to time. Preparation of site-specific plans for all sites as prescribed in the annual plan for the next Silvicultural year. Preparation of maps and other required data for site-specific plans. Conducting surveys such as Rapid Mapping Exercise, rootstock calculation, and carbon stock calculation for prescribed plots. Providing technical and scientific assistance in tree marking according to working plan rules and guidelines. Establishing sample plots, demarcating boundaries, and recording baseline data on soil, species diversity, regeneration status, and environmental factors. Identifying and marking seed bearer trees with paint. Identifying and demarcating photo and video points for long-term monitoring. Maintaining research journals with survey and monitoring data, budgetary provisions, works, and photographs. Monitoring ongoing intervention works and submitting reports to the Conservator of Forests (CF), Bhagirathi Circle. Identifying plots suitable for monitoring by time-lapse cameras for phenological studies. Sampling and assessing natural regeneration in old plots using secondary data. Conducting training and workshops for frontline staff to upgrade technical skills. Performing critical analyses of intervention plots vis-à-vis field results and suggesting gap-filling measures. Identifying long-term monitoring indicators and preparing annual monitoring reports. Any other forestry or wildlife activities assigned by higher officials. Data Entry & Processing: Enter, digitize, and update official records, beneficiary lists, and government files into state databases and portals. Office Applications & Documentation: Draft letters, official memos, tables, and reports using MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and basic database software. G2C (Government-to-Citizen) Assistance: Help citizens and visitors register for online government schemes, complete digital applications, and process utility/administrative requests. System & Equipment Maintenance: Operate and maintain office computers, printers, scanners, and peripherals; troubleshoot minor software or hardware glitches and coordinate with IT support for major issues. Record Keeping & Filing: Maintain physical and digital logbooks of daily data entry work, correspondence, and system downtime.

followed by the Services Selection Board (SSB) interview
medical examination and final merit list. The final merit list is based on SSB marks
subject to medical fitness
eligibility and vacancy availability.

Application Shortlisting: The Indian Army will shortlist applicants based on JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List and the prescribed cut-off. SSB Interview: Shortlisted candidates will undergo a five-day SSB assessment. Medical Examination: Candidates recommended by the SSB will undergo a medical examination at a military hospital. Final Merit List: Merit will be prepared based on marks obtained in the SSB interview. Joining Letter: Medically fit candidates will receive joining instructions according to merit
eligibility and available vacancies.

The TES-57 SSB interviews are tentatively expected between February and March 2027. The SSB assessment is conducted over five days and consists of two stages. Candidates who do not clear Stage I are sent back on the same day.
The SSB assessment includes evaluation by psychologists
Group Testing Officers and Interviewing Officers.
Selection centre allocation and interview instructions will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through the registered email address
SMS and official recruitment system.
The TES-57 final merit list is prepared on the basis of SSB marks. Higher academic qualifications
previous performance and NCC background do not provide additional merit-list weightage. Final joining depends on medical fitness
the candidate's merit position
fulfillment of eligibility conditions and available vacancies.

Review all entries and submit the application before the closing deadline.
Retain the submitted application details for further recruitment stages.
