content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, secured at least 60% aggregate marks in these three subjects and appeared in JEE Main 2026. The entry is open to unmarried male candidates who satisfy the prescribed nationality, age and medical standards. Must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized education board. Must have studied Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM). Must have secured a minimum aggregate of 60% marks in PCM. The PCM percentage is calculated using Class 12 marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Must have appeared in JEE Main 2026. Yes. Appearing in JEE Main 2026 is mandatory for TES-57. The Indian Army will shortlist eligible applicants using the JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List (CRL). Meeting the Class 12 PCM percentage requirement alone does not guarantee an SSB interview call. The 60% requirement applies to the aggregate marks obtained in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics in Class 12. Candidates must enter their actual PCM percentage up to two decimal places without rounding it off. The notification allows unmarried male candidates who satisfy the prescribed nationality requirements, including: Citizens of India. Subjects of Nepal. Eligible persons of Indian origin who migrated from the countries listed in the notification with the intention of permanently settling in India. Certain candidates require a Government of India eligibility certificate. The notification provides an exemption from this certificate requirement for Gorkha subjects of Nepal. The entry is restricted to unmarried male candidates. Selected candidates must undertake not to marry until they complete the training programme. A candidate who marries after applying will not be selected for training, even if successful in the selection process. Marriage during training can lead to discharge and recovery of the prescribed training expenditure.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026 is 16 years 6 months to 19 years 6 months as on 1 July 2027. Candidates must have been born between 1 January 2008 and 1 January 2011, with both dates included. Age Proof: The date of birth recorded in the Matriculation or Class 10 certificate, or the accepted equivalent certificate, will be used. Changes to the recorded date of birth are not permitted.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for Indian Army TES 57 begins with shortlisting based on JEE Main 2026 CRL, followed by the Services Selection Board (SSB) interview, medical examination and final merit list. The final merit list is based on SSB marks, subject to medical fitness, eligibility and vacancy availability. Application Shortlisting: The Indian Army will shortlist applicants based on JEE Main 2026 Common Rank List and the prescribed cut-off. SSB Interview: Shortlisted candidates will undergo a five-day SSB assessment. Medical Examination: Candidates recommended by the SSB will undergo a medical examination at a military hospital. Final Merit List: Merit will be prepared based on marks obtained in the SSB interview. Joining Letter: Medically fit candidates will receive joining instructions according to merit, eligibility and available vacancies. The TES-57 SSB interviews are tentatively expected between February and March 2027. The SSB assessment is conducted over five days and consists of two stages. Candidates who do not clear Stage I are sent back on the same day. The SSB assessment includes evaluation by psychologists, Group Testing Officers and Interviewing Officers. Selection centre allocation and interview instructions will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through the registered email address, SMS and official recruitment system. The TES-57 final merit list is prepared on the basis of SSB marks. Higher academic qualifications, previous performance and NCC background do not provide additional merit-list weightage. Final joining depends on medical fitness, the candidate's merit position, fulfillment of eligibility conditions and available vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Training Period 2027
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo four years of integrated military and engineering training. The programme consists of three years at a Cadets Training Wing and one year at the Indian Military Academy, Dehradun. Candidates who successfully complete the four-year training programme will be awarded an Engineering degree. Candidates recommended by the SSB must submit preferences for all three Cadets Training Wings. Final allocation is decided by the Indian Army.

On successful commissioning as a Lieutenant, they become eligible for the Level 10 pay scale of Rs. 56,100–1,77,500 and applicable allowances. The advertised annual CTC is an approximate figure and is not the same as guaranteed monthly take-home salary. Promotion to higher ranks is subject to the relevant service conditions and selection requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Indian Army TES 57 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply online through the official Indian Army recruitment portal between 14 October and 12 November 2026. The application window closes at 12:00 noon on the last date. Visit the official Indian Army recruitment website at https://joinindianarmy.nic.in/ . Open the online application section for 10+2 Technical Entry Scheme - 57. Read the TES-57 notification and application instructions carefully. Complete the online application with the required personal and educational details. Enter the correct date of birth as recorded in the accepted Class 10 certificate. Enter the actual Class 12 PCM aggregate percentage up to two decimal places without rounding off. Provide the required JEE Main 2026 application details. Review all entries and submit the application before the closing deadline. Retain the submitted application details for further recruitment stages. After the application window closes, download and print the system-generated application form as instructed. Important: Candidates should submit only one application. Multiple applications by the same candidate may result in cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Application Correction and Printout Instructions
content_sections.text: The Army permits candidates to correct application details before the online application window closes. After the final submission process, changes are not permitted under the notification's instructions. Check and correct all application entries before the deadline. Resubmit the application after making permitted changes. The application printout becomes available approximately 30 minutes after the application window closes. Print two copies of the application form carrying the system-generated roll number. Carry one self-attested copy to the SSB interview and retain the other for personal reference. Do not send a hard copy of the application to the Directorate General of Recruiting.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TES 57 Documents Required for SSB Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must carry the required documents for verification at the SSB interview. The notification specifies original certificates and self-attested photocopies. The original documents will be returned after verification at the SSB. Candidates must follow any additional instructions included in their SSB call-up letter.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The recruitment process involves two stages. Stage I consists of a Written Test / OMR / CBT comprising objective-type multiple-choice questions covering General Knowledge, General Science, General Mathematics, General English, Official Language, Professional Knowledge, Reasoning, and Aptitude. The duration is 60 minutes with a 1/3rd negative marking for incorrect answers and a qualifying percentage of 40%. Candidates qualifying Stage I are called for Stage II in a 1:5 ratio, which involves an assessment of talent comprising a practical demonstration in the applied discipline (35 marks) and testimonials/prizes in the applied discipline (15 marks).

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Take chest X-rays for TB screening with handheld or mobile X-ray equipment, following the set protocols, radiation safety standards and infection prevention practices. Provide X-ray services during Active Case Finding (ACF), Passive Case Finding (PCF), outreach activities, screening camps, health melas and special drives, as the District TB Officer (DTO) directs. Label X-ray images correctly and upload or transfer them on time through the designated digital platform so they can be read and acted on. Work with Medical Officers, STS, STLS, TB Health Visitors and other field staff on referral, sputum or sample collection and follow-up of people identified as presumptive TB. Keep accurate records and send daily reports to the DTO or NTEP district team: people screened, X-rays taken, activity location and type, presumptive TB cases, referrals and other indicators. Maintain the X-ray equipment, keep it ready for use and report any malfunction, damage, shortage or technical problem straight away. Help the DTO plan and map X-ray-based TB screening activities, and help validate, reconcile and report screening data. Attend NTEP training, review meetings and monitoring activities, and follow the technical, radiation safety, confidentiality and patient privacy rules. Coordinate with the three Directorates at district level and with Block Medical Officers to plan and run camps. Operate HHX Ray units in Active Case Finding campaigns among high-risk and hard-to-reach populations, and make sure screened people are linked to diagnosis and treatment services. Do any other TB screening, diagnosis and case-finding work that the District TB Officer or District Health Officer assigns.

content_sections.heading: AUD Psychotherapist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: M.A. in Psychology with at least 55% marks or an equivalent GPA from a recognized university. M.Phil in Clinical Psychology / M.Phil in Psychoanalytic Psychotherapy / M.Phil in Psychotherapy and Clinical Thinking, or post-master's training, degree or diploma with specialization in psychotherapy, clinical practice or counselling. At least two years of experience in clinical practice / psychotherapeutic work and/or counselling in the field of mental health, at public or private institutions, universities, hospitals, clinics or NGOs. Internships done as part of an academic programme do not count as valid work experience. You must hold the essential qualifications as on the closing date of application. Ph.D. in Clinical Psychology / PsyD (Doctor of Psychology) / Ph.D. with demonstrable interest in psychodynamic and psychoanalytical work. Experience in teaching and supervising trainee counsellors, psychotherapists or clinical psychologists. Evidence of research or publications in psychotherapy or clinical practice. Well-developed sensitivity, empathy, regard and in-depth understanding of the human psyche. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: Psychometric screening of first-year batches of all programmes to identify psychologically vulnerable students, through a Mentor-Mentee System, a Buddy System and other preventive mechanisms. Psychotherapy and clinical counselling for students. Clinical supervision, administrative and organisational work, and community mental health work. Intellectual and practice-based processes and activities. Adopting and implementing a uniform mental health policy, drawing on the UMMEED Draft Guidelines, the MANODARPAN initiative and the National Suicide Prevention Strategy. Consistent, informal and confidential support to students, especially during examinations and academic transitions. Protocols for immediate referral to mental health services, local hospitals and suicide prevention helplines. Training teaching and non-teaching staff in psychological first aid, spotting warning signs, responding to self-harm and making referrals. Training teaching, non-teaching and administrative staff to work with students from vulnerable and marginalised backgrounds in a sensitive, inclusive and non-discriminatory way. Confidential, accessible mechanisms for reporting, redressing and preventing sexual assault, harassment, ragging and bullying on the basis of caste, class, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion or ethnicity, and psycho-social support to victims. Sensitisation programmes (physical and/or online) for parents and guardians on student mental health. Adding mental health literacy, emotional regulation, life skills and awareness of support services to orientation programmes and co-curricular activities. Keeping anonymised records and preparing an annual report on wellness interventions, referrals, training sessions and mental health activities. Regular career counselling for students and parents that is inclusive and sensitive to socio-economic and psychological contexts, plus structured academic planning and mechanisms for monitoring and accountability. Any other duties assigned by the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: IoP Scientific Assistant-B (Electronics) Job Description
content_sections.text: The incumbent will be primarily associated with the Ion Beam Laboratory (IBL) and will provide electronics and instrumentation support for its accelerator and experimental facilities. Development, assembly, testing and maintenance of analog/digital electronics, instrumentation, power supplies and control systems. Development and integration of electronics for detectors, experimental setups, data-acquisition and computer-controlled instrumentation. FPGA/microcontroller programming and interfacing, wherever required. Troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, repair and preventive maintenance of electronic and instrumentation equipment. Operation, maintenance and upgrading of electronics and instrumentation associated with the Ion Beam Laboratory and other experimental facilities. Providing electronics/instrumentation support, including repair and maintenance, to other experimental laboratories of the Institute as required. Assisting faculty members, scientific/technical staff and students in the development, installation and operation of experimental systems. Maintaining appropriate technical documentation, equipment records, spares and inventory related to assigned systems. The post involves hands-on scientific and technical work. The selected candidate may be required to work in the Ion Beam Laboratory, other experimental laboratories and associated service areas and, depending upon operational requirements, beyond normal working hours/shifts. Any other scientific/technical duties assigned by the Competent Authority according to the requirements of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Superintendent and Junior Engineer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 32 years for all three posts. Your age is checked against the date of birth on your 10th certificate or birth certificate. No other document is accepted. Nationality: Indian nationals can apply, including Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs). Essential: First class Bachelor's degree with 6 years of experience in relevant area, OR Post Graduate with 4 years relevant experience. Desirable: Experience in Establishment Matters, Finance and Accounts, Audit, RTI, Stores and Purchase, Administration, Academic matters, Legal matters etc. in Central Government/State Government/Central Govt. Autonomous Bodies/Central University/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/IIITs etc. Essential: Degree in Engineering in relevant field with 02 years experience, OR Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. Desirable: Experience in civil engineering works in Central Government/State Government/Central Govt. Autonomous Bodies/Central University/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/IIITs etc. The notice lists building construction and maintenance, estimation and costing, BOQ and quantity surveying, site supervision, infrastructure development, water supply and sanitation, STP/drainage systems, preparation and interpretation of drawings, contract/work management, quality control, CPWD/PWD specifications, horticulture, basic plumbing and carpentry maintenance, and campus infrastructure maintenance. Essential: Degree in Engineering in relevant field with 02 years experience, OR Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. Desirable: Experience in the same types of government bodies listed above. The notice names electrical installation and maintenance, LT/HT distribution systems, transformers, substations, DG sets, UPS and power backup systems, electrical panels and cabling, lighting, earthing, fire alarm/ELV systems, central air-conditioning and HVAC systems, VRF/VRV systems, chillers, AHUs, FCUs, cooling towers, ventilation, ducting, pumps, thermostats and associated control systems, estimation and costing, electrical safety, statutory compliance, contract/work management, and campus electrical infrastructure maintenance. Your qualifications must come from a recognised Board, University or Institute. If you claim an equivalent qualification, you must show proof at document verification. If your university has no CGPA conversion formula or definition of First Class, 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA counts as First Class. Only full-time experience counts, and any single period shorter than six months is ignored. Experience certificates must be on official letterhead, signed by the Competent Authority, and must show your designation and pay level or pay. Qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date of online submission. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates get relaxation as per Government of India norms for reserved posts. Contractual and outsourced employees of IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their continuous service in an equivalent post

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee checks every application. If it asks you for more documents or clarifications, you get three working days to send them. The provisional shortlist is posted on the Institute website, and you then have three working days to raise any grievance by email. Admit cards are sent through the portal or to your registered email, usually at least 21 days before the exam. All tests are held at IIIT Pune, Talegaon, and no TA/DA is paid. The Civil syllabus covers building materials, concrete technology, building construction, estimating and valuation, contracts, surveying, geotechnical, transportation, environmental and structural engineering, RCC design and GFR (Works). A waitlist panel may be kept for one year.

faq.question: Q1. Is a diploma holder eligible for the IIIT Pune Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes. You need a Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. With a Degree in Engineering in the relevant field, 02 years of experience is enough.

faq.question: Q2. How many Junior Superintendent vacancies are there for each category?
faq.answer: There are six: UR-3, OBC-NCL-2 and SC-1. The Junior Engineer (Civil) and Junior Engineer (Electrical) posts have one UR vacancy each.

faq.question: Q3. What counts as first class for the Junior Superintendent post?
faq.answer: If your university does not define First Class or give a conversion formula, 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA is treated as First Class.

faq.question: Q4. Do I have to send a hard copy after applying online?
faq.answer: Yes. The signed, self-attested set must reach the Registrar at PO - Talegaon, Pune - 410507, by 09 December 2026, 05:30 PM. Eligibility is decided on this hard copy.

faq.question: Q5. Is there negative marking in the written exam?
faq.answer: Yes. Every wrong answer loses 1/4 mark, for all three posts.

faq.question: Q6. Do JoPT marks count in the final merit?
faq.answer: For Junior Engineer posts, yes: Stage-I (50) and JoPT (50) are added to make 100. For Junior Superintendent, the JoPT is only qualifying at 50%, and merit is based on the 100-mark written exam.

faq.answer: Up to 5 years, for regular employees with at least 3 years of continuous regular service in the same line or an allied cadre. Contractual or outsourced staff at IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their service there, up to 10 years.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for both Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but each post needs its own application and fee. For example, a UR candidate pays ₹1,180 per post.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the probation period?
faq.answer: One year. It can be extended before you are made regular.

content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Job Description
content_sections.text: Communication and Analytics Manager Build and document data pipelines (ETL) that consolidate data from MIS, ERP, HR, academic and finance systems into an analytical layer. Integrate and maintain academic and administrative datasets of the Institute. Develop and maintain dashboards and periodic reports for institutional decision-making covering academic performance and programme outcomes. Prepare data submissions and analyses for statutory and ranking exercises (NIRF, AISHE, QS, THE, AICTE) and reporting. Design and execute exploratory and confirmatory analyses to answer specific questions. Any other relevant task assigned by the Advisor/ Dean (CDO) from time to time. Junior Multimedia Specialist Assist in the creation of multimedia content for the Institute, including posters, brochures, social-media creatives, event publicity materials, photography, videography, and basic video editing for official communication channels. Support the Communication and Analytics Manager in managing digital content archives, data collection, and assisting in the scheduling and dissemination of content across social media platforms.

content_sections.heading: TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year in every discipline. TNPDCL can increase or decrease the number of vacancies, whatever figure the notification gives. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwD follows the guidelines under the Apprentices Act. If you claim reservation, you must provide a certificate in the Government standard format. Without it, you will be treated as a 'General' category candidate. BC/MBC candidates who claim the OBC (Non-creamy layer) category must bring an OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format from the certificate issuing authority. Up to 10% of the vacancies are reserved (horizontal reservation) for wards of regular (permanent) employees of TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO. Wards of contract, temporary, casual or retired employees cannot use this quota. Ward quota places that are not filled will go to other available candidates under the usual procedures. content_sections.heading: TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: As per the Apprenticeship Rules. Domicile and year of passing: You must be from Tamil Nadu and must have passed your engineering diploma in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or May 2026. Minimum educational qualification (Category - I Technician (Diploma) Apprentices), any one of: A Diploma in Engineering or Technology (Regular - Full time) in the relevant discipline, granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education set up by a State Government. A Diploma in Engineering or Technology (Regular - Full time) in the relevant discipline, granted by a University. A Diploma in Engineering and Technology granted by an institution that the State Government or Central Government recognises as equivalent to the above. Candidates with higher qualifications (B.E / B.Tech. and above) are not wanted for Diploma Apprentice selection. Previous training or experience: You cannot apply if you have already done, or are now doing, an apprenticeship under NATS 2.0 / NAPS (Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973) or PMIS Internship Training. You also cannot apply if you have one year or more of work experience. Physical standards: As set out in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rule 1992 and any later amendments. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: BOAT (SR) draws up a shortlist from the online application data. It is based on your percentage of marks in the basic qualification for your discipline. Intimation: Shortlisted candidates are told by email, at the email address they registered on the portal. Certificate verification: Shortlisted candidates must attend certificate verification at the TNPDCL office. The shortlist goes up on nats.education.gov.in . To find it, go to the bottom of the home page, then Regional Events, then BOAT (Southern Region), then Apprenticeship News. The notice asks students to check there every day.

content_sections.heading: Training Conditions
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year, as per the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973. When the apprenticeship ends, TNPDCL (TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO) has no obligation to offer you a job. Finishing the apprenticeship does not give you a right to employment. No TA / DA is paid for attending certificate verification, and no boarding or lodging expenses are paid. Incomplete or wrong online applications, and applications received after the due date, will be rejected. No further communication about them will be entertained. Canvassing or putting pressure through any source will disqualify you. Your name will be removed from the records without notice. BOAT (SR) has not authorised any person or organisation to coordinate or liaise its work, so beware of touts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The steps depend on whether you are already registered on a National Web Portal. Go to https://nats.education.gov.in , click Student, then Student login, then Forgot Password. Enter your registered email id. You will get an activation link to reset your password. Log in with your registered email id and new password, and complete the application form. You will get a unique 12-digit Enrolment Number. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies", search for "TAMIL NADU POWER DISTRIBUTION CORPORATION LIMITED (TNPDCL)" and click Apply. Your status will show as "applied". Log in with your email id and password. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies", search for "TAMIL NADU POWER DISTRIBUTION CORPORATION LIMITED (TNPDCL)" and click Apply. Your status will show as "applied". Go to https://nats.education.gov.in , click Student, then Student Register. Complete the application form. You will get a unique 12-digit Enrolment Number (ATN...). Log in with your email ID and password. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies", search for "TAMIL NADU POWER DISTRIBUTION CORPORATION LIMITED (TNPDCL)" and click Apply. Your status will show as "applied". Percentage of marks is mandatory: Enter your diploma percentage, as shown on your Diploma Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet, in the "% of marks" column on the NATS portal. If you leave it out, your application will not be considered. Diploma Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet Community certificate in the Government standard format (SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwD), or an OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format for BC/MBC candidates claiming OBC (NCL) For ward quota candidates: the Ward Certificate in the Annexure 'A' format, filled in and signed with seal by the officer, plus a copy of the parent's ID card Ward candidates also apply through the student login. They do not need to send a hard or soft copy of the Ward Certificate to BOAT (SR) or to any TNEB / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO office. They show it only at certificate verification. For clarifications or to check your student enrolment, write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible local candidates living within 16 km of Narora Atomic Power Station get first preference, subject to the reservation rules. If there are not enough eligible local candidates in a category, candidates from outside the area are considered on merit. The shortlist is based on the percentage of marks in the respective trade or discipline. If two candidates have the same percentage, the one born earlier ranks higher. If the date of birth is also the same, the candidate with the higher Matriculation (10th) percentage ranks higher. Candidates graded in CGPA, GPA, SGPA or letter grades must submit the conversion table issued by their institute. If the institute has no conversion formula, NPCIL uses the following equivalents:

content_sections.heading: Training Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of training: Narora Atomic Power Station, Narora, PO NAPS Township, Distt. Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh - 203389. Duration: a maximum of 12 months for all three types of apprentice. Each apprentice signs a contract of apprenticeship with NPCIL under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. The contract ends when the training period ends. Apprentices who stay away from training may have to refund the whole cost of their training, meaning the stipend received, as decided by the Central Apprenticeship Advisor. NAPS is a highly protected area, so apprentices are engaged only after they submit a Police Verification Certificate issued by the District Police Authorities. No hostel or transport is provided. NPCIL is not obliged to offer a job to anyone who completes the training, and apprentices are not obliged to accept one. Completing the apprenticeship gives no right to claim a job at NPCIL. Management may cancel or change the number of seats in any trade or discipline, or cancel the whole process, without giving reasons. Seats may stay unfilled if there are not enough suitable candidates.

content_sections.heading: About CSIR-CMERI CoEFM
content_sections.text: The CSIR-CMERI Centre of Excellence for Farm Machinery was set up in 1965 as an extension centre of the Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute, Durgapur. It works under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), an autonomous body under the Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. The centre is on Gill Road, Ludhiana, and its current research priority is Smart Farm Machines and Technologies.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected by a walk-in interview before a Selection Committee. They can choose Hindi or English as the language for the interview. The selection process may continue until late evening or into the next day. Candidates who do not meet the eligibility criteria at any stage, during the process or later, will have their candidature cancelled without any reason being given. The decision of CSIR-CMERI on selection is final, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for project work in R&D projects at the centre's laboratories, and it is co-terminus with the project. The tenure shown for each post may be extended or curtailed. It lasts until the project ends or the requirement ends, whichever is earlier, and never beyond a maximum of six years. Offers of engagement depend on the availability of funds and approval by the Competent Authority. No TA/DA is paid for attending the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: DCPU Saran Support Person Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be older than 30 years and younger than 65 years. Age is counted as on 1 July 2026. The notice states that the age limit fixed for selecting members of the Child Welfare Committee in the state applies. You need one of the following: A postgraduate degree in Social Work (MSW), Sociology, Psychology, Child Development or Law; or A graduate degree in any discipline with a diploma in Child Rights or Counselling, plus three years of work experience. The notice treats at least three years of work in one of these fields as desirable: child rights, child protection, legal work, child psychology counselling, sociology or psychology. Preferred: experience with a District Legal Services Authority, a District Child Protection Unit, a Child Welfare Committee, a Juvenile Justice Board, a POCSO court or Childline services. You must be a citizen of India. You must be a resident of Saran district. Your record must be clean. No criminal case may be registered against you anywhere in India, and you must never have been found guilty of moral turpitude. You must submit an affidavit confirming this. You must not have been dismissed or blacklisted by any organisation working in child protection or child development. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A selection committee chooses candidates on the basis of their educational qualification and an interview. The interview date will be posted on the notice board of the District Child Protection Unit, Saran and on saran.nic.in . The guidelines on Support Persons' service and duties will be posted in the same places. The list of candidates eligible for interview and the panel list will also be published on the website and the office notice board.

content_sections.heading: About SAIL Bokaro Steel Plant
content_sections.text: Bokaro Steel Plant in Bokaro, Jharkhand, is a plant of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL). The notice describes SAIL as a Maharatna Public Sector Enterprise and India's leading steel-making company. Bokaro General Hospital (BGH), where these doctors will work, is a 910-bedded multispecialty hospital run by SAIL.

content_sections.heading: SAIL Bokaro Specialist and GDMO Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: B stands for backlog. Vacancies reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are included within these numbers; the official notice gives the break-up. Post-paid CUG SIM, covering monthly call charges, rental and taxes up to Rs. 350 a month for MBBS doctors and Rs. 500 a month for MBBS doctors with a PG Diploma or Degree in a speciality. Non-SAIL doctors can take company accommodation (2 BHK or equivalent) on payment if they want it, subject to availability. Rent, electricity and water are charged at the rates SAIL employees pay for that category of quarter. Former SAIL employees up to E-7 grade may keep their allotted company accommodation during the engagement, subject to availability, by paying the rent, electricity and water charges. Former employees above E-7 grade, or those holding designated or earmarked accommodation, can only be considered for the accommodation an E-7 executive gets. Medical benefits: former SAIL employees keep the medical benefits they already have as ex-employees. Other doctors get medical benefits for themselves and their spouse at the unit hospital only, and only if their previous organisation does not provide them. No referrals to outside hospitals are allowed. 10 days of leave a year, with prior approval. Maternity leave is given under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961. No HRA is paid. content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The doctors will work in different departments of Medical and Health Services (M&HS) as needed and do the work assigned to them. The minimum is 8 hours a day, six days a week, or 48 hours a week. Doctors who work fewer hours are paid on a pro-rata basis, and the monthly rate cannot go above the maximum for their category.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview. Medical screening. The engagement starts as soon as selection is complete and engagement orders are issued. All certificates are checked only at the walk-in interview, and candidates who cannot produce them will not be interviewed. BSL may engage fewer doctors than advertised, reject any application or cancel the whole process without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The first engagement is for one year or until the doctor turns 70, whichever comes first. The Company may extend it one year at a time, up to a maximum of 3 years under the same contract. Re-engagement is allowed, within the age limit. Performance is reviewed every year. Based on that review, the tenure may be cut short or extended. Either side can end the contract with one month's notice. The company can end it for poor performance, moral turpitude, conviction by a court, insolvency, loss of licence to practise, grave misconduct or financial irregularity, or long-term medical unfitness. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis and gives no right to regular appointment in BSL. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the courts at Bokaro Steel City, Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: AAI will select eligible candidates through document verification and interview. According to the official notification, candidates must secure a minimum of 50 marks in the interview for selection based on merit ranking. Document Verification: Verification of educational qualifications, experience certificates and other prescribed documents. Interview: Assessment of eligible candidates based on the requirements of the relevant consultant position. Merit-Based Selection: Selection based on interview merit ranking, subject to the prescribed minimum of 50 marks. The document verification and interview schedule will be communicated later by AAI.

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Contract Period
content_sections.text: The initial consultant engagement will be for one year. The contract may be extended for another year at a time, subject to the applicable conditions, with a maximum cumulative engagement period of five years. The assignment is full-time, and selected consultants cannot undertake another assignment during their consultancy period. They will be engaged as independent consultants rather than regular AAI employees.

content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. It is located in the NCR Biotech Science Cluster on the Faridabad-Gurugram Expressway in Faridabad. The institute carries out translational research and builds research collaborations to turn concepts into products that improve human health. Its centres include the Centre for Maternal and Child Health, the Centre for Tuberculosis Research, the Centre for Bio-design and Diagnostics and the Clinical Development Services Agency. All the posts in this notice are under research projects of BRIC-THSTI.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Laboratory Operations & Instrumentation: Contributes to the establishment and operationalization of the bioanalytical laboratory, including development and implementation of analytical workflows, laboratory processes, and documentation systems. Operate, troubleshoot, and maintain LC-MS/MS and HPLC systems to ensure reliable analytical performance. Support instrument qualification, calibration, preventive maintenance, and performance verification of laboratory equipment. Maintain accurate laboratory records and ensure adherence to laboratory safety and good documentation practices. Provide routine supervision and technical guidance to junior analysts and laboratory staff. Oversee the maintenance of reference standards, reagent inventory, logbooks and lab notebooks. Bioanalytical Method Development & Validation: Prepare method development, validation, and analytical protocols for new projects after required literature search. Develop, optimize, and validate LC-MS/MS and HPLC methods for quantification of metabolites in biological matrices (e.g., plasma, serum, tissues). Generate analytical summaries, concentration datasets, and bioanalytical study reports in compliance with laboratory quality systems. Familiarity with common laboratory techniques, including gel electrophoresis, molecular assays, and serological assays. Experience in handling small animals, histopathology. Experience in isolating PBMCs and working knowledge of FACS. Familiarity with common laboratory techniques, including gel electrophoresis, molecular assays (PCR, rt-PCR), and serological assays (ELISA, multiplex antibody detection assays), Gene cloning, protein expression. Candidates having work experience in a BSL-3 (Biosafety Level 3) laboratory environment will be preferred. Preparation of recombinant plasmids. Preparation and culturing of Mycobacterium tuberculosis strains in the BSL-3 laboratory. Setting up biochemical, immunological and cell-based assays. Conduct laboratory tests, experiments, and analyses in support of SiB program objectives. Collaborate with researchers and scientists to perform various technical tasks. Maintain accurate records of experiments, data, and results. Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards in the laboratory. Provide support in the development and implementation of research protocols. To assist in any other works like fields/site visits related to projects or other scientific/ technical activities. Conducting/ handling pre-clinical animal studies, expert in cell culture, performing immunological Assays, FACS, Cell sorting etc., data analysis and report writing. Hands-on Experience in conducting/ handling animal studies, cell culture, molecular biology, microbiology, FACS and report writing.

content_sections.text: The selection process varies by post and is generally conducted in two or three phases, based on a total merit of 100 marks. A summary of the selection process for each post is given below. For posts with negative marking (Assistant Registrar and SDE Civil), 0.25 marks are deducted for each incorrect answer, and no marks are awarded or deducted for an unanswered question. For all other posts, no marks are deducted for an incorrect or unanswered question. Shortlisting for Physical Document Verification and subsequent stages is generally done in a post-wise/category-wise ratio of 1:5, based on merit determined from the Written Test and provisional Academic Achievement marks taken together. In case of a tie, candidates are ranked first by age (older candidate senior), then by alphabetical order of name, and finally by alphabetical order of father's name.

content_sections.text: AIIMS Nagpur describes itself as an apex healthcare institute set up by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY). It aims to correct regional imbalances in quality tertiary-level healthcare and to make the country self-sufficient in graduate and postgraduate medical education and training. content_sections.text: FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. Qualifications are counted as on the last date of submission of the application. The age limit for every post is "Upto 40 years". Age means completed age in years as on the last date of submission of the application. Reservation is as per Government of India rules. Essential: B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution. Or B.Sc in life sciences with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)]. Desirable: Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Essential: M.Sc Nuclear medicine technology from recognized university/institution. 5 years of experience as Nuclear Medicine technologist (B.Sc Nuclear Medicine or equivalent + 5 years experience). Desirable: RSO level II certification. Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Essential: M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution with 60% marks. Or M.Sc with minimum 60% marks from a recognized university/institution with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)] with minimum 50% marks. Experience required: 02 years' experience. Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Desirable: RSO level II certification. PhD in Nuclear medicine specialty. The notice says the prescribed qualifications are only the minimum: having them does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview or to selection. The candidate must not have been convicted by any Court of Law. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each post pays a consolidated monthly amount as shown in the vacancy table. The pay does not increase during the contract period. The emoluments are consolidated, as decided by the competent authority. The appointee does not get Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or any other benefit given to regular Government servants. The appointee also cannot claim allowances or facilities given to the regular/permanent faculty of AIIMS Nagpur. If extra duties are assigned, no additional allowance is paid for them. Paid leave may be allowed at 01 day for each completed month of service. The appointment is purely on contract for 11 (Eleven) Months, counted from the date of joining. It ends earlier if regular appointments are made against these posts or another arrangement is made. The contract may be extended, depending on the institute's needs and satisfactory performance. If it is not extended, it lapses automatically. The job cannot be regularized at any stage, and the appointee has no claim or right to regular appointment to any post of AIIMS Nagpur. Either side can end the appointment at any time with one month's notice or one month's salary. It can also be ended if the appointee fails to complete the first three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. The competent authority can also terminate it before the end of the tenure without giving a reason. The appointment is whole-time. The appointee cannot take any other assignment, paid or unpaid, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. An appointee who applies elsewhere or resigns within the first 03 (three) months will not get a No Objection Certificate, a Relieving Letter or an Experience Certificate. Appointment depends on medical fitness, certified by the competent medical board. On appointment, the appointee must take an oath of allegiance to the Constitution of India or make a solemn affirmation. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or written test, or for joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the AIIMS Nagpur website (aiimsnagpur.edu.in). If you are a General/OBC/EWS candidate, pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 1,000/- by NEFT into the bank account below. PwBD/SC/ST candidates are exempted from the fee. Fill in the application form and attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, testimonials and other documents. Send the application, the copy of the payment receipt and the certificate copies through the Google form (forms.gle/6YFqwBs9umvivtgs5). Make sure the application reaches AIIMS Nagpur by 05:00 PM on 10 November 2026. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Documents named in the notice: Application in the prescribed format Copy of the fee payment receipt (also "may bring" it to the interview) Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates/testimonials and other relevant documents All relevant original documents, for verification before the interview No Objection Certificate at the time of interview, for candidates working in Central/State Government, Semi Government or an Autonomous body (without it, the candidature may be rejected) For help or clarification, email [email protected] and put the name of the post you applied for in the subject line, or call 07103-295590.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on shortlisting, scrutiny of applications with document verification, and an interview. If a large number of applications is received, a screening test may be held to shortlist candidates for interview. Shortlisting: Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the basis of educational qualification, relevant experience and/or shortlisting criteria decided by the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur. Scrutiny and document verification: Before the interview, a duly constituted committee checks each application and verifies documents for qualification, experience, category, age and so on. Only candidates declared eligible after this check can appear for the interview. Interview: The interview will be held at AIIMS Nagpur, or at another place and in another mode if the Executive Director decides so. Candidates must score the minimum qualifying marks (suitability standard) set by the Selection Committee to be placed on the merit panel. Candidates below this standard will not be selected, whatever their merit position. Appearing for the interview does not give anyone a right to selection. The notice says this selection procedure is indicative and may be changed at the discretion of the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur. The decision of the Competent Authority on selection is final, and no representations will be entertained.

exam_pattern.details: General Studies (Objective Type): 1. General Science, 2. History of India, 3. Indian National Movement, 4. Indian Polity, Economy and Culture, 5. Indian Agriculture, Commerce and Trade, 6. Population, Ecology and Urbanisation (in Indian context), 7. World Geography and Geography and Natural Resources of India, 8. Current National and International Important Events, 9. General Intelligentsia, 10. Special Knowledge regarding Education, Culture, Agriculture, Industry, Trade, Living and Social Traditions of Uttar Pradesh. | General Hindi (Objective Type): (1) Opposites (10 words), (2) Sentences and Correction in framing (10 sentences), (3) One word for several words (10 words), (4) Same uses and same nature words (10 words), (5) A Noun as defined by an adjective and an adjective (10 words), (6) Synonymous words (10 words). | Paper-1, General Studies-I: | Indian History, Art and Culture: Indian Culture (art forms, literature and architecture from ancient to modern times); Modern Indian history (1757 to 1947): significant events and personalities; the Freedom Struggle; post-independence consolidation and reorganisation within the country (till 1965). Indian Society: Salient features of Indian society and culture; role of women, population and associated issues, urbanisation; liberalisation, privatisation and globalisation and their effects on social structure; social empowerment, social justice and inclusive growth. Geography of India: Physical, Economic and Human Geography of India; Geography of Uttar Pradesh (physical, human and economic aspects, and contemporary issues related to planning and development). Environment and Disaster Management: Environment concept, ecosystems, cycles and biosphere; man-environment relationship, pollution, degradation, conservation and Environment Protection Act; nature and types of disasters; disaster management cycle (Preparation, Rescue, Relief and Rebuilding), role of NDMA, NDRF and SDRF. Science and Technology: Developments and applications of science and technology in everyday life; India's science and technology policy; satellite communication, remote sensing, GPS, space technologies; IT industry, telecommunication; missile systems, UAVs, stealth technology, chemical and biological weapons; nanoscience and nanotechnology; robotics and artificial intelligence; nuclear power policy, nuclear energy applications, radiation, radioactive waste; biotechnology and microbiology, biopiracy, bioinformatics and ethical dimension in biotechnology. | Paper-2, General Studies-II: | Indian Polity and Constitution: Historical underpinnings, evolution, features, amendments, significant provisions and basic structure of the Constitution; role of the Supreme Court; functions and responsibilities of the Union and the States, federal structure, devolution of powers and finances up to local levels; role of the Finance Commission in Centre-State financial relations; Parliament and State legislatures. Governance: Structure, organisation and functioning of the Executive and the Judiciary; pressure groups; Public Interest Litigation (PIL); appointment to Constitutional posts; statutory, regulatory and quasi-judicial bodies including NITI Aayog; Government policies and interventions for development and Information Communication Technology (ICT). Economy and Agriculture: Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), manufacturing sector, energy scenario, means of transport; Government Budget and financial system, effects of liberalisation and globalisation, industrial policies, foreign trade; production of major crops, commercialisation of agriculture, manures, fertilizers, irrigation, storage, transportation and marketing of agricultural produce, e-technology for farmers; farm subsidies and minimum support prices, agricultural diversity, problems of agriculture in U.P., technology missions in agriculture. Ethics and Integrity: Ethics foundations and characteristics; ethical thoughts (Rit and Dharma, Purushartha, Yama, Niyama, Brahma-viharas, Utilitarianism, Deontological theory, Emotivism); attitude; aptitude and emotional intelligence. Current Affairs: Current affairs of regional, national and international importance including games and sports: Global, South Asia and SAARC, India, and Uttar Pradesh. | The Ethics and Integrity and Current Affairs topics appear under the label "Paper-IV" in the printed syllabus on page 8. Candidates should confirm their paper placement in the official PDF. | Paper-3, General Hindi and Writing (marks as printed): | Title of an unseen prose passage, explanation of three underlined parts and summary (5+15+10 = 30 marks) Summary of a given government letter in tabular form (10 marks); correspondence: official letter, semi-official letter, office order, circular, reminder, office memorandum, notification, noting and report (10+10 = 20 marks) Technical terminology (administrative and commercial): Hindi to English and English to Hindi translation (10+10 = 20 marks) Idioms and proverbs: meaning and use in sentences, only ten (10x3 = 30 marks) Grammar: noun, pronoun, adjective, case, verb (5x3 = 15 marks); punctuation (5 marks); correction of errors in spelling and in sentences (5+5 = 10 marks) Letters (vowels and consonants) and their classification (10 marks) Hindi word groups: tatsam, tadbhav, deshaj, videshi (10 marks); Hindi word formation: prefix, suffix, sandhi, samas (10 marks); Hindi word meanings: synonyms, antonyms, multiple-meaning words, one word for a phrase, homophones (20 marks) General knowledge of computers (10 marks) | Paper-4, Hindi Essay: The paper has two sections, and one essay must be written from each. First section (80 marks, 800 words): 1. Science, environment and technology; 2. Economic sector; 3. Agriculture, industry and trade; 4. Natural disasters (landslide, earthquake, flood, drought, etc.). Second section (120 marks, 1200 words): 1. Literature and culture; 2. Social and political sector; 3. National and international events; 4. National development plans and projects.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online through the O.T.R. based system. Applications sent through any other medium are not accepted. The online application is completed in four stages.
It is mandatory to complete One Time Registration (O.T.R.) and obtain an O.T.R. number before applying.
Candidates without an O.T.R. number must obtain it from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submitting the online application.
Only after obtaining the O.T.R. number can a candidate apply through https://uppsc.up.nic.in.

First Stage: On the Commission's website, click "ALL NOTIFICATIONS/ADVERTISEMENTS" and open the online advertisement (User Instructions, View Advertisement, Apply). Click "Apply" and then "Authenticate with O.T.R." and tick "Yes" or "No" for "Have You Completed Your O.T.R. Registration". If "Yes", enter the O.T.R. number, click "Proceed", and authenticate through the O.T.P. received on the registered mobile number/email ID or the O.T.R. password. Personal details from the O.T.R. are displayed automatically, and the candidate fills only the essential qualification required for the post. If "No", first obtain the O.T.R. number from the O.T.R. portal and then continue.

Second Stage: The Applicant Dashboard is displayed. Click "Submit Details" under "Application Part-2" against the applied post. The permanent and correspondence address and application form appear from the O.T.R., along with the preferential qualifications for the post. Choose Yes or No against each preferential qualification.

Third Stage: In the "Fee Confirmation Window", click "Yes" in front of "Proceed for fee payment". The SBI MOPS page opens with three modes of payment: Net Banking, Card Payments and Other Payment Modes. After payment, a "Payment Transaction Slip" is displayed and should be printed using the Printer Icon. If payment fails, log in through "Candidate Dashboard Login" with the O.T.R. number, authenticate, and click "Pending Payment" to pay the fee.

Fourth Stage: The application form is displayed on screen and its print should be taken and kept safely, as it must be produced in the Commission's office if any discrepancy arises. After applying, a candidate can modify the qualification details of the applied post only once through "Candidate Dashboard Login", until the last date for correction/modification.

On the final application page there is a Declaration. Clicking "I do not agree" drops the application. A Preview is available before final submission, and a successful submission report can be printed.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess all the requisite qualifications up to the last date for submitting applications. The Commission does not advise candidates about their eligibility. Candidates who are still appearing in the examination of the essential qualification are not eligible and need not apply. Qualification: Bachelor's degree, with specific requirements for some posts (see below). Age: 21 to 40 years on 01 July 2026, with relaxations. Marital status: Male candidates who are married and have more than one wife living, and female candidates who have married a person already having a wife, are not eligible unless the Hon'ble Governor has granted an exemption. Reservation and age relaxation: Candidates of reserved categories who are not permanent residents of U.P. are not given the benefit of reservation or age relaxation. Nationality: Not specified in the pages provided.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Qualification
content_sections.text: For the post of Samiksha Adhikari, candidates must have a Bachelor's degree from a University established by law in India, or a qualification recognised by the Government as equivalent, up to the last date for receipt of online applications. Some posts have specific educational qualifications, listed below. Candidates for posts with specific educational qualifications must give their options clearly. The notification gives three qualification entries for the Manager, Care-Taker and Receptionist (Swagati) posts of the U.P. Public Service Commission. The extracted text does not make clear which entry belongs to which post, so candidates should check the PDF (page 3). The entries are: Entry A: Bachelor's degree from a recognised University. Preferential qualifications: (a) one year's course in Cookery, Bakery, Table-laying, Flower-arrangements or an equivalent course; (b) knowledge of Horticulture; (c) knowledge of Accounts rules; (d) administrative experience such as supervision of Furrash, Mali, Chaukidar, Attenders and Sweepers. A note in Hindi lists diploma courses treated as equivalent to point (a), including a minimum one-year Diploma in Food Production, Bakery and Confectionery, Food and Beverage Service or House Keeping, as well as certain other courses. Entry B: Bachelor's degree from a University established by law in India or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Preferential qualifications: (a) three years Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering; (b) knowledge of Horticulture; (c) knowledge of Accounts rules; (d) administrative experience such as supervision of Furrash, Mali, Chaukidar, Peons, Attenders, Sweepers and Drivers. Entry C: (a) Bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a recognised University with History, Geography, English Literature, Anthropology or Architecture as one of the subjects at degree level. (b) Good knowledge of Hindi. For the posts of Samiksha Adhikari, Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari, Samiksha Adhikari (Account), Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (Account), Care-Taker, Receptionist (Swagati), Manager and Store Keeper, a candidate who has served in the Territorial Army for a minimum of two years, or has obtained a 'B' certificate of the National Cadet Corps, shall, other things being equal, be given preference in direct recruitment. The notification refers to a Government Order dated 19-07-2023 (No. 03/2023/312/47-dk-2-312 LC/2022) on the equivalence of a graduate degree from a university established by law in India, and to Government Order No. 08/2022/2/47-dk-2-2022/02 LC/2022 dated 05.05.2022 for the equivalence of the "O" Level certificate awarded by the DOEACC Society. The Hindi text of the first order is reproduced in the PDF and candidates should read it there. The relevant service rules named in the notification are: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission Subordinate Service Regulations, 2006 (as amended) The Uttar Pradesh Secretariat Subordinate Service Rules, 1999 (as amended) The Uttar Prade

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must have attained 21 years and must not have crossed 40 years on 01 July 2026. They must not have been born earlier than 2nd July 1986 and not later than 01 July 2005. For PH candidates, the maximum age limit is 55 years, meaning they must not have been born before 02 July 1971. Conditions for Chief Minister Fellowship research scholars (as per the Uttar Pradesh Public Services (Relaxation of Age Limit and Weightage for Research Scholars of Chief Minister Fellowship for Competitive Examinations) Rules, 2026): Emergency Commissioned/Short Service Commissioned Officers whose Army service has been extended for rehabilitation may apply for age relaxation only if they obtain a certificate from the competent authority of the Army, Navy or Air Force that their service has been extended for rehabilitation and no disciplinary action is pending, and submit a written undertaking to get released immediately from the Army if selected. These facilities are not admissible if the officer gets a permanent commission in the Army, was released on tendering resignation, or was released on grounds of misconduct or physical disability or on his own request and gets gratuity. Reservation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Class and Economically Weaker Section candidates of U.P. is admissible as per the relevant Government rules. Horizontal reservation is also admissible for Dependents of Freedom Fighters of U.P., Female candidates, Ex-Servicemen of U.P., P.H. of U.P. and Outstanding sports persons of U.P., on settlement of vacancies as per rules. Reservation for P.H. of U.P. is permissible only for the notified or identified posts.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Selection Process
content_sections.text: Preliminary Examination: Held at various centres in the districts of U.P. to select candidates for the Main (Written) Examination. Objective type, with negative marking. Main (Written) Examination: Only candidates declared successful in the Preliminary Examination are admitted. Candidates must fill a fresh application form and pay the Main Examination fee, and must appear against the same Roll No. allotted for the Preliminary Examination. Selection is made on the basis of total marks obtained in the Main (Written) Examination. Document verification and medical examination: Candidates must submit a hard copy of their online application with self-attested copies of marksheets and certificates when asked. Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination as required under the Rules. On the basis of the Preliminary Examination result, candidates equal to fifteen times the number of vacancies are declared successful for the Main Examination. Minimum efficiency standard: 35% for SC and ST candidates and 40% for candidates of other categories in the Preliminary/Main Examination. Candidates scoring below this are treated as disqualified. Candidates serving under the Central or State Government must produce a 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer, issued by the competent authority. An interview or personality test is not mentioned in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Exam Pattern and Syllabus
content_sections.text: General Studies (Objective Type): 1. General Science, 2. History of India, 3. Indian National Movement, 4. Indian Polity, Economy and Culture, 5. Indian Agriculture, Commerce and Trade, 6. Population, Ecology and Urbanisation (in Indian context), 7. World Geography and Geography and Natural Resources of India, 8. Current National and International Important Events, 9. General Intelligentsia, 10. Special Knowledge regarding Education, Culture, Agriculture, Industry, Trade, Living and Social Traditions of Uttar Pradesh. General Hindi (Objective Type): (1) Opposites (10 words), (2) Sentences and Correction in framing (10 sentences), (3) One word for several words (10 words), (4) Same uses and same nature words (10 words), (5) A Noun as defined by an adjective and an adjective (10 words), (6) Synonymous words (10 words). Paper-1, General Studies-I: Indian History, Art and Culture: Indian Culture (art forms, literature and architecture from ancient to modern times); Modern Indian history (1757 to 1947): significant events and personalities; the Freedom Struggle; post-independence consolidation and reorganisation within the country (till 1965). Indian Society: Salient features of Indian society and culture; role of women, population and associated issues, urbanisation; liberalisation, privatisation and globalisation and their effects on social structure; social empowerment, social justice and inclusive growth. Geography of India: Physical, Economic and Human Geography of India; Geography of Uttar Pradesh (physical, human and economic aspects, and contemporary issues related to planning and development). Environment and Disaster Management: Environment concept, ecosystems, cycles and biosphere; man-environment relationship, pollution, degradation, conservation and Environment Protection Act; nature and types of disasters; disaster management cycle (Preparation, Rescue, Relief and Rebuilding), role of NDMA, NDRF and SDRF. Science and Technology: Developments and applications of science and technology in everyday life; India's science and technology policy; satellite communication, remote sensing, GPS, space technologies; IT industry, telecommunication; missile systems, UAVs, stealth technology, chemical and biological weapons; nanoscience and nanotechnology; robotics and artificial intelligence; nuclear power policy, nuclear energy applications, radiation, radioactive waste; biotechnology and microbiology, biopiracy, bioinformatics and ethical dimension in biotechnology. Paper-2, General Studies-II: Indian Polity and Constitution: Historical underpinnings, evolution, features, amendments, significant provisions and basic structure of the Constitution; role of the Supreme Court; functions and responsibilities of the Union and the States, federal structure, devolution of powers and finances up to local levels; role of the Finance Commission in Centre-State financial relations; Parliament and State legislatures. Governance: Structure, organisation and funct

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online through the O.T.R. based system. Applications sent through any other medium are not accepted. The online application is completed in four stages. It is mandatory to complete One Time Registration (O.T.R.) and obtain an O.T.R. number before applying. Candidates without an O.T.R. number must obtain it from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submitting the online application. Only after obtaining the O.T.R. number can a candidate apply through https://uppsc.up.nic.in. On the final application page there is a Declaration. Clicking "I do not agree" drops the application. A Preview is available before final submission, and a successful submission report can be printed.

faq.answer: Yes, candidates from other states can apply, but they will be treated under the unreserved category as reservation benefits are restricted to original residents of Uttar Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Warangal District Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for the Warangal District Recruitment 2026 are offline only. Each post has its own application form, attached to the notification. The form is addressed to The District Collector & Magistrate / Chairman, District Selection Committee, Warangal District. Download the application form and instructions from the official website of Warangal District. Use the form for the post you are eligible for. Fill in the form. It asks for your name and your father's, mother's or spouse's name as per the Aadhaar Card, date of birth, age as on 01/07/2026, local status/district, community and sub-caste, PwD/PH/VH status and educational details. Paste 1 photograph on the application form. Enclose copies of the certificates listed below. The notification asks for self-attested copies, and the application form says all certificates should be attested by a Gazetted Officer. Enclose the acknowledgment card. Submit the filled form in person or through Registered Post at: O/o District Medical & Health Officer, Warangal District. Applications are received from 27 October 2026 to 31 October 2026, between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM, on working days only. Applications must reach the office by 31 October 2026. Applications received after that date will be summarily rejected. The District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The notification asks for these certificates to be enclosed with the application form: SSC or equivalent examination Intermediate or 10+2 examination Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks memos of all the years (qualifying examination) Registration Certificates of Board of Indian Medicine (for AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification and Medical Officer Posts) Latest Caste Certificates issued by the Tahsildar / MRO concerned Study Certificate for the years from 4th Class to 10th class, and in case of private study, Residency Certificate from the Tahsildar / MRO concerned PH Certificate for candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant Certificates for candidates claiming Ex-service man quota 1 Photograph duly pasted on the application form Acknowledgment card The forms for the AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Dietician, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional also ask for: SSC, Intermediate / 10+2 (where applicable) and qualifying examination certificates, each with a Bonafide Certificate Registration certificate of the concerned Board / Council, where applicable PG qualification certificate, where applicable One recent passport-size photograph Gazetted attested copies of all required certificates/documents The Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) form has its own checklist: Bonafide Certificate from Class 4th to 7th Latest caste certificate, where applicable Study certificate from 4th Class to 10th Class and/or prescribed residency certificate, as applicable PwD / PH certificate, where applicable One recent passport-size photograph Gazetted attested copies of all required certificates/documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The sub-caste certificate is mandatory, and so is the PwD / PH / VH certificate for anyone who claims that status. By signing the declaration in the form, the candidate accepts that false or incorrect information, or hiding relevant facts, may lead to rejection of the candidature or cancellation of the engagement. AYUSH Doctor with PG Qualification and AYUSH Medical Officer candidates may apply in any District in the concerned Multi Zone, but selection is restricted to one District.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the AYUSH Medical Officer post?

faq.answer: The candidate must have passed the VII Class examination and must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years as on 01/07/2026. The maximum age is relaxed by 5 years for SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates, 10 years for disabled persons, and 3 years plus the length of armed forces service for ex-servicemen.

It started as a dedicated COVID hospital in 2020, and its general non-Covid services started in 2022. According to the notice, the hospital has a 50-bedded ICU, OTs and laboratories, its own oxygen supply, and serves an urban and rural population of about 10 lakh.

faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies, 1 for each post, since the notice does not print a number. They are General Manager at CTTC Kolkata, CTTC Bhubaneswar and CTR Ludhiana, Principal Director at FFDC Kannauj, CDGI Firozabad and CIHT Jalandhar, and Director at CFTI Agra.

faq.question: What is the last date for the DC MSME CEO posts?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application is 23 November 2026. The application must reach the Office of the Development Commissioner (MSME), New Delhi, by that date.

faq.question: What qualification is needed for General Manager, CTTC, Kolkata?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Degree in Mechanical /Production Engg or equivalent from a recognized University / Institution. The post also needs 15 years' experience in Production/Training Department of a Tool Room/reputed Engineering Industry, of which 10 years must be in a responsible technology/ Management Position.

faq.question: What is the age limit for DC MSME Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 50 years for the General Manager and Principal Director posts and not exceeding 45 years for Director, CFTI, Agra. Age is worked out on the closing date for receipt of applications, 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Who gets age relaxation, and how much?
faq.answer: For most posts the relaxation is up to 5 years for SC/ST/Internal candidates and 3 years for OBC. For FFDC Kannauj, the 5 years also cover employees of Govt., Semi-Govt./Quasi Govt. Organizations / Autonomous Bodies and departmental candidates, and the 3 years also cover Ex-servicemen/PH. For CDGI Firozabad, the 5 years also cover departmental candidates and employees of Govt/semi-Govt organizations.

faq.question: What is the salary for the DC MSME CEO posts?
faq.answer: The General Manager posts and Principal Director, CIHT, Jalandhar are at Level-13A, with an Entry Pay (Basic) of Rs. 1,31,100/-. The Principal Director posts at FFDC and CDGI are at Level-13, with Rs. 1,23,100/-, and Director, CFTI, Agra is at Level-12, with Rs. 78,800/-.

faq.question: Is HRA paid on top of the basic pay?
faq.answer: Yes, all 7 posts carry allowances as per Government Rules. These include DA, TA and HRA (in case accommodation is not provided), as per norms, on top of the basic pay.

faq.question: How do I apply for DC MSME Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Proforma from the detailed advertisement and attach your supporting documents. Send it by speed post or registered post to the Additional Development Commissioner (TR), Office of the Development Commissioner (MSME), Room No. 32082, 2nd Floor, Kartavya Bhawan-3, Janpath Road, New Delhi-110001, so that it reaches by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Are the DC MSME CEO posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are to be filled on contract basis for 5 years initially. They can be extended further, based on the review of performance, till the age of superannuation.

faq.question: Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must send a separate application for each post or location. Each envelope must say "application for the vacancy of" followed by the position and location you are applying for.
