The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Apply Offline
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit the prescribed application form through Speed Post or hand delivery to the General Services Section of NCDC, Delhi. Applications must reach the office on or before 9 November 2026 . General Services Section Room No. 202, National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), 22, Sham Nath Marg, Delhi - 110054. Office Submission Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days. Important: Applications received after 9 November 2026 will not be accepted. The date of dispatch is not a substitute for timely receipt by NCDC.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCDC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official NCDC website at ncdc.mohfw.gov.in . Open the Vacancies section under Work With Us. Download the notification for engagement of 30 contractual human resources. Read the post-specific qualifications, experience and age criteria. Print the application form included on pages 10 and 11 of the notification. Fill in the post applied for, personal information, educational qualifications, experience and contact details. Attach a self-attested photograph and the applicable educational, experience, age-proof and supporting documents. Check that the form is complete and that the required copies are self-attested. Send the completed application through Speed Post or submit it by hand at the designated NCDC office. Ensure the application reaches NCDC by 9 November 2026. Check the registered email address for interview communication if shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NCDC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit the supporting documents relevant to their qualifications and experience along with the prescribed application form. Completed application form. Self-attested photograph. Degree, diploma and professional qualification certificates. Relevant experience certificates. Age-proof document. Supporting documents for other claims made in the application. The application form also asks for reference details, training or short courses attended, awards or achievements, mailing address, permanent address, phone number and email ID.

content_sections.heading: NCDC Recruitment 2026 Contract Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The initial contractual engagement is for one year. Continuation will depend on yearly requirements. Selected candidates must sign a Contractual Service Agreement at the time of joining. Contractual personnel will not be treated as regular NCDC employees. Contractual engagement does not provide any claim for permanent government appointment. No TA will be paid for attending the interview. No separate medical facility or additional financial allowance is provided beyond the consolidated remuneration under the stated conditions. Annual leave of 30 days and 10 days of casual or sick leave are provided as specified in the notice. Either party may terminate the service by giving one month's notice.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice gives one set of working requirements for all project fellows: Visit the NCR-based Thermal Power Plants regularly to collect samples, analyse data and carry out chemical study of the foam from the FGD units. Work in close coordination with IITD and NTPC's TPPs in the NCR for data collection and analysis. Modelling and optimisation can be done through CFD simulation. Project fellows will be encouraged to register for the PhD programme under the Institute rules. A fellow admitted to the PhD programme will work on a PhD topic related to the project only, and will give time to it after completing the course work. The Government of India has mandated 7% mixing of biomass in thermal power plants for co-firing. The notice says the use of agro-waste in these plants has been lower than expected because of practical problems such as foaming and tripping of the pumps in the flue gas desulfurization (FGD) unit, ash handling and combustion instability. It also points to a lack of standardised data on how biomass behaves under Indian conditions. The project's objectives are: Collect biomass samples, both torrefied and non-torrefied, and characterise them (proximate, ultimate, FTIR, XRD and ICP-MS) to find possible causes of foaming and suggest pre-treatment strategies. Collect foam samples from FGD units while monitoring pH, oxygen, flue gas composition, temperature and blending ratio, and study the foams in depth to find the causes and mechanisms of foaming in the FGD-absorber. Optimise the biomass blending ratio, lime quality and injection rate to remove foaming in the FGD-absorber at the lab scale. Identify and develop suitable corrective measures to suppress foaming in the FGD-absorber. Carry out a detailed study to develop solutions for the increased moisture content in calcium sulphate (gypsum) caused by foaming in FGD.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process is a written examination of two hours with objective-type questions, each with only one correct answer. The notice describes this written examination and does not mention an interview. Shortlisting: Meeting the minimum qualifications does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called. If many applications are received, the Institute may restrict the number of candidates called, based on higher qualifications/experience in Government sectors and/or other criteria. Shortlist and communication: The list of candidates shortlisted for the written examination will be published on the Institute website. Successful candidates will also be notified by email, and no other communication will be issued. Candidates must give a working email ID and mobile number. Syllabus: The syllabus is sent to the shortlisted candidates by email. The paper setters decide the weightage for each topic. Question papers are not disclosed, because they form a question bank for future recruitment. Original documents: Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents for reservation, educational qualification, date of birth, experience, etc., before the selection process. Those who do not are not allowed to take part. Employed candidates must produce the NOC and VCC at the written examination, or their candidature will be rejected. Tie in marks: If two candidates get the same marks in the written examination, the older candidate is placed higher in merit, as per Government of India norms.

content_sections.heading: CCI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The operational and functional areas of experience defined in the notification for each post are as follows: Operation & Maintenance of any cement, manufacturing, process industries. Basic knowledge of hard-wired interlocks & preparing algorithms. Process instrumentation and computer/microprocessor-based control systems. Structural design and detailing. Execution and implementation of civil projects. Construction and maintenance of industrial infrastructure. Design and construction of large concrete silos or storage structures. Foundation work and related geotechnical aspects. Maintenance of existing civil assets in industrial settings. Sales & Marketing, Sales & Accounts. Market Development and Channel Management. Customer Relationship Management (CRM). Sales Planning & Execution. Competition Analysis & Reporting. Billing & Dispatch Coordination. MIS and ERP Systems. content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical education and research institute in Puducherry. These posts are part of a research project run by an outside funder, ICMR. The project is the PReMI Study (Preventing Premature Myocardial Infarction), a community-digital intervention to reduce cardiometabolic risk among young high-risk adults in South India. The Project Investigator is Dr Venkatachalam J of the Department of Preventive and Social Medicine.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 7 posts in total, across three post types. All of them are for the same project, with the same funding agency, Project Investigator and likely duration. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives each post its own essential and desirable requirements, listed below. All three posts have the same age rule: a maximum of 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications (6 November 2026), with relaxation as per GoI guidelines. Two rules apply to every post. The qualification and experience must be in a relevant discipline/field and from a reputed institution/organization. The experience must have been gained after getting the essential qualification. Other essential requirements: Excellent communication skills in Tamil & English. Two-wheeler with DL (Driving License). Desirable: Experience in community-based public health research. Experience working with PHCs or community health programmes. Experience in NCD prevention and control or related public health programmes. Interested in doing extramural Project PhD under the PI. Experience in field-team coordination, participant recruitment, or data collection. Publication in indexed journals. The notice says this project position may be considered for the extramural project PhD stream. In your application, say whether you want to be considered for a PhD position if the Institution approves one in future. Being selected for the post does not guarantee a PhD place. That needs further approval, a pass in an additional written exam and the PI's agreement after selection. The notice points candidates to the PhD guidelines on the JIPMER website. Other essential requirements: Excellent communication skills in Tamil and English. Proficiency in MS Office, especially MS Excel. Desirable: Experience in data management or monitoring in health/public health research projects. Experience with electronic data capture systems or research databases. Experience in data cleaning, validation, and quality checks. Other essential requirements: Excellent communication skills in Tamil & English. Two wheeler with Driving License (DL). Desirable: Experience in community-based health or public health research. Experience in participant recruitment, follow-up, or field-based data collection. Experience in blood pressure measurement, anthropometry and blood sample collection. Experience working with PHCs or community health programmes. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification_as_printed: Post Graduate Degree in public health or epidemiology (or) three years graduate degree with three years' experience in the relevant field / subject.
Three years graduate course or diploma with two Years Experience in relevant subject.
Three years graduate course (Bsc Nursing, Bsc MLT) or diploma with two Years Experience in relevant subject.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All the posts pay a consolidated monthly amount and no other allowances. The notice also says the consolidated salary may vary from time to time, and no allowance or facility will be given beyond it. Each post has a likely duration of three years.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate day-to-day field activities and study operations. Supervise field staff and support household screening and participant recruitment. Coordinate and monitor delivery of study interventions and follow-up activities. Manage digital messaging and participant communication systems. Maintain field logistics, records, and study-related documentation. Ensure timely and complete data collection and reporting. Manage study databases and digital data capture systems. Perform data entry verification, cleaning, and validation. Monitor data completeness, consistency, and quality. Prepare and organise datasets for statistical analysis. Maintain data records and support routine data reporting. Conduct community-based data collection through household visits. Perform blood pressure measurement and anthropometric assessments. Collect blood samples as per the study protocol. Conduct participant follow-up and provide counselling support. Identify participants with abnormal findings and facilitate referral to PHCs. Maintain accurate study records and ensure timely data collection.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for JIPMER Recruitment 2026 are accepted by email only. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Fill in the application form attached to the notification. Scan the filled form, your CV and your supporting documents into one PDF file. Name the PDF file "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (the notice's example is "James_DEO_2023_application"). Write the name of the post you are applying for in the email subject line. Email the PDF to [email protected] by 05.00 pm on 6 November 2026. If you are applying for two or more posts, fill in a separate application form for each post, scan it and send it with its enclosures in a separate email. Documents named in the notice: Filled application form in the prescribed format CV Supporting documents / certificates (documentary proof) Your choice on being considered for the Extramural Project PhD Stream (Project Technical Support – III) A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on the details in their application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be shown on the JIPMER website. The final selection will be based on the CV, the application and a written test/interview. According to the notice's evaluation criteria, these stages may follow the review of the application form. The notice does not say which areas each stage will cover. Written test Skill test Interview Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. If there are a very large number of applications, stricter criteria than those listed may be used to decide eligibility. The Project Investigator's decision will be final. The Principal Investigator will decide whether the interview is held in person or by videoconference. For a videoconference, each candidate must arrange a suitable device (computer/laptop/mobile) with audio and camera, plus a good internet connection. The date and time of the interview will be announced after shortlisting.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications, applications not in the prescribed format and applications that do not meet the essential criteria are likely to be summarily rejected. You may attach your CV to the application form. Applications with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. The Principal Investigator may relax or change the qualification, experience and other terms and conditions. Giving wrong or false information at any stage of selection, or any kind of canvassing, will lead to disqualification. If found after engagement, it can lead to termination. content_sections.heading: WBPSC Sub Surveyor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To meet the WBPSC Sub Surveyor eligibility, candidates must satisfy the qualification, age, language and certificate conditions below. Candidates must be Indian citizens or other nationals declared eligible by the Government of India. Ability to read, write and speak in Bengali is an essential requirement. It is not mandatory for candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali, unless specifically mentioned. The candidature of candidates with poor performance in the knowledge of Bengali test is liable to be cancelled. Candidates must fulfil the essential qualifications by the closing date of the online application. Candidates claiming EWS, SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), Ex-Serviceman, MSP or PwBD status (40% and above) must hold the certificate from the competent authority of West Bengal, obtained within the closing date of applications. All degrees, diplomas and certificates must be from universities/institutions duly recognized by the competent authority. The WBPSC Sub Surveyor qualification can be met in either of the two ways given below. Where experience is prescribed, it means experience gained in full-time employment/research in the relevant field within the closing date of receipt of applications. The experience certificate from the Head of the Organization/Department or competent authority must mention the duration of employment (date, month and year), the field of experience, the basic pay and consolidated pay, and the nature of duties performed. Where only grading is awarded and no Division/Class, the exact percentage of marks and the conversion formula adopted are to be mentioned with documentary evidence, if required.

rows.qualification: (i) Passed Madhyamik Examination or equivalent, and (ii) 3 years' Diploma in Survey Engineering from any recognized institute (affiliated by AICTE or West Bengal State Council of Technical Education)

(i) Passed Madhyamik Examination or equivalent, (ii) 2 years' certificate course for Surveyor from a recognized Industrial Training Institute, and (iii) 1 year's experience in Survey and Settlement work based on modern survey techniques and conversant in differential Global Positioning System (DGPS) and/or Electronic Total Stations (ETS) technology to carry out modern methods of surveying, from any Government empanelled organization or from an Indian Geographic Information System (GIS)/Surveying Company recognized under the Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme, Department of Land Resources, Government of India, having at least 3 years' experience in preparation of large scale mapping and land records

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Sub Surveyor Age Limit
content_sections.text: The WBPSC Sub Surveyor age limit is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years as on 01.01.2024, in terms of Finance Department Notification No. 1707-F(P2) dated 16.05.2026 read with Notification No. 2619-F(P2) dated 20.07.2026. The age recorded only in the Madhyamik or equivalent certificate is accepted. No relaxation is applicable to SC/ST/OBC candidates of other states, who are treated as General candidates. The Ex-Servicemen relaxation is for those who have put in not less than 6 months' continuous service in any rank (combatant or non-combatant) in the Armed Forces of the Union. The provisions of the West Bengal Services (Raising of Age Limit) Rules, 1981 are not applicable.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Sub Surveyor Salary
content_sections.text: The WBPSC Sub Surveyor salary is Pay Level-7, with a pay scale of Rs. 24,700/- to Rs. 63,900/- as per the WBS (ROPA) Rules, 2019. Besides pay, the post carries allowances as admissible. The amount of the allowances is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Sub Surveyor Application Fee
content_sections.text: The WBPSC Sub Surveyor application fee is Rs. 110, plus service charges wherever applicable, payable through online mode only. SC/ST candidates of West Bengal and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities having physical disabilities of 40% and above are not required to pay any fee. OBC candidates are required to pay the usual fee. No claim for refund of the fee is entertained, and the fee is not held in reserve for any other examination.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Sub Surveyor Selection Process
content_sections.text: The WBPSC Sub Surveyor selection process is a written examination of two papers. The final merit list is prepared on the basis of the marks obtained in Paper-II only. The notification also refers to Document Verification, but does not give its schedule. Qualifying marks are fixed at 30% of the marks allotted for Paper-I. The Commission has the discretion to fix the qualifying marks in Paper-II. Marks in Paper-II are taken into consideration only for candidates who attain 30% marks in Paper-I. There is negative marking of 0.25 mark for each wrong answer in the MCQ-type Paper-II. If two or more candidates get equal marks in Paper-II, preference is given to the senior candidate by date of birth. Marks are electronically captured from the scanned OMR sheet using uniform customized software, without manual intervention. Objections to the model answers displayed on the website must be filed strictly within the specified time limit. Paper-I: Letter writing, drafting a report and grammar (Bengali/Nepali), as per the standard of Madhyamik or equivalent examination. Paper-II, English: Fundamentals of the English language such as vocabulary, grammar, composition, synonyms, antonyms and correction of structure of sentence. Paper-II, Elementary Mathematics: Arithmetic, algebra, geometry, trigonometry and mensuration, as per the standard of Madhyamik or equivalent examination. Paper-II, Survey Engineering: As per the standard of Diploma examination.

rows.subjects: English (50), Elementary Mathematics (50), Survey Engineering (100); 200 multiple choice objective type questions of 1 mark each

content_sections.heading: Documents and Certificates for WBPSC Sub Surveyor Recruitment
content_sections.text: One Photo ID, to be mentioned in the application form with its number and issuing authority: Madhyamik or equivalent certificate bearing photograph, Passport, PAN card, EPIC (voter ID card), Driving license, Aadhaar card, or any other ID proof issued by the State or Central Government. The same original photo ID must be brought to the examination venue. Madhyamik or equivalent certificate (for age and qualification) and the Diploma, or the ITI certificate with experience certificates, as applicable EWS: Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure-C), issued by the Additional District Magistrate in charge of development matters of the district, or the District Welfare Officer, Kolkata and Ex-officio Joint Director, BCW & TD for Kolkata. Renewed/revalidated certificates must be submitted prior to the examination and at the time of appointment. SC, ST and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): Certificate issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer of the sub-division concerned, or in Kolkata by the authorities named in the notification. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates must submit renewed/revalidated certificates prior to the examination and at the time of appointment. PwBD: Disability certificate from a Medical Board constituted at Government Medical College Hospitals in Kolkata, District Hospitals and Sub-Divisional Hospitals. For scribe and/or compensatory time, the Appendix-I certificate regarding physical limitation to write from the Chief Medical Officer/Medical Superintendent of a Government Health Care Institution. Meritorious Sportspersons (MSP): Certificate from the competent authority and the duly filled and signed FORM 1/2/3/4, as applicable, at the time of document verification. The sports covered are Athletics, Badminton, Basket Ball, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Swimming, Table Tennis, Volley Ball, Tennis, Weight Lifting, Wrestling, Boxing, Cycling, Gymnastics, Judo, Rifle Shooting, Kabaddi, Kho-Kho and Archery. Ex-Servicemen: Certificate from the Army/Air Force/Naval Headquarters showing the date of joining, the period of service and the date of release or completion of service. Candidates with Benchmark Disabilities who have a limitation in writing may be allowed a scribe. The scribe should have an educational qualification one step below that of the candidate. Candidates producing a valid Appendix-I are allowed compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour. The details of the scribe cannot be added after final submission of the application. For Blindness, Locomotor Disability (both arms affected, BA) and cerebral palsy, the scribe facility is given if the candidate desires it.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WBPSC Sub Surveyor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online only on the Commission's website. More than one application by the same candidate is strictly forbidden, and the candidature of a candidate who submits more than one application will be cancelled. Check the qualification, age limit, Bengali language requirement and certificate requirements. Visit the WBPSC website, https://psc.wb.gov.in, and complete the online application between 20.10.2026 and 09.11.2026. Mention one valid Photo ID with its number and issuing authority. Pay the fee online by 09.11.2026 (up to 3 p.m.), if applicable. Submit the application. It is treated as final, and no change of category claim is entertained after final submission. Take a printout of the form and verify the details. Use the one-time edit window from 11.11.2026 to 16.11.2026 if any correction is required. To change the address, update it first in the Profile Section and then use the Edit option. The photograph and signature specifications are not given in the notification.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Sub Surveyor Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications can be submitted online only. Once submitted, the application is final, and the Edit option can be used only once, during the edit window. All certificates for EWS, SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), MSP, Ex-Serviceman or PwBD must be obtained within the closing date of submission of applications. Without the relevant certificate at document verification, the candidature is summarily rejected. Admission to the examination is provisional, subject to determining eligibility in all respects. A candidate found ineligible at any stage, even after the letter of recommendation, has the candidature cancelled. No candidate is allowed to take the examination without a valid admit card, and no candidate is admitted to a venue other than the one on the admit card. The Commission is not the authority to check the veracity of documents produced by the applicants. It may require further proof and may make enquiries about character and other particulars. Providing false information about age, qualifications or caste/category leads to penal action and cancellation of candidature. Mobile phones, Bluetooth devices, smart watches and other communication devices are not allowed inside the examination premises. Candidates are frisked at entry points, separately for male and female candidates. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidature. Misconduct reported by the examination centre supervisor leads to cancellation of candidature and debarment from future examinations and selections. All information about the recruitment will be available from time to time on https://psc.wb.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: About NRL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Numaligarh Refinery Limited (NRL) is a Navaratna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas engaged in refining and marketing petroleum products. This recruitment engages experienced retired or serving professionals to support critical refinery operations during this expansion.

content_sections.heading: CUTN Counsellor Job Description
content_sections.text: The Counsellor will work closely with students, faculty members and staff. The role covers counselling services, workshops and campus-wide mental health and well-being initiatives. The listed responsibilities are: Provide individualized one-on-one counselling sessions to students. Facilitate group counselling sessions addressing common student mental health concerns. Organize and deliver workshops, seminars and webinars on mental health and psychological well-being. Conduct psychometric assessments and prepare clinical case reports as required. Maintain strict confidentiality and manage sensitive student information with discretion and professionalism. Conduct regular courses and interactive sessions for Psychology students. Conduct training programs for student peer mentors and support volunteers. Prepare and submit monthly analytical reports for performance review and program evaluation. Provide crisis intervention and manage psychiatric emergencies effectively. Collaborate with faculty, hostel wardens and administrative staff to support student well-being initiatives.

how_to_apply: GSL accepts applications only through its online application system, followed by a hard copy sent by post. Online applications open at 00.00 hrs on 23 October 2026 and close at 17.00 hrs on 22 November 2026.
Visit www.goashipyard.in. Under the link Notice Board- 'Careers', click the link 'GSL Careers'.
Click the 'Apply Online' button and select the post you wish to apply for.
Complete the personal information in the online application form, then fill in the payment details.

Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online through SBI e-pay (debit card/ credit card/ net banking etc.). Wait for the intimation from the server and do not press back or refresh, to avoid double charges.
Download and print the "Fee receipt" generated on successful payment. If no fee receipt is generated, the payment has failed: log in again and repeat the payment.
SUBMIT the application form. Without this step the form is treated as incomplete, and it cannot be edited after the online application is completed.

Take two printouts of the system-generated online application form. Send one, with all relevant documents, to: General Manager (HR&A), HR&A Department, Goa Shipyard Limited, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa – 403802. Keep the second copy for future reference.
The printout and hard copies of the relevant documents must reach GSL on or before 2 December 2026.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application, with the prescribed fee, for each post. For difficulty applying online, contact [email protected].

Applications without the prescribed fee are liable to be rejected. The candidature of applicants who pay less than the prescribed fee, or pay by any other method, will be rejected. Fees paid by ineligible candidates are forfeited, and no correspondence will be entertained about them.
Keep scanned copies (preferably JPG/PDF) of these documents ready before filling in the online application:
Passport size colour photograph with a light background (preferably white), with nothing covering the face and eyes, below 450 KB.
Signature in black ink on plain white paper, below 450 KB. It must be a scan of your own pen signature, not a digital signature.
SSC certificate as proof of date of birth, not more than 500 KB.
Educational qualification mark sheet & degree, not more than 1 MB.
Caste Certificate, not more than 500 KB.
Experience Certificates, not more than 1 MB.
Aadhaar Card, not more than 500 KB.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: GSL accepts applications only through its online application system, followed by a hard copy sent by post. Online applications open at 00.00 hrs on 23 October 2026 and close at 17.00 hrs on 22 November 2026. Visit www.goashipyard.in. Under the link Notice Board- 'Careers', click the link 'GSL Careers'. Click the 'Apply Online' button and select the post you wish to apply for. Complete the personal information in the online application form, then fill in the payment details. Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online through SBI e-pay (debit card/ credit card/ net banking etc.). Wait for the intimation from the server and do not press back or refresh, to avoid double charges. Download and print the "Fee receipt" generated on successful payment. If no fee receipt is generated, the payment has failed: log in again and repeat the payment. SUBMIT the application form. Without this step the form is treated as incomplete, and it cannot be edited after the online application is completed. Take two printouts of the system-generated online application form. Send one, with all relevant documents, to: General Manager (HR&A), HR&A Department, Goa Shipyard Limited, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa – 403802. Keep the second copy for future reference. The printout and hard copies of the relevant documents must reach GSL on or before 2 December 2026. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application, with the prescribed fee, for each post. For difficulty applying online, contact [email protected] . Applications without the prescribed fee are liable to be rejected. The candidature of applicants who pay less than the prescribed fee, or pay by any other method, will be rejected. Fees paid by ineligible candidates are forfeited, and no correspondence will be entertained about them. Keep scanned copies (preferably JPG/PDF) of these documents ready before filling in the online application: Passport size colour photograph with a light background (preferably white), with nothing covering the face and eyes, below 450 KB. Signature in black ink on plain white paper, below 450 KB. It must be a scan of your own pen signature, not a digital signature. SSC certificate as proof of date of birth, not more than 500 KB. Educational qualification mark sheet & degree, not more than 1 MB. Caste Certificate, not more than 500 KB. Experience Certificates, not more than 1 MB. Aadhaar Card, not more than 500 KB.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for all posts except the Junior Manager posts will be through an interview only. For the Junior Manager posts there is a written test and an interview. Management reserves the right to raise the minimum eligibility criteria for shortlisting if there is a large response. It also reserves the right to decide the criteria for screening and shortlisting applications. The written test carries 85 marks and the interview 15 marks. Candidates who score 50% or above in the written test (UR & EWS), or 45% or above (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD, when the post is reserved), will be shortlisted for document verification followed by the interview. The qualifying marks for the interview are 50% or above for UR & EWS and 45% or above for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD (when the post is reserved). Among the candidates who qualify in the interview, selection is by merit on the overall aggregate of written test and interview marks, following the reservation guidelines. A tie is decided by seniority in age. Call letters will be sent only by e-mail to the registered e-mail ID of shortlisted candidates. GSL is not responsible for non-receipt of e-mail or loss of a candidate's e-mail ID and password. Outstation candidates who qualify for the interview will be paid travelling allowance by the shortest route from their residence (as registered in the Online Application System) to Goa Shipyard Limited. TA is paid only on production of proof of journey (hard copy of tickets), as per company rules:

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for JKSSB Junior Engineer Mechanical Recruitment
content_sections.text: Domicile Certificate in the prescribed format, valid up to the cut-off date Educational qualification certificates, valid on or before the cut-off date Category Certificate in the prescribed format, if claiming reservation or age relaxation Matriculation certificate showing name, date of birth, father's name and mother's name Bonafide Certificate in the format prescribed by the Board, issued by the Controller/Registrar of the university, for degrees from recognized universities, colleges or institutes outside the UT of J&K other than Central Universities Ex-Servicemen: Certificate in Form-XIV signed by the competent authority under Rule 18 of the Jammu and Kashmir Reservation Rules, 2005, and an affidavit sworn before a 1st Class Judicial Magistrate (S.O. 361 of 2021 dated 20.10.2021) PwBD candidates using a scribe: Disability Certificate (self-attested), Certificate regarding physical limitation to write (Annexure-B), Letter of Undertaking for Using Own Scribe (Annexure-C), and the scribe's qualification certificate and photo-ID copy Printout of the online application form, two recent colour passport size photographs (not older than 6 months, with date) and an original valid photo-ID proof In-service candidates: certificate at the last paragraph of the application form, signed and stamped, forwarded through the proper channel (Head of Department/Designated Authority)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JKSSB Junior Engineer Mechanical Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online only. No other mode of application is accepted, and the instructions for filling the online application will be made available separately on the Board's website. Check the eligibility conditions for domicile, qualification and age as on the cut-off dates. Visit the official website www.jkssb.nic.in and follow the online application instructions published for this notification. Fill in the application form carefully. Write the name, date of birth, father's name and mother's name exactly as in the matriculation certificate. Upload the live photograph and signature (size 10 KB to 20 KB), the category certificate (maximum 200 KB, PDF) and the self-attested qualification certificates (maximum 200 KB, PDF), as required. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card. Review the form, submit it, note the application number and take a printout to produce at Document Verification. Do not send the hard copy to the JKSSB office.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Junior Engineer Mechanical Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only one online application is allowed for the same item number. If more than one is detected, the latest application is considered. Appearing in the examination more than once for the same item number leads to cancellation and debarment. No change or correction in the application form is entertained after submission, including preferences for cadre and department. Applications with a blurred or illegible photograph or signature are summarily rejected. Candidature remains provisional until documents are verified by the Appointing Authority. Ineligible candidates will not be allowed in later stages. A claim for reservation based on an invalid, false or forged certificate leads to debarment from JKSSB examinations and penal action. Reserved category applicants using a certificate format other than the prescribed one will not be entertained. PwBD candidates can avail a scribe and/or compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination on production of the Annexure-B certificate and the Annexure-C undertaking. The candidate must arrange their own scribe, and the scribe must not be a candidate for the same examination or a relative. Mobile phones, smart watches, smart glasses, AI-enabled devices, Bluetooth devices and similar electronic equipment, even if switched off, are prohibited in the examination hall. Roll number slips are not issued by post. Candidates must visit the JKSSB website regularly for updates, and carry two recent passport size photographs and an original photo-ID proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License, PAN Card, Passport, School/College/University I-Card or Employer ID Card) to the examination. Candidates should apply well before the last date to avoid website overload during the closing days. Submission of the form implies consent to security screening, including physical frisking, metal detector scanning, biometric capture, facial recognition and Aadhaar authentication. The decision of the Board on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, conduct of examinations and the merit list is final and binding.

The candidate should be familiar with Ames bacterial reverse mutation assay, in vitro micronucleus assay, chromosomal aberration assay, and in vivo micronucleus/comet assays. faq.question: Q1. When is the CSIR-IICB walk-in interview for 2026?
faq.answer: The CSIR-IICB walk-in interview under Advertisement No. R&C/592/2026 will be held on 3 November 2026 (Tuesday).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the CSIR-IICB walk-in?
faq.answer: The reporting time is 08:45 A.M. and the entry gate closes at 10:00 A.M. The venue is CSIR–Indian Institute of Chemical Biology (CSIR-IICB), 4, Raja S.C. Mullick Road, Jadavpur, Kolkata – 700032.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-IICB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 41 vacancies: 12 Senior Project Associate, 12 Project Associate-II, 16 Project Associate-I and 1 Project Assistant-II. The notice says the number may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for CSIR-IICB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualification differs for each vacancy code. For example, Project Assistant-II (5922609) needs a B.Sc./3 years Diploma in Engineering/Technology, while Project Associate-I codes 5922633 to 5922636 need an M.Sc in Chemistry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR-IICB project posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for Senior Project Associate and 35 years for the other posts, reckoned as on the date of interview. SC/ST/PwBD/Women get 05 years of relaxation and OBC candidates get 03 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for CSIR-IICB Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I gets Rs. 31,000/- p.m. + HRA with NET/GATE or equivalent, or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA otherwise. Project Associate-II gets Rs. 35,000/- or Rs. 28,000/- p.m. + HRA on the same basis, except code 5922639, which pays ₹28,000/- p.m. + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the CSIR-IICB walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the filled Application Form along with the originals and self-attested copies of your date-of-birth proof, all mark-sheets and certificates since Matriculation, and your final degree mark sheet or Ph.D award certificate. Also bring NET/GATE proof, an NOC if you are employed, one passport size photograph and a caste certificate where applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one vacancy code at CSIR-IICB?
faq.answer: Yes. If the vacancy codes fall under different Selection Committees, submit a separate application form for each Committee and write all the relevant vacancy codes on each form.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSIR-IICB project job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and it gives no claim to regularization or absorption. The total tenure cannot exceed six years, including engagement in all CSIR labs.

faq.question: Q10. Can final-semester students attend the CSIR-IICB walk-in?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who are in the final semester or whose results are awaited are not eligible for these positions.

faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Electronics & Radar Development Establishment (DRDO LRDE), Bengaluru, to engage retired government, PSU, and autonomous body officials as Consultants on a short-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies distributed across post codes 2026/LRDE/356 to 2026/LRDE/361, with 1 post per post code.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 4 November 2026, which is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all categories of retired government employees applying for these consultant positions is 63 years as on the closing date of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the contract tenure for these consultant positions?
faq.answer: The tenure of contract is one year, which is extendable as per extant norms, with specific tasks estimated between 1 to 3 years depending on the post code.

faq.question: Q6. How is the remuneration determined for pensioners?
faq.answer: For pensioners, a fixed monthly amount is admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement, remaining unchanged for the contract term without annual increments.

faq.answer: Yes, no retired Government Servant is eligible for appointment as a Consultant unless there is a gap of at least fifteen (15) days between their retirement and appointment as a consultant.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on short-listing of candidates according to the percentage of marks obtained in the basic prescribed qualification for the respective disciplines. content_sections.text: Candidates must have participated in UPSSSC Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2025. A PET 2025 scorecard must have been issued by the Commission. Candidates whose PET 2025 results are marked Provisional or Under Investigation may apply provisionally, subject to the Commission's final decision. Qualification Cut-off Date: Candidates must possess the required essential qualifications and relevant supporting certificates by 27 November 2026. Qualifications must satisfy the service rules applicable to the selected department. Equivalent technical qualifications are governed by the recognition orders included with the notification. For various posts, candidates who have served at least two years in the Territorial Army or possess an NCC 'B' Certificate may receive preference when other recruitment conditions are equal. Candidates should verify special-selection eligibility before selecting those posts.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be placed in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000/-. Their monthly emoluments will include basic pay, DA, HRA (where corporation accommodation is not available) @ 35% of basic pay for cafeteria, Site Allowance (LBA) @ 10% of basic pay + DA, and contribution towards EPF and NEEDCSS (NEEPCO Defined Contribution Superannuation Pension Scheme) @ 9% of basic pay + DA. Additional benefits include leave, medical benefits for self and dependent family members, Performance Related Pay (PRP), gratuity, uniform, communication expenses, and furniture reimbursement as applicable per company rules. The minimum monthly CTC is approximately Rs. 1,00,000/-. Upon successful completion of the 1-year training period at one or more corporation locations, trainees will be placed in E-3 grade.

selection_process: The selection process comprises the scrutiny of online applications
a Computer Based Test (CBT)

and a Personal Interview. The shortlisting of applications is based on marks obtained in the engineering degree and industrial safety diploma/degree along with experience. The CBT consists of two sections: Section 1 (Professional Knowledge Test / SKT) on Industrial Safety / Fire & Safety carrying 75 marks
and Section 2 (Executive Aptitude Test / EAT) on numerical ability
reading comprehension
reasoning
general awareness
data interpretation
etc.
carrying 25 marks. The exam paper contains 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each
with a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer. The duration of the exam is 2 hours.

Upload scanned copies of required documents, including proof of date of birth, complete mark sheets and certificates for X, XII, and Engineering graduation, experience certificates, category certificates (in Government of India format, with OBC-NCL issued in the current financial year), PwBD certificate, conversion certificate for grade/CGPA to percentage, recent passport-size color photograph (JPEG, 20 KB to 100 KB), and signature (JPEG, 20 KB to 100 KB).

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000/-. Their monthly emoluments will include basic pay, DA, HRA (where corporation accommodation is not available) @ 35% of basic pay for cafeteria, Site Allowance (LBA) @ 10% of basic pay + DA, and contribution towards EPF and NEEDCSS (NEEPCO Defined Contribution Superannuation Pension Scheme) @ 9% of basic pay + DA. Additional benefits include leave, medical benefits for self and dependent family members, Performance Related Pay (PRP), gratuity, uniform, communication expenses, and furniture reimbursement as applicable per company rules. The minimum monthly CTC is approximately Rs. 1,00,000/-. Upon successful completion of the 1-year training period at one or more corporation locations, trainees will be placed in E-3 grade.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEEPCO Executive Trainee (Safety)
content_sections.text: Log on to the official website at www.neepco.co.in and navigate to the "Careers" section. Candidates belonging to General, EWS, and OBC (NCL) categories must pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 560/- through SBI e-Pay. SC, ESM, and female candidates are exempted from the application fee, though SC, ST, and PwBD candidates applying for unreserved posts must pay the fee. Fill out the online application form with accurate details regarding graduation marks, percentages, and experience. Upload scanned copies of required documents, including proof of date of birth, complete mark sheets and certificates for X, XII, and Engineering graduation, experience certificates, category certificates (in Government of India format, with OBC-NCL issued in the current financial year), PwBD certificate, conversion certificate for grade/CGPA to percentage, recent passport-size color photograph (JPEG, 20 KB to 100 KB), and signature (JPEG, 20 KB to 100 KB). Submit the online application and take a printout of the system-generated registration slip/form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises the scrutiny of online applications, a Computer Based Test (CBT), and a Personal Interview. The shortlisting of applications is based on marks obtained in the engineering degree and industrial safety diploma/degree along with experience. The CBT consists of two sections: Section 1 (Professional Knowledge Test / SKT) on Industrial Safety / Fire & Safety carrying 75 marks, and Section 2 (Executive Aptitude Test / EAT) on numerical ability, reading comprehension, reasoning, general awareness, data interpretation, etc., carrying 25 marks. The exam paper contains 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each, with a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer. The duration of the exam is 2 hours.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Eligibility Criteria

content_sections.text: The upper age limits for various posts are 30 years for Technical Officer, 35 years for Security Officer, 28 years for Security Assistant, 28 years for Technician (1), and 25 years for Multi-Tasking Staff. content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Salary
content_sections.text: Posts carry usual allowances such as Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Transport Allowance (TA) admissible to central government employees as applicable to CSIR. Council employees are also eligible for accommodation as per CSIR allotment rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online through SBI Collect / online payment gateway. Fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process varies by post category and generally involves screening, trade tests, physical tests, personality assessment tests, and competitive written examinations. Technical Officer: Screening Committee recommendation followed by a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 Qs, 100 Marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 50 Qs, 150 Marks), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 100 Qs, 300 Marks). Final merit is based on Paper II and III. Security Officer: Screening followed by Physical Standards, Physical Test, and a Written Examination consisting of Paper-I (Mental Ability & Personality Assessment, 100 Qs, 100 Marks) and Paper-II (Subjective: Comprehension, Report Writing, Security Regulations & Firefighting, General Awareness, 100 Marks). Security Assistant: Screening, qualifying Skill / Physical and Personality Assessment Test (100 Qs, 100 Marks), followed by a subjective Competitive Written Examination (100 Marks). Technician (1): Trade Test followed by a competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 Qs, 100 Marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 50 Qs, 150 Marks), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 50 Qs, 150 Marks). Multi-Tasking Staff: Competitive Written Examination consisting of General Intelligence (25 Qs, 75 Marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Qs, 75 Marks), General Awareness (50 Qs, 150 Marks), and English Language (50 Qs, 150 Marks). Total 150 questions, 300 marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR AMPRI Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visit the CSIR-AMPRI official website at https://ampri.res.in and access the recruitment link for Advt. No. RECT-02/2026. Register using your name, email address, and mobile number. Pay the non-refundable application fee of ₹500/- online via SBI Collect / payment gateway (if applicable) and note the transaction number and e-receipt. Log in to the online portal and fill out the application form with correct details. Upload scanned copies of your recent passport-size colour photograph, signature, fee e-receipt, and all mandatory educational, category, and experience certificates (max size 1MB each). Verify all entered details and submit the application form. Download and retain a printout of the completed application form for future records. Do not send a hard copy by post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Downloaded copy of e-receipt / payment receipt of application fee Recent passport-size scanned colour photograph and candidate signature Matriculation / 10th Standard marksheet or certificate as proof of date of birth Educational certificates and marksheets supporting essential and higher qualifications Caste / Community / PwBD certificate in prescribed Government of India format (if applicable) Experience certificate specifying dates of service and nature of work (if applicable) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer for regular employees in CSIR, Government departments, autonomous bodies, or PSUs Discharge book/certificate or PPO for Ex-Servicemen Court judgment/decree and affidavit for widows, divorced, or judicially separated women claiming age relaxation

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill all eligibility criteria as of the last date of online application submission. Separate applications with separate fees must be submitted for each post code if applying for multiple posts. Candidates currently working in CSIR, Government organizations, autonomous bodies, statutory bodies, universities, or PSUs must upload a valid No Objection Certificate (NOC). No TA/DA will be paid for attending tests, except for eligible SC/ST candidates as per rules. All notifications regarding trade tests, written exams, and updates will be published solely on the official CSIR-AMPRI website. Selected candidates may be required to work in shifts (including night shifts), on holidays, and beyond normal office hours depending on job exigencies.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Document verification is done for shortlisted candidates only, prior to creation of the apprenticeship contract; any deviation from the desired qualification leads to rejection All qualifications must be from Indian Institutions recognized by the appropriate statutory authority Suppression of facts leads to disqualification at any stage of selection or during the apprenticeship period No TA/DA is paid to applicants called for any stage of the selection process Apprentices are not provided hostel accommodation, quarters, or transport by RCI, either during interview or during the apprenticeship period The engagement and training strictly follow the Apprentices Act 1961; there is no obligation for employment on completion of training Canvassing or personal follow-up for selection leads to immediate cancellation of candidature RCI reserves the right to terminate apprenticeship, or to amend/refix/cancel/suspend the selection process at any time, without assigning any reason; the Management's decision is final and binding, with no appeal entertained Selected candidates will not be allowed to withdraw from training except for reasons beyond their control, and must execute an apprenticeship contract on the respective portal before training begins Any legal dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble High Court, Hyderabad, Telangana

basic_details.job_title: BBMB Lineman Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 7 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Candidates who have passed 10th class with at least 40% marks and hold a National Trade Certificate in the Lineman trade can apply for 7 seats of one-year Lineman apprenticeship training with the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB), Construction Division, Dhulkote (Ambala), for session 2026-27, under the Apprenticeship Act 1961. Applications are accepted online only, through the NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026. Selection is on a merit list of 10th and ITI marks, with no written exam and no interview.

how_to_apply: Applications must be received online by the concerned office from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal, https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. No other mode of application will be accepted. You need your Aadhaar Card to register online.
Documents named in the notice (shortlisted candidates will be called to have them checked):
10th Mark sheet
ITI Certificate and Marksheets (the certificate must be issued by NCVT/SCVT)
Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC, if applicable)
Residence/Domicile certificate, if applicable
Aadhaar Card
important_instructions: Candidates who, after finishing their education, have done apprenticeship training or are doing it now in any other establishment under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 should not apply. Candidates who are already registered and have trained under these schemes will not be considered and need not apply. Selection and deployment of apprentices depend on the detailed provisions of the Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments, if any. The competent authority will decide the place of training based on administrative needs and the candidate's suitability for the area under Construction Division, BBMB, Dhulkote. Requests for a specific place of posting are generally not considered. The result of the apprentice engagement will be uploaded on the BBMB websites through the office of the System Software Manager, BBMB, Chandigarh. Office contact: Addl. Superintending Engineer, Construction Division, BBMB Dhulkote (Ambala City) 134007; Email: [email protected]; Telefax: 0171-2541524.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: NLC India Limited has issued for 1,067 ITI Trade and Graduate (Non-Engineering) apprenticeship training slots at Neyveli and Regional Office, Chennai. The official four-page notification provides the trade-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, stipend, training duration, selection rules, important dates and document-upload instructions. Official Notification PDF: Download NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the qualification required for their apprenticeship category. Graduate (Non-Engineering) candidates must also meet the prescribed passing-year restriction. Candidates must have passed ITI in the relevant trade from a recognized institute . The notification does not prescribe a qualifying-examination passing-year restriction for ITI candidates. Applicants must possess a regular full-time Bachelor's degree in the relevant discipline from a UGC-approved university . Eligible disciplines include Commerce, Business Administration, Computer Science, Computer Application, Geology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Pharmacy and Nursing, as listed in the vacancy table. Passing Year Requirement: Graduate (Non-Engineering) candidates must have passed their qualifying examination in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026 . This restriction does not apply to ITI Trade Apprentice candidates. Applicants must hail from Tamil Nadu or Puducherry. Candidates must have completed 18 years of age on or before 31 October 2026. Candidates who have already undergone or are undergoing NAPS/NATS apprenticeship training or the PM internship scheme at NLC India Limited or elsewhere are not eligible under the notification. Graduate applicants must have a regular full-time degree in the corresponding discipline. Candidates claiming reservation must produce valid certificates in the prescribed Government format.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age for NLC India Apprenticeship Training 2026 is 18 years as on 31 October 2026 , under Section 3(a) of the Apprentices Act, 1961.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend between Rs. 12,000 and Rs. 16,678 , depending on their training category and discipline. For Graduate Apprentices, the notified stipend includes Rs. 6,150 payable by the Government through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme . The stipend is paid during the prescribed 12-month apprenticeship training period. These are training stipends, not regular employee salary scales.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The notified training locations are Neyveli and Regional Office, Chennai. Completion of apprenticeship training does not provide any right to temporary or permanent employment with NLC India Limited.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on marks obtained in the relevant qualifying examination . The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination for these apprenticeship slots. Trade Apprentices will be selected based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination. Graduate Apprentices will be assessed based on the marks obtained in their Bachelor's degree, following the percentage-calculation procedure of the awarding university or institution. Where the university has an established CGPA or grade conversion procedure, that procedure will be followed. If no established conversion system is available, the CGPA or grade will be multiplied by 10 to obtain the equivalent percentage. For semester-wise marks without an established aggregate calculation method, the average of the semester-wise percentages will be used. For year-wise marks without an established aggregate calculation method, the average of the year-wise percentages will be used. If two or more candidates have the same percentage at the cut-off, preference will be given to the older candidate based on date of birth. Candidates may be required to furnish a certificate from their university or institution confirming the equivalent aggregate percentage for CGPA/OGPA-based qualifications.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important for 2026 Graduates: Candidates who completed their course in 2026 but have not received their Provisional Certificate may submit a Temporary Provisional Certificate in the prescribed format. It must be issued on the institution's official letterhead and signed and sealed by the Principal. Graduate applicants must include relevant semester-wise or consolidated marksheets and the CGPA/OGPA conversion certificate, where applicable. ITI applicants must include the relevant trade certificate and marksheets in the prescribed merged file.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility varies slightly according to the Technician Grade II post and trade. Candidates must possess the required educational qualification, relevant vocational certificate and prescribed work experience. The required two years of experience must be relevant to the concerned trade and should be obtained after acquiring the prescribed qualification. The notification permits experience certificates from Government, Semi-Government, Limited, Private Limited, registered private companies or registered firms, as applicable. For direct recruitment to the advertised Group C posts, candidates must satisfy the eligibility conditions prescribed by the Uttarakhand Government. The notification states that applicable candidates should fulfil the required Uttarakhand employment registration, domicile/permanent residence or educational conditions prescribed for direct recruitment. Among the conditions mentioned in the notification are registration with an employment office located in Uttarakhand up to the last date of application, holding an Uttarakhand domicile/permanent residence certificate, or having passed the prescribed school-level examinations from recognized institutions situated in Uttarakhand, as applicable under the rules. Additional provisions are given for certain Government employees, employees of specified State bodies and their eligible family members. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact condition applicable to their case. The Technician Grade II posts are described as non-gazetted and permanent posts with EPF benefits.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026 will be based primarily on an offline written competitive examination. Candidates who fail to obtain the prescribed minimum marks will not be treated as qualified in the written examination. The notification states that the examination will use an OMR answer sheet. Candidates should carefully follow all OMR instructions. Use of whitener or scratching/cutting of options is prohibited and may attract negative marking or other action as prescribed. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written competitive examination. Where two or more candidates obtain equal marks, preference will first be determined according to age, with the older candidate placed higher. Further tie-breaking will be carried out according to the rules stated in the notification.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II (Chemistry) Eligibility 2026

M.Sc. in Chemistry or B.Tech./B.E. in a Chemistry-related engineering/technical field, with at least 02 years of post-qualification experience, OR B.Sc. with Chemistry as a subject, with at least 06 years of post-qualification experience. Marks: at least 60% or an equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and at least 55% or an equivalent grade in Class 10th and 12th. content_sections.text: The main responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Creating high-quality, rigorous hands-on chemistry modules for grades 6-12, and updating and organising the resource repository. Adapting, making, testing and optimising activities, models and prototypes. Documenting the work as manuals, chapters, worksheets, presentations, videos and articles. Turning suitable activities into models that schools can use, with product specifications. Coordinating and running the testing of content in schools.

content_sections.heading: About WII
content_sections.text: The Wildlife Institute of India is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), Government of India. It is based in Chandrabani, Dehradun, Uttarakhand. It runs training programmes and academic courses and gives advice on wildlife research and management. This recruitment is run by its Recruitment and Placement Cell.

content_sections.heading: Projects, Duration and Duties
content_sections.text: The full title is "Study the Impacts of Morand-Ganjal Irrigation Project on Wildlife and Preparation of Wildlife Mitigation Plan". All three posts on this project last six months. Senior Project Associate: helps manage the team, plans and runs field research and surveys, and does data analysis and report writing. Project Associate II (RS & GIS): does data analysis and report writing. Project Associate I: supports field teams and does field research, surveys, data analysis and report writing. This project is a conservation plan for the critically endangered White Bellied Heron (Ardea insignis) and its habitats in the Lohit River and Noa-Dehing River Basins. The Project Associate I post lasts one year. The work covers field teams, field research, surveys, data analysis and report writing. This project prepares a site-specific wildlife management plan for the Sijimali Bauxite Mines in Rayagada Forest Division and Kalahandi (South) Forest Division, Odisha. The Administrative Assistant gives administrative and logistical support to the Project Principal Investigator for one year. This project prepares a wildlife mitigation and management plan for the Yettinahole Drinking Water Project in Hassan and Tumkur Districts, Karnataka. Both posts last one year. The Principal Project Associate manages teams and plans and runs field research, surveys, data analysis and report writing. The two Project Associates I support the field teams. This project assesses and monitors biodiversity in Saranda Forest Division, West Singhbhum District. The posts last one year and are "likely to be extended based on funding". Vegetation: collects vegetation data for habitat assessment, analyses the data and writes reports. Social: carries out social surveys in tribal-dominated areas, analyses the data and writes reports. Entomology: does pan trapping, light trapping and lab work on the specimens collected, and writes reports.

content_sections.text: For appointment by deputation (including short term contract), the age limit is 56 years, counted on the closing date for receipt of applications. (a) Service: holding an analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or five years' service in the grade after regular appointment in Level 12 (Rs. 78800-209200) of the Pay Matrix, or equivalent, in the parent cadre or department. content_sections.text: The selected officer can choose between two options. One is to draw pay in the parent cadre's pay matrix plus deputation (duty) allowance. The total period of deputation (including short term contract) shall ordinarily not exceed five (05) years. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment, in the same or another organisation or department of the Central Government. If selected, the officer's employer certifies that he or she will be relieved immediately.

This does not apply to those already in government, PSU or local-body employment. All other candidates attend at their own cost.

content_sections.heading: About PFI Analyst - Research
content_sections.text: Power Foundation of India (PFI) is a not-for-profit organisation promoted by leading power sector CPSUs to undertake policy advocacy, capacity building, research, knowledge dissemination, and sectoral development initiatives for the Indian power sector. The organisation functions from its registered office situated at B-28, Qutub Institutional Area, New Delhi 110016.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Analyst – Research position must fulfill the following criteria: Educational Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, preferably in Electrical/Power from a recognized university, and an MBA in Power/Energy/Finance or an M.Tech in an Energy related field. Experience: 2 years of relevant post-qualification professional experience in the power sector, with demonstrated experience in policy research, regulatory analysis, tariff assessment, power markets, or related areas. Applicants must possess experience in analysing power sector policies, regulations, tariff petitions, regulatory orders, and legal judgments, with an understanding of the Indian electricity sector and its regulatory framework. Experience in conducting quantitative and sectoral analysis, preparing research papers, policy notes, reports, and presentations, and providing analytical inputs for policy advocacy and stakeholder consultations is also required. Added Advantage: Exposure to international power sector developments, regulatory practices, and emerging areas such as energy transition, market reforms, and competition will be considered an added advantage. Age Limit: Maximum 28 years as on the closing date of application (30 November 2026). Candidates should refer to the official notification for complete discipline-specific eligibility details. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed on a regular, full-time basis, subject to satisfactory verification of credentials and fulfillment of the organisation's applicable service rules. The CTC of the selected candidate shall be protected, and an additional increase of 10% to 30% over the existing CTC may be offered as per PFI policy, depending upon qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, and overall suitability. Candidates will also be entitled to PF, gratuity, medical/insurance coverage, and other applicable benefits in accordance with the rules and policies of PFI.

content_sections.heading: PFI Analyst - Research Job Description
content_sections.text: The appointed Analyst – Research will report to the Head- Regulatory and Research. Key responsibilities and performance areas include: Conducting research on key power sector policy and regulatory issues, including power markets, retail competition, parallel licensing, contracts for difference, and emerging areas. Preparing policy notes, research papers, analytical reports, briefing notes, and presentations based on detailed research and analysis. Monitoring and analysing policies, regulations, guidelines, and orders issued by MoP, CERC, CEA, SERCs, and other relevant authorities. Examining tariff petitions and regulatory filings of GENCOs, TRANSCOs, and DISCOMs, including assessment of tariff structures, cost components, and financial implications. Tracking and analysing judgments and orders of the Supreme Court, High Courts, and APTEL to assess their implications for the power sector and stakeholders. Compiling, analysing, and interpreting regulatory, tariff, financial, and sectoral data to support evidence-based policy research and decision-making. Undertaking comparative research on international practices and regulatory frameworks and assessing their applicability to the Indian power sector. Supporting stakeholder consultations, workshops, expert discussions, and industry interactions on power sector and regulatory matters. Contributing to policy advocacy and preparing comments, submissions, and recommendations on key regulatory and policy issues. Developing and maintaining a strong understanding of the technical, regulatory, commercial, financial, and energy-transition dimensions of the power sector. Supporting the preparation of PFI presentations, reports, knowledge products, and other research outputs for internal and external stakeholders. Providing research, analytical, and cross-functional support to the Regulatory & Research Division and undertaking other assignments as required.

content_sections.heading: About IARI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) is located at Pusa, New Delhi-110012. Its Division of Agricultural Engineering is filling this post under the project "Development of an AI-based robotic precision transplanter for onion crop". The project is funded by DST, Ministry of Science and Technology, GOI.

content_sections.text: Candidates must be at least 18 and at most 35 years old. The application form asks for age as on the date of the interview. Under Govt. of India/ICAR Rules, the upper age limit is relaxed as follows: M.Tech./M.E. (Agricultural Engineering/Mechanical/Electronics Engineering/Manufacturing Engineering) with a 4/5 years Bachelor's degree. Candidates should also have qualified NET (ICAR/UGC/CSIR) or GATE, with two years of research experience. Expertise in agro-machine fabrication CAD for mechanical/electronic circuit development Computer programming: C, Python and Android Application programming Only candidates with the essential qualifications will be interviewed. Candidates who cannot show their essential degree completion certificate by the date of the interview cannot attend. For the full eligibility details, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview. The notice says eligible candidates may attend an offline interview on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 AM in the Conference Room, Division of Agricultural Engineering, IARI, Pusa, New Delhi. The institute will also tell applicants the mode of interview in advance by email or SMS, so applicants must have a working email address and mobile number. If candidates are given online slots, they must be available in their slot. Candidates who do not respond after repeated calls may not ordinarily be considered. The decision of the Joint Director (Research), ICAR-IARI, New Delhi will be final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis. It ends with the project. It is offered initially for one year, or until the project tenure ends or the project is terminated, whichever is earlier. It can be extended for the rest of the project if performance is satisfactory. Selected candidates cannot claim a regular appointment or absorption in IARI or ICAR. Indiscipline or failure to carry out assigned duties can lead to termination under ICAR rules. The JRF gets no regular leave. CL and RH are allowed up to (8+2) = 10 days a year. The JRF is a full-time worker and must follow the administrative, financial and disciplinary rules of ICAR-IARI. Attendance is recorded in an attendance register.

content_sections.text: The fee (intimation charges) is Rs. 250/- per candidate. It is paid online only, between 29 October 2026 and 12 November 2026, by Debit Card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Card, Mobile Wallet or UPI. The candidate pays any bank transaction charges. To apply for more than one post, submit a separate form and fee for each post. If you apply more than once for the same post, only your latest complete application counts and the other fees are forfeited.
