content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: IBPS first screens the applications against the minimum eligibility criteria and gives preference to candidates staying in Mumbai. Shortlisted candidates are called for document verification, an online examination and a personal interview. All of these take place at IBPS House, 90 Ft DP Road, Behind Thakur Polytechnic, Off. W E Highway, Kandivali (East), Mumbai 400101. The exam is in English, with a composite time of 90 minutes for each post. IBPS may change the exam structure. Negative marking: 0.25 of the marks for a question is deducted for each wrong answer. Unanswered questions carry no penalty. Cut-off: you need a minimum score in each test, and a total high enough to be shortlisted. IBPS fixes the cut-offs based on the number of vacancies. Interview: candidates who pass the online exam are interviewed the same day, or the next day depending on the response. Merit list: a committee makes the selection, and its decision is final. Provisionally selected candidates are informed later by email or letter. If the process runs into a second day, candidates arrange their own lodging. IBPS does not reimburse travel or boarding costs. Candidates who arrive after the reporting time on their call letter, or who come without the required documents, will not be allowed to take part.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Probation: 1 year from the date of joining. Confirmation depends on completing it satisfactorily and on the IBPS staff rules. Service bond: Rs. 1 lakh. You must serve at least 2 years from joining or pay Rs. 1 lakh to IBPS. The bond period may be extended by the number of loss of pay (LOP) days. Posting: Mumbai only, as a permanent posting. You must arrange your own accommodation. Candidates from outside Mumbai are welcome if they are committed to relocating permanently. Commitment: all positions require full 24x7 commitment to the Institute. At joining: a medical fitness certificate from a civil surgeon or a doctor empanelled with LIC of India/PSBs, and police verification, are mandatory.

faq.question: Q2. What is the starting salary of an IBPS Assistant?
faq.answer: Basic pay is ₹ 25,500/-, with a total emolument of about ₹ 54,210 a month and an annual CTC of about ₹ 10.57 Lakhs.

faq.question: Q3. Can freshers apply?
faq.answer: No. The Assistant and Programming Assistant posts need at least 2 years of post-qualification experience, and Server Administrator needs at least 3 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is a distance-education degree accepted?
faq.answer: No. Degrees obtained through correspondence, distance education or the open university system are not accepted.

faq.question: Q5. Is there negative marking in the online exam?
faq.answer: Yes. A quarter (0.25) of the marks for a question is deducted for each wrong answer. Questions left blank carry no penalty.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the exam and interview be held?
faq.answer: Both take place only at IBPS House, 90 Ft DP Road, Behind Thakur Polytechnic, Off. W E Highway, Kandivali (East), Mumbai 400101, and candidates pay their own travel costs.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a service bond?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates sign a Rs. 1 lakh bond and must serve at least 2 years, or pay Rs. 1 lakh to IBPS.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but you need a separate application form and a separate Rs. 250 fee for each post. An application for one post cannot be transferred to another.

faq.question: Q9. Does IBPS provide accommodation in Mumbai?
faq.answer: No. You must arrange your own housing, and candidates already living in Mumbai get preference.

faq.answer: Write it in English, in your own handwriting, with black ink on white paper, and not in capital letters. Scan it at 800 x 400 pixels with a file size of 50 KB-100 KB.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist and Senior Project Scientist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. Essential qualification: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline. OR: MTech with 1st class, MSc with 1st class, or an equivalent degree in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline, with 6 years of experience in related areas, from a reputed university. Required skillset: Strong aptitude for independent research. This includes formulating and refining research questions, developing suitable methods, managing research with limited supervision and taking a leading role in producing high-quality academic outputs. Experience of mixed-methods research, such as survey design, interviews, data analysis and conjoint analysis. Desirable: Evidence of independent research through publications, working papers, research projects or similar outputs (highly desirable). Experience in the energy sector, project finance or energy technologies, and industry contacts. Essential qualification: MTech/MS (or an equivalent technical degree) with 1st class, OR BTech/MSc/Post graduate with 1st class in a relevant discipline, with 3 years of experience in economics, energy systems, innovation studies, public policy, political science, sociology, engineering, or a related discipline, from a reputed university. Required skillset: Experience of mixed-methods research, including survey design, interviews, data analysis and conjoint analysis. Desirable: Strong quantitative and data-analysis skills. Experience in the energy sector, financial databases, project finance or energy technologies, and industry contacts. Interest in developing research skills and possibly doing a PhD or following a research career. SC/ST candidates may be given a 5% relaxation of marks. If no candidate is found suitable, the Selection Committee may downgrade a post. Check the official notification for the full eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Selected Candidates
content_sections.text: The notice lists the same work for both posts: Examine how environmental, social, permitting and community-related factors affect the development, financing and implementation of energy and infrastructure projects. Help design and run a survey of energy-sector developers to collect primary data on renewable energy firms' cost of capital, financing conditions, environmental and social risks, and community opposition. Combine survey evidence with financial and project-level datasets to study links between cost of capital, project risk, environmental and social factors, and community acceptance. Do literature reviews across energy finance, innovation studies, project development, environmental risk and community acceptance, and contribute to academic papers, reports and presentations. Produce clear visualisations and present the findings to academic and policy audiences (Principal Project Scientist). The notice says the Senior Project Scientist post offers the chance to contribute to academic publications and gain experience in interdisciplinary research on energy, finance, policy, technology and sustainability.

content_sections.heading: NFSU Job Description
content_sections.text: Senior Developer Duties and Responsibilities Network forensics (live packet capture, protocol dissection, traffic pattern analysis). Anomaly detection and behavioral analysis for suspicious device activity, SSL/TLS inspection, DNS analysis, and C2 detection. Deleted data recovery and file carving techniques, systems programming, and portable tool development, embedded systems and hardware interfacing (USB, serial communication). Evidence handling, chain of custody, and forensic integrity. Advanced Analytics & AI: AI/ML model integration (anomaly detection, classification), experience with LLM/SLM optimization, prompt engineering, or RAG-based systems. Log Analysis & Intelligent Monitoring: log correlation across multiple data sources, anomaly detection from logs using statistical or AI-based techniques, pattern identification and behavioral analysis in system/network logs, ability to design and implement automated log analysis pipelines. Specialized Domain Knowledge: digital forensics & cyber security, mobile device analysis, malware analysis and threat investigation, OSINT tools and methodologies. Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-performance software systems in cybersecurity and digital analysis domains. Develop and integrate backend services, APIs, and data processing pipelines. Work on Linux and system-level environments, including low-level data handling and device interaction. Implement data acquisition, parsing, analysis, and correlation across multiple sources (system, network, and application data). Build analytical dashboards and visualization tools for investigation and decision support. Develop and integrate AI/ML models (including LLM/SLM) for anomaly detection and intelligent insights. Ensure forensic integrity, data security, and compliance with relevant standards and policies. Implement logging, monitoring, and automated analysis mechanisms for large-scale data. Develop cross-platform solutions and optimize for performance and portability. Generate automated reports and documentation for analysis and investigation. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure timely delivery of project objectives. Perform testing, validation, and security assessment of developed systems. Junior Developer Duties and Responsibilities Develop secure and scalable systems, work on Linux-based environments, and build APIs and data pipelines. Implement logging and monitoring mechanisms.

Eligible candidates possessing the required qualifications and experience must submit their applications along with copies of self-attested documents (Qualification & Experience) to the Deputy Conservator, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore – 575 010 on or before 20-11-2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for the position is 40 years. The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be as on first day for the month in which applications were invited.

qualification.details: Degree in any Engineering from a recognized University. | Minimum 5 years experience in tendering process. | Familiar in preparing tender estimates, Notice Inviting Tender, tender document, bids evaluation including preparing technical bid & price bid comparative statements & minutes of tender committee meeting, preparation of note files for approval of the Competent Authority and work order creation etc. Hands-on experience in using procurement tools for tendering process through e-governance applications of Govt. of India like CPP and GeM portals. Candidates having work experience in Port sector. | The maximum age limit for the position is 40 years. The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be as on first day for the month in which applications were invited.

time and venue of interview will be informed accordingly. NMPA reserves the right to fix the minimum standard / qualifying marks for selection of position.
important_instructions: Tenure of the Engagement: The tenure of the engagement shall be for a period of 03 years from the date of joining the duty/service, extendable by 02 years on mutual consent. Monthly Remuneration: The consolidated pay for Senior Manager (Tender cell) on contract basis is ₹75,000/-. An increment of 5% on consolidated monthly of remuneration would be considered for every completed year of service, subject to satisfactory performance. Leave entitlement: The selected candidate will be permitted to avail 15 days of Casual Leave in a calendar year with the prior permission of the competent authority. No provision exists for the encashment of the non-availed portion of the Casual Leave or for carrying forward the said leave to the next calendar year. In case of absence in excess of 15 days, payment will be subject to proportionate reduction of salary. Medical facility: Entitled to avail free medical facility at Srinivas Port Hospital, Panambur, Mangalore for self with dependent spouse and children to the extent of the In-house facilities available in the hospital. Execution of Bond: The selected candidate shall execute a security bond, before joining to the post, on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹200/-, as per the text in the enclosed format. An amount of ₹7,000/- (Rupees Seven thousand only) per month will be retained from your salary, subject to a maximum of ₹70,000/- (Rupees Seventy thousand only) and will be refunded after completion of the contract period without any interest. TA/DA for Tour Travel: For joining the post, no Travelling Allowance will be paid. However, the TA/DA will be paid for official tour during the contract period, as applicable to the regular officers of the equal rank in the port with the same basic pay. No office vehicle will be provided for attending duty at headquarters. Hence, you should make your own arrangement of transportation for attending duty headquarters at Panambur, Mangalore. Accommodation: Port accommodation will be provided subject to availability at rent as per NMPA policy, which will be deducted from the consolidated pay. In addition, allied charges such as water charges & Electricity charges shall have to be borne by occupant. Termination of Contract: NMPA reserves the right to terminate your contract appointment at any point of time by giving one month’s notice without any liability. In the event of misconduct, the contract appointment can be terminated by the port without any notice and without assigning any reason. In case the selected candidate wish to leave the contract appointment at NMPA, he/she shall be required to give one month advance notice in writing. Claim for permanent absorption: Your engagement is purely on contract basis and shall not confer you any right to lay claim for permanent absorption in the port service, against any post whatsoever. Other engagement: The selected candidate shall not engage or enter yourself either directly or indirectly in any place, business or take up any employment in any other organization, while you are in service at NMPA. Integrity and devotion: The selected candidate shall serve faithfully, obey orders of superiors and perform the job/duties assigned to you diligently. You shall also maintain absolute integrity and devotion to duty. Misconduct or causing loss to port property if any during the period of your contract engagement will attract penal action. You shall be responsible for the charge entrusted to you and the care of items /property entrusted to you by the port. Furnishing information: Furnishing false information or concealment or evasion of any factual information would be ground for disqualification. Declaration if any given or information furnished by you proves to be false or there has been suppression of any material information which comes to the notice of NMPA, at any point of time during your term, your service is liable to be terminated forthwith without any notice.

content_sections.text: Tenure of the Engagement: The tenure of the engagement shall be for a period of 03 years from the date of joining the duty/service, extendable by 02 years on mutual consent. Monthly Remuneration: The consolidated pay for Senior Manager (Tender cell) on contract basis is ₹75,000/-. An increment of 5% on consolidated monthly of remuneration would be considered for every completed year of service, subject to satisfactory performance. Leave entitlement: The selected candidate will be permitted to avail 15 days of Casual Leave in a calendar year with the prior permission of the competent authority. No provision exists for the encashment of the non-availed portion of the Casual Leave or for carrying forward the said leave to the next calendar year. In case of absence in excess of 15 days, payment will be subject to proportionate reduction of salary. Medical facility: Entitled to avail free medical facility at Srinivas Port Hospital, Panambur, Mangalore for self with dependent spouse and children to the extent of the In-house facilities available in the hospital. Execution of Bond: The selected candidate shall execute a security bond, before joining to the post, on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹200/-, as per the text in the enclosed format. An amount of ₹7,000/- (Rupees Seven thousand only) per month will be retained from your salary, subject to a maximum of ₹70,000/- (Rupees Seventy thousand only) and will be refunded after completion of the contract period without any interest. TA/DA for Tour Travel: For joining the post, no Travelling Allowance will be paid. However, the TA/DA will be paid for official tour during the contract period, as applicable to the regular officers of the equal rank in the port with the same basic pay. No office vehicle will be provided for attending duty at headquarters. Hence, you should make your own arrangement of transportation for attending duty headquarters at Panambur, Mangalore. Accommodation: Port accommodation will be provided subject to availability at rent as per NMPA policy, which will be deducted from the consolidated pay. In addition, allied charges such as water charges & Electricity charges shall have to be borne by occupant. Termination of Contract: NMPA reserves the right to terminate your contract appointment at any point of time by giving one month’s notice without any liability. In the event of misconduct, the contract appointment can be terminated by the port without any notice and without assigning any reason. In case the selected candidate wish to leave the contract appointment at NMPA, he/she shall be required to give one month advance notice in writing. Claim for permanent absorption: Your engagement is purely on contract basis and shall not confer you any right to lay claim for permanent absorption in the port service, against any post whatsoever. Other engagement: The selected candidate shall not engage or enter yourself either directly or indirectly in any place, business or take up any employment

content_sections.text: Educational Qualification B.Tech / M.Tech / M.S. in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI or related discipline. Certification in cloud DevOps or MLOps platforms (AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Expert, GCP Professional ML Engineer) is highly desirable. Contributions to MLOps or DevOps open source projects is preferred Experience: 7–10 years in machine learning operations or DevOps engineering. Minimum 4 years building CI/CD pipelines for AI/ML model deployment in enterprise or government ecosystems. Proven experience with containerized and microservice architectures.

content_sections.heading: NeGD MLOps Lead Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities for the MLOps Lead post include: Design and manage continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for AI/ML models across multiple environments. Establish model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback mechanisms to ensure stability and traceability. Automate training, testing, and serving workflows using containerized solutions. Define infrastructure-as-code templates for scalable AI deployment on on-prem or cloud environments. Collaborate with Data Science and Engineering teams to standardize model input/output formats and performance metrics. Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting for deployed models to ensure high availability and accuracy over time. Ensure compliance with Responsible AI guidelines for deployment, including bias auditing and explainability tracking.

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Job Description
content_sections.text: The consultants shall perform project management activities pertaining to the implementation of the Mission for Atmanirbharta in Pulses across several domains: Policy & Strategy Support: Review current pan-India situation, identify gaps, support strategy document preparation, assist in convergence across schemes, identify best practices, and suggest mid-course corrections. Stakeholder Management & Coordination: Coordinate and report to high-level stakeholders including PMO, NITI Aayog, and line Ministries; assist States/UTs in scheme guidelines; support handholding and capacity building. Program Implementation & Monitoring: Facilitate periodic monitoring against performance indicators, track ground-level issues, and assist in preparing review reports. Knowledge Management & Capacity Building: Document lessons learned, success stories, and innovative practices; disseminate guidelines and FAQs; facilitate cross-learning between States/UTs. Other Tasks: Assist DA&FW with media documentation, transportation logistics using GPS-enabled systems, accommodation booking, e-tendering support, digital branding, social media engagement, live streaming, designing digital platforms and dashboards, promoting AI/ML tools, ensuring cybersecurity, submitting monthly progress reports, and any other assigned task.

content_sections.heading: About RECPDCL
content_sections.text: REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited, formerly REC Power Distribution Company Limited, is a wholly owned subsidiary of REC Ltd., a "Maharatna CPSE" under the Ministry of Power, Government of India. It provides consultancy across the power sector. Its work includes project management consultancy, smart metering, smart grid, solar projects, third-party quality inspection, energy audit, DPRs and power transmission projects. It also works with Government of India schemes such as R-APDRP, IPDS, PMDP, RFMS and NFMS.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Benefits
content_sections.text: The pay is a monthly consolidated amount (L5: Rs. 1,55,250 for Compliance and Rs. 1,35,000 for Offset; L3: Rs. 85,000; L2: Rs. 62,000). Other benefits are paid on top of it, as admissible under company policy: Mobile set, laptop and office bag reimbursement Hardship allowance for a Ladakh posting Medical benefits Group Personal Accident Insurance

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview. It is held at the RECPDCL Corporate Office or online, as the management decides. Offers go out in order of merit, based on the number of vacancies. If many applications come in, RECPDCL may use higher shortlisting criteria. The indicative shortlisting ratios are: Marks are given only for qualifications and experience backed by documents submitted by the last date. Experience counts only if it clearly relates to the advertised post. A tie at the cut-off is broken in this order: Higher marks/CGPA in the essential qualification Longer total post-qualification experience More directly relevant domain experience If the tie remains, all tied candidates may be shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Tenure: 1 year at first, which may be extended based on need and performance, up to a maximum of 4 years and 6 months. Nature of the job: purely temporary and not against any permanent vacancy. It gives no claim to regular employment at RECPDCL. Place of posting: Corporate Office, Gurugram and/or project offices across India. Management may post selected candidates to any office, project or unit. Lead Verifier posts: the posting is decided by organisational and project needs and told to candidates at the interview or at joining. Medical fitness: engagement depends on a medical fitness test, with no relaxation in standards. Travel and stay: interview candidates get to-and-fro fare by the shortest route on proof of journey, as per policy. Lodging is not paid. Government and PSU staff: must apply through proper channel, or give an NOC at the interview or a relieving order at joining. Canvassing: any form of canvassing leads to disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.S. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Electronics or a related discipline Advanced degree (M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D.) or published work in the chosen specialisation is highly desirable Certifications are not mandatory; demonstrated work, as listed under Minimum Evidence at Screening, shall carry greater weight Candidates from non-traditional backgrounds with strong verifiable work will be considered in lieu of formal qualification Experience 7+ years developing and deploying AI/ML systems (10+ years preferred); minimum 4 years building systems in the chosen specialisation deployed in production (Agentic AI: minimum 2 years building LLM applications or agents in production) At least 2 years leading a team of engineers or data scientists, including setting technical direction and reviewing their work Demonstrable delivery of at least one system in the chosen specialisation used by real users at scale, with documented evaluation: field-level accuracy (NLP & Document AI), word error rate or resolution rate (Speech AI), error rates at operating thresholds (Computer Vision), or task-success rates and safety controls (Agentic AI) Hands-on experience fine-tuning open-weight or foundation models on domain data Experience with Indian languages, scripts or code-mixed data is a strong plus Experience overseeing vendor delivery is desirable

content_sections.heading: NeGD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected AI/ML Lead candidates will handle technical leadership and specialisation responsibilities across multiple domains: Own the technical roadmap of the team’s reusable services, choosing between prompting, retrieval, fine-tuning and smaller specialised models on accuracy, cost, latency and data governance grounds, and documenting the rationale. Lead in-house engineers and data scientists, review their work, and remain hands-on in code, training and debugging. NLP & Document AI: OCR, layout analysis and parsing for scanned, handwritten and mixed script documents; extraction, classification, PII redaction, summarisation, similarity and deduplication; retrieval-augmented question answering over rules, circulars and case files, with citations and grounding checks. Speech AI: speech recognition, synthesis, translation and language identification for Indian languages, including 8 kHz telephone audio and code-mixed speech; assistants on web, WhatsApp, IVR and mobile with retrieval-grounded answers, human hand-off and safe failure; real-time voice pipelines within latency budgets. Computer Vision: face detection, 1:1 verification, 1:N search, liveness and presentation-attack detection at large scale; tamper, forgery and photo-substitution detection for identity documents and certificates; field-photo and satellite imagery analytics; deployment on server, mobile and edge. Agentic AI: agents for planning, tool use, memory and multi-agent coordination using LangGraph or equivalent and the Model Context Protocol (MCP); least-privilege tool permissions, human approval for every consequential action, audit trails and rollback; reusable agent templates for drafting, document scrutiny and request routing. Evaluation & Safety: Build golden datasets and specialisation-appropriate metrics with the QA Lead, set release thresholds, and run subgroup analysis across languages, document types, demographics or acoustic conditions; test services for prompt injection, presentation attacks, adversarial inputs and leakage of personal data before release with the AI Safety team. Deployment & Reuse: Deploy services through the AI platform and gateway, publish them to the service catalogue with documentation and SLAs, and contribute models and evaluation sets to AIKosh Vendor Oversight; review designs, code and evaluation evidence of vendor teams, and recommend acceptance or rejection of deliverables. Responsible AI & Privacy: Apply anonymisation, data minimisation and DPDPA 2023 requirements, with stricter handling for biometric data in Computer Vision, and document models through model cards and evaluation records.

content_sections.heading: NeGD AI Safety Researcher Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities for the AI Safety Researcher position include: Design and execute adversarial attack campaigns - evasion, model inversion, membership inference, model extraction, data poisoning - against pod deliverables including document intelligence, predictive-analytics and fraud-scoring models, and visual AI, face-embedding and liveness models. content_sections.heading: About RGCB
content_sections.text: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology is a biotechnology research institute at Thycaud Post, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. According to the notice, RGCB has sophisticated scientific equipment that supports research across several divisions, along with technology development units and core facilities. These technical posts provide the hands-on support behind that work.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The Technical Officer provides hands-on engineering support to research laboratories, technology development units and institutional facilities. The post needs practical expertise in biomedical instrumentation, electronics, embedded systems and field-level engineering work. The duties include, but are not limited to: installing, operating, maintaining, calibrating and troubleshooting biomedical, electronic and laboratory instruments hardware prototyping, PCB design, circuit debugging, sensor integration and embedded system development for research and translational projects calibration, reliability testing and quality checks of scientific equipment supporting field deployments, mobile laboratory operations and outreach programmes, including installation, testing and user training preparing technical documentation, equipment specifications and procurement notes for engineering components coordinating installation, AMC and compliance of procured systems supporting IT-enabled systems, communication interfaces and sensor-based monitoring platforms training students, researchers and project staff on instrument handling, safety procedures and good operating practice reporting equipment status, updates and replacements in real time, and maintaining all equipment on site The job description also asks for excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems and propose solutions. This post provides day-to-day laboratory and research support across RGCB's scientific divisions. The duties include: routine laboratory procedures, preparing reagents and buffers, and handling biological and chemical samples assisting scientists with experimental workflows and recording observations accurately operating and maintaining centrifuges, spectrophotometers, incubators, electrophoresis units, microscopes and PCR systems keeping equipment calibrated and clean, and documenting its use sample processing, biochemical and molecular assays, and maintaining cell culture materials where required managing laboratory inventories and stocks, and following safety protocols and biomedical waste disposal norms giving technical help to students and project staff, and coordinating sample submissions with core facilities This post helps with routine work in scientific, clinical and molecular laboratories. The duties include: supporting the Laboratory-in-Charge in day-to-day work keeping the designated laboratory sections running smoothly maintaining laboratory records ensuring safety, hygiene, autoclave and waste disposal compliance general administrative and support work: keeping work logs, processing orders, indents or invoices, and simple clerical and accounting tasks tasks given by the Competent Authority

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for any of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: First, an Institutional Screening Committee checks every application against the minimum qualifications. Applications that do not meet them are rejected without further correspondence. Meeting the requirements does not on its own guarantee a place in the selection process. Shortlisted candidates take a three-tier examination, held only in Thiruvananthapuram. Candidates are shortlisted for Tier III based on their combined Tier I and Tier II score (maximum 300 marks). The designated authority decides the cut-off. The list for Tier III is published on the RGCB website and on the notice board at the Main Campus, and no individual messages are sent. Tier III is a qualifying Pass/Fail practical test based on the job description. If you have applied for more than one post, you take a separate skills test for each one. The final merit list ranks candidates who passed Tier III by their total Tier I and Tier II score. Results are published on the Institute's website, and successful candidates are informed by email. At every tier you must bring the RGCB Admit Card and one valid Government of India identity card: Aadhaar Card, Passport, PAN Card, Voter ID or Driving Licence. If you cannot show both, you will be disqualified on the spot.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates can be posted to any office or branch of the Institute anywhere in India, as administrative needs require. Appointment orders are issued following the procedures used in Autonomous Institutes of the Government of India. The Institute may withdraw any or all advertised posts at any time without giving a reason. Any canvassing leads to automatic disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply with a Plus Two qualification?
faq.answer: Yes. You can apply for Technical Assistant Group I (Pay Level 2) if you passed Plus Two / Higher Secondary / VHSE or equivalent with First Class and have one year of documented work experience.

faq.question: Q2. Which degrees are accepted for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: A First Class B.E./B.Tech. in Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a First Class M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Physics or Chemistry. You also need two years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. Does private-sector experience count?
faq.answer: No. The experience must be documented work in the relevant field at Central or State Government research institutions, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies or Universities.

faq.question: Q4. Is there negative marking in the exam?
faq.answer: Yes, in Tier I only. Each wrong answer costs 0.50 marks, and each correct answer earns 2 marks.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the exams be held?
faq.answer: All three tiers, for every post, are held only in Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must submit a separate application for each post. If shortlisted, you take a separate Tier III skills test for each.

faq.question: Q7. Which posts have OBC and EWS vacancies?
faq.answer: Technical Assistant Group II has 1 OBC and 1 EWS post. Technical Assistant Group I has 1 OBC post. Both Technical Officer posts are UR.

content_sections.heading: About IRCON
content_sections.text: IRCON International Limited calls itself a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways. It builds turnkey infrastructure projects in Railways, Highways, Buildings, the Power sector and other areas, in India and abroad. Its registered office is at C-4, District Centre, Saket, New Delhi – 110 017. These posts are for its Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The only post is Manager/Electrical – on contract. It has 37 vacancies, and the notice divides them by category as shown below. The notice says the number of posts may change after a further assessment of requirement. Full Time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering with not less than 60% marks or equivalent grade from recognized University/ Institute approved by AICTE/UGC, as on 01.10.2026. The percentage is taken from the consolidated mark sheet issued by the University/Institution. If the university or institute does not issue a consolidated mark sheet, the final percentage is the average of all semesters/years. Candidates must write their percentage without rounding it off. If the mark sheets show CGPA/OGPA/DGPA: If the university/institute has no rule for converting CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or a letter grade into a percentage, a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale is treated as 60%. A score on any other scale is prorated. If the university/institute does provide a conversion, the candidate gives the equivalent percentage using that institution's norms. A certificate to this effect may be obtained from the university/institute, and it must be produced at the time of verification. Candidates need at least five years of experience after their qualification, as on 01.10.2026. The experience must be in Electrical construction, Procurement, Installation, Testing and commissioning/TRD Maintenance in Railways, Metro Rail or Power Transmission/Distribution utilities. Experience in Railway OHE/Power Supply/SCADA, E&M or Electrical utility Diversion will be preferred. Teaching, training, consultancy or freelancing experience does not count as relevant experience. The maximum age is 50 years as on 01.10.2026. Age relaxations follow the Government of India's guidelines, as long as the candidate has the required qualification and experience. Candidates should be in sound health and free from colour blindness. No relaxation in health standards will be allowed. Candidates can apply whether or not they are working on the cut-off date, as long as they have the essential qualification and post-qualification experience. Ex-contract employees of IRCON whose services ended because their projects closed can also apply if they meet these requirements. They must send a copy of their termination letter with the application, and the new appointment will be a fresh appointment with no link to their earlier employment in IRCON. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Contract Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: a fixed consolidated pay of Rs. 60,000/- per month, plus an annual increment of 5% on the fixed consolidated pay after each completed year of service. There are no allowances on top of the fixed pay. Contract period: initially 18 months, subject to satisfactory performance. The contract may be extended for another year if the candidate's services are satisfactory and the Project requires it. The posts are only for the NFR Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions and not for IRCON's regular establishment. The appointment is co-terminus with the Project and gives no right to claim absorption into the regular establishment or appointment in other projects of the company. Medical cover: contract employees must take a Medical Health Insurance Policy of Rs Three Lakhs for themselves, covering Covid-19 and other diseases, with a premium ceiling of Rs 4000/- per annum. The premium is reimbursed when the employee submits a copy of the policy and the original premium receipt. PF: the minimum PF prescribed under the EPF & MP Act 1952 is deducted from the salary, and IRCON makes a matching contribution. The accumulated amount is paid when the contract ends. Leave: one leave for each calendar month of service. Leave can be carried forward and accumulated, but unused leave is not encashed during the contract or on resignation or termination. No other type of leave is admissible. Employees get one weekly off and the public holidays on which the project office is closed. Working hours, working days and offs are the same as for the Project. TA/DA is admissible if the employee is deputed on outstation duty. No other perks or benefits are admissible.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the originals and one set of photocopies of the following: The application, typed on A-4 size paper in the format attached to the notice. The format asks for personal and contact details, community, whether any relative works or has worked in IRCON, last/present organisation, academic and professional qualifications with marks, and work experience as on 01-10-2026. It also needs a self-attested passport-size photograph and the signed declaration. Experience certificates in chronological order. Candidates in a current job must also bring the last two months' salary slips from their present employer, because an offer letter alone is not accepted as proof of experience. Date of birth/Class X passing certificate as proof of date of birth. Caste certificate/EWS certificate/age relaxation certificate, in the format prescribed by the Government of India's guidelines. Qualification degree/diploma and the mark sheets of all semesters/years, so that the percentage in the qualifying degree can be calculated. For ex-contract employees of IRCON: a copy of the termination letter. OBC candidates need a caste certificate issued by the competent authority for appointment to services under the Government of India, in the Annexure-A format attached to the notice. Only an OBC certificate issued in the current financial year will be accepted as proof of not belonging to the "creamy layer".

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration opens at 09:30 am at the venue for that date. Candidates can register up to 1:00 pm only. Interviews start at 10:00 AM. Only candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be interviewed. Candidates must bring the original certificates proving their age, community, educational qualifications and experience. Without them, the interview will not be held. Depending on how many candidates register, the process may take more than one day, so candidates should plan their travel with this in mind. Requests to change the date, time or location will not be entertained.

The Centre runs programmes to modernise libraries and information centres in universities, colleges, institutes of higher learning and R & D institutes in India using computer and communication technology. content_sections.text: All three salaries are fixed monthly amounts. The Project Coordinator (₹75,000) and Project Assistant (₹25,000) salaries come "with scope of 5% annual increment". The notice prints no such line for the Office Assistant (₹15,000). Duties include: Laboratory maintenance and monitoring instruments Coordination with fellows Procurement and project finance documentation Organizing seminars and workshops Assisting in proposal writing and fund-raising activities Maintaining day-to-day project operations Office and laboratory support Maintaining records and documentation Assisting in organizing seminars/workshops Mobilizing candidates Supporting target-based revenue generation activities of the E-YUVA Center Any additional duties assigned by the Project Coordinator/Chief Coordinator/PI Under the general conditions, every candidate will also have to perform other duties and work assigned by the Central University of Rajasthan from time to time.

content_sections.heading: WAPCOS Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Site Engineer: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Civil / Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from an AICTE-approved University / Institute. Minimum 3 years and less than 5 years of post-qualification experience in the construction sector. Project Engineer: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Civil / Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from an AICTE-approved University / Institute. Minimum 5 years and less than 10 years of post-qualification experience in the construction sector. Architect: Full-time Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) from a recognised University / Institute, with valid registration with the Council of Architecture (COA). Minimum 5 years and less than 10 years of post-qualification experience in the construction sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DIAT SRF/JRF posts?

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DIAT JRF post?

faq.answer: The age must not exceed 32 years for the SRF and 28 years for the JRF, as on 9 November 2026. SC/ST, Women and PwBD candidates get up to 05 years of relaxation, and OBC (NCL) candidates get 03 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for DIAT SRF and JRF?

faq.answer: Email a signed brief bio-data, the application form, proof of Date of Birth, and your mark sheets and degree certificates as one PDF file to [email protected]. Use the subject "Application for SRF or JRF".

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Sri City
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Sri City, Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh, describes itself as a Research and Teaching Institute focused on Computer Science, Electronics and Communications, and their applications in other domains. It is an Institution of National Importance set up by the Government of India (MHRD), the Government of Andhra Pradesh and Industry Partners (represented by Sri City Foundation) as a not-for-profit Public Private Partnership (N-PPP) Society. The JRF post is in a project taken up under administrative approval No. DS-2B-13012(2)/32/2026-Sec.2 from SDSR-SHAR, ISRO, dated 22 October 2026. The project works with data from the Multi Object Tracking Radar (MOTR), an L-Band Active Phased Array Radar that has tracked and catalogued nearly 54 space objects at altitudes of 400 to 900 km. The received signal is studied to find a debris object's dynamics, spin, size and RCS, so that the debris can be catalogued and its drag coefficient and lifetime worked out.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates need both of the following: B.Tech./B.E. in Electronics and communication/Equivalent with 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) and above, and M.Tech./M.E. in RF and Microwave Engineering/Equivalent with 60% (or 6.5/10 CGPA) and above. SC/ST/PwD applicants get a 5% relaxation in the marks for each of these qualifications. NET/GATE/national level examinations conducted by the Central Govt and their agencies etc. This is listed as a desirable qualification, not an essential one. Strong knowledge in electromagnetics fundamentals Fundamentals of radar, Types of Radars, working principles of Tracking Radars Radar cross section, theoretical models to compute RCS Basis understanding of space debris, size estimation models, free space wave propagation, and Good hands on using MATLAB/Python Strong knowledge in Antenna concepts Working experience EM simulation tools Good understanding of ML models The preference may be given to candidates who have published papers in reputed Journals/Conferences (paid journals are not considered) The Institute may relax the qualification and experience at any time for exceptional candidates. content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To meet the CWC eligibility, a candidate must satisfy the nationality, qualification and age conditions as on the last date of application, 15.11.2026. A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of settling permanently, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam with the intention of settling permanently in India. Candidates in the last four groups must hold a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India. The minimum age to apply for all the posts is 18 years. content_sections.heading: CWC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The CWC age limit is a maximum of 28 years as on 15.11.2026 for all the posts. Candidates should not have been born earlier than 16.11.1998 and later than 15.11.2008, both days inclusive. The maximum age in Table-A is applicable to UR candidates, and the following relaxation is given on top of it. With cumulative age relaxation, the maximum age limit cannot exceed 55 years as on 15.11.2026. For Ex-Servicemen (post codes 07 and 08), the period of actual military service is deducted from the actual age, and the resultant age should not exceed the maximum age limit by more than 3 years (8 years for SC/ST and 6 years for OBC candidates). The relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with any one of the other categories listed above, except SC/ST/OBC themselves. Departmental candidates (regular CWC employees) get age relaxation only if they have at least 5 years of service left on the last date of receipt of applications. Age concession is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age or qualifying-marks relaxation.

content_sections.text: The CWC application fee is Rs. 850 plus intimation charges of Rs. 500 (Rs. 1,350 in total) for UR, EWS and OBC candidates. A candidate applying for more than one post must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated. If no e-receipt is generated, the payment has failed, and the candidate should log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Role: overall coordination, administration, monitoring and smooth functioning of the Weekend MBA (Executive MBA) Programme. Programme Coordination: coordinate the overall functioning of the Programme in accordance with the directions of the Competent Authority and the Institute's established procedures. Academic Scheduling: work with the concerned faculty members and academic departments to prepare and finalise the programme schedule, including class sessions, examinations, guest lectures and other academic activities, as approved by the competent authorities. Faculty Coordination: act as the primary administrative point of contact for faculty members on academic sessions, teaching requirements, schedules and programme delivery. Admissions Coordination: coordinate the admission and enrolment process with the concerned departments and authorities, following the prescribed procedures and timelines. Admission decisions remain with the designated authority. Student Administration: oversee programme-related student administration, including enrolment status, attendance monitoring, academic calendar communication and the resolution or referral of administrative concerns. Programme Monitoring and Reporting: monitor the implementation of the approved schedule, oversee programme records and prepare or review periodic reports for the competent authorities. Examination Coordination: coordinate examination schedules, arrangements and related administrative requirements. Academic evaluation and decisions remain with the designated faculty or authority. Weekend Operations: oversee the operational readiness of weekend sessions, making sure administrative, logistical and technical requirements are coordinated in advance. Interdepartmental Coordination: liaise with IT, infrastructure, security, housekeeping and other support services on programme-related requirements and follow-up. Supervision of Administrative Work: allocate, guide and monitor the work assigned to the Assistant. Events and Special Activities: coordinate guest lectures, orientation sessions, programme events and other approved activities. Issue Escalation and Compliance: identify operational issues, help resolve them and escalate matters that need policy decisions, approvals or intervention to the competent authority. selection_process: Stage Details Marks
Written examination 120 objective-type (multiple choice) questions, duration 2 hours 360
Interview For candidates shortlisted on the basis of written exam marks 40
Total 400

Selection for both posts is based on a total of 400 marks: a written examination of 360 marks and an interview of 40 marks. The final merit list is prepared from the marks obtained out of these 400 marks.
Every question has four options
of which only one is the most suitable answer. The answer bubble must be darkened with a black ball point pen on the OMR sheet. The question paper will be in Hindi and English
except for language subjects. Each correct answer carries 3 marks. For every wrong or multiple answer

1 mark is deducted (negative marking). The cut-off and marks obtained by candidates will be displayed on the Commission's website after the selection process is complete. The syllabus for the written examination is available on www.upessc.up.gov.in.
If more than one candidate has equal merit
marks are compared in this order:
Marks in the written examination. If still equal
marks obtained in the interview. If still equal
the highest percentage in the postgraduate degree. If still equal
marks in B.Ed. (Principal) or B.Ed./B.P.Ed. (Headmaster). If the written exam
interview
postgraduate and B.Ed. (or B.Ed./B.P.Ed.) percentages are all equal
the older candidate is placed higher.

Exam centres will be fixed as required at district headquarters. A candidate can be allotted any centre. The district of the exam centre will be shown on the website 10 days before the exam date. The admit card with centre details can be downloaded through the link on the Commission's website 3 days before the exam. Candidates will be informed by SMS

content_sections.heading: About NeGD
content_sections.text: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) is an independent business division under the Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. It is based at Electronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. NeGD supports MeitY in programme management and in carrying out e-Governance projects under the Digital India Programme. Its initiatives include DigiLocker, UMANG, Poshan Tracker, OpenForge Platform, API Setu, National Academic Depository, Academic Bank of Credits and Learning Management System.

Demonstrable end-to-end ownership of at least two models or AI systems, with measured outcomes. Hands-on experience with at least one LLM or deep learning application deployed for end users, with documented evaluation. Experience in at least two of the following: fraud or anomaly detection, forecasting, risk scoring, NLP and LLM applications, computer vision or document AI, speech, and causal inference. Experience with large, heterogeneous datasets, including linkage of records across sources. Experience in a regulated sector (financial services, healthcare, telecommunications or the public sector) or with Indian-language data is a plus. content_sections.heading: NeGD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Role summary: The Data Scientist will design, develop and evaluate statistical, machine learning and AI solutions, including LLM applications, retrieval systems and deep learning models for text, image, speech and document data. The role requires sound judgement in selecting the appropriate technique, rigorous validation of predictive and generative models, and delivery of production-quality code. Translate business requirements into well-defined analytical problems with a clear decision, baseline and evaluation metric. Select the appropriate approach (rules-based, classical machine learning, deep learning, a fine-tuned model or an LLM) based on accuracy, cost, latency and explainability, and document the rationale. Assess data feasibility, including label quality, leakage and bias, and advise where the data is insufficient for the objective. Develop and validate models for classification, regression, ranking and forecasting, starting from robust baselines. Develop fraud and anomaly detection models for imbalanced settings with limited labelled data. Generate labels through weak supervision, active learning and LLM-assisted labelling, with human validation. Develop LLM-based solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation, document extraction, summarisation and tool-using agents. Design retrieval components (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search and re-ranking), and adapt models through prompting, parameter-efficient fine-tuning and distillation. Develop deep learning solutions for NLP, document understanding (OCR and vision-language models), vision and speech, including Indian-language and code-mixed data. Optimise cost and latency, including the choice between open-weight and API-based models. Validate models using leakage-free schemes, and quantify uncertainty through prediction intervals, calibration and conformal prediction. Evaluate generative AI systems through golden datasets, separate retrieval and generation metrics, hallucination checks, and LLM-based evaluation calibrated against human labels. Conduct error and subgroup analysis across cohorts, languages and input types. Design experiments and apply quasi-experimental methods to assess whether deployed models have improved outcomes. Develop tested, peer-reviewed, production-quality Python code and ensure all experiments are reproducible. Hand over models to the MLOps team with defined monitoring metrics, drift thresholds and retraining triggers. Monitor deployed systems for quality, drift, latency and cost, and incorporate failures into evaluation sets. Measure and mitigate performance disparities across cohorts, and provide explanations for decisions affecting individuals. Test LLM systems for prompt injection, jailbreaks and leakage of personal data, and design guardrails in coordination with security specialists. content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Project Recruitment 2026 Job Description and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: For the ICMR project "MolOnco-DnT-CenTr: Translational Centre For Diagnostic And Therapeutic Technologies in Molecular Oncology", the role involves: Leading the development and optimization of U-bent fiber-optic biosensor platforms for sensitive and specific detection of DNA/RNA biomarkers associated with gastric cancer and other molecular oncology applications. Designing and optimizing bioassay strategies, including capture-probe functionalization, hybridization/sandwich assays, antibody–nanoparticle conjugation and signal amplification. Independently developing and validating DNA/RNA and antigen-based assays, with emphasis on sensitivity, specificity, reproducibility and robustness. Developing surface functionalization, biomolecule immobilization and stabilization strategies. Integrating bioassays with optical/plasmonic readout systems and developing multiplexed diagnostic platforms. Planning analytical and bioanalytical validation studies. Coordinating clinical sample testing and validation, and leading translation of laboratory-scale assays into prototype point-of-care diagnostic devices. Coordinating project staff, research fellows and students. Troubleshooting experimental, biochemical, optical and instrumentation challenges. Maintaining experimental records, datasets, SOPs and technical documentation, and ensuring project milestones and deliverables are achieved. Contributing to reports, publications, patents, proposals and technology-transfer activities, mentoring junior researchers, and collaborating with clinical, biological, engineering and translational research teams. For the ICMR project "MolOnco-DnT-CenTr: Translational Centre For Diagnostic And Therapeutic Technologies in Molecular Oncology", the role involves: Contributing to the design, development and validation of a plasmonic fiber optic biosensor for the detection of DNA biomarkers associated with gastric cancer. Strategic design and development of a U-bent fiber optic biosensor platform, including probe surface functionalization with capture oligonucleotides, conjugation of 5-methylcytosine antibodies with gold nanoparticles for plasmonic signal generation, and establishment of a hybrid sandwich assay for sensitive and specific detection of selected methylated DNA biomarkers. Assay development for given DNA/RNA or antigen targets, and stabilization of antibodies and oligonucleotides to achieve a minimum one-year shelf-life of point-of-care devices, while ensuring reliability and reproducibility of the assays. Optimization of biosensor parameters such as probe chemistry, conjugation strategies and signal amplification to maximize sensitivity and specificity, followed by translation of the optimized assay onto a multiplex detection platform for faster and higher-throughput analysis. content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The project aims to reduce energy use and emissions in the glass industry. One focus is recovering and reusing waste heat from hot exhaust gases. The project is also studying whether part of the fossil fuel can be replaced with cleaner options such as biomass and/or hydrogen blends. The notice lists these objectives: Understand the design and dimensions of the existing furnace and prepare proper drawings of it, using different available 3-D techniques, at Gold Plus Float Glass Private Limited. Study and analyze the thermal performance and emission characteristics of Gold Plus Float Glass Private Limited's existing furnace, using appropriate methods. Establish a complete heat and mass transfer analysis of Gold Plus Float Glass Private Limited's existing furnace, through simulation and validation via experimental observations. Optimize the existing furnace of Gold Plus Float Glass Private Limited at the Belagavi plant, using different insulating materials for improved performance. The JRF/SRF will be encouraged to register for a PhD programme, following the Institute rules. Fellows admitted to the PhD programme will have a PhD topic related to this project only. After completing the course work, they will be deputed to the industry at Kanagala (Belgaum), Karnataka. The fellow must work in the glass industry for data collection and analysis. content_sections.heading: About RGNAU
content_sections.text: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) is a Central University under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Govt. of India. It was established by the Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU) Act, 2013 (No. 26 of 2013), and its headquarters are at Fursatganj, Dist. Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. The University describes itself as an institution of higher learning in the aviation field that aims to provide research for the aviation industry in India.

content_sections.text: The University is engaging 10 Professional Trainees in three fields. * The number of Electrical Engineering / Civil Engineering positions may increase or decrease at the time of selection. Ability to prepare policy notes, briefing papers, presentations, and analytical reports for senior Government officials. Electrical Estimation and Costing: preparation of detailed estimates, BOQ, rate analysis, quantity take-off, material costing, cable sizing, and estimation based on CPWD/DSR rates. content_sections.heading: About DGFT Panipat
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) as an attached office of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, headed by the Director General of Foreign Trade. DGFT makes and carries out the Foreign Trade Policy, whose main aim is to promote India's exports. It also issues scrips/authorisations to exporters and checks the obligations attached to them through a network of 24 regional offices. The Panipat office (Office of the Joint DGFT) is at BSNL CSC Building, Near Police Station, G.T. Road, Panipat - 132103, and its phone numbers are 0180-2650984 and 2651427.

content_sections.text: Young Professionals will be hired in four disciplines. The notice gives no split of the 2 vacancies by discipline. The minimum qualification for each discipline is shown below exactly as the notice prints it. Preference goes to candidates with experience in Foreign Trade / Public Policy / Management who are also skilled in computer applications (MS Word, Excel, Data Analytics, etc.). content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: A consolidated fee of Rs. 52,000/- per month, minus Professional Tax/TDS as applicable. It is paid once the controlling Officer certifies that the work for each period has been completed. Young Professionals do not get any other allowance or facility on top of this fee. Travel: Young Professionals may have to travel to any place in India. On tour, they get the same TA/DA as an Assistant Section Officer of the Central Government. Tenure: The job starts at one year and may be extended up to three years, depending on work performance and efficiency. No extension is allowed beyond three years under any circumstances. The period starts from the date of joining DGFT as a Young Professional. Nature of the job: The job is purely temporary. Young Professionals will not be treated as a "staff member" or an "official" of DGFT. Working here gives no claim or right to a later job with DGFT or any other Government Department. Notice period: The Department can end the job at any time with 30 days' notice or pay instead of notice. A Young Professional can also leave with the same notice. DGFT Headquarters may change the notice period through notifications from time to time. Leave: Young Professionals get 1.5 days of leave for each completed month during the one-year period. This leave is pro-rata and needs the controlling Officer's prior written approval. Unused leave cannot be carried forward to the next year. Up to one more month of leave without pay can be considered with the prior approval of the controlling Office. In exceptional cases, such as professional development or training, this rule may be relaxed with the approval of the Commerce Secretary, subject to official needs. Maternity leave: Women Young Professionals may be eligible for maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017, as issued by the Ministry of Labour & Employment in letter No. S-36017/03/2015-SS-1 dated 12 April 2017. Compensation: If a Young Professional dies, is injured or falls ill while serving DGFT, neither they nor their next of kin are entitled to any compensation or appointment.

content_sections.heading: DGFT Panipat Young Professionals Job Description
content_sections.text: Work on policy formulation and on running the schemes under the Foreign Trade Policy. Working hours are normally 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days, with a half-hour lunch break. When the work demands it, Young Professionals may have to stay late and may be called on Saturdays, Sundays and other holidays.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The qualification must be held on the date of application. The GATE rules decide eligibility as much as the degree does: Between 21 and 42 years on 1 January 2026 : born not earlier than 2 January 1984 and not later than 1 January 2005 . content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Document verification in phases. Candidates are called in a reasonable number, category-wise, strictly in order of the uploaded GATE score, for scrutiny of the score card, documents, eligibility and reservation claims. Appearing at verification confers no right to selection. Shortlist for interview. After verification, about two times the advertised vacancies in each category (minimum five) are shortlisted on GATE score. Interview. Worth 10% of the total; the Commission may test Odia reading, writing and speaking here. Final merit. GATE score at 90% plus interview marks; the final list equals the number of advertised vacancies per category. Ties are broken first by interview marks, then by age (older first). After the result, OPSC publishes the GATE score (at 90%) of the last selected and last shortlisted candidate in each category, together with individual GATE and interview marks.

content_sections.text: Pay: Level-12, Cell-1 of the pay matrix under ORSP Rules, 2017, with dearness allowance and other allowances as sanctioned by the Government of Odisha. Probation: two years from the date of joining. Pension: appointees are covered by the contributory pension scheme (NPS) under the Odisha Civil Services (Pension) Amendment Rules, 2005; submitting the NPS application at joining is mandatory. Selected candidates are examined by a Medical Board before appointment.

faq.answer: A total of 758 vacancies are notified, including 750 vacancies for Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) and 8 vacancies for Assistant Executive Engineer (Mechanical).

faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Engineering in Civil or Mechanical from any University or Institution recognised by the Government or Associate Member of Institutions of Engineers of India, along with a valid GATE score in the respective engineering discipline.

qualification.details: Chief Actuary / Actuarial Advisor: Minimum 15 years post-fellowship actuarial experience, including at least 5 years at senior leadership level handling large insurance or social security portfolios. Sr. Actuarial Specialist (Valuation & Projections): Minimum 10 years experience in actuarial valuation, projections, stress testing, or scenario analysis in life, health, or social insurance. Sr. Actuarial Specialist (Policy & Scheme Design): Minimum 8 years post-qualification experience in actuarial work including policy impact analysis or scheme design. Actuarial Analyst / Modeller: 3 to 6 years experience in actuarial modelling, valuation support, or insurance analytics. Statistical / Research Officer (Actuarial Support): Minimum 5 years experience in statistical analysis, experience studies, or analytical research. Chief Data & Analytics Officer (CDAO): Minimum 15 years of post-qualification professional experience, including at least 7 years at senior leadership level in data, analytics, actuarial support systems, large IT/data programmes, or evidence-based policy systems, and hands-on responsibility for enterprise-scale data ecosystems covering architecture, governance, analytics, and institutionalisation. Desirable: Prior leadership role in Government / PSU / Statutory Body / Large Regulated Institution, and experience supporting actuarial valuation, financial projections, formulation, or audit-intensive environments. Data Governance Officer: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience, including direct responsibility for data standards, metadata frameworks, data definitions, and governance controls across multiple datasets or organisational units, and experience dealing with audit observations, definitional disputes, and statutory reporting requirements. Desirable: Exposure to nationwide or data systems in Government / PSU / Insurance / Social Security organisations. Data Engineering Officer: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience, including design and implementation of enterprise-level data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, data warehouses or analytical platforms, and responsibility for automation, validation, performance tuning, documentation, and auditability of data pipelines. Desirable: Experience handling large transactional or financial datasets in regulated or Government environments. Data Analytics Officer: Minimum 10 years of post-qualification experience, including development of analytical reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and structured datasets for senior management or statutory use, and demonstrated ability to prepare valuation-ready or policy-ready analytical outputs. Desirable: Experience supporting actuarial analysis, social sector analytics, or public finance reporting. Data Protection Officer (DPO): Minimum 8 years of post-qualification experience, including implementation of data privacy frameworks, access controls, audit trails, and compliance mechanisms, and experience handling regulatory compliance, audits, or data-related risk assessments. Desirable: Exposure to Government IT systems, statutory audits, or DPDP-aligned compliance environments. Technical Officer (Data Quality & Metadata): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in data quality checks, validation, metadata maintenance, or data documentation activities. Desirable: Experience working in audit-sensitive or governance-driven data environments. Technical Officers (Data Engineers): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in development and maintenance of data pipelines, extraction, transformation, and validation processes. Desirable: Experience with large administrative, financial, or insurance datasets. Technical Officer (Data Analyst / Statistical Officer): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in statistical analysis, reporting, trend analysis, or analytical dataset preparation. Desirable: Experience in social security, insurance, public finance, or Government data systems. Technical Officer (Data Privacy & Access): Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in data access control, audit logging, compliance support, or information security operations. Desirable: Experience supporting privacy audits or statutory compliance reviews. | Candidates must refer to the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility details for each post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated remuneration from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 3,30,000 per month
salary_details.details: Remuneration is a consolidated monthly amount fixed within the prescribed range by the Selection Committee or Competent Authority, and shall not be construed as pay in terms of applicable pay rules. No annual increment, Dearness Allowance, pension, gratuity, General Provident Fund, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession, medical reimbursement, or other service benefits admissible to regular Government servants shall be payable. Consolidated remuneration is subject to tax deduction at source (TDS).

selection_process: Selection is conducted through a two-stage process: preliminary scrutiny and shortlisting
followed by a personal interview. There is no written or online test.

Applications received online within the prescribed period are scrutinized for eligibility based on submitted documents. Eligible applications are assessed on essential and desirable qualifications along with years of relevant post-qualification experience. Candidates are shortlisted in order of merit strictly up to a ratio of 1:10 candidates per vacancy
or such other ratio determined by the Competent Authority. All candidates tied at the cut-off score are shortlisted.
Shortlisted candidates appear before a duly constituted Interview/Selection Committee comprising not less than three members (an odd number)

including the Chairperson (an officer not below the rank of Insurance Commissioner) and at least one external subject-matter expert in Actuarial Science or Data Science/Analytics. The committee assesses educational and professional qualifications
relevant post-qualification experience
domain knowledge
aptitude
and overall suitability.

The final select panel is prepared in order of merit based on committee recommendations and is subject to the approval of the Competent Authority. A reserve panel of up to 3 candidates per vacancy is maintained for up to one year from declaration or until the next selection.
how_to_apply: Visit the official ESIC website (esic.gov.in) or access the online application portal link directly.
Navigate to the engagement recruitment portal for contractual professionals.
Fill in personal, educational, professional, and experience details in the online application form.
Upload relevant documents and certificates supporting age, educational qualifications, experience, and eligibility criteria.
Review and verify all entered details and uploaded certificates thoroughly before submission.
Submit the completed online application form before the portal closing date of 12 November 2026.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of 3 years, extendable up to 2 years (one year at a time), and does not constitute regular appointment or confer any right to regularisation or absorption in ESIC or Government service. The engagement may be terminated by either party with one month's prior notice in writing or payment of one month's consolidated remuneration in lieu of notice, without assigning any reason. ESIC reserves the right to terminate engagement immediately without notice or payment in lieu in cases of misconduct, fraud, breach of confidentiality, conflict of interest, unauthorised absence, or false information. Selected professionals are entitled to leave at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year on a pro-rata basis, and un-availed leave cannot be carried forward to the next year. Selected candidates must maintain strict confidentiality of official, actuarial, statistical, and data-related information and shall not engage in private practice, parallel consultancy, or outside employment. All work products, models, reports, codes, and analyses developed during the engagement vest exclusively with ESIC. Any dispute arising out of this engagement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts or tribunals at New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Remuneration is a consolidated monthly amount fixed within the prescribed range by the Selection Committee or Competent Authority, and shall not be construed as pay in terms of applicable pay rules. No annual increment, Dearness Allowance, pension, gratuity, General Provident Fund, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession, medical reimbursement, or other service benefits admissible to regular Government servants shall be payable. Consolidated remuneration is subject to tax deduction at source (TDS).

content_sections.heading: ESIC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted through a two-stage process: preliminary scrutiny and shortlisting, followed by a personal interview. There is no written or online test. Applications received online within the prescribed period are scrutinized for eligibility based on submitted documents. Eligible applications are assessed on essential and desirable qualifications along with years of relevant post-qualification experience. Candidates are shortlisted in order of merit strictly up to a ratio of 1:10 candidates per vacancy, or such other ratio determined by the Competent Authority. All candidates tied at the cut-off score are shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates appear before a duly constituted Interview/Selection Committee comprising not less than three members (an odd number), including the Chairperson (an officer not below the rank of Insurance Commissioner) and at least one external subject-matter expert in Actuarial Science or Data Science/Analytics. The committee assesses educational and professional qualifications, relevant post-qualification experience, domain knowledge, aptitude, and overall suitability. The final select panel is prepared in order of merit based on committee recommendations and is subject to the approval of the Competent Authority. A reserve panel of up to 3 candidates per vacancy is maintained for up to one year from declaration or until the next selection.
