content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for ESIC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official ESIC website (esic.gov.in) or access the online application portal link directly. Navigate to the engagement recruitment portal for contractual professionals. Fill in personal, educational, professional, and experience details in the online application form. Upload relevant documents and certificates supporting age, educational qualifications, experience, and eligibility criteria. Review and verify all entered details and uploaded certificates thoroughly before submission. Submit the completed online application form before the portal closing date of 12 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of 3 years, extendable up to 2 years (one year at a time), and does not constitute regular appointment or confer any right to regularisation or absorption in ESIC or Government service. The engagement may be terminated by either party with one month's prior notice in writing or payment of one month's consolidated remuneration in lieu of notice, without assigning any reason. ESIC reserves the right to terminate engagement immediately without notice or payment in lieu in cases of misconduct, fraud, breach of confidentiality, conflict of interest, unauthorised absence, or false information. Selected professionals are entitled to leave at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year on a pro-rata basis, and un-availed leave cannot be carried forward to the next year. Selected candidates must maintain strict confidentiality of official, actuarial, statistical, and data-related information and shall not engage in private practice, parallel consultancy, or outside employment. All work products, models, reports, codes, and analyses developed during the engagement vest exclusively with ESIC. Any dispute arising out of this engagement shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts or tribunals at New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Program Manager (AI) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Program Manager (AI) will run delivery across a portfolio of AI projects for government departments. The work covers in-house teams and empanelled agencies, plans and dependencies, contracts and payments, approvals, and governance reporting. The Program Manager (AI) leads the Product Managers and Business Analysts. The key responsibilities are: Integrated Portfolio Planning: maintain one integrated plan across the portfolio, covering milestones, dependencies, the critical path and capacity. Vendor and Contract Management: track agency milestones and service levels, coordinate acceptance with technical leads and the QA Lead, release payments against evidence, and manage change requests. Governance and Reporting: prepare monthly reports for steering and oversight committees, prepare fund-utilisation reports with the finance team, and maintain audit-ready records. Approvals, Data Access and Dependencies: track and unblock departmental approvals, data-sharing agreements, compute allocations and security clearances, and escalate with a clear ask. Portfolio Metrics: track live use cases, adoption, quality, cost and spend against plan, and flag variances early. PMO Operations: run weekly reviews, decision logs and the register of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with common templates and cadence across teams. Team Leadership: lead and develop the Product Managers and Business Analysts.

content_sections.text: NeGD screens applications on the basis of qualifications, age and relevant experience. Screening: NeGD reserves the right to set a higher threshold of qualifications and experience for screening, so as to limit the number of candidates called for interview. Interview: only shortlisted candidates shall be invited for interviews. Practical assessment: each shortlisted candidate completes one practical assessment. From a list of 15 projects with dates, dependencies and blockers, the candidate produces a one-page integrated plan, the critical path and a status note for a steering committee. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Age, qualification and experience are checked as on the closing date of the application, 12 November 2026. The notice gives only an upper age limit for each post, and says the Institute reserves the right to relax the upper age limit for deserving candidates. Only qualifications from recognised Boards, Universities or Institutes, and relevant post-qualification experience, will be counted. The Institute or the Selection Committee decides whether experience is relevant. Experience: at least five years of relevant experience in corporate business development, institutional sales, executive education, management training, corporate learning and development, or key account management. Must have shown the ability to engage with senior corporate executives and convert business opportunities into revenue-generating assignments. Must have excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-management skills. Desirable: experience in securing executive education, management development, leadership development or customised corporate training programmes. Desirable: existing professional relationships with corporates in India and other major business centres. Desirable: experience working with business schools, management institutes, consulting firms, corporate academies or training organisations. Desirable: a demonstrated track record of achieving business development and revenue targets. Experience: relevant experience in executive education, programme management, training administration, event/programme operations or institutional administration. Desirable: experience in a reputed academic institution, executive education centre, training organization or similar environment. Essential competencies: strong programme/project-management capability; excellent planning and organisational skills; experience in managing conferences, training programmes, executive education or comparable institutional events; ability to handle multiple programmes at the same time; strong service orientation and attention to detail; ability to coordinate across multiple administrative departments; vendor-management and negotiation skills; working knowledge of budgeting and financial administration; strong proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and digital collaboration tools; ability to work under pressure and handle programmes outside regular working hours when required. Professional experience: at least 15 years of post-qualification experience in construction, estate management, civil engineering works, or maintenance of buildings and infrastructure. This experience must be in Government departments, reputed educational institutions, universities, colleges, public sector undertakings, or commercial organizations of comparable nature and complexity. At least 5 of these years should be in a position carrying Pay Level 10 or above under the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC), or an equivalent pay scale in other organizations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: For every post except the Corporate Relations Officer, the salary is fixed within the range based on experience and qualification, and the final figure depends on the Selection Committee's recommendation. For the Corporate Relations Officer, the Selection Committee recommends the final monthly pay. Performance is assessed every quarter, but the variable pay is calculated monthly, subject to quarterly KPI verification and approval. The variable pay is performance-linked and not guaranteed. The Institute will share the detailed KPI and Performance Metrics framework at joining. This covers the quarterly KPI scorecard, target-setting, incentive calculation, verification and approval, and the conditions for incentive payment. The Corporate Relations Officer's approved official travel and other eligible expenses are reimbursed under the Institute's applicable rules. The Estate Officer must live on campus and will be given campus accommodation. The applicable licence fee and charges for water, electricity and other utilities, if any, are payable as the Institute prescribes. All posts are fixed-term contracts, which may be extended based on institutional requirements and satisfactory performance. The positions are purely contractual and for a limited period, and no claim can ever be made for regularising them. The notice does not specify the length of the contract.

content_sections.text: This post is based in Chennai, with travel to IIM Tiruchirappalli and other locations as needed. The officer builds corporate relationships, identifies the training and executive learning needs of organisations, generates business and secures Executive Education programmes for IIM Tiruchirappalli. The officer acts as a key link with corporates, public sector undertakings, multinational companies, large domestic organisations and other institutions for customised and open-enrolment Executive Education Programmes. The officer reports to the designated authority responsible for Executive Education and corporate engagement. Corporate Relationship Development: identify and build relationships with senior executives, HR heads, L&D heads, business leaders and other decision-makers in Corporates/Government Organizations/MNCs; develop a network of corporate clients; build long-term relationships to generate recurring business. Business Development and Programme Acquisition: identify corporate training needs for MDPs, Leadership Development, Long and Short Duration, Blended Learning and Faculty Development Programmes, Customised Corporate Training Programmes and Consultancy Projects; turn qualified leads into confirmed programmes; understand client requirements, participant profiles, delivery preferences and budgets; work with departments and faculty on proposals. Revenue Generation: achieve quarterly targets for confirmed programmes and revenue, as approved by the Institute; build a sustainable pipeline and repeat engagements; support negotiations, proposal submission, commercial discussions and closure. Programme Coordination: coordinate with the Dean (CR & FA), the Chairperson - Executive Education, faculty and administrative departments for handover and delivery; keep in touch with clients from first enquiry to confirmation and beyond; monitor client feedback. Market Intelligence and Reporting: track corporate learning requirements, industry trends and competing offerings; keep a structured database of clients, leads, proposals, follow-ups and conversions; submit monthly progress reports and quarterly performance reports. Performance is assessed quarterly on revenue from confirmed programmes, the number and value of new programmes, lead conversion, new accounts and repeat business, pipeline quality and timely follow-up, and client satisfaction, coordination and quality of reporting. The Manager–EEC is responsible for the end-to-end operational planning, coordination and delivery of Executive Education and Consulting programmes once an assignment is confirmed. The role focuses on programme operations, logistics, administration, financial coordination, service quality and team management. faq.question: What is the age limit for IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years for the Corporate Relations Officer, Manager – Executive Education and Consulting and Estate Officer. It is 50 years for both Assistant Manager posts and 40 years for the IT Support Engineer, Editorial Assistant and Hindi Supervisor, as on the closing date. The Institute reserves the right to relax the upper age limit for deserving candidates.

faq.question: What is the salary for IIM Trichy non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- for the Editorial Assistant and Hindi Supervisor, up to Rs. 75,000/- to Rs. 90,000/- for the Manager – EEC and Estate Officer. The Corporate Relations Officer gets a fixed ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 plus variable pay of up to ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 a month.

faq.question: How do I apply for IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through www.iimtrichy.ac.in/en/careers-non-teaching, upload your documents, photograph and signature, and submit by 12 November 2026 (5.00 pm). Applications sent any other way will not be considered, and you do not need to send a hard copy unless asked.

faq.question: What is the selection process for IIM Trichy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates go through a selection process that may include a written test/skill test and an interview. The Institute or the Selection Committee decides how candidates are shortlisted and the mode and stages of selection.

faq.question: Are the IIM Trichy non-teaching posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. All the posts are on a fixed-term contract, which may be extended based on institutional requirements and satisfactory performance. No claim can ever be made for regularising these positions.

faq.question: Is certification mandatory for the IIM Trichy IT Support Engineer post?
faq.answer: CCNP / BCNE / Fortinet NSE Level 3 or higher is mandatory, and RHCE/MCSE is preferred. The certification is not essential for candidates with 3+ years of L3 Level hands-on network and security experience directly with the OEMs, network and security MNCs or national-level institutes the notice lists.

faq.question: Does the IIM Trichy Estate Officer get campus accommodation?
faq.answer: Yes. The Estate Officer must live on campus and will be given campus accommodation. The applicable licence fee and utility charges are payable as the Institute prescribes.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these points under "Desirable Skill Set / Indicative Job Description" for the Project Engineer and Estate Officer: Prepare estimates for various civil, electrical, mechanical, and sanitary work undertaken or proposed by the institute. Prepare progress reports on on-going work and report the same to the authorities of the institute on a monthly basis. Supervise the execution of the works in all civil, electrical, and gardening work, according to the norms and standards. Ensure the successful achievement of the targets fixed for completion of each project, with due consideration for speed and economy of scale, and/or proper maintenance of building structures, water supply channels, and regular maintenance of all the electric generators, and ensuring proper use of the same. Invite and open quotations related to the Estate Office through committees duly constituted for the purpose; examine/recommend the tenders for acceptance/rejection with proper justification and notes. Conduct various audits related to the safety of buildings, disability, etc.; inspect the buildings, structures and road, etc. under his/her charge as often as necessary, examine their condition from safety and maintenance point of view and take/suggest necessary action. Test/check the measurements recorded in the M. Books and certify. Ensure compliance with all the provisions of the Labor Laws and/or guidelines of the regulatory authorities in respect of the workers engaged by the working contractors in the Institute or workers hired through approved agencies. Advise the Director and Registrar in all technical matters and ensure that all work executed is as per the guidelines prescribed by the MOA/ Bye-Laws/ CPWD/State's PWO and that these works are carried out with the authorization/approval of the Works Committee or Building Committee, etc., as per the prescribed procedure. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: For contract appointments, the engagement is initially for a period of 2 years and extendable on mutual consent. Selected contract appointees may be considered for the IDA Pay Scale subject to satisfactory completion of 2 years. Applicants applying through proper channel from Govt/PSUs with at least 2 years regular service may be considered directly for IDA Pay on contract basis. For deputation, the initial period is 3 years, extendable up to 5 years. Deputationists may draw either their parent organization pay plus 10% deputation allowance and 10% project allowance on Basic Pay, or equivalent CMRL IDA pay scale with IDA, HRA, and Cafeteria Allowance (31.5% of Basic Pay). In addition to consolidated pay, contract staff receive Medical & Personal Accident Insurance, Life Insurance, Mobile Phone reimbursement, official SIM Card, and other admissible allowances under CMRL HR policy.

content_sections.heading: CMRL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Installation, testing, commissioning & operation of Signal & Telecom systems in Railway / Metro. Hands-on work in Electronic Interlocking, Absolute / Automatic signalling on DCTC/AFTC/Axle Counter track detection. Handling backbone OFC, copper/cables, LAN/WAN servers, digital/IP exchanges, PA System & Surveillance Systems. Operation of wireless transmission systems, AFTC/CBTC signalling systems, tendering, and contract management. Implementing Railway / Metro Rail safety policies under statutory rules, O&M Act 2002, and Metro Railways General Rules (MRGR). Special instructions regarding Metro train operations, periodical safety inspections, and safety audit reporting. Investigation of incidents, accidents, failures, and coordination with CMRS. Conducting periodical mock drills, safety trainings, seminars, monitoring staff fitness, disaster response, and framing safety rules. Implementation, design, execution, testing, commissioning, O&M of Telecom systems in Railways/Metros. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Basis of appointment: the posts are advertised on a Regular/ Contract/ Tenure basis. The initial appointment will be on tenure/deputation for a period of 5 years. Exceptionally deserving selected candidates may have a tenure/deputation of appointment as per the Institute's requirement. Consolidated pay: the Institute may consider hiring candidates on a suitable consolidated monthly remuneration basis, as it deems fit. Lower post: a candidate may be hired for a lower post if the Institute deems it fit. Deputation: officers holding analogous posts on a regular basis in their parent cadre/department may also apply for appointment on a deputation basis. A deputationist may be considered for absorption, subject to the needs of the post, the officer's suitability, the consent of the lending and borrowing organisations, and the applicable Government of India rules on absorption as amended from time to time. Being considered for absorption gives the deputationist no vested right. Accommodation: selected candidates will be given accommodation on the Institute campus or in leased accommodation, with electricity and water charges paid as actual. A candidate who is given this accommodation will not be eligible for House Rent Allowance. Medical facilities: Institute employees and their dependents get medical facilities as per Institute rules. Children Education Allowance: admissible at the applicable rate for up to two children, as per Central Government Norms. Commitment: all the positions require a full 24x7 commitment to the Institute. Provisional appointment: appointment orders issued to finally selected candidates are provisional. The Institute will verify antecedents and documents (character/antecedent/Police verification, all original documents, experience certificate and other documents). If any fact or document is later found to be fabricated or altered, or a candidate with a doubtful background has hidden it, the candidature will stand cancelled and their services may be terminated.

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Lead and oversee the Career Development Services function, including placements, internships, corporate relations and employer engagement. Develop and implement strategic initiatives to strengthen industry and alumni partnerships, enhance student employability and employer outreach, and promote the Institute's brand among leading recruiters. Establish effective policies, processes and systems for placement operations. Align career development initiatives with industry requirements. Provide strategic insights to senior management based on placement trends and outcomes. Lead initiatives for continuous improvement, innovation and stakeholder engagement. Undertake any other duties assigned by the Competent Authority. Oversee the Institute's Wellness Centre, managing all administrative and functional operations. Provide medical care to students and staff, and maintain health records. Coordinate with hospitals and verify medical claims. Ensure availability of medicines and first aid. Look after campus sanitation and hostel and mess inspections, and ensure overall healthcare readiness. Other duties assigned by the Institute. Maintain, manage, develop and provide technical support for campus physical infrastructure in the respective disciplines. Critically evaluate and provide constructive inputs on all project documentation submitted by internal departments and external agencies to the Administration. Implement and follow up on policy and legal matters pertaining to all construction projects of the Institute, including arbitration and court matters, wherever required. Supervise and monitor civil infrastructure works, including site execution, technical scrutiny of drawings and specifications, quality control, and verification of measurements. Coordinate with contractors, review project progress and provide support in billing certification. Ensure statutory compliance and proper project documentation, and resolve technical and execution-related issues. Any other task(s) assigned by the competent authorities of the Institute from time to time. Maintain, manage, develop and provide technical support for campus physical infrastructure in the electrical discipline. Implement and follow up on the Institute's policies relating to electrical works under construction and maintenance projects. Prepare electrical designs, specifications, load calculations, and tender packages. Supervise execution and ensure quality control of electrical works, and verify contractor bills. Coordinate with architects, civil engineering teams, other agencies, and statutory authorities on electrical installations. Monitor project progress and maintain project records. Promote energy efficiency and net-zero campus practices in electrical installations. Perform any other task(s) assigned by the competent authorities of the Institute from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: A latest photograph, not older than six months. Certificates of qualification(s), from matriculation onwards. Experience certificate(s) on the issuing organisation's letterhead, showing the date of issue, the specific period of work, the designation and the pay drawn for each position, duly certified by the competent issuing authority. Proof of date of birth. Caste/category certificate. Candidates claiming reservation or a fee concession for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD/Ex-servicemen must attach the relevant certificate(s) in the format prescribed by the Central Government. For ST candidates: the caste validity certificate issued by the Scheduled Tribe Certificate Scrutiny Committee of the respective State Government, enclosed with the application. For OBC (NCL) reservation (where the post is reserved for OBC): a self-declaration as per Annexure – I, along with a certificate in the prescribed format issued by the Competent Authority. For PwBD candidates: a valid disability certificate issued by a competent medical authority in the prescribed format. Candidates seeking horizontal reservation and/or age relaxation under PwBD must submit it at the time of application and produce the original at document verification/joining. PwBD reservation is given as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and the Government of India orders under it, where the post is identified as suitable for or reserved for PwBD candidates. For EWS (where the post is reserved for EWS): the EWS certificate in the Government of India format, produced at document verification by candidates shortlisted for it. EWS covers persons not under the SC, ST or OBC reservation whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh. "Family" means the applicant, parents, siblings below 18, spouse and children below 18. Income from all sources counts (salary, agriculture, business, profession, etc.) for the financial year before the year of application. A person is excluded from EWS, whatever the family income, if the family owns 5 acres of agricultural land and above; a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above; a residential plot of 100 sq. yards and above in notified municipalities; or a residential plot of 200 sq. yards and above in areas other than notified municipalities. Income and assets must be certified by an officer not below the rank of Tehsildar in the State/UT concerned. No Objection Certificate from the present employer, for candidates working in Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertakings. Original certificates, to be produced at the selection process and again at joining, if selected.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Indore is a government technical institute at Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore 453552, Madhya Pradesh. The JRF post is in an ANRF-PMECRG research project led by Principal Investigator Dr. Vivek Verma of the Department of Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science. The project aims to unravel thermomigration behavior in high-entropy solder alloy systems through computational thermodynamics, diffusion modeling and experimental characterization, enabling predictive design of thermally stable advanced materials for next-generation electronics.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must meet one of these three options: M.Tech./ M.E./ M.S. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical Engineering/ Materials Science and Engineering/ Metallurgical and Materials Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Manufacturing/ Production Engineering. Candidates with MTech/ME/MS degrees in these disciplines should have previously qualified GATE once. OR B.Tech./ B.E. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical Engineering/ Materials Science and Engineering/ Metallurgical and Materials Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Manufacturing/ Production Engineering/ Engineering Physics, with a valid GATE score. OR M.Sc. in Materials Science, Physics, Nanoscience and Technology, with a valid GATE score OR Equivalent Fellowship. Strong foundation in physical metallurgy, thermodynamics and mechanical behavior. Understanding of phase transformations, diffusion phenomena, microstructure–property relationships and strengthening mechanisms in metallic systems. Experience in materials characterization techniques and/or mechanical property evaluation. Proficiency in scientific computing tools, Thermo-Calc and DICTRA. The age limit for the JRF post is a maximum of 28 years. The notice does not mention a date on which age is counted. The notice says strong preference will be given to candidates who are interested in pursuing a PhD at IIT Indore. Candidates with clear research motivation and long-term commitment to doctoral studies will be prioritized. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises three stages: Shortlisting, Interview, and CTC Negotiation. Shortlisting: Fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide shortlisting parameters to call an adequate number of candidates. Interview (100 Marks): The interview carries 100 marks. For the posts of GM & Chief AI officer, DGM (Risk and Operational Analytics), DGM (AI Governance and Compliance), and DGM (Data Engineering, Model Application Dev and AI Ops), shortlisted candidates must deliver a 10-minute presentation on their relevant job profile, projects undertaken, or milestones achieved. Qualifying marks in the interview are decided by the Bank. Intimation or call letters for the interview will be uploaded on the Bank's website or sent by email; no hard copy will be sent. CTC Negotiation: CTC negotiation is conducted one-by-one with candidates at the time of interview or separately after the interview process. Merit List: The final merit list is prepared in descending order based solely on scores obtained in the interview. In case of a tie in cut-off marks, candidates are ranked according to age in descending order. content_sections.heading: NeGD Co-Lead Job Description
content_sections.text: The Co-Lead positions involve heading specialized strategic functional domains, spearheading large-scale nationwide digital interventions, handholding Central Ministries and State/UT Governments, collaborating with industry, academia, and startups, and driving proactive Business Development and institutional partnerships for NeGD services and digital public platforms. Co-Lead – Digital Transformation & Strategy: Establish digital governance roadmap, draft techno-legal frameworks, provide technical and process advisory, handle solution architecture, monitor digital governance projects, provide cross-tech advisory (AI, Cloud, IoT, GIS), lead business development, conduct stakeholder engagement, and create procurement advisory models. Co-Lead – Digital Infrastructure & Cyber Security: Advise ministries on cyber security policies and incident response, support secure cloud and infrastructure adoption, facilitate new engagements for advisory services, review DPRs and security architectures, draft RFPs and SLAs for security services, and plan cyber security capacity building initiatives. Co-Lead – Emerging Technologies: Lead technical conceptualization and pilot development of AI/ML and Generative AI applications, integrate cross-disciplinary emerging technologies (Blockchain, IoT, Drones/GIS), engage with ministries for emerging tech deployments, define ethical AI frameworks, organize hackathons, and appraise AI/ML DPRs. Co-Lead – Data Analytics & Business Intelligence (BI): Architect and oversee Big Data analytics platforms and data lakes, define enterprise data integration and ETL/ELT pipelines, direct rollout of executive BI dashboards, lead business development for analytics requirements, establish data governance protocols, and formulate model RFPs for Big Data platforms.

Whether employed or not and, if yes, details of employment (department, rank, pay level, date of joining) with a self-attested copy of the NOC from the employer. content_sections.text: Director (Finance): Overall charge of Finance and Accounts function including Corporate Accounts, Taxation & Audit, Bills, Treasury, Sales Export & Investments, Financial Concurrence, Costing & Budgeting, Provident Fund & Gratuity, formulation of long-term financial strategies, capital structure optimization, investment planning, resource mobilization, dividend management, financial risk mitigation, ESG reporting, internal financial controls, digital transformation of finance functions, and liaison with banks and statutory authorities. Director (Operations): Overall charge of Regional Offices, production, engineering, mines safety, sales & marketing. Formulation of strategy, systems, policies & procedures to operations of mines as per industry best practices, achieving production targets, ensuring compliance with statutory and regulatory provisions, ESG compliance, adoption of latest mining technology, digital mining, automation, drone-based surveying, decarbonisation, and mine closure planning. Director (Human Resources): Overall charge of entire Personnel & Administration function including HR Development, Industrial Relations & Labour Welfare, Medical, Corporate Communications, Corporate Social Responsibility, Security, Estate, RTI & Administration, organizational HR transformation, talent acquisition, performance management, training & development, compensation & benefits, change management, employee engagement, and DEI initiatives.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OMC Director
content_sections.text: Download the application format (Annexure-I) from the official websites. Fill in all required details, affix a passport size photograph, and enclose a write-up on significant contributions and suitability for the post. Attach required testimonials, educational certificates, mark-sheets, experience certificates, and organizational charts. Government servants and PSU executives must route their applications through proper channel as specified in the notification. Enclose Integrity Certificate (Annexure-II) and APAR/PAR grading of past five years (Annexure-III) in sealed covers. Superscribe the envelope containing the application as "Application for the post of Director (Finance), OMCL" / "Application for the post of Director (Operations), OMCL" / "Application for the post of Director (Human Resources), OMCL" respectively. Send the complete application by Speed Post, Registered Post, or e-mail to the Special Secretary (FE) to Government in Steel & Mines Department, Odisha, Bhubaneswar-751001 (Email: [email protected] ) to reach by 30.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection of candidates shall be made after taking into consideration the overall suitability of the candidates concerned by the Public Enterprises Selection Board (PESB) through an interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received beyond the stipulated date (30.11.2026) and incomplete applications shall not be considered. faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Warangal Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIT Warangal Faculty Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification (NITW/FR-2/2026) issued by the National Institute of Technology Warangal to fill 34 faculty positions across various departments at different pay levels.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies are available, comprising 1 for Professor, 3 for Associate Professor, 6 for Assistant Professor Grade I, and 24 for Assistant Professor Grade II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM IST.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the respective discipline with First Class in preceding degrees (UG and PG, or direct Ph.D. after BE/B.Tech with First Class at the Bachelor's level).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is ₹2000 for Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates, ₹1000 for SC/ST/PwD candidates, and $50 for Indian citizens applying from abroad.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances like HRA provided on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, dearness allowance, transport allowance, and house rent allowance (if campus accommodation is not available) are provided as applicable to Central Government Employees.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible for age relaxations and category certificates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, and PwD categories receive age relaxations and reservation benefits as per Government of India norms, subject to submitting valid prescribed certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: The Institute conducts scrutiny, shortlisting based on cumulative essential credit points, written tests, presentations of teaching and research seminars, and personal interviews before a duly constituted selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply for more than one faculty position?
faq.answer: Yes, separate applications must be submitted if an applicant is applying for more than one faculty position.

content_sections.text: APPSC has announced that the Assistant Executive Engineer recruitment examination will be conducted as a single-level examination in Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. No separate screening test will be conducted, irrespective of the number of applications received. Single-level objective-type written examination. Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. No separate screening test. Normalization may be applied if the examination is conducted in multiple sessions. The notification also includes a Computer Proficiency Test scheme in its annexures. Candidates should follow the detailed notification for its applicability in the final recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: APPSC AEE Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC AEE written examination consists of three objective-type papers at engineering degree standard. Each paper carries 150 questions and 150 marks, making a total of 450 questions and 450 marks. Negative Marking: One-third of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each incorrect answer. The examination scheme directs candidates to appear for the papers relevant to their engineering degree and post code. The notification states that Paper III for Post Codes 02 and 06 will be conducted in different sessions.

DC Generators and Motors. Transformers. Three-phase Induction Motors. Three-phase Alternators. Synchronous Motors. Single-phase Induction Motors. Utilization of Electrical Energy. The Mechanical Engineering Paper III applies to Post Code 08. Thermodynamics. Heat Transfer. Refrigeration and Air Conditioning. Turbomachines. Theory of Machines. content_sections.heading: APPSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Each post under APPSC Recruitment 2026 has its own educational qualification requirement. Candidates must possess the required qualification as on the date of the Detailed Notification. Full eligibility, including age limit and community-wise relaxation, will be published in the Detailed Notification. A Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Industrial Engineering from a recognised university, along with a minimum of two years of industrial work experience in medium and large-scale manufacturing process industries, preferably in Industrial Safety, Occupational Safety, Health and Environment Management. The experience certificate must be issued by the Chief Executive of the concerned industry. For English Reporters: a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline, Shorthand (English) at a minimum speed of 150 words per minute, and Typewriting (English) of a higher grade from the State Board of Technical Education. For Telugu Reporters: a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline, Shorthand and Typewriting (Telugu) both of a higher grade, and a practical test at 80 words per minute in Telugu Shorthand. Preference is given to candidates who additionally hold the corresponding qualification in the other language. A Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as a main subject, or with Mathematics, Economics, Commerce, or Computer Science as a main subject provided Statistics was studied as a paper in one, two, or all three years of the degree. A Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Bio-Chemistry, Biology or Environmental Sciences from a recognised university. First Class candidates will be given preference. A first or second class Master's Degree in Social Anthropology, Sociology or Social Work from a recognised university, along with a minimum of two publications in national-level academic journals. A Postgraduate Degree in Mathematics, Pure Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Applied Economics, Applied Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Econometrics or Computer Science from a recognised university.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: For every post under APPSC Recruitment 2026, selection is through a single-level examination only; no Screening Test will be conducted irrespective of the number of applications received. The examination will be conducted in online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. If the single-level exam is held across multiple sessions, APPSC will apply a normalisation process to the marks, with the methodology to be notified separately. For all objective-type papers, each wrong answer is penalised with one-third of the marks prescribed for that question, as per the applicable government orders cited in each notification's syllabus annexure.

content_sections.heading: Coal India General Manager Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must have the specified engineering qualification, minimum 20 years of relevant post-qualification experience and additional eligibility based on their professional background. Educational Qualification: B.Tech, B.E. or B.Sc. Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience in State/Central/Private power utilities. Applicants must have at least 10 years of experience in the execution of coal-based thermal power projects involving a 500 MW unit or above, including 2 years at senior managerial level. Role: Leadership and supervision of mechanical execution of thermal power projects.

content_sections.heading: Can Private-Sector Employees Apply for Coal India E8 Recruitment?
content_sections.text: Yes. Eligible private-sector professionals can apply for Coal India General Manager Recruitment 2026. However, they must meet additional conditions relating to the employer's turnover, their employment status, CTC and relevant experience. The applicant must have worked in a regular capacity in an eligible private-sector company, joint venture or specified cooperative federation. The organization must meet the prescribed annual turnover threshold of Rs. 1,000 crore or more. The average audited annual turnover of the three relevant preceding financial years will be considered. The candidate must meet the minimum annual CTC requirement of Rs. 52 lakh in the last financial year. Preference will be given to applicants from listed companies in the case of private-sector companies. Important: Meeting the Rs. 52 lakh CTC condition alone does not establish eligibility. Candidates must also satisfy the prescribed engineering qualification, total experience and relevant domain-experience requirements.

content_sections.heading: Is Rs. 52 Lakh CTC Mandatory for Coal India General Manager?
content_sections.text: For applicants from the private sector, the notification prescribes a minimum CTC of Rs. 52 lakh per annum in the last financial year. This is a private-sector eligibility condition. Government and PSU applicants are assessed under the relevant grade and pay-scale equivalence requirements specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Can PSU E7 Officers Apply for Coal India General Manager E8 Posts?
content_sections.text: Yes. Government and PSU candidates can apply if they meet the prescribed educational qualification, experience and grade-equivalence requirements. For the notified posts, the additional grade requirement includes a minimum of 2 years in the immediately lower grade under the applicable DPE-notified IDA pay scale, or the corresponding prescribed Government/CDA equivalence. The notification specifies the following reference levels: IDA E7 Pay Scale: Rs. 1,00,000 - Rs. 2,60,000 (2017) IDA E7 Pay Scale: Rs. 43,200 - Rs. 66,000 (2007) CDA / Government: Rs. 37,400 - Rs. 67,000 (PB-4), Grade Pay Rs. 8,900 under 6th CPC, or Pay Level 13A under 7th CPC For Government organizations with non-comparable pay structures, the Selection Committee will determine grade equivalence using hierarchy, responsibility, pay structure, total emoluments and service period, based on supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Does Contract or Trainee Experience Count Towards 20 Years?
content_sections.text: Coal India has prescribed rules for calculating qualifying experience. Experience is generally counted from the date of acquiring the required engineering degree. Internships and summer/winter training during studies do not count. Ad-hoc, contractual, officiating and ordinary trainee service do not count. Regular Management Trainee, Executive Trainee or Graduate Engineer Trainee service that subsequently leads to absorption in a regular cadre may be counted. Actual service across multiple organizations may be combined. Employment gaps are not counted as experience.

faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, for various contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BEE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for Project Engineer and Sector Expert posts across different specialized divisions within the Bureau of Energy Efficiency.

faq.question: Q3. What are the specific posts available under this notification?
faq.answer: The posts include Sector Expert for S&L Division, ADEETIE, ECSBC / Buildings, Artificial Intelligence, and Project Engineer for National Exam Coordinator (NECA).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Sector Expert posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or Architecture with minimum 60% marks, along with a Postgraduate or Master's degree in relevant disciplines like Energy Planning, Environmental Science, or Computer Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Engineer (National Exam Coordinator – NECA) position is 30 years as per the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Sector Expert positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Sector Expert posts will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹1,00,000/- per month during their contractual period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form along with necessary documents is 17-11-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for BEE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Interested candidates must send their filled applications in the prescribed proforma by post to the designated official address.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Secretary, Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power, Govt. of India, 4th Floor, Sewa Bhawan, R. K. Puram, Sector-1, New Delhi – 110066.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of eligible candidates will be carried out through a personal interaction round conducted by the competent authority at BEE.

content_sections.heading: NICL CISO Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. Essential: An Engineering Graduate / Post-Graduate Engineer or MCA (Master of Computer Applications). At least one of the following professional certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) Certified Chief Information Security Officer (CCISO) Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) Candidates must have 15 years of experience in Technology functions, with at least 10 years of demonstrable experience in network and cybersecurity domains as on 01-07-2026. Of this, a mandatory minimum of 10 years must be in Leadership Roles encompassing: SOC (Security Operations Center) transformation Enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy execution BFSI/public sector digital security transformation This must include key functions such as Security Solution Architecture covering Information Security Governance, Risk and Compliance Management, and Security Operations - all of which should have been held at a Senior Management level within the respective organization. The notification states that a minor variation in total experience may be considered for the right candidate with proven BFSI/PSU impact; however, demonstrated hands-on expertise and leadership in SOC transformation is described as non-negotiable. No information on age relaxation for any category has been provided in the official notification.

content_sections.text: Register for and appear in GATE-2027 as per the instructions and timelines notified by the GATE-2027 Organizing Institute, in the GATE paper corresponding to your discipline. Download your GATE-2027 admit card with registration number once activated, from the official GATE website. Visit the "Careers" section of the GAIL website: https://gailonline.com. Apply online, indicating your GATE-2027 Registration Number, within the application window: 17 February 2027, 11:00 AM to 18 March 2027, 6:00 PM . Apply for only one post/discipline; applications for more than one post/discipline will not be considered. Important: No other means or mode of application will be accepted. Applications without a valid GATE-2027 registration number will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. What is GAIL recruiting for through GATE-2027?
faq.answer: GAIL (India) Limited will recruit Executive Trainees (ET) in Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation, and Mechanical disciplines using GATE-2027 marks.

faq.question: Q2. When can I apply on the GAIL website?
faq.answer: The GAIL application window opens on 17 February 2027 at 11:00 AM and closes on 18 March 2027 at 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in Engineering in the relevant discipline (or an equivalent/allied branch as listed) with a minimum of 65% marks for General/EWS/OBC(NCL) candidates, or 60% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 26 years as on 18 March 2027, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and 10 years for PwBD, subject to conditions.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply with GATE 2026 marks?
faq.answer: No. Only GATE-2027 marks are valid for this recruitment; GATE marks from 2026 or earlier will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for more than one discipline?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for only one post/discipline; multiple applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Are final-year students eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently in the final year (2026–27) of their Engineering degree are eligible, subject to securing the minimum prescribed aggregate percentage up to the last semester/year at the time of applying, and submitting the final degree certificate and mark sheets by 31 August 2027.

content_sections.heading: IPL Recruitment 2026: Remuneration by Grade
content_sections.text: Remuneration for Individual Consultants is decided within the corresponding band, based on years of post-qualification relevant experience. Final remuneration for a selected candidate depends on expectations, experience, and expertise, and the decision of IPL is final and binding. Consultants will also be allowed to undertake tours as required by their duties, for which TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation shall be paid or reimbursed as per Company policy.

content_sections.heading: IPL Recruitment 2026 Selection Procedure
content_sections.text: Selection is done by way of Interview. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. IPL reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates for interview after preliminary screening/shortlisting, with reference to qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirement. IPL will call only those candidates who match the requirements for the specific grade, position, and IC Code indicated in the application form. Applying for a higher grade does not automatically make the applicant eligible for a lower grade. Applicants must apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code. Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend an interview in Delhi or in online mode, as decided by IPL in its absolute discretion. IPL will not reimburse any expenditure incurred by an applicant for appearing at the interview. IPL reserves the right to appoint none, one, or more Individual Consultants against any IC Code.

content_sections.heading: Period and Nature of Engagement
content_sections.text: Individual Consultants will be engaged for a fixed period of two years, which may be extended by one year at a time, up to a maximum tenure of five years (2+1+1+1 years), for providing services on specific projects as per requirement. Continuation beyond the first and subsequent years is contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on defined Key Performance Indicators. Engagement is on a Contractual and Full-Time basis, during which the selected candidate is not allowed to take up appointment/engagement/assignment anywhere else.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IPL Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications can be submitted by email or by post, depending on the IC Code applied for. Postal Address (alternative mode): AGM-HR, IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL), 3rd Floor, Tower – E, World Trade Centre (WTC), Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi - 110029

content_sections.heading: About AIC STPI Bengaluru
content_sections.text: AIC STPI Bengaluru is an incubation centre in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It works under STPI and STPINEXT Initiatives, whose logos appear on the notice. It runs incubation programmes and Open Challenge Programs (OCPs) for startups, gives marketing assistance to the startups it incubates, and manages AIM/STPI grants.

content_sections.text: Age limit: below 35 years for both posts. Age is counted as on the last date for receiving applications. The notice says relaxation is permissible for deserving candidates. Experience in the relevant field counts only from the date you obtained the minimum essential qualification. The Administrative Executive role needs strong financial expertise, Tally/ERP accounting, and good Excel, data management and MIS reporting skills. The Marketing & Project Coordinator role needs business development, startup ecosystem engagement, digital marketing, social media management and AI-enabled communication skills. Read the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_and_experience: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent; 2-3 years of experience
MBA – Marketing / Business Development / Communications or equivalent; 2-3 years of experience

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: This post handles the centre's administration, finance and grant management from start to finish. Finance and accounts: vouchers, ledgers, bank reconciliation, vendor payments, bills, invoices and reimbursements; Income & Expenditure and Receipts & Payments statements; MIS reports; budget-head-wise expenditure tracking. Grant and government finance: AIM/STPI grant use and balance tracking; Utilization Certificates (UCs); PFMS-related processes and grant releases; financial reporting for AIM, STPI, PMG, the Governing Board and audits. Statutory compliance: GST, TDS, PF and ESI; coordination with the Chartered Accountant, the auditor and statutory consultants; keeping audit records up to date. Administration and procurement: day-to-day administration of the Incubation Centre; vendor records, quotations, work orders and contracts; procurement under government/STPI procedures; asset and inventory records. e-Office: e-Office/Parichay file creation, movement and tracking; notes for internal approvals; following up on pending approvals. This post supports the centre's startup outreach, partnerships, marketing, digital presence and programmes. Startup outreach and OCP: outreach for Open Challenge Programs and incubation programmes; startup databases; coordination with universities, incubators, accelerators and startup communities; application campaigns and screening. Business development: partnerships with corporates, GCCs, industry, academia, investors, hospitals, technology companies and CSR organisations; proposals and MoUs; CSR support, sponsorships and investor roundtables. Marketing and digital presence: LinkedIn and other social media channels, website content and newsletters; startup and founder stories; press releases; content calendars and engagement analytics; working with photography, video and agency vendors. Digital marketing: tools such as Canva for communication material, and analytics tools to measure campaigns. Programmes and events: OCPs, workshops, Demo Days, hackathons and investor engagements; an annual/quarterly events calendar; post-event reporting. Startup marketing assistance: putting marketing assistance in place for incubated startups and tracking its use and results.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee checks the applications received by the last date. It looks at qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience. Candidates who meet the advertised qualifications and experience may be screened in. Screened-in candidates are called for a personal interview before a Selection Committee on the scheduled date and time. The Selection Committee recommends a candidate or a panel of candidates, in order of merit, for appointment. Applying does not by itself mean you will be called for a test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The contract runs for 3 years or until the end of AIC STPI Bengaluru, whichever is earlier. It may be renewed based on performance, subject to the project tenure being extended. Both posts report to the CEO or the STPI Jurisdictional Director, as the STPI Jurisdictional Director decides. The job is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The work location can change by mutual agreement. If a candidate is found ineligible on any ground after appointment, their services may be terminated without a reason being given. Any litigation is subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi courts.

content_sections.text: The Competition Commission of India (भारतीय प्रतिस्पर्धा आयोग) has its office at Office Block-1, 9th Floor, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi – 110023 (Tel: 011-24664100, Fax: 011-20815022). These posts are in the office of Director General, CCI. The Office Memorandum was issued by the HR Division of the Commission.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be complete in every respect and must use the prescribed pro-forma in Annexure-III of the notice. The candidate's employer forwards them through proper channel. Only eligible and willing candidates whose services can be released immediately on selection should be forwarded. The application, with all the documents listed under Enclosures below, must reach this address by 21 December 2026 (5:00 PM): Deputy Director (HR), Competition Commission of India, 9th Floor, Office Block-1, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi-110023 Fill in the Format of Application (Annexure-III) and paste a copy of a passport size photograph in the space provided. Fill in items 1 to 20. These cover the post applied for, date of birth, date of superannuation, service, present employer's status, present and substantive posts with pay details, educational qualification from Matric onwards, how you meet the essential and desirable requirements, and your employment history in chronological order. Under item 14, give your experience of handling investigation or enforcement of any economic or regulatory law, and your experience in Competition Law/Matters. Name the laws and the number of years. If you do not hold a post in the new Pay Matrix, Pay Band or Grade Pay of the Central Government, state how your pay scale compares with the Central Government's pay scales and attach supporting documents. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies in total: 1 post of Young Professional-I (F&A) and 1 post of Young Professional-II (F&A).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with scanned documents must be submitted by email on or before 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for Young Professional-I (F&A)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Com., BBA, or BBS degree with at least 60% marks from a recognised university or college, along with at least one year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Young Professional-II (F&A)?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Com./BBA/BBS with 60% marks plus either CA/ICWA/CS (Inter) with one year experience, or an MBA (Finance) or equivalent with at least 60% marks and one year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years as on 20 November 2026, with relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST and women, and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is ₹30,000 for Young Professional-I and ₹42,000 for Young Professional-II, with no HRA admissible.

faq.question: Q7. When and where will the interviews be conducted?
faq.answer: Interviews will be held on 25 November 2026 in the Committee Room, Directorate, ICAR-IARI, New Delhi-110012, at 10:00 AM for YP-I and 2:30 PM for YP-II.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely temporary and on a contractual basis for an initial period of one year, extendable up to a maximum of three years.

faq.question: Q9. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the completed application form, original and self-attested copies of certificates and mark sheets from Class X onwards, experience certificates, relative declaration, and an NOC from their current employer if applicable.

basic_details.job_title: District Panchayat Kanker, Chhattisgarh Accountant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: District Panchayat Kanker, Chhattisgarh has announced 4 vacancies for the Accountant (Contract) post on a contract basis for 1 year, which is renewable for 1 year based on performance and mutual consent. Eligible applicants must possess a Bachelor of Commerce with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST), with a second class pass for Bastar and Sarguja divisions. Candidates are required to apply online on or before 1 November 2026 at 12:00 midnight. The selection process consists of a Merit List, Document Verification, and Computer Practical Exam.

how_to_apply: Access the designated online registration portal at zpkanker.indicompute.com or through www.kanker.gov.in.

Fill in personal details, residential address, category, and active Chhattisgarh employment registration number. Candidates will be solely responsible for any incorrect entry, and no correction will be permitted once submitted.
Enter academic qualifications including Higher Secondary and B.Com details, along with marks obtained.

Upload self-attested copies of essential certificates including the Chhattisgarh local resident certificate, permanent caste certificate, live employment exchange card, mark sheets, and medical board certificate (for PwD candidates).
Attach the appointment order, experience certificate, and current employer NOC if claiming marks for experience in government rural development schemes.
Submit the online application before the closing time of 12:00 midnight on 01 November 2026. Late applications will not be accepted.
important_instructions: Candidates must hold an active employment exchange registration certificate from Chhattisgarh; applications without an attested copy of a valid live certificate will be rejected. Eligible candidates will be called for document verification in a 1:5 ratio; absent candidates or those appearing with incomplete documents will not be granted a second opportunity under any circumstances. No travelling allowance (TA) or any other allowance will be paid for attending document verification or examinations; candidates must attend at their own expense and arrangements. Candidates currently serving in government offices must present a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer. All updates, claims and objections lists, call letters, merit lists, and final select lists will be published exclusively on the district portal (www.kanker.gov.in). The number of advertised positions may be increased or decreased based on the creation of contingency funds under the VB-G RAM G mission. Resolution of any objections in the recruitment process will be made by the Collector & District Programme Coordinator VB-G RAM G, and that decision shall be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 contract vacancies have been released for the Accountant (Contract) post under the Viksit Bharat - Rojgar aur Aajeevika ke liye Guarantee Mission (Gramin). Note: All 4 vacancies fall under the Open/Free category (Mukt) according to the reservation roster (UR: 1 Open, ST: 2 Open, OBC: 1 Open).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet all the eligibility criteria specified below before submitting their online application: Nationality & Domicile: The applicant must be a local resident of Chhattisgarh State. A valid domicile certificate issued by a competent authority in the prescribed format is mandatory. Educational Qualification: Must have passed a Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) with at least 55% marks. Candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) categories require a minimum of 50% marks. For candidates belonging to the Bastar and Sarguja divisions, passing in second class is required. Required educational qualifications must be completed on or before the date of application submission. Employment Registration: The applicant must possess an active and live registration certificate from an Employment Exchange (Rojgar Karyalaya jivit panjiyan) in Chhattisgarh. Age Limit: The candidate must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01 September 2026. Age relaxations apply as per circulars issued from time to time by the Chhattisgarh General Administration Department. Experience (Weightage): Work experience in government rural development schemes at an equal or higher pay scale carries additional marks in selection (5 marks for 1 to 2 years, 10 marks for 2 to 5 years, and 15 marks for more than 5 years). Experience elsewhere will not be counted. To claim marks for experience, candidates must attach: (1) copy of appointment order, (2) experience certificate, and (3) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer. Ineligibility / Disqualifications: Candidates having more than two living children, with one born on or after 26 January 2001, are not eligible for appointment. Disqualifications under Rule 1961 of the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (General Conditions of Service) will also apply. Furthermore, personnel previously dismissed or whose contract extensions were discontinued by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department due to irregularities are not eligible to apply. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Appointees will receive a consolidated monthly honorarium as determined under the guidelines approved by the Finance Department and Chhattisgarh State Government. The official notification does not mention the in-hand salary or exact remuneration amount. No special pay, dearness allowance (DA), house rent allowance (HRA), or compensation rent allowance will be payable on top of the consolidated pay. Eligibility for pay increments will be governed by Finance Department sanctions and government directives under contract appointment rules. The appointment is purely temporary and on a contract basis under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules, 2012 for an initial duration of 1 year. Leave entitlement will be governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules, 2012. The contract may be extended for an additional period of 1 year based on work requirements, efficiency, conduct, government directions, and mutual agreement between both parties. Selected candidates are required to execute an agreement contract on a Rs 50 stamp paper with the employer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Panchayat Kanker, Chhattisgarh Accountant (Contract)
content_sections.text: Access the designated online registration portal at zpkanker.indicompute.com or through www.kanker.gov.in. Fill in personal details, residential address, category, and active Chhattisgarh employment registration number. Candidates will be solely responsible for any incorrect entry, and no correction will be permitted once submitted. Enter academic qualifications including Higher Secondary and B.Com details, along with marks obtained. Upload self-attested copies of essential certificates including the Chhattisgarh local resident certificate, permanent caste certificate, live employment exchange card, mark sheets, and medical board certificate (for PwD candidates). Attach the appointment order, experience certificate, and current employer NOC if claiming marks for experience in government rural development schemes. Submit the online application before the closing time of 12:00 midnight on 01 November 2026. Late applications will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Merit List, Document Verification, and a Computer Practical Exam based on a 100-mark evaluation system. There is no personal interview. Based on applications received, a preliminary eligible/ineligible list for claims and objections will be published on the district panchayat notice board and on www.kanker.gov.in. Only one opportunity will be provided to rectify any clerical error during the claims and objections stage; no claim/objection will be entertained after the due date. Thereafter, eligible candidates will be invited for document verification in a 1:5 ratio. Candidates who successfully clear document verification will be shortlisted on merit for the 15-mark Computer Practical Exam. Candidates must carry an original photo identity card (Aadhaar Card or PAN Card) for identification. The final selection will be subject to the writ petition pending before the High Court of Chhattisgarh at Bilaspur regarding reservation.

content_sections.heading: MIMUL Management Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will perform various operational duties depending on their assigned posts: Management Trainee (Field Extension Activity): Village survey, data collection and entry; assessing milk production, surplus availability, and feasibility of Dairy Co-operative formation; conducting awareness programs and training; milk testing and AMCU operation; guiding Dairy Co-operative societies. Management Trainee (Plant Operation): Receiving milk from societies, testing, recording, chilling, and dispatching; operating and maintaining Bulk Milk Cooling units and maintaining plant hygiene; maintaining relations with societies and farmers; managing records and reports. Account Assistant/Jr. Account Assistant: General entry in Tally and billing software; bill generation and related activities; ledger posting, general accounts work, and handling accounting & taxation tasks; bill verification and release of payments. Executive (Sales): Marketing MIMUL milk and milk products, increasing sales volume, and handling distributors and retailers; planning and achieving sales targets; developing marketing intelligence; ensuring collection of sales proceeds; managing assets and logistics for distribution.

content_sections.text: The APPSC ASO syllabus consists of General Studies and Mental Ability in Paper I and subject-related topics in Paper II. Indian History, with emphasis on Andhra Pradesh and the National Movement. Geography of India and Andhra Pradesh. Indian Polity, Constitution, Governance and Public Policy. Indian Economy and Economic Planning. Sustainable Development and Environmental Protection. Disaster Management and Remote Sensing. Logical Reasoning and Analytical Ability. Internet and Computer Communication. Office Automation and Related Software Applications.

content_sections.heading: About DSLSA
content_sections.text: The Delhi State Legal Services Authority was set up under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, an Act of Parliament, and works under the administrative control of the High Court of Delhi. Its Central Office is on the 3rd Floor, Rouse Avenue District Court Complex, Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Marg, New Delhi-110002.

content_sections.heading: Work Profile
content_sections.text: Analytical study and research for future planning, so that the schemes of NALSA and DSLSA are implemented better. Support and assistance to victims in matters under the Delhi Victim Compensation Scheme in the District Legal Services Authorities. Legal assistance to victims of human trafficking, and looking after their welfare and rehabilitation together with NGOs working in the field. Preparing PowerPoint presentations, flyers, pamphlets, newsletters and information material for awareness and legal literacy programmes.

content_sections.heading: DSLSA Law Clerk-cum-Research Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not have reached 27 years of age on the last date for receipt of applications, 16 November 2026. You must be a law graduate who passed the LL.B./Law Graduation degree after March 2023, with at least 60% marks. The degree must be from a Law School, College, University or Institution recognised by the Bar Council of India for enrolment as an Advocate. Final-year LL.B. students may also apply. They must show proof of having the law degree at the interview. If they cannot, they may not be called for interview and their application may be rejected. You need good knowledge of MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel. With your application form, you must attach a PowerPoint presentation of at least 15 slides on one of these research topics: Provisions of Legal Services Authorities Act - 1987 Research Methodology Victimology Victim Compensation Rights of under Trial Prisoners Rights of Children Right of Persons of LGBT Community You must meet every eligibility condition on the last date for applications. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected on the basis of an interview only. No TA/DA is paid to candidates called for interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: a full-time job, but purely contractual and temporary. You cannot take up any other profession, service or engagement while you work for DSLSA. Period: the first engagement is for three months. It may be extended from time to time, up to a maximum of one year. Extensions depend on your work assessment, performance and conduct, and on what the Authority needs. No claim to a regular post: the engagement gives no right to a regular appointment or to continue in service at DSLSA. The Authority may end the engagement at any time without giving reasons. Leave: 12 days a year, with no more than 3 days in a calendar month. Leave above these limits is deducted pro rata from your pay. Leave you do not use cannot be carried forward to an extended period or encashed. Notice period: you must give one month's notice before leaving. Otherwise, one month's pay is deducted or recovered. Working hours: you may have to work beyond office hours, and no overtime is paid.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DSLSA Law Clerk-cum-Research Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the official website, www.dslsa.org . Open the web link for the Law Clerk-cum-Research Assistant application. It is live from 2 November 2026, 10:00 AM to 16 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Fill in the online application form. Attach your PowerPoint presentation of at least 15 slides on one of the listed research topics. Submit the form before 5:00 PM on 16 November 2026. Applications sent any other way, such as a hard copy or by e-mail, will be rejected without consideration. Final-year students must bring proof of their law degree to the interview.

content_sections.heading: CRCS Consultant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not be older than 62 years at the time of applying. content_sections.heading: Duties of the Consultant
content_sections.text: The Consultant will deal with Court Cases, VIP Matters and Finance. The Consultant will also help run the office's day-to-day work across its areas of activity, in line with its mandate.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be called for an interview. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or for joining the post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The terms follow Department of Expenditure Office Memorandum No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. The engagement is purely on contract. It does not count as re-employment. The first term is one year. It may be extended after review, at the sole discretion of the Office or Ministry. The post is full-time. During the contract you may not take any other assignment in a public or private organisation. The place of work is the CRCS office at World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi. There is no accommodation and no allowance, including Dearness Allowance, transport, residential accommodation, personal staff, CGHS and medical reimbursement. There is no Provident Fund, pension, insurance or gratuity. Leave is 1.5 days for each completed month. Leave cannot be carried beyond a calendar year, unused leave is not paid for, and no single spell of leave may be longer than three days. The Department can end the engagement at any time without notice or reason. The Consultant can resign by giving 15 days' notice or paying the consultancy fee instead. The Consultant must keep the Department's information confidential, avoid conflicts of interest and keep absolute integrity. The Department may review the Consultant's work at any time. If any information you give turns out to be false, or you hide a material fact, you can be removed from the engagement. The Department is not responsible for any loss, accidental damage or injury that happens during the work, including travel.

content_sections.heading: About SMP Kolkata
content_sections.text: Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata, formerly Kolkata Port Trust, is a Major Port Authority with its office at 15, Strand Road, Kolkata-700 001.
