content_sections.text: The circular also gives the older scales for the post: Rs. 20,600 to Rs. 46,500 (pre-revised, as on 01.01.2007) and Rs. 10,750 to Rs. 16,750 (pre-pre-revised, as on 01.01.1997). The post is a Class I post and is classified as a "Selection" post. According to the Recruitment Rules, 2 of the 4 existing posts of Senior Assistant Secretary / Senior Assistant Secretary (Public Relations) will be designated as Assistant Secretary Grade-I / Assistant Secretary (Public Relations) Grade-I. content_sections.heading: SMP Kolkata Senior Assistant Secretary Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Deputation or absorption is open to officers of a Major Port Authority who hold one of the following: an analogous post, or the post of Assistant Secretary Grade I / Assistant Secretary (Public Relations) Grade-I in the scale of Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 1,60,000 (pre-revised Rs. 9,100 to Rs. 15,100), with 5 years of regular service in the grade. Eligibility is checked as on 30 October 2026, the last date for applications. The Recruitment Rules set an upper age limit of 35 years for direct recruitment. They state that this age limit does not apply to promotion, absorption or deputation. Essential: a degree in any discipline from a recognized University. The Recruitment Rules state that this qualification also applies to candidates coming on deputation or absorption. For direct recruits, the rules ask for five years of experience in the executive cadre in General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations and similar fields in an Industrial, Commercial or Government Undertaking. This experience condition does not apply to deputation or absorption. Deputationists need the 5 years of regular service in the grade described above. Post Graduate degree / diploma in Personnel Management, Industrial Relations, Social Work, Labour Welfare or allied subjects, or a Degree in Law from a recognized University/Institution. Post Graduate Diploma in Public Relations / Mass Communication, Journalism, with two years of experience in the executive cadre in the field of Public Relations. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see Annexure-I of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Allowances on Deputation
content_sections.text: Within one month of joining the Kolkata Dock System, the officer chooses one of two options. The first is pay in the scale of the post at the Port. The second is basic pay in the parent organisation's scale plus deputation allowance. The deputation allowance ceilings rise by a further 25% each time Dearness Allowance goes up by 50%. If the officer is covered under NPS, SMPK pays the employer's contribution. SMPA also bears a gratuity contribution of 4% of basic pay plus applicable DA. An officer who keeps the parent pay scale gets LTC under the parent organisation's rules, and SMPK pays for it.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Deputation is for three (03) years from the date the officer takes charge, and it can be extended by up to two (02) more years. The Recruitment Rules give a probation period of 2 years for the post. Leave rules of the parent organisation continue to apply, but SMPK keeps the leave account and sanctions the leave. If a departmental inquiry is started during deputation, SMPK may send the officer back to the parent organisation. SMPK can end the deputation early after giving three months' notice. In exceptional cases it can do so without notice. Any matter not covered by the terms is governed by SMPK's rules. Any relaxation of the terms needs SMPK's prior approval.

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Open Enrolment programmes are either Short-duration Programmes (SDPs) of 3-6 days or Long-duration Programmes (LDPs) that run over 6 months to 1 year. This is an individual contributor Sales role in a B2C and B2B context. The job is to generate leads (aspirants), engage with them and turn them into paid participants for each cohort. The duties are: Handle all inbound and outbound leads and close each sale when the finalised candidate pays. Follow up with direct aspirants and sponsoring organisations by phone, email and in person. Provide data analytics and feedback on what is and is not working, to fine-tune Digital Marketing campaigns. Understand how social media campaigns are run and what goes into social media posts. Work with the DM team to design marketing collaterals, such as videos, graphic artwork and text for webpages, brochures and testimonials, across different media platforms. At the top end of the role, own the end-to-end Sales and Marketing of the assigned programmes and devise a go-to-market strategy for them. Analyse past data to spot broad trends and build data-driven strategies. Understand similar products in the market. Lead end-to-end execution of the Marketing Plan: campaign planning, analysis, execution, tracking, reporting and troubleshooting. Monitor and optimise campaigns. Work with internal and external stakeholders, such as faculty, other departments, corporate L&D/HR, vendors and the digital marketing team. Create MIS and dashboards for all stakeholders. Give inputs for case studies, brochures and videos for social media and the website.

content_sections.heading: About MBMC
content_sections.text: Mira Bhayandar Municipal Corporation is the civic body for Mira Bhayandar in Thane district, Maharashtra. Its Public Health Department works from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Bhayandar (W). The person appointed will work at the corporation's Bharatratna Indira Gandhi Hospital in Mira Road.

content_sections.heading: MBMC Mammography Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A degree in the science faculty from a recognised university, with Radiology as a subject. 3 years' experience as a Mammography Technician in a government-recognised hospital. Knowledge of Marathi is required. The application form also has a section for computer qualifications (MSCIT or an equivalent recognised course). Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: MBMC will check the applications it receives and prepare a draft merit list of eligible candidates. Appointments will be made from this list in order of merit, based on MBMC's needs and the notice's terms and conditions. Selected candidates must report for appointment with their original eligibility and experience documents, a passport-size photograph and one set of self-attested photocopies. MBMC will not write to candidates who are found ineligible.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The first appointment order will be for six months, on an honorary, purely temporary basis. The selected candidate must join within 3 days of receiving the appointment order. The job requires at least eight hours of duty a day, depending on the hospital's needs. The head of department sets the working hours. Because this is an essential service, extra work may be needed when required. The post is entirely honorary and on contract. It gives no right to claim a permanent post, absorption into MBMC service or the benefits of permanent staff. Candidates also cannot take this claim to court. MBMC may end the appointment without notice. It does not have to give one month's notice. To resign, you must give at least 15 days' written notice. If you do not, that month's honorarium will not be paid. Service can be ended without notice for doubtful integrity, misconduct or improper behaviour, misleading seniors, absence or disobeying orders. It can also be ended at any stage if your work is not satisfactory. The Medical Health Officer or head of department decides what the work involves. The Commissioner may change the number of posts or other details, change the process, or cancel the recruitment at any stage without giving a reason. Your candidature will be cancelled automatically if you are found ineligible or if you use misconduct or pressure at any stage. If you have already been appointed, the appointment will be ended.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MBMC Mammography Technician Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the MBMC website . The notice says applications not made on this form within the deadline will not be accepted. Paste a passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign below it. Fill in your full name in Marathi and in English capital letters. Then add your permanent and current addresses, phone number, email, date of birth, age, sex, nationality, whether you are domiciled in Maharashtra, marital status and the languages you know. List your educational qualifications from Class 10 upwards, giving percentages only. Do not give grades, SGPA or CGPA. Then add any additional qualifications and your computer qualification. Give details of your experience: the institution, whether it is government, semi-government or private, the period, the total time and why you left. Answer the question on court, criminal or disciplinary cases, list the copies you are attaching, and sign the declaration. Complete and sign the undertaking (हमीपत्र) stating that no criminal case is registered against you. Submit the application by 5.00 pm on 10 November 2026 at: Public Health Department, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Ground Floor, Bhayandar (W), Tal. Dist. Thane - 401101. Attach self-attested true copies of your mark sheets and certificates as proof of age, educational qualification, marks and experience. Applications will be rejected if candidates are not eligible, if the form is incomplete or wrongly filled, or if these copies are missing. The Public Health Department can be contacted at [email protected] or by phone on 022-28192828 / 28193028.

content_sections.heading: ICMR-NIRWoH Senior Consultant - Hindi/Rajbhashya Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in the effective implementation of the Government of India Official Language Policy in the Institute. Prepare Hindi quarterly progress reports of the Institute. Translate the Institute's annual report and other documents into Hindi. Prepare reports and necessary details regarding the inspection questionnaire of the Parliamentary Committee on Official Language. Translate various forms, circulars, manuals, articles, office orders, letters, and other documents from Hindi to English and English to Hindi. Prepare official correspondence, office orders, office notes, and drafts on computer in Hindi. Provide assistance to the Institute's Hindi Committee in activities relating to Official Language implementation. Assist the In-charge Rajbhasha Officer in the implementation of the Official Language Policy and related official work. Assist in organising Hindi workshops, training programmes, and events such as Hindi Pakhwada. Assist in the compliance of work and recommendations related to the Town Official Language Implementation Committee (TOLIC / नराकास). Perform any other related tasks assigned by the competent authority from time to time.

selection_process: StagePattern
Written test100 marks, three hours. Covers translation from English to Urdu and from Urdu to English, short notes on current affairs and general knowledge. All answers must be written in Urdu.

Voice test and interview100 marks. The voice test checks voice quality, modulation, diction, pronunciation and accent. It may be followed by an interview with the Selection Committee to judge your suitability for radio news.
There are two stages of selection. Both test your professional competence and your knowledge of Urdu. All tests and interviews are held in Delhi.

Candidates who score 50 or more in the written test are called for the voice test. The Selection Committee recommends for empanelment those who score 50 or more in the voice test and interview. Only shortlisted candidates are informed
and they are told by email. The final results are posted on www.newsonair.gov.in.
how_to_apply: Use the prescribed proforma given in the advertisement. Applications in any other format are not accepted.

Fill in every detail in CAPITAL LETTERS. The form asks for your name, date of birth, address, mobile number, email ID, educational qualification, category, draft/UTR number and amount, work experience (name of the office, post held and job details) and, if you are in Government service, an NOC.
Paste your photograph in the box provided and sign the form.
Pay the fee by bank draft or online transfer, and write the draft or UTR number on the form.
Put the application and all its enclosures in an envelope. Write on the envelope: "Application for Newsreader-cum-translator(Urdu) in NSD, Akashvani to be engaged on casual assignment basis".
Send it so that it reaches the Sr. Administrative Officer, News Services Division, Akashvani, Room No. 221, New Broadcasting House, Parliament Street, New Delhi-110 001 by 6 pm on 23 November 2026.
Self-attested copies of your educational certificates
An attested copy of your SC/ST/OBC certificate, if this applies to you
The bank draft, or the UTR details of your online payment
A No Objection Certificate from your employer, if you work in a Government or autonomous body

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical education and research institute at Dhanvantri Nagar, Puducherry. These posts are in the research project "Heat Exposure Assessment and Labour Tailored Interventions: A Holistic Approach for Building Climate-Resilient Workplaces in Selected Occupational Groups (HEALTH)". ICMR funds the project. It is run by Dr. Palanivel C in the Department of PSM, JIPMER. According to the application form, the work involves travel to the field and to other centres for the study.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of the details in the application, the CV and the documentary proof provided. The list of eligible candidates will also be shown on the JIPMER website. Only shortlisted candidates are called for the written test and/or interview. If there are a very large number of applications, stricter criteria may be used to decide eligibility. The final selection is based on the CV, the application and the written test/interview, and the Project Investigator's decision is final. At the Principal Investigator's discretion, interviews may be held in person or by video conferencing. For an online interview, candidates must arrange their own computer, laptop or mobile with audio and camera, and a stable internet connection. The date and time of the interview will be announced one week in advance. No TA/DA is paid for attending.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are on offer in this JIPMER project?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts in total: 1 Project Research Scientist-III (Medical), 3 Project Technical Support-III and 2 Project Technical Support-I, all in the ICMR-funded HEALTH project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: The pay is a consolidated Rs. 21,600 a month, made up of Rs. 18,000 plus 20% HRA, with no other allowances.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply for Project Technical Support-III without a postgraduate degree?
faq.answer: Yes. A graduate degree in any discipline with three years of experience is enough. A PG in public health or environment is the alternative route.

faq.question: Q4. Is Tamil required?
faq.answer: Both Project Technical Support posts require the ability to converse in Tamil fluently. For the Research Scientist post, good communication in Tamil and English is a desirable skill, not a requirement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age for the technical support posts?
faq.answer: The limit is 35 years for Project Technical Support-III and 28 years for Project Technical Support-I, counted as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What should the email subject line and file name be?
faq.answer: Put the name of the post in the subject line. Name the single PDF "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_DEO_2023_application".

faq.question: Q7. Will the interview be held online?
faq.answer: It may be held in person or by video conferencing, as the Principal Investigator decides. The date and time are announced one week in advance.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does this job lead to a permanent post at JIPMER?

content_sections.heading: About Bank of Baroda
content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda is a public sector bank. Its letterhead calls it "India's International Bank" and marks its 119th Foundation Year. The notice was issued from Mumbai on 28 October 2026 by the Chief General Manager (HRM & Marketing).

content_sections.heading: Salary and Pay Scale
content_sections.text: The pay scales are MMG/S-II (basic pay Rs. 64,820 to Rs. 93,960), MMG/S-III (Rs. 85,920 to Rs. 1,05,280) and SMG/S-IV (Rs. 1,02,300 to Rs. 1,20,940). Salary and other pay follow the industry-level bipartite settlement and the Joint Note for officers in the banking sector. On top of basic pay, officers may get bank-specific allowances, perquisites and other facilities under the bank's policies.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Project Finance – Infrastructure & ESG: credit policy and pricing, using ESG and sustainability factors to assess credit proposals, independent credit risk evaluation of loan proposals, and sector analysis. MSME Credit Risk Management: risk-return evaluation of the loan portfolio, stress testing and scenario analysis for capital adequacy, and monitoring credit risk capital. Enterprise and Operational Risk Management: the bank-wide risk framework, risk appetite and limits, CRAR and economic capital, the ICAAP exercise and Pillar III disclosures. Fraud Incidence and Root Cause Analysis: root cause analysis of frauds, including digital risks, and loss data and incident management in line with RBI guidelines on Operational Risk. Manager - Digital Fraud: fraud tools and rules for Debit cards, Internet and Mobile Banking, IMPS and UPI, plus dashboards. Uses SAS/SQL and credit data from sources such as CIBIL and Equifax. MSME Relationship: finding MSME business, meeting revenue targets, cross-selling, recovering long-outstanding debts and checking financial statements. Business Finance: performance MIS, Funds Transfer Pricing, cost management, capital budgeting and balance sheet and accounting policy advice. Chief Manager - Internal Controls: the Internal Controls Framework, ICOFR, reconciliation of office accounts, GL review under IRAC norms, and work with Statutory Auditors on IFC audits.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection may include application scrutiny, an online test, a psychometric test or any other suitable test, followed by Group Discussion and/or Interview or several rounds of interviews. Shortlisting may be based on online test scores, qualifications, work experience, domain expertise, skill set and suitability. The bank does not share its shortlisting criteria. If an online test is held, you need a minimum score in each section and overall. Candidates tied at the cut-off mark are ranked by age, oldest first. The minimum qualifying mark in the Personal Interview is 60% for General and EWS candidates and 55% for reserved categories. The bank may change these marks. The final merit list combines the online test and/or interview scores. The bank may consider you for a different position if you meet that position's eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Probation: 12 months (1 year) of active service from the date of joining. Service bond: serve at least 3 years, or pay the bank three months' gross salary (capped at Rs. 3 Lakhs) if you leave earlier. Posting: any branch or office of the Bank anywhere in India. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply. Selected candidates sign an employment contract. Serving government, PSU and bank employees must produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview and a relieving letter on joining.

basic_details.short_information: Register for Job Alerts Important: Candidates must meet the A-2 medical standard, including the prescribed vision requirements without glasses. The supplied CEN states that candidates who have undergone LASIK or other surgery to correct refractive error are not eligible for Station Master.

application_fee.details: The application fee is Rs. 500 for general fee categories and Rs. 250 for eligible concession categories. Candidates who appear in the CBT may receive the applicable refund after deduction of bank charges. | Candidates must appear in the CBT to qualify for the applicable fee refund. The refund will be credited to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account confirmed during the application process. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their linked bank account is valid and operational. No refund is admissible for rejected or incomplete applications under the stated conditions. Economically Backward Class (EBC) fee concession is different from EWS and OBC reservation. Candidates claiming EBC fee concession must possess the required valid income or supporting certificate by the application closing date. | Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI through the prescribed online payment facility.

age_limit.details: The prescribed age limit is 20 to 33 years as on 1 January 2027, with relaxation for eligible categories. | The notification also provides relaxation for eligible personnel working in quasi-administrative Railway offices. Candidates eligible under multiple relaxation categories will receive the highest applicable relaxation, not cumulative benefits.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent from a Recognized University
qualification.details: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification from a recognized university by 25 November 2026 and satisfy the applicable age, nationality and medical requirements. | Important: Candidates awaiting the final results of the prescribed educational qualification are not eligible to apply. The required degree or equivalent qualification must have been obtained by the application closing date. | Applicants must be Indian citizens or belong to other nationality categories specifically permitted in the notification, subject to the prescribed eligibility-certificate requirements where applicable.

salary_details.details: Station Master posts carry initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400 per month under Pay Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. | The notified Rs. 35,400 amount is the initial basic pay, not the final in-hand salary. Gross and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

selection_process: Particulars Selection Rule
CBAT Shortlisting Normally 8 Times the RRB-Wise Vacancies
Document Verification Shortlisting Normally 1:1 of RRB-Wise Vacancies
CBT Weightage 70%
CBAT Weightage 30%
Final Selection Combined Merit, CBAT Qualification, Documents and Medical Fitness
The selection process includes a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT)
Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT)
Document Verification and Medical Examination.
Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear in the objective examination

and normalized CBT scores are used for CBAT shortlisting. Computer Based Aptitude Test: Candidates shortlisted from the CBT must qualify in each prescribed CBAT test battery. Document Verification: Candidates are called according to combined CBT and CBAT merit
Railway preferences and vacancies. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the prescribed A-2 medical fitness standard.
CBAT shortlisting numbers may increase or decrease according to the requirements of the Railway Administration.

pattern_table.Subject: Basic Science, Mathematical and Analytical Capability

pattern_table.Exam Mode: One-Third of Marks per Wrong Answer
Applicable for CBT Conducted in Multiple Shifts

exam_pattern.details: The CBT comprises 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks with a duration of 120 minutes. There is a penalty of one-third of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer. | The minimum qualifying marks establish examination eligibility but do not guarantee shortlisting for CBAT.

syllabus.details: The CBT syllabus includes Basic Science, Mathematics, Data Analysis and Interpretation, Logical Capability and Mental Reasoning. | Number System, Ratio and Proportion, Averages and Percentages. Profit, Loss, Discount, Time, Speed, Distance, Power and Work. Algebra, Linear Equations, Arithmetic Progression, LCM and HCF. Geometry, Trigonometry, Area and Volume. Basic Probability and Statistics. Units, Measurements, Mass, Weight, Density, Energy, Friction, Heat and Temperature. Basic Electricity, Levers and Simple Machines. Data Interpretation through Tables, Charts, Graphs, Pie Charts and Scatter Plots. Venn Diagrams, Data Sufficiency and Data Arrangement. | Binary Logic and Syllogism. Clocks and Calendars. Assumptions and Blood Relations. Family Trees and Logic-Based Puzzles. English Reading Comprehension. | Analogy. Series Completion. Coding and Decoding. Ranking and Arrangement Problems. | The topics listed in the notification are illustrative and may not represent an exhaustive question list.

how_to_apply: Visit the unified Railway Recruitment Boards website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
Open the Station Master Recruitment 2026 notification under CEN 08/2026.
Read the eligibility, age, medical fitness and vacancy conditions carefully.
Open the authorized online application portal at rrbapply.gov.in when the application facility becomes active.
Create an account if applying through the RRB portal for the first time, or sign in using existing RRB account credentials.
Enter the required personal information and complete the prescribed account authentication.
Provide the educational qualification and applicable category details.
Select one RRB and indicate the Railway Zone preferences available for the selected RRB.
Capture a live photograph using a webcam or mobile camera according to the portal instructions.
Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents.
Review the application carefully, including the RRB selection and personal details.
Submit the online application and complete the applicable fee payment.
Save or print the application confirmation and payment details for future reference.

Important: Details entered during account creation, including registered mobile number and email address, cannot be modified afterward. The chosen RRB also cannot be changed through the subsequent correction window.
important_instructions: Only one application to one selected RRB is permitted. Candidates must possess the required educational qualification by 25 November 2026. The A-2 medical standard is mandatory for Station Master. Candidates who have undergone LASIK or other refractive-error correction surgery are ineligible under the supplied medical conditions. CBAT requires a minimum T-score of 42 in each test battery. The original prescribed vision certificate must be produced at the CBAT stage. Final merit gives 70% weightage to CBT and 30% to CBAT. Applicants should use their own active mobile number and email address. Wrong or false application details may lead to rejection or cancellation of candidature. Examination dates, city details and admit cards will be announced through the official RRB websites. The number of notified vacancies is provisional and may change according to Railway requirements.

content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification from a recognized university by 25 November 2026 and satisfy the applicable age, nationality and medical requirements. Important: Candidates awaiting the final results of the prescribed educational qualification are not eligible to apply. content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Medical Standard 2026
content_sections.text: Station Master candidates must satisfy the A-2 medical standard , including strict unaided vision requirements. LASIK Surgery Restriction: According to the supplied CEN, candidates who have undergone LASIK surgery or another surgical procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for the Station Master post. Candidates shortlisted for CBAT must produce the prescribed original medical vision certificate as per Annexure-VI or Annexure-VIA, whichever applies. Candidates without the required certificate will not be permitted to appear in CBAT. Failure to meet the A-2 medical requirements may result in rejection, and no alternative appointment will be offered for medical unsuitability.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Station Master posts carry initial basic pay of Rs. 35,400 per month under Pay Level 6 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The notified Rs. 35,400 amount is the initial basic pay, not the final in-hand salary. Gross and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 500 for general fee categories and Rs. 250 for eligible concession categories . Candidates who appear in the CBT may receive the applicable refund after deduction of bank charges. Candidates must appear in the CBT to qualify for the applicable fee refund. The refund will be credited to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account confirmed during the application process. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their linked bank account is valid and operational. No refund is admissible for rejected or incomplete applications under the stated conditions. Economically Backward Class (EBC) fee concession is different from EWS and OBC reservation. Candidates claiming EBC fee concession must possess the required valid income or supporting certificate by the application closing date. Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI through the prescribed online payment facility.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process includes a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT), Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT), Document Verification and Medical Examination . Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear in the objective examination, and normalized CBT scores are used for CBAT shortlisting. Computer Based Aptitude Test: Candidates shortlisted from the CBT must qualify in each prescribed CBAT test battery. Document Verification: Candidates are called according to combined CBT and CBAT merit, Railway preferences and vacancies. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the prescribed A-2 medical fitness standard. CBAT shortlisting numbers may increase or decrease according to the requirements of the Railway Administration.

rows.selection_rule: Combined Merit, CBAT Qualification, Documents and Medical Fitness

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT comprises 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks with a duration of 120 minutes. There is a penalty of one-third of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer. The minimum qualifying marks establish examination eligibility but do not guarantee shortlisting for CBAT.

rows.subject: Basic Science, Mathematical and Analytical Capability

rows.computer_based_test: One-Third of Marks per Wrong Answer

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT syllabus includes Basic Science, Mathematics, Data Analysis and Interpretation, Logical Capability and Mental Reasoning. Number System, Ratio and Proportion, Averages and Percentages. Profit, Loss, Discount, Time, Speed, Distance, Power and Work. Algebra, Linear Equations, Arithmetic Progression, LCM and HCF. Geometry, Trigonometry, Area and Volume. Basic Probability and Statistics. Units, Measurements, Mass, Weight, Density, Energy, Friction, Heat and Temperature. Basic Electricity, Levers and Simple Machines. Data Interpretation through Tables, Charts, Graphs, Pie Charts and Scatter Plots. Venn Diagrams, Data Sufficiency and Data Arrangement. Binary Logic and Syllogism. Clocks and Calendars. Assumptions and Blood Relations. Family Trees and Logic-Based Puzzles. English Reading Comprehension. Analogy. Series Completion. Coding and Decoding. Ranking and Arrangement Problems. The topics listed in the notification are illustrative and may not represent an exhaustive question list.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master CBAT 2026
content_sections.text: The Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) is mandatory for candidates shortlisted through CBT. Candidates must secure a minimum T-score of 42 in each CBAT test battery , without category-wise relaxation. Candidates must qualify in every test battery to be considered for the final merit list. There is no relaxation in the minimum T-score for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS or Ex-Servicemen candidates.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The online application process is scheduled to begin on 27 October 2026 through the official Railway Recruitment Boards application portal. Application Status: Scheduled to open on 27 October 2026. Apply Online: RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026 Online Application Portal Last Date: 25 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Applicants must select only one Railway Recruitment Board. Submission of multiple applications to the same or different RRBs may result in rejection and disqualification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RRB Station Master Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the unified Railway Recruitment Boards website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in . Open the Station Master Recruitment 2026 notification under CEN 08/2026. Read the eligibility, age, medical fitness and vacancy conditions carefully. Open the authorized online application portal at rrbapply.gov.in when the application facility becomes active. Create an account if applying through the RRB portal for the first time, or sign in using existing RRB account credentials. Enter the required personal information and complete the prescribed account authentication. Provide the educational qualification and applicable category details. Select one RRB and indicate the Railway Zone preferences available for the selected RRB. Capture a live photograph using a webcam or mobile camera according to the portal instructions. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents. Review the application carefully, including the RRB selection and personal details. Submit the online application and complete the applicable fee payment. Save or print the application confirmation and payment details for future reference. Important: Details entered during account creation, including registered mobile number and email address, cannot be modified afterward. The chosen RRB also cannot be changed through the subsequent correction window.

content_sections.heading: RRB Station Master Document Upload Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: The application process requires live photograph capture rather than uploading a previously saved passport-size photograph. The signature must be written in running handwriting and must not be in block or capital letters. Applicants should keep original educational, date-of-birth, identity, category and other applicable certificates ready for future document verification.

content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Video Editor – Digital Learning Job Description
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the role covers post-production of course content written by faculty, including editing, motion graphics and storyboard development. The aim is to turn raw recordings into polished, learner-ready video modules delivered across Digital Learning platforms. The key responsibilities are: Edit raw faculty recordings into finished, learner-ready video modules, including cuts, pacing, graphics, captions and audio cleanup. Work regularly with faculty, the production team and other stakeholders so that course videos are recorded, edited and ready for delivery across platforms. Develop digital learning materials, including interactive content, animations, illustrations and motion graphics, and support the creation of online simulations and games. Design and create storyboards and post-production media, along with related course elements such as video/audio editing, images and graphics. Handle complete post-production activities, including editing, graphic design, encoding to different online learning platform specifications (e.g., Open edX, Coursera, SWAYAM), tracking/versioning, and sound. Apply Digital Learning's visual and branding standards consistently across all published video content. Coordinate with the Videographer before editing to understand the shoot intent, available takes and continuity notes. Manage version control, review cycles and the incorporation of faculty feedback through to final sign-off. Organise and archive project files, footage and final assets in line with Digital Learning's content management practices. Coordinate with other departments and technical experts, including IT, to resolve technical issues in production and delivery. Analyse requirements and design/modify eLearning modules using authorised tools across Digital Learning platforms. Identify possible improvements and new course development/editing tools to raise production quality.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Graduate Photo and Signature Size 2026
content_sections.text: For RRB NTPC Graduate CEN 06/2026, candidates are not required to upload a pre-existing passport photograph . The application portal will capture a live photograph during the online application process. The photograph must be captured live using a computer/laptop webcam or mobile phone front camera. Use a pure plain white background. Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour, to maintain contrast. Look directly at the camera with a neutral expression. The entire face must be clearly visible and centered. The head should occupy at least 50% of the photograph area. Do not wear a cap, mask or spectacles while capturing the photograph. Do not photograph a printed or existing digital photograph. Important: Since the photograph is captured live, there is no separate RRB NTPC photo upload size or KB requirement for a pre-existing photograph under CEN 06/2026. The signature must be written by the candidate in normal running handwriting. Signatures written in BLOCK LETTERS, CAPITAL LETTERS or disjointed letters are not accepted.

basic_details.short_information: There are 10 Academic Resource Person (ARP) posts (अकादमिक रिसोर्स पर्सन) for the development blocks and the Nagar (city) resource centre of Moradabad district. Only teachers working in council schools under the Basic Shiksha Parishad, U.P. can apply. The Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Moradabad (कार्यालय जिला बेसिक शिक्षा अधिकारी मुरादाबाद) accepts applications only by registered post or speed post, sent to its office on Court Road, Moradabad. Applications must reach the office by 05 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Selection is through a written test and an interview.

qualification.details: There are 10 Academic Resource Person (ARP) posts in total. They are split across the development blocks as shown below. | The number of posts may be reduced or increased as needed. | Qualification: a graduation degree (स्नातक उपाधि) with a teacher training qualification. Experience: at least 5 years of teaching experience in council primary or upper primary schools. Service left: at least 5 years must remain before your retirement. No inquiry of any kind may be pending against you, and you must never have been found guilty in any disciplinary proceedings. Former ARPs who have already completed the maximum 3-year ARP tenure cannot be selected. There is one exception: if a block resource centre receives fewer applications than it has posts, ARPs who have completed 3 years may apply. Cut-off date: teaching experience and the minimum service left before retirement are counted from 05 November 2026. Item 13 of the notice also says that teaching experience and age are calculated from the date of the office memo. | For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification and the Government Order dated 15 June 2026. | Tenure: each ARP term is 1 year. It is renewed every year after a Performance Appraisal and approval by the District Selection Committee. An ARP can serve for a maximum of 3 years. Salary: the ARP keeps being paid from their own school (कार्यरत मूल विद्यालय). There is no increase in salary. Mobility allowance: ARPs do supportive supervision (सहयोगात्मक पर्यवेक्षण) against a monthly target. If they meet the target, they are paid a mobility allowance of Rs. 4,500/- per month as per the rules, after submitting a mobility bill (मोबिलिटी देयक पत्रक). No incentive of any kind is paid apart from the travel allowance.

selection_process: Stage Marks Details
Written Examination 70 Only candidates who score 60 percent or more can go on to the interview.
Interview 30 Covers subject knowledge, self-motivation, leadership ability, commitment and vision for elementary education, among other things.
Selection has two stages: a written test
then an interview. The final merit list is based on the marks from both.
The merit list will be prepared from the combined marks of the written test and the interview. The selection criteria and other guidelines follow the Government Order dated 15 June 2026.
important_instructions: If the last date changes, the update will be given through an office memo and the block-wise WhatsApp groups set up at district level. The District Magistrate (जिलाधिकारी) will settle any complaint or dispute about ARP selection, and the District Magistrate's decision is final. Any matter not covered in the notice will be handled under the Government Order mentioned above. The notice is to be published on the district website, https://moradabad.nic.in/, and put up on the notice boards of the Block Education Officers.

I/1358920/2026, 68-5099/375/2025-अनुभाग-5 (बेसिक शिक्षा), dated 15 June 2026. The District Selection Committee approved the selection, and the notice is signed by Amit Singh, District Basic Education Officer, Moradabad.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: You must use the prescribed application format. The notice says the format is attached to it, and that the ARP application form is available at the district headquarters and at the BRC (Block Resource Centre). Send the application to this address: District Basic Education Officer Office (जिला बेसिक शिक्षा अधिकारी कार्यालय), Court Road, Moradabad, PIN Code-244001 Get the ARP application form in the prescribed format from the district headquarters or the BRC. Fill in the form and attach all the enclosures. Have the application, with all its enclosures, forwarded by your Block Education Officer (खण्ड शिक्षा अधिकारी). This is compulsory. Put the application in a sealed envelope. Write the name of the development block you are applying for clearly, in bold letters, on top of the envelope. Send it only by registered post or speed post (पंजीकृत डाक / रजिस्टर्ड डाक / स्पीड पोस्ट डाक). It must reach the office by 05 November 2026, 5:00 PM. An application will be rejected without any further correspondence if it is not in the prescribed format, if it reaches the District Basic Education Officer's office after the last date, or if it was not sent by registered or speed post. The applicant is responsible for any such rejection. Applications are invited block by block, in line with the number of vacancies in each block. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There are 10 Academic Resource Person (ARP) posts in total. They are split across the development blocks as shown below. The number of posts may be reduced or increased as needed. Qualification: a graduation degree (स्नातक उपाधि) with a teacher training qualification. Experience: at least 5 years of teaching experience in council primary or upper primary schools. Service left: at least 5 years must remain before your retirement. No inquiry of any kind may be pending against you, and you must never have been found guilty in any disciplinary proceedings. Former ARPs who have already completed the maximum 3-year ARP tenure cannot be selected. There is one exception: if a block resource centre receives fewer applications than it has posts, ARPs who have completed 3 years may apply. Cut-off date: teaching experience and the minimum service left before retirement are counted from 05 November 2026. Item 13 of the notice also says that teaching experience and age are calculated from the date of the office memo. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification and the Government Order dated 15 June 2026. Tenure: each ARP term is 1 year. It is renewed every year after a Performance Appraisal and approval by the District Selection Committee. An ARP can serve for a maximum of 3 years. Salary: the ARP keeps being paid from their own school (कार्यरत मूल विद्यालय). There is no increase in salary. Mobility allowance: ARPs do supportive supervision (सहयोगात्मक पर्यवेक्षण) against a monthly target. If they meet the target, they are paid a mobility allowance of Rs. 4,500/- per month as per the rules, after submitting a mobility bill (मोबिलिटी देयक पत्रक). No incentive of any kind is paid apart from the travel allowance.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: a written test, then an interview. The final merit list is based on the marks from both. The merit list will be prepared from the combined marks of the written test and the interview. The selection criteria and other guidelines follow the Government Order dated 15 June 2026.

Covers subject knowledge, self-motivation, leadership ability, commitment and vision for elementary education, among other things.

The District Magistrate (जिलाधिकारी) will settle any complaint or dispute about ARP selection, and the District Magistrate's decision is final. Any matter not covered in the notice will be handled under the Government Order mentioned above. The notice is to be published on the district website, https://moradabad.nic.in/, and put up on the notice boards of the Block Education Officers.

content_sections.heading: AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Eligibility Criteria

rows.details: Retired Short Service Commission Officers of the Indian Army, Indian Navy, Indian Air Force, or Indian Coast Guard
Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university
Basic ATC Course/ATM and AL (Basic) and GCA/ATSS Course
Minimum 5 years (cumulative) of ATC duties, with at least 1 year of ATC duties at a Joint User Defence Airfield

content_sections.heading: AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Age Limit

rows.requirement: Not more than 50 years as on the last date for submission of application (1 October 2026)
The period between the date of retirement from the Indian Army/Navy/Air Force/Coast Guard and the last date for submission of application must not exceed 6 years
Any extension of the contract cannot take the consultant beyond 55 years of age

content_sections.heading: AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Remuneration & Allowances
content_sections.text: As per DoPT OM F. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, a fixed monthly remuneration is admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. This fixed amount remains unchanged for the entire term of the contract – there is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period. HRA: Not admissible. Transport Allowance: A fixed amount for commuting between residence and place of work, not exceeding the rate applicable to the appointee at the time of retirement; this amount also remains unchanged during the appointment. TA/DA on official tour, if any, is admissible as per the consultant’s entitlement at the time of retirement. TDS will be deducted at source from the remuneration.

content_sections.heading: AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written examination. Only candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria and are shortlisted will be called for Application Verification followed by an Interview . Final selection is based on merit ranking of the interview alone. The schedule for verification/interview will be intimated to shortlisted candidates only on their registered email ID. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the application verification/interview, for joining the assignment, on its completion, or at any point during the engagement process. Mere submission of an application, or meeting the eligibility criteria, does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview/selection. Prior to commencement of the contract, AAI may require the selected consultant to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate (equivalent to defence medical standards) from a recognized physician, duly certified by the ATS In-Charge of the Joint User Defence Airfield where deployment is likely.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AAI SSCO Consultant Engagement 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Applications through any mode other than the specified email will NOT be accepted. Ensure the email ID given in the application remains active, as all call letters and further information will be sent by email only.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled Application Form (Annexure-1), including: name, date of birth, age as on 01.10.2026, father’s name, gender, service branch (Army/Navy/Air Force/Coast Guard), date of joining and date of discharge from the Armed Forces, permanent and correspondence addresses, mobile number and email ID Details of Educational/Professional Qualification – exam/qualification, university/college, month & year of passing, percentage of marks Details of Work Experience – organization/department, designation with level, period (from-to), total experience, nature of work (attach a separate sheet if required) Self-attested copies of all supporting documents substantiating educational qualification and work experience claims A recent photograph, and the candidate’s signature with the declaration on the application form

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Initial engagement is for 1 year only, extendable by 1 more year at a time; the total cumulative period cannot exceed 5 years, and no extension can take the consultant beyond 55 years of age. The engagement is full-time; consultants will not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the engagement period. A formal Contract/Agreement specifying the terms and conditions will be drawn up between the selected consultant and AAI. Consultants will assist and support Air Traffic Control (ATC) operations at the concerned Joint User Defence Airfield, including ATC/SMC operations, watch extension, and other ATC-related activities as assigned by the ATS In-Charge. Leave is allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Consultants must mark attendance daily at their place of reporting/engagement. Unavailed leave in a calendar year is neither carried forward nor encashed into the next year. Absence beyond admissible leave and notified holidays results in a proportionate deduction from the consultancy remuneration. AAI may terminate the engagement if the consultant remains absent without intimation to the supervisory authority for more than 3 working days. In case of death, injury or illness of the consultant attributable to the performance of services under the contract, AAI shall not be responsible for any compensation. False or insufficient information, or lack of proof to ascertain eligibility, will lead to summary rejection of candidature at any stage, with appropriate action as deemed fit. AAI reserves the right to upgrade the eligibility criteria if a large number of applications are received, and to cancel/modify/withdraw/postpone this engagement notice. AAI may terminate a consultant’s services at any time by giving 1 month’s notice or remuneration/fees in lieu of the notice period, and AAI management’s decision is final. A consultant may similarly seek termination by giving AAI 1 month’s notice or remuneration/fees in lieu.

content_sections.heading: About NMPA
content_sections.text: New Mangalore Port Authority is a port under the Govt. of India (Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways), located at Panambur, Mangalore - 575010. Its letterhead calls it "Fully Solar Powered" and "An ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, 45001:2018 & ISPS Compliant Port", and it carries the Sagarmala logo. The office phone numbers printed on the notice are 0824 - 2407341 and 2887399.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The vacancy is open to eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities who have the qualifications and experience set out in the Recruitment Rule (RR) in Annexure I. The RR was published in the Gazette of India: Extraordinary. It classes the post as Class-I and as a selection post, with a scale of pay of 10750-300-16750 (pre-revised). The crucial date for deciding eligibility is 20 November 2026 . Under the RR, absorption/deputation will be of officers holding analogous posts, or the post of Asst. Secretary Gr-I in the scale of pay of Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade, in a Major Port Trust. The RR lists the following qualifications for direct recruitment: Essential (i): A degree from a recognised university. Essential (ii): Five years experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations etc. in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking. Desirable: Post Graduate degree/diploma in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Social Work/Labour Welfare or allied subjects or degree in Law from a recognised university/institution. According to the RR, the educational qualifications for direct recruits will apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation, but the experience for direct recruits will not. The RR prints an upper age limit of 35 years for direct recruitment. It also states that this age limit does not apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation. The RR fills the post by promotion. If that fails, the post is filled by absorption/deputation, and if both fail, by direct recruitment. The feeder posts for promotion are Asst. Secretary Gr.I or Hindi Officer in the pay scale of Rs. 9100-15100. The RR gives a period of probation of 2 years. Candidates should check the official notification (Annexure I) for the full eligibility details of the post. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is in the scale of pay of Rs.50,000-1,60,000 (Pre to pre revised Rs.10750-16750). Annexure VI sets out the following terms and conditions of deputation at New Mangalore Port Authority: Period of deputation: 3 years, extendable to 4 years. In exceptional circumstances it can be extended to 5 years. The Central Government decides this for a post whose holder is regarded as the Head of Department, and the Chairman decides it for any post below the level of Head of Department. Pay: The employee may choose to have pay fixed in the deputation post under the normal rules. Or the employee may draw the pay of the post held in the parent department plus a deputation allowance, under the conditions as modified from time to time. Dearness allowance: Paid under the rules of the parent department or of NMPA, depending on whether the employee keeps the parent department's scale of pay or draws pay in the Port's scale. Local allowance: If the deputationist chooses the parent department's pay, H.R.A. is payable as per the parent department's rules at the rates applicable to NMPA employees. Joining time pay and transfer T.A.: T.A. and joining time are given both when joining the deputation post and when returning to the parent department, under the Port's rules. The Port bears this cost. Travelling allowance: Travelling allowance for journeys on duty during deputation is regulated under the rules of NMPA. Leave and pension: The leave and pension rules of the parent organisation continue to apply. Provident fund: The employee keeps subscribing to the Provident Fund of the parent organisation. If the deputationist is governed by the Contributory Provident Fund Rules, the Port pays the employer's contribution for the period of deputation. Medical facilities: As available to employees under the rules of the New Mangalore Port. Residential accommodation: If the Port allots accommodation, rent is recovered as per the Rules/Regulations of the New Mangalore Port. Residuary matters: Service conditions not covered above are governed by the rules and orders of the parent Department/Organisation.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, under the head "Clerk District Courts of Punjab" on the official website sssc.gov.in. No other mode of submission is accepted. The broad process is:
Registration: Fill the Registration form first, followed by the Application Form.
Real-time photograph: Capture a real-time photograph using an inbuilt or attached webcam, as required within the Online Application Form.
Upload documents: Upload a scanned recent passport-size photograph (not more than one month old, against a white background) and a scanned signature.
Fill in all details carefully: Enter all personal details, including category and sub-category, correctly - no change is permitted after submission.

Pay the fee: The application form is linked to a fee payment gateway (internet banking, debit card, credit card, or UPI); the online application is considered submitted only after successful payment of the fee, which is non-refundable.
Retain documents: Keep a printed copy of the submitted application, and retain 5 copies of the uploaded photograph for later stages of the recruitment process.

Candidates must ensure the real-time photograph, the uploaded scanned photograph, and the photograph pasted on the E-Admit Card all match, and that their facial appearance at the exam matches these photographs - any mismatch means the candidate will not be allowed to enter the examination centre.
important_instructions: All applicants, irrespective of category, can submit only one application for a particular category; if more than one application is submitted, only the latest will be considered. Merely satisfying the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicant to be called for the examination; admission at every stage is provisional and subject to subsequent scrutiny. Applicants currently in government service must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their Head of Office/Department and produce it when called for; failure to do so will result in cancellation of candidature. Reservation benefits require applicants to submit the latest, valid certificates issued by the Competent Authority of the Government of Punjab, valid as on the closing date of the application. E-Admit Cards will be uploaded on the website (with E-mail/SMS notification) and must be downloaded by candidates themselves; admit cards are not sent by post. No mobile phone, electronic device, watch, or jewellery/ornaments are allowed inside the examination centre. All applicants must give an undertaking that they will work anywhere in the State of Punjab where posted. Concealing material facts or furnishing false information can lead to rejection of candidature at any stage; canvassing in any form or use of unfair means will lead to cancellation of candidature. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the exam or for checking of original testimonials/interaction. Success in the examination confers no automatic right to appointment, which remains subject to the Competent Authority's satisfaction regarding the candidate's suitability in all respects.

content_sections.heading: About NDMA Intern
content_sections.text: The National Disaster Management Authority, Government of India, has instituted this exclusive internship program as part of its organizational structure. The initiative aims to engage young talent with various divisions of NDMA and leading organizations of India, providing research support and experiential learning in the domain of disaster management.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: At least ten interns will be inducted during a year across various divisions of NDMA. The engagement is based on the skills and interest areas of the interns across broad thematic verticals, including Governance and Institutional Strengthening for DM, Risk Analysis and Mitigation (Includes loss and damage assessment in the context of disaster vulnerability and resilience), Disaster Management Plans, Community Based Disaster Management, Information Knowledge Management System/s (IKMS) for Disaster Management, School Safety, Urban Risk Management, Disaster Risk Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation, and Risk Insurance in Disaster Management. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian nationals enrolled as postgraduate/research students in reputed University/Institute within India or abroad, or have recently graduated with a university degree in concerned subject. Essential Qualification: Be enrolled in postgraduate degree programme in Disaster Management or in an equivalent post graduate degree program such as Development Studies, Economics, Humanities, Sciences, Management, Engineering, Health Studies etc. or have recently graduated with a university degree in concerned subject. If the student pursues a different academic discipline, there should be a clear linkage with disaster management. Desired Qualifications: Excellent computer knowledge (Microsoft Office applications), excellent written and spoken English, and excellent interactive and interpersonal skills, and flexibility to work in a multicultural environment.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The interns will be paid a remuneration of 12,000/- per month. The duration of the internship shall be at least six to eight weeks and not exceeding two months. NDMA will provide working space, internet facility and other necessities deemed fit by the divisional head. The interns will be required to have their own laptops. Internship based out of remote locations/work from home will be considered.

content_sections.heading: NDMA Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: The intern will assist/collate research/analysis in the following fields: SOP and Guidance Notes Project Assignments Research Assignments Training/Capacity Building and Documentation Process Documentation Day to day assignment- On the job training Any other tasks as assigned by the Supervisor

content_sections.heading: GeM Assistant Risk Officer Job Profile
content_sections.text: The job profile includes working in a dynamic, data-driven work environment involving collaboration with employees from the Government and Private Sector. The role of the Assistant Risk Officer involves identifying, analysing, assessing, and mitigating operational, financial, and strategic risks. The indicative list of responsibilities includes: Assist the Risk/Vigilance Officer in day-to-day preventive, punitive, and participative vigilance functions relating to transactions on the GeM portal. Carry out bid-cycle analysis, short-duration bid analysis, and bid decryption checks to detect cartelisation, price manipulation, bid-rotation, and other irregular bidding patterns. Monitor and analyse participation of suspended, blacklisted, or debarred sellers on the platform, and flag violations or attempts at circumvention for further examination. Undertake seller-profile analytics and buyer/seller behaviour analysis to identify anomalous transaction patterns, unusual pricing, or related-party arrangements warranting scrutiny. Assist in preliminary scrutiny and fact-finding on complaints received through CPGRAMS, CVC, whistle-blower mechanisms, and other channels, and prepare notes for the Risk/Vigilance Officer. Maintain vigilance case records, complaint registers, and trackers, and compile periodic statistical returns for submission to the Risk/Vigilance Officer/CVO. Build and maintain analytical queries, scripts, and dashboards (e.g. Python, SQL, Power BI/Tableau) for continuous, rule-based, and statistical transaction monitoring. Assist in compiling inputs for the Annual Vigilance Report, the Agreed List, the List of Officers of Doubtful Integrity, and other periodic returns required under CVC guidelines. Coordinate with the IT/Product teams for implementation of system-level red flags and preventive vigilance controls on the portal. Any other responsibility as assigned by the Vigilance Officer/Chief Vigilance Officer from time to time.

basic_details.short_information: Industry 4.0 Innovation Centre (I4IC) has announced 1 vacancy for the Accounts Officer post on a Fixed Term contractual basis for a maximum period of 3 years. Candidates must apply through an offline application process by submitting a hard copy along with all supporting documents to the Secretary, Industry 4.0 Innovation Centre on or before 6 November 2026. Applicants must attach a filled Curriculum Vitae with a passport-size photograph along with self-attested copies of all required documents. The qualification required for the post is a CA (Inter) /CMA (Inter) pass with a bachelor's degree

qualification.details: Educational qualifications, experience, age limit, and remuneration terms for the post are outlined below: | Post Name: Accounts Officer (Fixed Term Contract Basis) Vacancies: 01 Project/Centre Background: Established pursuant to the Union Budget FY 2026–27 regarding CPSE-led Hi-Tech Tool Rooms & Service Bureaus for commissioning and operation of a Hi-Tech Tool Room and Service Bureau at Guwahati (Assam), with a spoke at Barauni (Bihar). Remuneration: Rs. 70,000/- per month (All-inclusive monthly fixed remuneration). There will be no increment of the Monthly Fixed Remuneration in any case whatsoever. Besides the monthly fixed remuneration, no other allowance will be paid to the FTE. No separate HRA will be provided; the selected candidate must arrange their own accommodation at Guwahati. Educational Qualification: CA (Inter) / CMA (Inter) pass with a bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized University. Experience (Post qualification): Minimum 3 years' experience in maintaining accounts and financial management. Experience shall be considered from the date of passing CA/CMA – Intermediate Exam. Experience in Government, PSU, Society, Trust, or Project-based organizations will be preferred. Age Limit: Maximum 38 years. The date of reckoning age and other eligibility criteria shall be the last date of receipt of applications (06.11.2026). Period of Contract: The engagement shall be on a Fixed Term contractual basis for a maximum period of 3 (Three) years commencing from the date of engagement. The contract can be terminated at any time by giving 30 (Thirty) days' notice by either party. Other Benefits & Working Terms: Transportation: The Accounts Officer has to make their own transportation arrangements for attending regular office. Official tour travelling expenses will be reimbursed as per Society Policy. Company Holiday Calendar: Normal holidays of the Society will be applicable, though candidates may be called to attend office on weekly off days or any holiday in case of urgency. Leave: Allowed to avail 1 (one) day casual leave for each completed month of service. Working Hours: 48 hours per week work schedule, working in line with regular officers of the Society and observing normal office timings. Mediclaim: Entitled to avail Mediclaim Insurance Policy facility limited to Rs. 5 Lakhs for the period of engagement covering self, spouse, and maximum 2 dependent children (age limit up to 18 years only). Insurance is to be bought by the Accounts Officer and the Society will reimburse the premium. | FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? selection_process: The selection stages for the post are as follows:

Scrutiny of Applications: Applications received by the Society will be scrutinized. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through their valid Email IDs provided in the application to appear before the interview board on specific dates and venue. No Travelling Allowance / Daily Allowance will be paid to candidates for appearing in the personal interview.
important_instructions: The engagement to the post is subject to the candidate being found medically fit; selected candidates must produce a fitness certificate from a registered medical practitioner before being considered for engagement. The opinion of the Hospital/Medical Officer authorized by the Society in this regard shall be final. Valid 10-digit mobile number and email ID must be furnished in the application form; correspondence (if any) from Society I4IC will be made only through the email provided by candidates, and the Society will not be liable for non-receipt due to wrong or invalid email ID. Responsibilities of receiving and downloading information/communications will be of the candidate. Candidates must produce original certificates, testimonials, and other documents at the time of interview for verification; failure to do so may cause rejection of candidature. Candidate(s) working in any Govt. / Govt. Undertaking organization, if selected, must produce a Release Letter (in original) from the present employer at the time of joining the Fixed Term contractual engagement at Society, I4IC. The selected candidate will be required to join immediately if selected; an extension for a maximum of 15 (fifteen) days from the stipulated date may be allowed upon intimation, failure of which will result in cancellation of provisional selection. Selected candidates on fixed-term contract are not permitted to take up any other assignment for the entire duration of their engagement. Any candidate not appearing in the interview on the specific date and time will have their candidature cancelled with no claim entertained. Incomplete applications and applications received after the stipulated date/time shall be rejected. I4IC Society reserves the right to cancel or postpone the Fixed Term Contractual Engagement Process at any stage without assigning any reason. Candidates are advised to keep checking the I4IC Society and NRL website regularly for any updates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UIDAI Assistant Account Officer
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested officers must submit their application online through the UIDAI Career Portal at https://career.uidai.gov.in. After submission of the online application, download and print the duly filled online application form generated through the Career Portal. Submit the signed hard copy of the application to your Cadre Controlling Authority or Parent Organisation for forwarding through proper channel. Ensure the Cadre Controlling Authority forwards the application along with cadre clearance, vigilance/disciplinary clearance, ACRs/APARs for the last five years duly attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or an officer of equivalent rank, and the certificate in the prescribed format at Annex-I. Forward the complete application along with all requisite documents to: Director (HR), Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Aadhaar Complex, NTI Layout, Tata Nagar, Kodigehalli, Technology Centre, Bengaluru – 560 092, so that it is received by 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify a written examination or interview stage. Selection is conducted on a deputation basis among eligible officers whose services are spared by their parent organisation and forwarded through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: UIDAI Assistant Account Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Individuals who apply for the post may not withdraw their candidature subsequently. Private candidates are not eligible as the post is filled on deputation basis. Only applications submitted online through the UIDAI Career Portal and subsequently forwarded through proper channel with all requisite documents will be considered. Mere submission of an online application does not confer any right for consideration unless duly forwarded through proper channel. Applications received after the last date or incomplete applications may not be considered. UIDAI reserves the right to post the selected officer at any other location or select a candidate for another location based on administrative reasons or exigency of service. The Authority reserves the right to withdraw this circular at any time, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments for the advertised positions are structured as follows: Senior Project Associate: Rs. 57,000 + HRA Project Associate II: Rs. 42,000 + HRA (for NET or GATE qualified candidates); Rs. 33,000 + HRA (for non-NET or non-GATE qualified candidates) Project Associate I / Project Associate I (Social) / Project Associate I (Spatial analyst): Rs. 37,000 + HRA (for NET or GATE qualified candidates); Rs. 30,000 + HRA (for non-NET or non-GATE qualified candidates) Project Assistant: Rs. 27,000 + HRA Administrative Assistant: Rs. 24,000 + HRA The project duration for most positions is one year, with certain project durations noted as one year (likely extended or likely to be extended).

content_sections.heading: WII Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Candidate will implement the objectives of the project and will carry field survey, preparation of technical reports on freshwater biodiversity conservation. Candidate will collect data on aquatic biodiversity, literature review, data analysis, report writing. Conduct social survey, data analysis, and report writing. Data collection on aquatic biodiversity, data analysis, report writing. Data collection on aquatic biodiversity, data analysis, and report writing. Assisting the research team in logistics, maintenance of stock registers, and project accounts. Assisting the team in data collection on movement ecology, habitat parameters, sample collection for population genetics work, logistics, sea turtle nesting across beaches, basecamp maintenance, monitoring beach dynamics, satellite tagging, and other project-related activities. Provide technical support to the SPMU in strategic planning, implementation of project activities, facilitating consultative meetings, ensuring coordination, guiding the preparation and monitoring of safeguard plans (IPPs and LRPs), assessing environmental and social safeguard risks, ensuring Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC), and managing the Grievance Redress Mechanism (GRM). Conduct needs assessments of Eco-Development Councils (EDCs) and Community-Based Organisations (CBOs), develop community engagement processes, design capacity-building programmes, organise training for EDCs/CBOs and paravets, support community conservation institutions, and monitor training activities. Establish participatory community-based monitoring systems, build patrolling and wildlife monitoring teams, deliver training on wild cat habitat management, coordinate monitoring equipment use, develop community participation and incentive mechanisms, and support data sharing.

selection_process: The selection process consists of two primary stages:

exam_pattern.details: Written Examination: The written test comprises 25 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying 2 marks each, totaling 50 marks. The duration of the exam is 45 minutes. Subjects covered include General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Mathematics, and General Mental Ability. | Skill Test: The skill test carries 250 marks with a time limit of 10 minutes. Candidates are required to type a passage of approximately 250 words accurately on a computer using Ubuntu Linux system, LibreOffice, and Unicode Font (Mangal etc.). 1 mark is deducted for each omitted word and error/mistake. Formatting settings such as headings, bold text, paragraphs, and underlining are also treated as errors.

Affix a self-attested recent passport-size color photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all educational certificates, technical qualifications, age proof (Matriculation marksheet), category certificate, and domicile certificate.
Enclose self-signed photocopies of identity documents such as Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence, or Voter ID Card.
If employed in government or semi-government service, attach a self-attested copy of the No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the competent authority.
Write the name of the post applied for and category clearly on the top of the envelope containing the application.
Send the completed application form exclusively by post to reach the office of the District and Sessions Judge Korba on or before 30 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date and time or through modes other than post will be rejected. Incomplete applications or applications not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected. Separate applications must be submitted if applying for more than one post, clearly superscribed on respective envelopes. Original identity proofs and documents must be produced during the skill test or verification stages. Selected candidates will undergo a 3-year probation period and must pass medical fitness standards prescribed by the Medical Board. Any attempt to influence the selection process directly or indirectly will lead to immediate disqualification and legal action.
