content_sections.heading: Korba District Court Assistant Grade-3 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of two primary stages: First Stage: Written Examination Second Stage: Skill Test Candidates shortlisted from the written exam will be called for the skill test in a 1:10 ratio per post. A category-wise waiting list valid for up to one year will also be prepared based on skill test scores.

content_sections.heading: Korba District Court Assistant Grade-3 Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Written Examination: The written test comprises 25 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying 2 marks each, totaling 50 marks. The duration of the exam is 45 minutes. Subjects covered include General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Mathematics, and General Mental Ability. Skill Test: The skill test carries 250 marks with a time limit of 10 minutes. Candidates are required to type a passage of approximately 250 words accurately on a computer using Ubuntu Linux system, LibreOffice, and Unicode Font (Mangal etc.). 1 mark is deducted for each omitted word and error/mistake. Formatting settings such as headings, bold text, paragraphs, and underlining are also treated as errors.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Korba District Court Assistant Grade-3 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and application form format from the official website www.dcourts.gov.in/korba . Fill out the prescribed application form clearly with all required personal and educational details. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size color photograph on the designated space of the application form. Attach self-attested photocopies of all educational certificates, technical qualifications, age proof (Matriculation marksheet), category certificate, and domicile certificate. Enclose self-signed photocopies of identity documents such as Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence, or Voter ID Card. If employed in government or semi-government service, attach a self-attested copy of the No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the competent authority. Write the name of the post applied for and category clearly on the top of the envelope containing the application. Send the completed application form exclusively by post to reach the office of the District and Sessions Judge Korba on or before 30 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Korba District Court Assistant Grade-3 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date and time or through modes other than post will be rejected. Incomplete applications or applications not in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected. Separate applications must be submitted if applying for more than one post, clearly superscribed on respective envelopes. Original identity proofs and documents must be produced during the skill test or verification stages. Selected candidates will undergo a 3-year probation period and must pass medical fitness standards prescribed by the Medical Board. Any attempt to influence the selection process directly or indirectly will lead to immediate disqualification and legal action.

content_sections.heading: RNU Akashvani Dehradun Casual News Reader Cum Translator Job Description
content_sections.text: Casual News Reader Cum Translator (Hindi)- CNRT: To translate, edit and format news stories; Reading news stories in an impactful and interesting way for the audio medium. Casual News Reader cum Translator (Kumauni): To translate, edit and format news stories; Reading news stories in an impactful and interesting way for the audio medium.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Proof of age (Class 10th mark list / 10th certificate issued by State Board / CBSE / ICSE / copy of birth certificate). Proof of essential and desirable qualifications mentioned against the category applied for (academic qualification, professional qualification and work experience). Proof of residence (Aadhaar card / Passport / Driving Licence / Voter ID / Rental Lease Agreement carrying name / residence certificate issued by Tehsildar). Community Certificate (applicable for SC/ST/OBC category) for claiming concession in application fee. One passport-size photograph to be pasted in the designated space in the application form. Transaction ID and proof of application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure comprises three stages: written test, voice test and an interview to assess the professional competence and knowledge of the candidate in the concerned language. Each test carries 100 marks. The syllabus for the written test includes translation from English to Hindi for Hindi News Reader, Hindi to Kumauni for Kumauni News Reader and vice versa, short notes on current affairs and general knowledge, etc. Candidates securing 50 marks and above in the written test will be called for voice test. In the voice test, the following are to be adjudged: voice quality, modulation, diction, pronunciation, and accent. The voice test may be followed by an interview to assess the suitability of the candidate for the RNU job.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application processing fee is non-refundable and must be deposited through the bank account mentioned in the notification (Account Name: Prasar Bharati, BCI, Doordarshan Kendra, Dehradun; Account Number: 31152871600; IFSC Code: SBIN0000630; Branch: SBI DEHRADUN).

basic_details.job_title: DPCC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Offline for 59 Legal Assistant, Scientific Assistant & More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC), Department of Environment, Government of NCT of Delhi, has issued a rolling advertisement for 59 posts on deputation, including short-term contract, open only to officers holding a regular post in the Central or State Government, a Union Territory, a recognised research institute, an autonomous or statutory body, or a PSU. Candidates must be no older than 56 on the closing date of the phase they apply in. Officers working in private organisations, on contract, retired or unemployed are not considered.

important_dates.age reckoned as on: Closing date of the phase in which the application is received

qualification.details: "Analogous post" means the same post held on a regular basis in the parent organisation. Where the circular names a pay level, the years of regular service must be in that level or its equivalent. "Related field of engineering" for the engineering posts means Civil, Environment, Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, ECE, Biomedical Engineering, Water Resources, Remote Sensing, GIS or Hydrology.

selection_process: The circular does not set out a written test or a scoring scheme. It refers to candidates being called for interview
and the NOC requirement for advance-copy applicants is specifically for "appearing in interview". DPCC reserves the right not to fill any post
and the number of posts may change. Selection details will be posted on the DPCC website from time to time.
how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through proper channel, in the prescribed proforma, in English or Hindi.
Download the advertisement and the application form from dpcc.delhigovt.nic.in under "Office Order & Circulars".

Fill in the proforma: post applied for, personal and department details, date of retirement, education, a point-by-point statement of how you meet each essential and desirable requirement, employment history with pay level of the post held on a regular basis (enclose your latest salary slip), nature of present employment, feeder-grade status, total emoluments, and supporting information such as publications, awards and professional affiliations. Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign the declaration.
Attach self-attested copies of proof of age, educational qualifications, work experience, and SC/ST/OBC/PwD certificate if claiming.

Have your employer or cadre-controlling authority complete the certification on the last page: that the particulars are correct, you hold the qualifications and experience, you will be relieved if selected, no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending, integrity is certified, the CR dossier or attested ACR/APAR copies for the last five years are enclosed, and whether any major or minor penalty was imposed in the last ten years.

Your department forwards the application with the signed bio-data, attested APAR copies for five years, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance and penalty statement to: The Administrative Officer, Delhi Pollution Control Committee, 3rd Floor, IT Park, DMRC Building, Shastri Park, Delhi – 110053
Write the name of the post on the envelope.

If your department's forwarding may be delayed, you may send an advance copy. In that case you must produce a No Objection Certificate from your department to appear for the interview, with an undertaking to submit all requisite documents before joining. An advance copy does not replace the proper-channel application.
Applications that are incomplete, not through proper channel, or without attested APAR copies are not considered; there is no second chance within the phase.
If you already applied to DPCC's earlier rolling advertisement with complete documents, you do not need to apply again.
Each post has two independent conditions (service and qualification). Check both before asking your department to forward the application, since candidature cannot be withdrawn later.
No correspondence or representation is entertained about interview calls or selection.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Eligibility
content_sections.text: "Analogous post" means the same post held on a regular basis in the parent organisation. Where the circular names a pay level, the years of regular service must be in that level or its equivalent. "Related field of engineering" for the engineering posts means Civil, Environment, Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, ECE, Biomedical Engineering, Water Resources, Remote Sensing, GIS or Hydrology. Senior Environmental Engineer (Level 12, 8 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 11; and a Master's degree in engineering in a related field with ten years' experience in pollution control or a related field after the Master's. Environmental Engineer (Level 11, 15 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 10; and either a Bachelor's degree in engineering in a related field with eight years' experience in pollution control after the degree, or a Master's degree in engineering in a related field with six years' experience after the Master's. Assistant Environmental Engineer (Level 10, 15 posts): analogous post in Level 10 on a regular basis; and a degree in engineering in a related field with two years' experience in pollution control or a related field, or a Master's degree in engineering. Additional Director (Scientific) (Level 13, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 12; and a Master's degree in science with fifteen years' experience in pollution control or related subjects, or a doctorate in science with ten years' experience. Senior Scientist L-II / Scientist-D (Level 12, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 11; and a Master's degree in science with thirteen years' experience in pollution control or related subjects, or a doctorate in science. Senior Scientist L-I / Scientist-C (Level 11, 2 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 10; and a Master's degree in science with eight years' experience in pollution control or related subjects. Scientist-B (Level 10, 1 post): analogous post, or eight years' regular service in analogous posts in Level 6; and a Master's degree in science with three years' experience in pollution control or related subjects. Scientific Assistant (Level 6, 4 posts): analogous post, or ten years' regular service in Level 4; and a Bachelor's degree in science with experience in laboratory work. Senior Lab Assistant (Level 4, 5 posts): analogous post, or eight years' regular service in Level 2. The circular sets no separate educational qualification for this post. Assistant Law Officer (Level 7, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 6; and a Bachelor's degree in law with four years' experience as a legal practitioner or four years handling legal work in a government department, PSU, autonomous or statutory body. Legal Assistant (Level 6, 5 posts): analogous post, or three years' regular service in Level 6 after regular appointment; and a degree in law. Service condition: analogous post,

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: each post carries the pay matrix level shown in the vacancy table. Pay, allowances and other terms of deputation are regulated by DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended, which governs pay fixation and deputation (duty) allowance for officers on deputation. Tenure: one year, extendable up to three years. Deputation including any immediately preceding ex-cadre post should not ordinarily exceed three years in total. Withdrawal: candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Chennai Port Authority
content_sections.text: Access the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways. Submit the online application for the PS to Chairman post. Take a printout of the submitted online application. Gather copies of educational qualifications, experience certificates, and a self-attested passport-size photograph. Obtain a copy of the undertaking not to withdraw if selected. Ensure the application is forwarded through the proper channel along with ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, vigilance clearance, verification of university certificates, and NOC. Send the complete documents to SECRETARY, CHENNAI PORT AUTHORITY, RAJAJI SALAI, CHENNAI – 600 001 on or before 11 November 2026.

content_sections.text: Copies of educational qualifications and experience Undertaking of the applicant not to withdraw if selected Self-attested Passport Size Photo Photocopy of ACRs / APARs of the applicant for the last 5 years duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Deputy Head of Department Willingness of the candidate for joining the post in case of selection No Objection Certificate of respective Port Authority Vigilance / Administrative Clearance certificate Certificate confirming the veracity of University Certificates Certificate if ACR / APAR for a particular period is not available Details of major/minor penalties imposed during the last 10 years, if any Complete service details of the applicant at Annexure-4

selection_process: The selection test includes verification of original documents
medical test
physical test
and interview
held at Reserve Police Ground Sambalpur.
A Medical Board shall test the physical fitness of the candidates

and the decision of the Board is final and binding. Persons with physical deformities shall not be eligible for appointment. Only those who are found medically fit are allowed to participate in further tests.
Candidates must be physically fit and mentally alert

and capable of discharging field duty by putting in hard labor for at least 8 hours a day during day or night. Candidates must cover a distance of 5 (five) Kilometers on foot within a period of one hour. Those who fail to cover the distance within the time will be disqualified.
Candidates who qualify in the medical test and physical test will appear before the Selection Board for an interview to test their suitability for appointment as Special Police Officers.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form and detailed advertisement from the official Odisha Police website at police.odisha.gov.in.
Fill up all required columns of the application form neatly and completely in a typed format as per the provided Performa.
Attach two recent passport-size self-attested photographs.
Enclose self-attested copies of certificates in support of age, qualification, and discharge certificate.
Enclose two character certificates attested by two different Group-B Gazetted Officers.
Submit the completed application form along with all relevant documents to the Office of the D.I.G of Police, N.R., Sambalpur, on or before 31 October 2026 at 05:30 PM.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date of submission will be summarily rejected. The re-employed persons shall have to wear the uniform and the badge as prescribed by the D.G. & I.G. of Police, Odisha. Candidates are required to execute an agreement for re-employment on a contract basis for not more than one year. The selection test will be held at Reserve Police Ground Sambalpur on 10 November 2026 at 06:30 AM. The decision of the Medical Board regarding physical fitness is final and binding.

Preview your duly submitted application and obtain a printout or screenshot of the filled-up application for your record.
important_instructions: Applications are acceptable ONLY IN ONLINE MODE; applications received through any other mode will be rejected straightway. Experience and qualification shall be reckoned as on the date of submission of online application. Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified, however, it can be cancelled without refund of fee. If an EWS candidate is not available for selection, the post will be treated automatically as de-reserved and filled up from a non-EWS candidate of unreserved category. Eligible candidates will only be informed through SMS alerts and emails about examinations or tests schedule.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HP High Court Stenographer
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment portal at https://highcourt.hp.gov.in/ or https://www.hphcrecruitment.in/login. Keep scanned copies of your coloured recent photograph (20 to 50 KB on white background), signature (10 to 20 KB on white background), Matric certificate as age proof (100 to 500 KB), ID Proof (100 to 500 KB), and other certificates/documents (100 KB to 2 MB in PDF) ready before filling the form. content_sections.heading: HP High Court Stenographer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are acceptable ONLY IN ONLINE MODE; applications received through any other mode will be rejected straightway. Candidates already in service of any Government or Semi Government concern shall be considered ONLY on receipt of their online application through proper channel along with "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) within 15 days from the last date fixed for receipt of application (Job Trainee/contract/casual/adhoc/daily wagers/work charged employees do not need to produce NOC). The category once claimed shall be treated final and no representation or correspondence will be entertained. Experience and qualification shall be reckoned as on the date of submission of online application. Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified, however, it can be cancelled without refund of fee. If an EWS candidate is not available for selection, the post will be treated automatically as de-reserved and filled up from a non-EWS candidate of unreserved category. rows.post: Assistant Professor & equivalent (Other than Agro-meteorology, Agril. Statistics, ABM, Computer Science & Food Science & Technology)
rows.qualification_required: Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture/ Horticulture/ Community Science/Veterinary Science as relevant to the requirement of the post. For the post of Assistant Professor in Sericulture, the essential requirement is Bachelor’s degree in either Sericulture or Agriculture. Secured minimum 55% marks or minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (MCGPA) of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in the discipline relevant to the post from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified National Eligibility Test (NET), or NET is waived for candidates with Ph.D. degree obtained under course credit system as per UGC Regulations, 2009, provided the candidate has at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5 on the last date of submission of application. A minimum score (44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST) as stipulated in the 'Academic Performance Indicator' (API) based 'Performance Based Appraisal System' (PBAS) is required to be called for interview.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Science with Physics or Meteorology as the major subject OR Passed Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture/Veterinary Science/Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Meteorology/Agricultural Meteorology from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture/ Veterinary Science/ Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry/ Agricultural Engineering. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Business Administration from an Indian university or a foreign university. OR MBA/PGDM from reputed institutions like IIM with two years working experience in reputed organization. Qualified NET (where applicable) or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Science with Statistics as major subject OR Passed Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture/Veterinary Science/Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Statistics/Agricultural Statistics from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Application/ Information Technology/ Engineering/ Science with Computer Science as major subject. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Computer Application/ Information Technology/ Information & Communication Technology/ Computer Engineering/ Electronics & Communication Engineering/ Computer Science from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, through the Commission's website upsssc.gov.in. Applications sent through any other mode will not be accepted. The broad process is:
On the UPSSSC homepage, under the "Live Advertisement Segment," locate and download/view the relevant advertisement.
Login via PET-2025 registration number: Candidates authenticate/log in using their PET-2025 registration number, verified via an OTP sent to their registered mobile number/email.

Review auto-filled details: Personal details recorded at PET-2025 (name, parents'/spouse's name, UP residency status, category, EWS status, horizontal reservation details, date of birth, gender, marital status, contact details) are displayed automatically.
Select post(s): Candidates must select the post(s) they wish to apply for; a post not selected will not be considered.

Confirm qualification details: Candidates confirm Yes/No for holding the required qualification for the selected post(s), and enter board/institution/university name, year of passing, certificate/roll number, and marks obtained.
Verify photo and signature: The photo and signature uploaded at PET-2025 are displayed automatically and cannot be changed at this stage.
Preferential qualification and address: Candidates indicate Yes/No for any preferential qualification, and their permanent/correspondence address from PET-2025 is displayed automatically.

Declaration and submission: Candidates must read and accept the declaration, enter the verification code, and submit. A completed application with an 11-digit registration number is generated; a printed copy should be retained safely.

Pay the fee: Pay the applicable fee (see Fee section above) via the payment options on the portal. The application cannot be finally submitted, downloaded, or printed until the fee payment is confirmed/adjusted by the bank.
Download and verify printout: After successful fee payment and adjustment, download and print the application form and check all entries carefully.
important_instructions: Candidates must possess the required essential qualification(s) and other eligibility conditions, and fall within the prescribed age limit, by the application closing date (6 November 2026). Candidates seeking reservation/age relaxation benefits must obtain the relevant caste/reservation certificate, in the prescribed format, issued by a competent authority on or before the date specified in the notification, and must produce it to the Commission when required. EWS category applicants must hold an EWS certificate issued between 1 April 2026 and 6 November 2026 (the application closing date), based on income for financial year 2025–26, valid for financial year 2026–27, in the prescribed format. Candidates must indicate their post preference at the time of document scrutiny; the Commission will attempt to allot posts as per preference, subject to availability, seniority, educational qualification, and age, but the Commission's decision is final. Only one application is to be made for the advertised posts. After final submission, applications can be modified only via the "Modify Application" option on the Applicant's Dashboard, using an OTP sent to the registered mobile/email, and only for specified fields (correspondence address, EWS and horizontal reservation category details, mandatory/preferential qualification details, and marital status) - other details, including category, date of birth, and gender, cannot be changed. Candidates must adjust their fee payment and download their application printout by the closing date or within 7 days thereafter (by 13 November 2026); after this, no fee adjustment or printout will be possible, and the application will not be considered valid. No request for correction/modification will be accepted after the correction deadline of 13 November 2026 under any circumstances. If any discrepancy or false information is found at any stage, the candidate's application/candidature will be rejected, and further debarment or disciplinary action may follow.

Prepare development strategies, sectoral targets, socio-economic goals and the UT Vision@2047, with a roadmap for achieving them. Draft policy briefs, presentations and other relevant documents. Coordinate with development partners and the technical agencies concerned. Support ways to strengthen horizontal and vertical coordination within the Government. Work with UT officials to prepare project proposals for the UT Government to implement. Assist the UT in strengthening its innovation ecosystem and its monitoring and evaluation ecosystem. Create and facilitate cross-learning platforms, and document the SIT's activities and good practices. Support the preparation of UT-level, regional and sectoral reports on a regular basis. Support regular updates on the UT's progress through the dashboard/portal maintained by NITI Aayog. Support the organisation of workshops and other SIT events, including preparing the relevant inputs. Perform any other tasks assigned by the supervisor (Team Leader) in the interest of the Mission.

content_sections.heading: CUS Associate Professor and Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must meet the eligibility criteria on or before the last date for receipt of applications. A: An eminent scholar with a PhD degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline and published work of high quality. You must be actively engaged in research, with at least 10 research publications in peer-reviewed/UGC-listed journals and a total Academic/Research Score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations, 2018. At least ten years of teaching experience in a university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at an equivalent level at a University/National Level Institution, with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidates. B: An outstanding professional with a PhD degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, from any academic institution (not included in A) or from industry. You must have made significant contributions to knowledge in the discipline, supported by documentary evidence, and have ten years' experience. A good academic record, with a PhD degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale, wherever the grading system is followed). At least eight years of teaching and/or research experience in an academic/research position equivalent to Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry. At least seven (07) publications in peer-reviewed/UGC-listed journals and a total academic/research score of 75 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations, 2018. For both posts, publications will be judged in light of UGC Public Notice F. No. 1-1/2018(CARE/JOURNAL) dated 16.07.2025. Papers in predatory or dubious journals, and presentations at predatory or dubious conferences, earn no academic credit. PhD holders who obtained their Master's Degree before 19 September 1991 may get a 5% relaxation, from 55% to 50%. On the UGC seven-point scale, grade "B" counts as equal to 55%: If your postgraduate degree or PhD is from a foreign university, you must enclose an Equivalence Certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi. Without it, the application will be rejected. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

Each Academic/Research (API) score must be backed by documentary evidence in the Performance Based Appraisal System (PBAS) Proforma. Claims without evidence will not be counted. Shortlisted candidates attend an interview and must produce original documents on age, qualifications, experience, fitness and any other claims. No TA/DA is paid for attending.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be on probation for the period set by UGC norms. Terms of appointment follow the Srinagar and Jammu Cluster Universities Act, 2016, its Statutes and Regulations, and the rules of the UGC and the Government of Jammu and Kashmir, where applicable. Where the university has no service rules of its own, the rules of the Government of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir apply. The university may verify your character, antecedents and documents at any time, including during service. Services will be terminated at once if documents are found to be fake or a background has been hidden.

content_sections.text: Every application is screened for qualification and completeness. Complete applications are sorted, and suitable candidates are shortlisted for interview. content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is purely a contractual engagement for specific requirements or projects. It is full-time, and you may not take up any other assignment during the period. The initial period is 03 years, renewed every year based on a performance appraisal. It can be extended by up to 2 more years with the competent authority's approval. Place of posting: OEA, DPIIT, GPOA-3, Netaji Nagar, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi - 110023. Working hours are normally 9 AM to 5.30 PM. When work demands, you may be asked to stay longer or to come in on Saturdays, Sundays and gazetted holidays. Paid leave builds up at 1.5 days for each completed month (18 days in a year) and cannot be carried forward. Female Junior Consultants and Consultants may be granted maternity leave of up to 26 weeks. For official tours, TA/DA and hotel accommodation are given as admissible to Central Government employees drawing grade pay of Rs. 5400/- (Junior Consultant) or Rs. 6600/- (Consultant). Either side can end the engagement with 30 days' notice or pay in lieu of notice. Police verification is required. If you are engaged urgently, you must submit the report within 02 months. You will be bound by the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, and you need prior sanction before publishing or broadcasting anything on your assigned work. You will be an independent consultant, not a staff member of DPIIT. The engagement gives no right to a permanent or regular job.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Deputy Registrar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age, educational qualification and experience are counted as on the closing date for applications. Essential qualification: Masters' degree or equivalent in any discipline with at least 55% marks or its equivalent Grade of B in the UGC seven points scale. Essential experience (either of the following): At least 9 years' experience as Assistant Professor in the AGP of Rs. 6000/- (Academic Pay Level – 10) and above, with experience in educational administration, or comparable experience in a research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education; or 5 years' administrative experience as Assistant Registrar or an equivalent post in Pay Band – 3, Grade Pay of Rs. 5400 (Pay Level–10) and above, with experience in handling computerized administration, Establishment, Stores & Purchase or financial matters. Desirable: A degree in Law, Management, Engineering, CA, CS or ICWA from a recognized University or institute. Officers of the Central or State Governments, Institutes of national importance, Universities or University-level institutions, or PSUs who: (a) (i) hold an analogous post, or (ii) have at least 5 years' service in posts carrying Grade Pay of Rs. 6600/- (Pay Level – 11) or its equivalent, with experience in administration, establishment and accounts matters; and (b) hold a Masters' degree or equivalent in any discipline with at least 55% marks or its equivalent Grade of B in the UGC seven points scale. The deputation post is held on lien by its regular incumbent. Because of this, only employees of Government organisations, Central Autonomous Bodies or PSUs who are allowed to keep a lien at their parent organisation will be considered. They must submit a supporting document from their parent organisation. Employees of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad who have served at least three years on a regular post: maximum age limit of 50 years. Candidates who have served at least three years on a regular post in the Institute or in other IITs, NITs, CFTIs and similar institutions: the maximum age limit may be relaxed by 5 years. This relaxation is not available to employees of private organisations. Regular employees of Central or State Governments, Ex-Servicemen, Divyang candidates and others: relaxation as per GoI norms. Scrutiny committee decides whether a candidate's experience is relevant to the post, and its decision is final. Candidates without the essential qualifications and experience will be disqualified. For full eligibility details for each mode of recruitment, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Preliminary shortlisting based on the essential qualifications and experience. If a large number of applications is received, the Institute may decide its own method of shortlisting. Presentation and Interview before the Selection Committee. The final selection depends on performance at this stage. The Institute may hold it online. A Written Test and a Computer or other Test may be held, if required, under the Recruitment Rules of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Shortlisted candidates who attend the Presentation and Interview are paid to-and-fro rail fare. This covers the shortest route from their normal place of residence in India to Dhanbad, limited to AC-3 tier, and is paid on submitting a claim with the tickets. Meeting the qualifications does not by itself guarantee a call for the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions

Posting: the Institute may assign or transfer the selected candidate to any section or department within the Institute. Disclosure: candidates must give full details of past employment, including any disciplinary proceedings, charge sheets or vigilance matters. Hiding such information, whether found before or after appointment, can lead to action under the rules.

content_sections.heading: TISS Senior Research Associate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A Master's degree in Social Sciences, Humanities, Development Studies, Education, Management or another relevant discipline, from a recognised university. content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For academic positions, the qualification, experience and related requirements are governed by the Ministry of Education guidelines. Candidates should have a demonstrated ability to make relevant intellectual contribution to experienced and potential managers through teaching, training research and published work. Candidates should also have a strong academic background and understanding of current developments in the related field. Faculty members are expected to carry out research, design and teach courses, engage in institution development, and conduct training programs and consultancy. Meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The post-wise minimum qualification and experience requirements given in the notification are listed below. Academic levels are as mentioned in the notification. Ph.D. with 10 years of experience out of which 4 years should be as Associate Professor. First Class (Min 60%) or equivalent grade in Master's Degree with a consistently good academic record. 5% relaxation for SC/ST/DAP and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master's degree. Minimum eight ABDC-B/ABS-3 or one ABDC-A/ABS-4 and 6 ABDC-B/ABS-3 or two ABDC-A/ABS-4 and 4 ABDC-B/ABS-3 or three ABDC-A/ABS-4 and 2 ABDC-B/ABS-3 or four ABDC-A/ABS-4 publications, indexed in either WOS or Scopus. A book published by reputed publisher will be preferred. One case along with teaching note published in Harvard Case Publishing/Richard Ivey/Emerald will be preferred. Minimum (preference) two FPM/Ph.D. guided. Preference for candidates having Ph.D. and/or teaching/research experience from AACSB/AMBA-BGA/EFMD-EQUIS accredited institutes. In case of overwhelming applications, the Screening Committee might use academic/publication/work-experience parameters as criteria for raising the bar and optimizing the application pool. If a candidate's academic credentials are excellent, however, does not have requisite research publications or experience, he/she may be considered for contractual appointment. content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Age Limit
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify an age limit for the Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, or Professor/Associate Professor of Practice posts. For the Senior Consultant (Academics) post on contract, the age bracket is 50 - 70 years. For Professor of Practice, the notification states that the retirement age will be 65 years.

content_sections.text: The application fee is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Salary
content_sections.text: The notification gives the following pay scale under the 7th CPC and the entry pay for each faculty position. The pay carries all other allowances such as DA, HRA/Leased Accommodation, LTC, Medical re-imbursement, Children Education Allowance, NPS, re-imbursement of telephone bills, incentive for research publications, faculty development fund for attending national and international conferences, membership of professional bodies etc. as per IIM Bodh Gaya Rules. Faculty members are permitted to pursue management consulting with income sharing with the Institute as per rules. The maximum consolidated remuneration for the Senior Consultant (Academics) post on contract is Rs. 1,50,000/- per month. In addition, the notification mentions accommodation on campus subject to availability or a fixed HRA of Rs. 15000/-, actual telephone reimbursement up to Rs. 1500/- pm, and medical allowances as per IIM Bodh Gaya Rules.

content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not list the selection stages in detail. It mentions the following points about how applications are handled: Papers published ONLY in ABDC Journals will be considered for shortlisting of applications. In case of overwhelming applications, the Screening Committee might use academic/publication/work-experience parameters as criteria for raising the bar and optimizing the application pool. Mere fulfillment of the qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates called for interview to fill a vacancy may be considered for lower posts if they are otherwise found suitable. Depending on the academic credentials of the candidate, the Institute may consider them for an offer on a contractual basis of one/two years. For regular appointments, there would be a probation period of 2 years. The list of waitlisted candidates will remain valid for 1 year from the date of declaration of result. Reservation Policy will apply as per the Government of India Rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification directs candidates to the IIM Bodh Gaya website for details and the Application Form. It does not describe the submission steps or state whether the application is online or offline. Candidates should follow the instructions on the official website. Visit the IIM Bodh Gaya website, www.iimbg.ac.in. Read the details of the post and area you are applying for, and obtain the Application Form from the website. Complete the application in every respect, as incomplete applications will not be entertained by the Institute. Apply on or before the cutoff date, 18 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIM Bodh Gaya Faculty Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications in any respect will not be entertained by the Institute. No correspondence, whatsoever, will be entertained from candidates regarding conduct and result of the interview and reasons for not being called for interview or selection. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Mulugu District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 posts: 4 AYUSH Medical Officer, 1 Pharmacist, 1 Psychosocial Counselor and 1 Yoga Professional, all in Mulugu District.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are received from 26 October 2026 to 31 October 2026, between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM on working days. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the AYUSH Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: A Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system, from a regular course of not less than 4 ½ years in a recognized teaching institution, with one year compulsory internship.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: D Pharmacy, B Pharmacy or Pharma D, and the candidate must be registered with the Telangana Pharmacy Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum is 44 years as on 1 July 2026. The maximum is relaxed by 5 years for SC, ST and BC candidates, by 3 years plus the length of armed forces service for Ex-Service men, and by 10 years for disabled persons.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay per month is Rs.40,000/- for the AYUSH Medical Officer, Rs.15,000/- for the Pharmacist and Rs.28,000/- for the Yoga Professional. The Psychosocial Counselor gets Rs.500/- per session, with atleast 200 visits in a year (on call).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the application form from the official website of Mulugu District. Submit it with self-attested certificates in person or by Registered Post to AYUSH Cell, O/o DM&HO Office, IDOC-Mulugu, Pin: 506343, by 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: On marks out of 100: up to 90 for the marks in the qualifying examination and up to 10 for age (0.5 mark for each completed year above 18, as on 1 July 2026). The merit list will be displayed on the website, and the selection list will follow the rule of reservation and the Presidential Order.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on an outsourcing basis up to 31 March 2027. After that, the services will be as per the need and subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Can an AYUSH Medical Officer candidate from another district apply?
faq.answer: Yes. The AYUSH Medical Officer post is a Multi Zonal cadre post, so a candidate can apply in any district in the concerned Multi Zone, but selection is restricted to one district.

content_sections.heading: RABL CARS Guest Teacher Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 years. SC, ST, OBC and women candidates get 5 years of relaxation as per CG Government rules. Master's Degree in the relevant subject of Agriculture with 55% or equivalent grade 6.50 on a 10.0 scale, with a good academic record. Candidates with a Master's degree must also have passed NET (National Eligibility Test) for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor and equivalent, in the discipline in which NET is conducted. They also need one publication in a refereed journal related to NAAS (National Academy of Agricultural Sciences, New Delhi). Ph.D. holders do not need NET if the Ph.D. was done with course work as prescribed by the UGC Regulation 2009. They must also have at least two full-length publications with a NAAS rating of not less than 4 on the last date of submission of the application. This would be for only one semester and needs approval from the competent authority. For the full eligibility conditions for the discipline, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview before a committee. The interview follows the university's 2019 guidelines and norms. The venue is the College of Agriculture, IGKV, Raipur (C.G.). Bring all your original documents for verification on the interview day. Candidates without them will not be allowed to appear. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. After the committee selects a candidate, the candidate must submit an affidavit on stamp paper of Rs. 50/- in the prescribed format, agreeing to the terms and conditions set by the Vishwavidyalaya.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is contractual. It lasts for one academic session or until a regular teacher is appointed, whichever comes first. The post is purely temporary. The selected candidate has no right to claim a regular appointment to any post advertised by IGKV, Raipur. Guest Teachers handle teaching, examinations, laboratory work, sports, cultural activities and any other work assigned from time to time. If performance is unsatisfactory, services can be ended with one week's notice. Anyone whose claimed credentials turn out to be false will be removed.

how_to_apply: Applications for Advertisement No. 465/202627 are accepted online only, on ojas.gujarat.gov.in, from 27 October 2026 (18:00 hours) to 10 November 2026 (23:59 hours). Only candidates with an OTR (One Time Registration) on OJAS can apply. Candidates who have not registered must complete the OTR first.
Go to https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in. Click Apply under "On line Application" and select GSSSB.
Click the name of Advertisement No. 465/202627, Food Safety Officer, Class-3, and then Apply. Read the advertisement under More Details, then click Apply now.
Enter your Registration No. and date of birth, then click "Apply with OTR". The Personal Details are already filled in from your registration. Fill in every field marked with a red asterisk (*).
Enter your SSC details: roll number, month and year of passing, and the board name as printed on the marksheet.

For the fee refund, enter your bank account details (name as in the passbook, bank name, IFSC code and account number). Upload the first page of the passbook in JPEG, JPG or PNG format. These details cannot be changed offline once submitted.
Fill in the Educational Details. Under "Declaration", select "Yes" and click "save" to generate the Application Number.

Click Upload Photograph and enter the application number and date of birth. Upload the photo (5 cm high, 3.6 cm wide) and the signature (2.5 cm high, 7.5 cm wide), each in jpg format and no larger than 15 kb. The photo must be passport size, with a white background and the date it was taken printed on it. That date must not be more than one year before the last date to apply.

Click "Confirm Application" in the Online Application tab, check all details, edit if needed, and confirm. Note the "confirmation number". Then use Print Application, select the advertisement, enter the confirmation number and date of birth, and print the application. Pay the fee online by 13 November 2026 (23:59 hours).

No change of any kind is possible after the application is confirmed. To change any detail, candidates must apply again before the last date, get a new confirmation number and pay the fee for it. The category entered cannot be changed later.

Only one application should be made. If there are several, the last confirmed one is accepted. For unreserved candidates, it is the last confirmed application with the fee paid. Fees paid on the earlier applications are not refunded.
The Application Form cannot be downloaded after the last date.
Candidates should keep five copies of the photograph. The same photo must be pasted on the exam attendance sheet and shown at every later stage.
For help with qualification, age, the online form or fee payment, call the Board's office at 079-23258916.

A scribe or compensatory time is given, on request, to candidates with a benchmark disability who have limits on writing, and to candidates with a temporary disability who cannot write. This follows Office Memorandum F.No.34-02/2015-DD-III dated 29/08/2018 and the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

After the admit card notice is published, get the form from the "Umedvar Upyogitao" tab, under "For Divyang candidates", on the Board's website, or from https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in/Home/ph. Email the filled form with the required certificates to [email protected] at least two days before the exam. Requests received later are not considered.

Candidates with locomotor disability (both arms affected, BA, at least 40%) need only the disability certificate. Other candidates also need the Appendix-I certificate from the Chief Medical Officer, Civil Surgeon or Medical Superintendent.

Compensatory time is 20 minutes per hour. The Board's decision is sent to the candidate by email. On exam day, the candidate must show the original certificates and the approval letter to the centre in-charge.

faq.question: What qualification is needed for GSSSB Food Safety Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in Chemistry, or a degree in Food Technology, Diary Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agriculture Science, Veterinary Science, Bio-Chemistry, Microbiology or Medicine. A bachelor's, master's or Doctorate degree in the listed Food Technology and Agricultural Science disciplines is also accepted. Basic computer knowledge and knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi are needed as well.

faq.question: What is the salary of a GSSSB Food Safety Officer?
faq.answer: The pay is a fixed Rs. 40,800 per month for the first five years. After that, with satisfactory service, the officer becomes eligible for regular appointment in the Rs. 29,200 – 92,300 (Level-5) pay scale.

faq.question: What is the selection process for GSSSB Food Safety Officer 2026?
faq.answer: Selection starts with a one-stage MCQ exam (CBRT/OMR). About two times the number of posts in each category are then called for document verification, and the selection list is prepared category-wise on merit.

faq.question: Is there negative marking in the GSSSB Food Safety Officer exam?
faq.answer: Yes, 1/4 of the marks for a question is deducted for each wrong answer. The paper has 210 questions (Part-A 90, Part-B 120) in 3 hours, and candidates need at least 40% in each part.

faq.question: Why are no posts for candidates with disabilities shown in GSSSB Advertisement No. 465/202627?
faq.answer: The posts reserved for candidates with disabilities in this cadre are advertised separately under Advertisement No. 466/202627, a special recruitment drive. Candidates with eligible disabilities can still apply under this advertisement and get the age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: About MLSU
content_sections.text: Mohanlal Sukhadia University (MLSU) is a university in Udaipur, Rajasthan. The notice comes from its Department of Visual Arts, which is part of UCSSH. The department runs a Skill Development Centre under the RUSA 2.0 Project, and the visiting faculty engaged through this notice will teach that centre's six-month courses.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Submit the duly filled application form to this address: Department of Visual Arts, M.L. Sukhadia University, Udaipur 313001 (Raj.). The notice does not say whether the form should be sent by post or delivered by hand. For the detailed terms and conditions and the prescribed proforma, the notice refers candidates to the University website, www.mlsu.ac.in. The form is titled "Application Form for Empanelment/ Engagement of Guest Faculty (Period Basis) for the Session 2026-27". It has two parts: You can pay the fee by Demand Draft, Cash or Online, in favour of Dean, UCSSH, MLSU, Udaipur (Raj.). FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists four six-month courses for which visiting faculty are to be engaged. The eligibility, the age limit and the pay are the same for all four posts. Educational qualification (all posts): "Minimum qualification Diploma, PG/ Graduation in specific subject." Experience (all posts): the notice asks for "experience in specific format". The application form asks for experience in the specific field, with certificates attached. Age limit (all posts): max. 60 years. Who may apply: the form lets applicants tick one of three categories: retired teachers from a University/College, teachers working in other institutions, and others. Pay: teaching assignments are given on a period basis, paid at the rates of honorarium approved by the University. Nature of engagement: the engagement is temporary and can be ended at any time without notice. The form is for empanelment or engagement of guest faculty (period basis) for the session 2026-27. Affidavit: selected candidates must submit the required affidavit when classes are allotted on a period basis.

Applications are made online through the institute's application link, and the closing date is 10 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Interested candidates may fill out the application online using the link given in the notice (listed under Important Links below) on or before 10 November 2026. All fields in the application form are mandatory. The following documents must be uploaded when submitting the application.
10th and 12th marksheets
Diploma/Graduation: all semester-wise marksheets and the final diploma/degree certificate
Masters/Post-Graduation: all semester-wise marksheets and the final degree certificate
An application submitted without these documents will be treated as incomplete and will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About MZU
content_sections.text: Mizoram University is based in Aizawl, Mizoram. DRDO has signed an MoU with Mizoram University to set up the DRDO - Industry Academia Centre of Excellence, Mizoram University (DIA-CoE, MZU) for directed research. The centre works with academic researchers and faculty, start-ups, industries and other institutes in the country to support and advance technology research. It carries out multidisciplinary directed applied research in four areas: Agro Bio Resources for Soldier Survival, Harnessing Environment for Soldier Survival, Defence Waste Management and Human Cognition Studies.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal

Its letterhead describes it as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. These posts are for the Department of Health Research (DHR), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India funded multicentric project "Economic Evaluation of Antimicrobial Stewardship (AMS) and Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) interventions in Indian Healthcare Facilities – Multicentric Study". The project runs under Principal Investigator Dr. Sagar Khadanga, Additional Professor, Department of General Medicine, AIIMS Bhopal.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: AIIMS Bhopal has 02 posts of Project Technical Assistant (Project Technical Support – III as per ICMR nomenclature), both shown as UR. The place of posting is AIIMS Bhopal. The essential qualification follows the ICMR guidelines for Project Technical Support – III and is either of the following: Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three years post-qualification experience; OR Post Graduate degree in relevant subject/field. Good understanding of the healthcare delivery system. Research/field work experience in public health projects. Good working knowledge of computer applications, such as MS Word and Excel. Excellent verbal & written communication skills. The essential qualifications are as per the ICMR Guidelines for Non-Institutional Project Human Resource Positions, as amended vide letter No. 16/29/2023/Admn dated 18.10.2024. All educational qualifications and certificates shall be from a recognised Board/University. Experience shall be preferably from Government organisations and is counted after the date of completion of the minimum essential qualification. Experience in the relevant field/area, as required for the project, will be considered. All community certificates shall be issued by the authorised officers of the Government. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum, and meeting them does not guarantee selection. The age limit is a maximum of 35 years as on the date of walk-in (10 November 2026). Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates, retrenched Government employees, departmental candidates (including projects) and ex-servicemen, in accordance with instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time. As per ICMR guidelines, the Head of the Institution may also grant an age relaxation of up to 5 years, on a case-to-case basis, to deserving candidates with experience of working in Government Research Organisations. The remuneration of Rs. 35,000/- per month is consolidated, as per the sanction of the funding agency, and includes HRA. No other allowances are paid. Paid leave is 1.5 days per completed month of engagement, as per ICMR guidelines. The tenure is 8 months. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project (up to 20/05/2027), subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of funding. Any extension depends on the funding agency extending the project. The appointment gives no claim to a regular post at AIIMS Bhopal or at the funding agency (DHR/MoHFW). The Principal Investigator may extend or end the employment. The contract ends automatically at the end of the specified period unless it is renewed, and either party can end it with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof. content_sections.heading: DIAT Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are required to perform specific roles according to their departments and specializations: Post Code 01 (Professor - School of Quantum Technology): Expertise in developing methods and devices for high sensitivity quantum sensing of magnetic fields, rotation, and gravity; design and development of advanced experimental platforms for quantum optics and quantum technologies, and advanced training based on them; expertise in quantum sensing and metrology with atomic vapours and laser-cooled atoms; quantum sensing with non-invasive quantum measurements and weak measurements; experience in precision optical and interferometric measurements. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The recruitment is purely on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027 to carry out AYUSH Public Health Programmes in Siddipet District under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad. Thereafter, services will be as per the need and subject to satisfactory performance. The selection will be made through the District Selection Committee based on merit out of 100 total marks: AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor, and Yoga Professional: 90 marks will be allotted based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination. Multi-Purpose Worker (MPW): 90 marks will be allotted for a written test. Conduct of the exam will be notified through the official website of Siddipet District. Age Weightage (All Posts): 10 marks are awarded for age, reckoned from 18 years of age as on 01.07.2026 (0.5 mark for each completed year of age up to a maximum of 10 marks). Psychosocial Counselor: A panel of eligible candidates will be empaneled and engaged on a call basis as and when required. Unit of Appointment: 95% local reservation applies. AYUSH Medical Officer is a Multi Zonal cadre post (can apply in any district in the concerned Multi Zone, restricted to one district selection). Pharmacist, MPW, Psychosocial Counselor, and Yoga Professional are District cadre posts.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Research Associate (RA) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Associate will work on the computational, empirical and digital parts of the research project. The focus is on turning linguistic datasets into research outputs and accessible digital resources. The duties listed in the notice are: Working with large text and speech datasets. Developing data-processing workflows. Applying quantitative and empirical methods for linguistic analysis. Contributing to the development and maintenance of user-friendly web interfaces, dashboards and data-visualization platforms for presenting linguistic research findings. Cleaning, structuring, processing and analysing linguistic data using computational tools. Developing reproducible workflows and data pipelines. Applying statistical methods to investigate research questions. Contributing to academic publications, research reports, conference presentations, grant proposals and technical documentation. The Associate should be available on campus, and the position is strictly on-site. According to the notice, the ideal candidate combines strong empirical research and analytical skills with computational proficiency and academic writing ability. The candidate should also be able to translate linguistic research requirements into functional and accessible digital tools.

West Zone: Personal interview during November 2026. North Zone: Personal interview during October 2026. East Zone: Personal interview as and when called before the Selection Committee.

how_to_apply: Candidates satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online through the KVIC online recruitment system. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted, and candidates are not required to send application documents separately to KVIC.
Visit the official KVIC website at www.kvic.gov.in.
Open the VACANCIES section.
Select the relevant Young Professional recruitment advertisement.
The candidate will be redirected to the KVIC Online Recruitment Portal at apps.kvic.gov.in.
Register using a valid and active email ID and mobile number.
Create the required login credentials.
Log in and select the relevant recruitment.
Select the Young Professional post for which you are eligible.
Enter personal details, educational qualification, experience and other required information.
Upload the photograph, signature and required certificates.
Check all information carefully before final submission.
Submit the online application.
Note the generated application/registration number and retain a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
Valid email ID.
Valid mobile number.
Personal details.
Educational qualification details.
Recent passport-size colour photograph.
Scanned signature using black ink.
A 200-word write-up about experience for entry in the online application.
Documentary proof of date of birth, such as Matriculation/10th certificate.
Final or provisional Postgraduate Degree/Certificate, as applicable.
Other educational, experience or relevant certificates wherever required.
Recent photograph: JPG/JPEG format, generally 50 KB to 100 KB.

Signature should be made on white paper with a black ink pen.
Signature should preferably be approximately 140 × 60 pixels.
Date-of-birth and Postgraduate certificates are mentioned with a size range of 50 KB to 1000 KB in the initial document checklist.
Other relevant certificates should preferably be in JPG/JPEG/PDF format and should generally not exceed 1000 KB unless otherwise specified.

Important upload-size note: The notifications contain an internal difference regarding the signature file size. The initial checklist states 10 KB to 50 KB, while the later detailed signature-upload instructions state 50 KB to 100 KB. Candidates should therefore follow the file-size requirement displayed on the live KVIC recruitment portal at the time of uploading.
important_instructions: Only full-time regular qualifications from the recognized institutions specified in the notification will be considered. Candidates must satisfy the eligibility conditions by the applicable last date. CGPA/OGPA or letter grades must be converted into percentage according to the University's or Institute's prescribed norms, and proof of the conversion formula must be produced when required. Internship training will not be counted as work experience. Candidates should use a valid email ID and mobile number and keep them active throughout the recruitment process. The name entered during registration should match the name appearing on the photo identity proof. Candidates must produce the original photo identity proof and provide a photocopy when attending the interview. The printed online application form and an original photo ID such as Voter ID, Driving Licence, PAN Card, Passport or Aadhaar Card should be carried to the interview. Original testimonials and documents must be produced at the time of interview or joining. Candidates should submit only a single application for the same recruitment post. Multiple applications may lead to cancellation or rejection. Once the application is finally submitted, changes may not be permitted except where specifically enabled by KVIC. Candidates should retain the application/registration number and a copy of the submitted application. The same passport-size photograph should be used throughout the recruitment process. Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate. False, fabricated or tampered documents, suppression of information, impersonation, misconduct or use of undue influence may result in cancellation of candidature. Serving Government/PSU officials, if selected, will be allowed to join only after being properly relieved from their parent organization. Recruitment updates, corrigenda, addenda and errata will be published through the KVIC website. KVIC reserves the right to shortlist candidates, reschedule the interview date or venue, alter advertised conditions or cancel the selection process. The engagement is temporary and contractual and does not confer a right to permanent employment or regularization.

The initial contract period is one year. Extension may be considered based on performance and requirement for a further period of up to two years. Working hours will be the same as those applicable to regular KVIC employees. No extra remuneration is payable for working beyond normal working hours or on holidays. Young Professionals are eligible for eight days of leave in a single year of consultancy. Unavailed leave cannot be carried forward to the next one-year tenure. Intervening Saturdays, Sundays and Government holidays during a spell of leave will not be counted against the eight days of leave. Young Professionals must maintain confidentiality and secrecy regarding information obtained during the assignment. Selected candidates must provide integrity certificates from two references along with an undertaking regarding criminal record or pending/contemplated criminal cases. Young Professionals are responsible for arranging and maintaining appropriate insurance at their own expense. Income Tax or other applicable State tax will be deducted at source according to prevailing rules. Young Professionals are required to comply with the applicable rules and regulations of KVIC and the Government of India. Either KVIC or the Young Professional may terminate the contract by giving one month's notice as specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: KVIC Young Professional Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification prescribed for the relevant Young Professional discipline. Only full-time regular courses are to be considered, and the qualifications must be obtained from a UGC-recognized Indian University, a UGC-recognized Indian Deemed University or through an AICTE-approved course, as applicable. Where a CGPA, OGPA or letter grade has been awarded instead of a percentage, candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage according to the conversion norms of the University or Institute and produce proof of the conversion formula when required for document verification. Internship training is not to be treated as work experience. The notifications state that only direct work experience, including fixed-term employment in an organization, will be considered as work experience. Good knowledge of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Good communication and writing skills. Sincerity and commitment to work. Young Professionals are expected to provide high-quality professional inputs in their respective disciplines. The work may include data analysis, project management, evaluation of schemes and programmes, start-up and innovation activities, special studies including feasibility studies, compliance supervision, training and development, implementation monitoring and other related work assigned by KVIC. The notifications state that the role requires strong academic credentials, relevant professional competence, analytical ability, professional achievement and leadership qualities.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur (CSJMU) for filling various teaching positions across multiple departments under Uttar Pradesh state norms.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 36 vacancies have been announced for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor positions in various disciplines and engineering branches.

faq.question: Q3. What are the starting and closing dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 26 September 2026 and concludes on 31 October 2026. Candidates must submit their applications well before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess qualifications as per UGC Regulations-2018, AICTE-2019, and U.P. State Government's rules depending on the specific teaching post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General, OBC, and EWS category candidates is Rs. 2500/-, while SC/ST candidates are required to pay Rs. 2000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a requirement to submit a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must submit a printout of their online application along with photocopies of relevant certificates and documents to the office of the Registrar, CSJMU, Kanpur via registered or speed post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSJMU teaching posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes short-listing of candidates, a written test (specifically for Assistant Professor posts), assessment of teaching skills, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from states other than Uttar Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: Yes, eligible candidates from all over India can apply, though reservation benefits and age relaxations will be applicable strictly as per U.P. State Government rules.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of CSJMU to apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the online application portal and find detailed notifications by visiting the official university website at www.csjmu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official notification has been released under the advertisement number No.CSJMU/Gen.Admin/980/Teaching/2026 dated 26-09-2026.

basic_details.short_information: KMRL has issued its Apprenticeship Recruitment Notification 2026-27 for 70 apprenticeship positions across technical, non-technical, diploma and ITI trades. The overview below summarizes the vacancies, qualifications, age, stipend, training period, eligibility restrictions, application process, selection procedure and official contact details. Important: These are apprenticeship training positions, not regular permanent KMRL employment. The vacancy count is indicative and may change according to company requirements and statutory provisions.

application_fee.details: Kochi Metro Rail Limited has confirmed that there is no application fee for the Apprenticeship Programme 2026-27.

age_limit.details: KMRL requires apprenticeship applicants to have completed 18 years of age. Candidates below 18 years are not eligible.

qualification.education_qualification: Relevant Full-Time Regular Degree, 3-Year Diploma or ITI Trade Certificate
qualification.details: Candidates applying for Kochi Metro Rail Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026 must have completed the relevant qualification through a full-time regular course from a government-recognized institution. Educational qualifications obtained through part-time, correspondence, distance education or online modes are not accepted. | Applicants must have completed a full-time regular four-year B.Tech or B.E. degree in one of the engineering disciplines notified by KMRL. | Applicants must possess a full-time regular three-year degree in BBA, B.Com or BCA from a recognized institution. | Candidates must possess a full-time regular three-year engineering diploma in the relevant notified discipline. | Applicants must have completed a full-time regular ITI course in the relevant advertised trade. | Candidates must have passed the qualifying examination within five years from the application closing date of 10 November 2026. The notification also requires candidates to be medically fit under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961. | Candidates awaiting final examination results. Candidates who have not completed 18 years of age. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in any organization for any duration. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates whose qualification was obtained through part-time education. Candidates holding correspondence, distance education or online-mode qualifications. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed qualification or medical fitness requirements.

salary_details.details: The monthly stipend depends on the apprentice's qualification category. Graduate apprentices receive Rs. 12,300, diploma apprentices Rs. 10,900 and ITI trade apprentices Rs. 9,600. An additional Rs. 1,200 per month is payable as food/messing allowance. | The notification states that Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under the NATS scheme will provide Rs. 6,150 for graduate apprentices and Rs. 5,450 for diploma apprentices. The remaining applicable stipend will be paid through KMRL's arrangements, as prescribed. | The DBT amounts form part of the notified monthly stipends and are not additional payments.
