content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Kochi Metro Rail Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026 must have completed the relevant qualification through a full-time regular course from a government-recognized institution. Educational qualifications obtained through part-time, correspondence, distance education or online modes are not accepted. Applicants must have completed a full-time regular four-year B.Tech or B.E. degree in one of the engineering disciplines notified by KMRL. Applicants must possess a full-time regular three-year degree in BBA, B.Com or BCA from a recognized institution. Candidates must possess a full-time regular three-year engineering diploma in the relevant notified discipline. Applicants must have completed a full-time regular ITI course in the relevant advertised trade. Candidates must have passed the qualifying examination within five years from the application closing date of 10 November 2026. The notification also requires candidates to be medically fit under the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961. Candidates awaiting final examination results. Candidates who have not completed 18 years of age. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training in any organization for any duration. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates whose qualification was obtained through part-time education. Candidates holding correspondence, distance education or online-mode qualifications. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed qualification or medical fitness requirements.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: KMRL requires apprenticeship applicants to have completed 18 years of age. Candidates below 18 years are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend depends on the apprentice's qualification category. Graduate apprentices receive Rs. 12,300, diploma apprentices Rs. 10,900 and ITI trade apprentices Rs. 9,600. An additional Rs. 1,200 per month is payable as food/messing allowance. The notification states that Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) under the NATS scheme will provide Rs. 6,150 for graduate apprentices and Rs. 5,450 for diploma apprentices. The remaining applicable stipend will be paid through KMRL's arrangements, as prescribed. The DBT amounts form part of the notified monthly stipends and are not additional payments.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Apprenticeship Training Period 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training for a period of one year from their date of joining. The training will end automatically upon completion of the one-year period, and no extension is permitted.

content_sections.text: The contract will be initially given for a period of 1 year and, based on a satisfactory performance report, it will be renewed for a further period of 1 year, making the total contract period 2 years. Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay of ₹35,000/- per month. No other allowance or perquisites including bonus, ex-gratia, variable pay, LFC, and medical reimbursement as admissible to regular employees will be paid or given. However, they are eligible to avail all other allowances provided to the Mobile Inspector of Branches such as lodging expenses and halting allowance, which will be paid as applicable to their respective cadre.

content_sections.heading: TMB Mobile Inspector of Branches Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected officers will handle responsibilities associated with the Inspection Division, including: Verify that all branch activities are conducted as per the bank's internal policies, procedures, and circulars. Ensure adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regulations and other statutory requirements. Check compliance with KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) norms. Scrutinize cash transactions, deposits, advances, and other high-value entries for irregularities. Verify cash balance and vault holdings against records. Examine loan and advance portfolios for proper documentation, sanctioning procedures, and follow-up. Ensure interest calculations and charges are correctly applied. Identify potential operational, credit, Trade Finance, and compliance risks at the branch level. Check for fraud-prone areas such as dormant accounts, unauthorized overdrafts, or forged documents. Evaluate the adequacy of internal controls and inspect security items like gold, title deeds, and pledged or mortgaged properties. Verify security systems such as CCTV, alarm systems, and fire safety measures, and check insurance coverage of branch assets. Assess branch service standards, review customer complaints and resolution processes, and observe staff-customer interactions. Audit account opening forms, loan files, vouchers, registers, safe custody, locker registers, and complaint registers, and ensure proper record retention and disposal. Verify staff attendance, leave records, code of conduct adherence, job role definition, and review training needs. Prepare detailed inspection reports highlighting observations, irregularities, risks identified, and recommendations for corrective action. Submit findings to the Regional Office or Head Office Inspection Division, follow up on compliance with previous inspection recommendations, and perform other related duties.

syllabus.details: General Knowledge & Reasoning: Current affairs (national/international), awareness of events, Indian history, Indian freedom movement, art & culture, geography, economics, general polity and constitution, awards and honors, sports, gender and weaker sections sensitivity, environmental issues, common abbreviations, current technological developments, Ladakh history, art, culture, geography, and current affairs. selection_process: Paper School Level Structure Marks
Paper 1 Primary (1–5) Part I – Language (qualifying, min 30%); Part II – General Studies 150
Paper 2 Middle (6–8) Part I – Language (qualifying); Part II – General Studies; Part III – Subject Paper 150
Paper 3 Secondary (9–10) & Special School Teacher Part I – Language (qualifying); Part II – General Studies; Part III – Subject Paper 150
Paper 4 Higher Secondary (11–12) Part I – Language (qualifying); Part II – General Studies; Part III – Subject Paper 150
Selection is made in two stages - a Preliminary Examination and a Main Examination. There is no interview.
Objective-type General Studies paper; all questions carry equal (1) marks. Duration: 2 hours; Total marks: 150. Each question offers 5 options (A
B
C
D
E); candidates must mark one option. Option (E) must be chosen if the candidate does not wish to attempt the question. Negative marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
and 1/3 mark deducted for any question left unanswered without selecting option (E). Covers general science
current national and international events
Indian history and Bihar's history
general geography
Bihar's geographical features
India's polity and economy
the freedom movement and Bihar's contribution
and general mental ability. Minimum qualifying marks: General category 40%
EBC 34%
SC/ST/women/Divyang candidates 32% (with an additional 4% horizontal relaxation for women
subject to a minimum of 32%
applicable only to Bihar domicile candidates). Number of candidates shortlisted for the Main Examination will be 2.5 to 10 times the total advertised vacancies
category-wise
based on merit.
Objective (MCQ) type

duration 2 hours for each paper; each question carries 1 mark. Negative marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong or unanswered question (same 5-option format as the Preliminary Exam). Language paper (Part I) is qualifying only
with a minimum of 30% required; it does not count towards merit. Same category-wise minimum qualifying marks apply as in the Preliminary Examination (General 40%
SC/ST/women/Divyang 32%). Merit is prepared from Main Exam marks - Part II only for Primary (1–5); Part II + Part III combined for all other levels. There is no re-evaluation.
Note: Guest teachers (Atithi Shikshak) meeting prescribed eligibility get service-based weightage marks of 5 marks per year of service
up to a maximum of 25 marks
added to their qualifying score in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations
per the applicable court orders and Education Department resolutions.

Log in at bpsconline.bihar.gov.in/candidate/login and complete your profile in six steps: Personal Information, Address Information, Other Information, Qualification Information, Experience Information, and Photo/Signature Upload.
Upload a live webcam photograph and scanned signatures in both Hindi and English.
Review all entries, tick the declaration checkbox, and click "Submit and Lock Profile" (profile details cannot be edited after locking, except by unlocking before final submission).
Go to the "New Application" tab, select this advertisement (No. 14/2026), choose your post/subject and up to 38 preferred districts in order of priority.
Pay the applicable fee online (SBI Payment Gateway) and confirm payment.
Click "Proceed to Application" and then "Submit Application" to finalise your form.
Download and print the confirmed Application Form from the "My Account" tab for future reference.

content_sections.heading: BPSC TRE-4.0 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made in two stages - a Preliminary Examination and a Main Examination. There is no interview . Objective-type General Studies paper; all questions carry equal (1) marks. Duration: 2 hours ; Total marks: 150 . Each question offers 5 options (A, B, C, D, E); candidates must mark one option. Option (E) must be chosen if the candidate does not wish to attempt the question. Negative marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer, and 1/3 mark deducted for any question left unanswered without selecting option (E). Covers general science, current national and international events, Indian history and Bihar's history, general geography, Bihar's geographical features, India's polity and economy, the freedom movement and Bihar's contribution, and general mental ability. Minimum qualifying marks: General category 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST/women/Divyang candidates 32% (with an additional 4% horizontal relaxation for women, subject to a minimum of 32%, applicable only to Bihar domicile candidates). Number of candidates shortlisted for the Main Examination will be 2.5 to 10 times the total advertised vacancies, category-wise, based on merit. Objective (MCQ) type, duration 2 hours for each paper; each question carries 1 mark. Negative marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong or unanswered question (same 5-option format as the Preliminary Exam). Language paper (Part I) is qualifying only, with a minimum of 30% required; it does not count towards merit. Same category-wise minimum qualifying marks apply as in the Preliminary Examination (General 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST/women/Divyang 32%). Merit is prepared from Main Exam marks - Part II only for Primary (1–5); Part II + Part III combined for all other levels. There is no re-evaluation. Note: Guest teachers (Atithi Shikshak) meeting prescribed eligibility get service-based weightage marks of 5 marks per year of service, up to a maximum of 25 marks, added to their qualifying score in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations, per the applicable court orders and Education Department resolutions.

content_sections.text: Important: Once fee payment is completed, the selected post/subject cannot be changed unless the payment is cancelled and the entire process is repeated. Cancelled payments and cancelled applications are not eligible for any refund or chargeback claim.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation certificate (proof of date of birth) Educational and professional/training qualification certificates and mark sheets as per the applied post CTET/BTET/STET (Paper-I or Paper-II, as applicable) qualifying certificate and mark sheet RCI-issued valid CRR number and certificate (for special school teacher posts) 6-month special/inclusive education training certificate (where applicable) Category certificate (SC/ST/EBC/BC), with caste and domicile certificate EWS certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable Disability (Divyang) certificate issued/countersigned by a government medical college or civil surgeon, where applicable Ex-servicemen certificate, where applicable Freedom fighter grandchild/great-grandchild relationship certificate, where applicable Transgender identity proof certificate issued by the competent authority, where applicable Guest teacher experience and appointment certificates issued by the District Education Officer, where weightage is claimed Valid photo identity card, as declared in the application 4 recent passport-size photographs Printed copy of the submitted Preliminary/Main exam application and e-Admit Card

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for a maximum of 38 districts, listed in order of preference; the merit list and posting will follow district priority against category-wise availability. A candidate may take part in this recruitment examination a maximum of 5 times , as per the Bihar Vidyalaya Adhyapak (Appointment, Transfer, Disciplinary Action & Service Conditions) Amendment Rules, 2024. Reservation benefits are applicable only to candidates who are original/domiciled residents of Bihar. Candidates must select only one subject - the one in which they have qualified the relevant Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET/BTET/STET). Reserved-category candidates applying against unreserved posts will not receive reserved-category age or qualifying-mark relaxations. There is no provision for re-evaluation of the objective-type Main Examination. Merely submitting the online application does not guarantee candidature; final eligibility will be decided based on documents furnished by the candidate. Provisional merit lists will be verified by the Education Department against submitted documents; the merit list may be revised based on this verification. No supplementary result will be published after the provisional result is declared. The Commission reserves the right to modify, postpone or cancel the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. What is MGUVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MGUVV Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment drive conducted by Mahatma Gandhi Udyanikee Evam Vanikee Vishwavidyalaya, Durg, Chhattisgarh, to hire eligible candidates for 50 vacant posts of Dean, Assistant Professor, and Assistant Librarian.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MGUVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 50 vacancies are available, comprising 2 posts for Dean, 40 posts for Assistant Professor across various disciplines, and 8 posts for Assistant Librarian.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MGUVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 14 November 2026 up to 17:30 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates require a Master's Degree in the concerned discipline with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) with a good academic record, along with passing the NET examination conducted by ICAR/UGC/CSIR (or holding a Ph.D. as per UGC regulations).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian posts?
faq.answer: The applicant's age shall not be more than 35 years for the post of Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian, with age relaxations applicable for bonafide residents of Chhattisgarh belonging to SC, ST, OBC, women, and Divyang categories as per C.G. Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Dean post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment to the post of Dean shall be 62 years as on the last date for submission of application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for UR and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for UR and OBC candidates, while it is Rs. 500/- for SC and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for MGUVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official university website at mguvv.ac.in by filling out the application form, uploading necessary certificates and documents, and paying the required fee online.

faq.question: Q9. Is the post of Dean permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment to the post of Dean is on a tenure basis for a period up to 05 years or till attaining the age of superannuation (62 years), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What are the selection criteria and scorecard weightage for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a scorecard system totaling 100 marks, which includes educational qualifications and examinations passed (55 marks), academic excellence (10 marks), performance in co-curricular activities (02 marks), publications/research excellence (08 marks), experience (05 marks), knowledge of agro-ecological/climatic conditions of Chhattisgarh (05 marks), and personal interview by the selection committee (15 marks).

content_sections.heading: DTU Research Score Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the minimum research score specified for their post and provide evidence supporting all claimed research achievements. The notification identifies the following activities for calculating academic and research scores. Research papers published in eligible indexed or approved journals. Books authored and eligible translation works. Innovative teaching pedagogy, curricula, MOOCs and electronic content. Research guidance and completed or ongoing research projects. Consultancy activities. Patents, policy documents, awards and fellowships. Invited lectures, seminars, conferences and eligible conference publications. The detailed score must be calculated according to Annexure-II and the criteria referenced from the UGC Notification dated 18 July 2018.

content_sections.heading: DTU Academic and Research Screening Score 2026
content_sections.text: The university evaluates candidates using Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance scores for shortlisting. The academic record is initially assessed using a 50-point schedule and scaled down to 20 points. Experience and research performance are initially assessed using a separate 50-point schedule and scaled down to 40 points. Important: The detailed marks awarded for publications, patents, research projects and related achievements depend on authorship, publication category, project value and other criteria in the notification. Candidates must calculate the score using the prescribed table rather than claiming the maximum points automatically.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: DTU will select candidates through eligibility screening, academic and research evaluation, document and point verification, teaching presentation and interview. Online application and submission of the required printed documents. Initial scrutiny under the discipline-specific Recruitment Rules. Publication of provisional eligibility lists. Consideration of candidates' representations, where applicable. Shortlisting based on Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance scores. Original Document and Point Mark Verification. Presentation assessing teaching aptitude and ability. Interview evaluating domain knowledge and interview performance. Final selection according to the prescribed assessment criteria. The university normally calls 10 candidates for the first vacancy and five candidates for each subsequent vacancy for interview, subject to recruitment requirements. Shortlisting for document verification is based on the combined 60-point score for Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance. Candidates tied at the shortlisting cut-off may also be included in the provisional shortlist according to the notification. Candidates shortlisted for verification must produce original certificates and relevant supporting evidence for the academic and research points claimed. If a candidate has not uploaded or attached evidence for a claimed assessment component, the university will award zero points for that component. Candidates unable to produce the required original documents will not be permitted to participate in the presentation and interview stages. Candidates successfully completing document and point verification must attend: Presentation: Assessment of teaching aptitude and ability. Interview: Assessment of domain knowledge and interview performance. Final selection takes account of academic record, experience, research performance, teaching aptitude, domain knowledge and interview performance.

content_sections.heading: About JMI Faculty of Dentistry
content_sections.text: The Faculty of Dentistry is a faculty of Jamia Millia Islamia, a university in New Delhi (PIN 110025). This notice offers the one-year BDS internship there to students from other dental institutions. The internship is run under the Ordinances of Jamia Millia Islamia.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form attached to the notice and submit it with the required documents to this address: Office of the Dean, Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi-110025. The deadline is 16 November 2026, 04:00 PM. The notice says the Institute will not be responsible for any delay in postal delivery or in delivery through any other agency, so the application has to reach the office by that time. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope. The application form has these parts: Personal details: name of the student, father's name, date of birth, nationality, religion, marital status, whether you belong to OBC/SC/ST, address for correspondence, email ID and mobile number. Academic details: the name and full address of the institution where you are doing the BDS Programme, the name and address of the affiliated university, the date you joined the BDS Programme and the date you passed the final BDS Examination. Reason and documents: your reason for seeking internship at Jamia, and a list of the documents and certificates you have attached (you may add extra sheets). Detail of BDS Examination Passed: for each year (I, II, III and Final) and each paper (Paper No. I to VIII), give the subject name, the number of extra attempts, the percentage of marks in the subject and any distinction or medal in the subject. Then give the overall percentage. Photo and undertaking: paste a self-attested photograph on the form, then sign the undertaking and write your name in block letters. In the undertaking you declare that your statements are true. If facts are found to be hidden or misrepresented at any stage, your candidature for internship may be cancelled without any liability on Jamia Millia Islamia. Specialist Grade - I posts carry a Pay Scale of Rs. 15600-39100 + Grade Pay 6600/- plus allowances as per Contractual engagement terms and conditions of Delhi Government. The appointment of teaching faculty shall be on contract basis for an initial period of 03 years, extendable further for another 02 years, with extension based on annual performance appraisal report up to the age of superannuation in the Government of Delhi. The appointment of Specialist Gr. III and Specialist Grade - I shall be initially on contract for a period of five years with a notice period of three month from either side for severance of contract.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification for these non-teaching posts. The post is open to distinguished experts who have made remarkable contributions in their professions. The fields named include engineering, science, technology, entrepreneurship, commerce, social sciences, media, literature, fine arts, civil services, armed forces and the legal profession. They also include community development, panchayati raj, rural development, watershed development, water harvesting, organic farming, small green-energy systems, municipal planning, community participation, gender budgeting and planning, inclusive development of tribals and public administration, among others. Experience: proven expertise in the specific profession or role, with at least fifteen (15) years of service or experience, preferably at a senior level. Qualification: a formal academic qualification is not considered essential when the candidate has exemplary professional practice instead. Such experts are exempted from the requirement of publications and from the other eligibility criteria for recruiting faculty members at the Professor level. However, they must have the skills needed for the duties listed in the job description. Departments running programmes under AICTE must also keep in view the norms of the Government of Gujarat Resolution dated 14/10/2024. Under these norms, a candidate needs one of the following: Ph.D. with 10 years of relevant experience in a large conglomerate; or Master's degree with 15 years of relevant working experience in a large conglomerate; or B.E./B.Tech. with 17 years of relevant working experience in a large conglomerate; or Ph.D. / Master's / B.Tech. with a minimum of five (5) patents and 5 years of experience in a start-up. A Ph.D. is desirable for guiding research scholars at the Ph.D. level but is not mandatory for teaching. Disqualification: people in the teaching profession, whether serving or retired, are excluded and will not be engaged as Professor of Practice. Their applications will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Professor of Practice honorarium is paid under University Circular No. પીજી/મહેનતાણું/11751/2022 dated 09/06/2022, at ₹2,000/- per hour. Under Ordinance-189, this amount cannot be met from the salary grant received from the State Government. When the Professor of Practice has to travel for University work, mileage allowance is paid under Finance Department Resolution No. મસભ/102012/761/ચ dated 22/03/2022: Travelling allowance is paid only for journeys actually made for University work, when the Head of the Department concerned certifies them. No travelling or daily allowance is paid for attending the Selection Committee/Interview. The first engagement is for one year and may be extended up to three years in all. After the three-year tenure, one further year may be granted for exceptionally good performance, and only once. The Head of the Department assesses performance and may recommend a further year. The Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor may approve or disapprove that recommendation. The position is not necessarily full-time. It is a fixed-term engagement and gives no right or claim to regular appointment, absorption, continuation or seniority in the University. A Professor of Practice gets no service benefits, E.P.F., gratuity or perks other than the fixed honorarium decided by the University. The engagement is outside the University's sanctioned posts and does not affect the recruitment of regular faculty members. The Professor of Practice works in the Department to which he or she is assigned, follows its time-table and carries the weekly theory and practical load set for the position.

rows.rate_of_mileage_allowance: At the rates fixed by the State Government from time to time

content_sections.heading: VNSGU Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: These are the duties and responsibilities of a Professor of Practice: Involvement in the development and designing of courses and curriculum. Introduction of new practice-oriented courses. Delivery of lectures and involvement in practical and project work as per the given work-load and the policies of the University. Encouraging students in innovation and entrepreneurship projects and providing the necessary mentorship for such activities. Focusing on enhanced industry–academia collaboration. Conducting workshops, seminars, special lectures and training programmes jointly with regular faculty members of the Department concerned. Carrying out joint research projects or consultancy services in collaboration with regular faculty members of the Department concerned. Advising and guiding students in their projects and dissertations and linking them with appropriate external stakeholders, including internship and placement opportunities. Research organisations of State and Central Government institutions and universities (non-teaching scientific and research positions) Central and State Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) National and international industry associations such as FICCI, CII and the like Reputed industries and non-governmental organisations International organisations such as the United Nations, the World Bank and similar bodies Civil servants (IAS / IPS / officials of Central and Provincial Services) and professionals Officials from professional councils Non-Resident Indians working with reputed overseas academic, research and industrial organisations, or with a demonstrated interest in Indian issues Armed forces personnel Persons of eminence in the chosen domain not covered above

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNSGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted online only . Physical forms are not accepted. Experts can also be nominated by others, or can send their own nomination to the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor with a detailed biodata and a short write-up on how they could contribute to the University. A nomination by others must include the biodata and the written consent of the expert. For queries, email [email protected] and put your mobile number in the body of the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Professors of Practice are selected under the "Procedure for Selection of Professor of Practice" in Ordinance-189 and the University Circular dated 15/04/2023. The Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor may invite nominations from eminent experts, with or without a recommendation from the Department. Because the position is held by persons of eminence, the Vice-Chancellor may also nominate eminent experts and approve their engagement directly. All other candidates go through the Selection Committee. The Committee has the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor or his or her representative, the Head of the Department concerned, the Dean of the respective Faculty, two subject experts nominated by the Vice-Chancellor, and one eminent external member (non-academic) nominated by the Vice-Chancellor. The minimum quorum is four members, and the Vice-Chancellor or his or her representative must be present. The University approves the engagement based on the Selection Committee's recommendations. It then issues a letter of engagement, and the expert must join the Department within the period stated in it. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called before the Selection Committee.

qualification.details: Qualifications and experience follow the Four-Tier Flexible Faculty Structure as per Ministry of Education guidelines (F.No.27-11/2011 TS.1 dated 23 April 2014). All degrees acquired by the applicant must be from an Institute / University recognized by the UGC/AICTE/AIU/GOI. All applicants shall have a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and First Class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor's Degree onwards). In case First Class is not mentioned in the preceding degrees by the University/Institution, candidates should have passed and secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate. Conversion from CGPA to percentage or vice versa given by an individual Institute/University will not be considered or allowed for determination of eligibility. | Other Essential Requirements: None. Additional Desirable Requirements: One publication in an SCI Journal. | Other Essential Requirements: One paper accepted for publication in an SCI Journal. Additional Desirable Requirements: Two papers in SCI Journals or one patent; may be based on Ph.D. work. | Other Essential Requirements: 04 papers in SCI journals after Ph.D.; one Ph.D. guided as sole or principal supervisor plus one continuing; two projects ongoing or one ongoing plus one completed; two experiments or computational projects added to teaching laboratories where appropriate; academic outreach activity equivalent to two self-financed short-term courses. Additional Desirable Requirements: 01 or more patents; supervising two or more students for Ph.D.; strong liaison with industry; offering courses through application of ICT. | For Engineering: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in the relevant discipline. Candidates possessing a Ph.D. directly after B.Tech./B.E. from reputed institutions are also considered provided they have First Class at the Bachelor's level. For Mathematics: First Class at both UG and PG levels (60% marks or 6.5/10 CGPA) with Ph.D. in the relevant discipline. Countable Experience: Only experience rendered on a regular basis in applicable pay scales as per UGC, AICTE, Government of India, or PSUs is counted. Experience rendered on part-time, ad-hoc, daily wage, visiting, guest faculty, fixed remuneration, contractual, or temporary basis will not be considered. Equal Treatment: There shall be no distinction between external and internal candidates with regard to the requirements of qualification and experience. Age Limit: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except in the case of faculty with an exceptionally brilliant research career and with an ongoing or approved externally funded research project. The crucial date for determining eligibility and preferred age limit is 21 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Qualifications and experience follow the Four-Tier Flexible Faculty Structure as per Ministry of Education guidelines (F.No.27-11/2011 TS.1 dated 23 April 2014). All degrees acquired by the applicant must be from an Institute / University recognized by the UGC/AICTE/AIU/GOI. All applicants shall have a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and First Class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor's Degree onwards). In case First Class is not mentioned in the preceding degrees by the University/Institution, candidates should have passed and secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate. Conversion from CGPA to percentage or vice versa given by an individual Institute/University will not be considered or allowed for determination of eligibility. Other Essential Requirements: None. Additional Desirable Requirements: One publication in an SCI Journal. Other Essential Requirements: One paper accepted for publication in an SCI Journal. Additional Desirable Requirements: Two papers in SCI Journals or one patent; may be based on Ph.D. work. Other Essential Requirements: 04 papers in SCI journals after Ph.D.; one Ph.D. guided as sole or principal supervisor plus one continuing; two projects ongoing or one ongoing plus one completed; two experiments or computational projects added to teaching laboratories where appropriate; academic outreach activity equivalent to two self-financed short-term courses. Additional Desirable Requirements: 01 or more patents; supervising two or more students for Ph.D.; strong liaison with industry; offering courses through application of ICT. For Engineering: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in the relevant discipline. Candidates possessing a Ph.D. directly after B.Tech./B.E. from reputed institutions are also considered provided they have First Class at the Bachelor's level. For Mathematics: First Class at both UG and PG levels (60% marks or 6.5/10 CGPA) with Ph.D. in the relevant discipline. Countable Experience: Only experience rendered on a regular basis in applicable pay scales as per UGC, AICTE, Government of India, or PSUs is counted. Experience rendered on part-time, ad-hoc, daily wage, visiting, guest faculty, fixed remuneration, contractual, or temporary basis will not be considered. Equal Treatment: There shall be no distinction between external and internal candidates with regard to the requirements of qualification and experience. Age Limit: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except in the case of faculty with an exceptionally brilliant research career and with an ongoing or approved externally funded research project. The crucial date for determining eligibility and preferred age limit is 21 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Tenure: 1 year, extendable every year up to a maximum of 3 years if performance is satisfactory, or until a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. The engagement can last until you turn 70 at most. It gives no claim to regularisation or to preference for a regular post. Leave: 2.5 days of paid leave for each completed month. It is refunded after the contract is completed and you produce a no-dues certificate. Notice period: Either side can end the contract with one month's notice. If you resign on the spot, you must deposit one month's salary into the ESI account by Challan. Agreement: You sign an agreement with the Dean on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.100/-, at your own cost. Private practice of any kind is prohibited, and so is working as teaching faculty at another hospital or medical college at the same time. There are no PF, pension, gratuity, seniority or promotion benefits, and no accommodation is provided. Income tax and professional tax are deducted every month. Attendance is marked both manually and on the Aadhaar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS). Being absent for more than 7 days without permission counts as abandoning the job and ends the contract automatically.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by a walk-in interview. Original documents are checked at the interview, and the selected names go onto a panel. The school engages teachers from this panel when a need arises. Being on the panel gives no right to a regular appointment in KVS.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Contractual teachers stay engaged until a regular teacher joins or the academic session ends, whichever comes first. If their performance is not satisfactory, their service can end earlier. They have no claim or right to a regular appointment and are not part of the Kendriya Vidyalaya teachers' cadre. Even when a vacancy exists, a candidate cannot claim an appointment. Engagement depends entirely on need. Dress code: teachers must be clean and trim and must not dress casually or informally on duty. Their dress must be neat and dignified. Contract teachers perform all the duties of regular teachers, including: Teaching their subject to the standards of Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan and CBSE Checking classwork, homework, examination papers and project work on time Setting question papers for the tests and examinations given by the examination department Preparing lesson plans and keeping students' academic records Preparing students for study-related activities, home activities and cultural competitions Escorting students to activities outside the school when needed Any other work the school assigns

content_sections.heading: About NLSIU
content_sections.text: As per the notifications, the National Law School of India University (NLSIU) was established in 1987 to be a pioneer in legal education. Over the last three decades, the University has evolved as an innovative leader in law, social sciences, humanities, and public policy education and research in India. It has also been ranked first among the law universities in the National Institute Ranking Framework (NIRF) for the last eight years. The University invites applications from exceptionally well-qualified individuals dedicated to academic teaching, scholarship, and institutional service.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Notification-wise Details
content_sections.text: The HAL Defence Public Sector Chair was established in 2012 through an endowment corpus from Hindustan Aeronautics Limited. The key objective of the Chair is to expand teaching and research on relevant areas of business laws, which include contracts management, defence sector procurement, dispute settlement, and environmental compliance among other areas. The Chair further seeks to strengthen academic learning and pedagogy, contribute to policy dialogue and reform, foster a community of world class researchers and academics, facilitate training programmes, hold national and regional convenings, and produce high-impact legal research. The Chair will be part of a dedicated team of faculty members working to advance learning and scholarship in the areas of contract law, property law, and other areas of business law intersecting with the defence sector. The responsibilities include: Teaching Deliver undergraduate and postgraduate courses; Supervise student assignments, submissions, and thesis (as required); Evaluate students through examinations, presentations, and assignments as required. Research Contribute to designing and expanding the research agenda of the Chair; Publish in academic journals, books, and media platforms; Develop research proposals and grant applications; Organise guest lectures, public talks, and panel discussions on subject areas of the Chair as required; Develop training programmes in the areas of contracts, dispute resolution, negotiations etc. with special reference to defence sector; Conceptualize and organize an annual conference on defence sector laws; Participate in stakeholder meetings and contribute to policy and reform dialogues as required. Administrative Serve on university committees and provide other institutional services as required. The notification adds that serving under the Chair provides an excellent opportunity for emerging scholars to advance their research, demonstrate thought leadership in their field, and make meaningful contributions to evidence-based policy discussions and reform initiatives. As per the notification, NLSIU along with the Department of Revenue, Government of India, has established the Department of Revenue (DOR) to recognize scholars and teachers in the field of taxation law, anti-corruption, and foreign exchange regulation. The stated aim is to produce high quality research, strengthen pedagogy, engage in public policy dialogue and attract world class researchers and academicians to the University. The DOR Chair Assistant Professor is expected to perform the following functions: Contribute to teaching, research, and scholarship in taxation laws at the University; Conduct training and capacity building programmes including for DOR officials as required; Provide legal opinion and analysis on related laws to DOR officials as required; Render active support in all related topics as mutually agreed to with the primary objective of enhancing the knowledge and professional skills of DoR exe

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is defined through Appendix A of each notification, titled “Minimum Qualifications for Recruitment to Regular Posts of Teachers in the University (per UGC Regulations, 2018)”. All six notifications require the Essential Qualifications in Section I. The two permanent-post notifications (Nos. 20/2026 and 21/2026) additionally refer to Section II.1. The notifications also state that the prescribed essential qualifications/experience are the bare minimum, and that merely possessing them will not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. The qualification should have been obtained from recognized Universities/Institutions.

rows.notification: 23/2026 – Assistant Professor (Humanities & Social Sciences), 5 Year Contract
24/2026 – HAL Defence Public Sector Chair, 5 Year Contract
25/2026 – Department of Revenue Chair, 5 Year Contract

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Qualification
content_sections.text: A Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A relaxation of 5% may be provided at the graduate and master’s level for the Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Differently abled categories for the purpose of eligibility and for assessing good academic record during direct recruitment to teaching positions. A relaxation of 5% may be provided to the Ph.D Degree holders who obtained their Master’s Degree prior to 19 September 1991. The eligibility marks of 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale prescribed by these regulations and the relaxation of 5% to the categories mentioned above are permissible, based on only the qualifying marks without including any grace mark procedures. Section II.1 is titled “Assistant Professor (Law)” in Notification No. 20/2026 and “Assistant Professor (Humanities & Social Sciences)” in Notification No. 21/2026. The conditions are the same in both and are given below as per the notifications. Option A: The candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET, subject to the following exemptions: OR Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai). Notification Nos. 22/2026, 23/2026, 24/2026 and 25/2026 refer only to Section I of Appendix A. Section II.1 (NET/Ph.D. conditions) is not referenced in these four notifications. Section II.1 does not form part of the Appendix A attached to them.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Age Limit
content_sections.text: The notifications do not specify any minimum or maximum age limit. They do state that candidates must upload certificates to support their claim for educational qualifications, age, experience etc. The only age-related figure mentioned is the age of superannuation, 65 years, for the permanent posts.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is not specified in the notifications. Candidates should check the Application Form on the University’s website for any fee-related information.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Salary
content_sections.text: All six posts carry the pay structure Level 10 as per VII CPC. The notifications do not state a monthly salary amount or any allowances.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notifications do not describe the selection stages in detail. They refer to an interview and state the following: Meeting the minimum qualification/experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. If a large number of applications is received, NLSIU reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated through email. Candidates serving in Government/Public Sector Undertakings (including Boards/Autonomous Bodies) must submit a No Objection Certificate from their current employer at the time of interview, if not submitted earlier. No correspondence will be entertained regarding the conduct/result of the interview or the reasons for not being called for an interview. The notifications do not mention a written test or any other stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLSIU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted through online mode only. As per the notifications, candidates can follow these steps: Go through the University’s website and read the relevant notification (No. 20/2026 to 25/2026) for the post you are applying to. Fill in the Application Form. Upload copies of all required certificates to support your claim for educational qualifications, age, experience etc. The application form will not be considered without these certificates. Submit the application on or before December 9, 2026 at 17:00 hrs (IST). For clarifications, candidates can contact the University at [email protected] . Candidates must produce original documents at the time of joining. Where an Application Form is incomplete or lacks the required information, it will not be considered (this condition appears in Notification Nos. 20/2026, 21/2026 and 23/2026).

content_sections.heading: About NITTTR Bhopal Post Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technical Teachers' Training and Research (NITTTR) Bhopal offers this Post Doctoral Fellowship specifically focused on the Indian Knowledge Systems (भारतीय ज्ञान परम्परा) tradition. The fellowship aims to promote advanced, high-quality research connecting traditional knowledge with modern research approaches in disciplines such as Indian Philosophy, Yoga, Ayurveda, Vedas, Sanskrit, Indian Literature, and Science.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Doctorate (PhD) in a relevant field such as Indian Philosophy, Ayurveda, Yoga, Vedas, Sanskrit, Indian Literature, Science, or other disciplines related to Indian Knowledge Systems. The doctoral research must be focused on topics related to the Indian Knowledge System. Experience in conducting advanced, high-quality research post-PhD. Ability to undertake independent or collaborative research projects in the domain of Indian Knowledge Systems with demonstrated novelty and rigor. Research papers published in reputed national and international journals. Experience presenting research findings at conferences and seminars related to Indian traditional knowledge, with a strong command over Indian Knowledge Systems topics. Ability to work independently as well as part of a research team, with an understanding of how to connect traditional knowledge with modern research approaches. Interest in teaching or mentoring may be preferred but is not always mandatory. The upper age limit is 35 years. As per Government of India guidelines, a five-year age relaxation shall be provided to candidates belonging to SC, ST, and OBC categories, women, and persons with disabilities, as applicable under relevant rules. content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Grade-II (Level-10): This post is purely contractual. The contract runs for one year from joining and is renewed every year on performance, up to a maximum of 5 years. Grade-I (Level-12): One year of probation, then regularisation if probation and the other Institute requirements are met. Probation may be extended. faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for Grade-II without any experience?
faq.answer: Yes. Annexure-II lists Nil experience and Nil credit points for Assistant Professor Grade-II. You still need a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and a first class in your preceding degrees.

faq.question: Q2. How much experience is needed for Assistant Professor Grade-I?
faq.answer: You need 03 years after the Ph.D., or 06 years of total teaching and research experience in a reputed academic institute, R&D lab or relevant industry. You also need 20 cumulative credit points.

faq.question: Q3. What counts as first class if my university does not define it?
faq.answer: The notice treats minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA as first class.

faq.question: Q4. Is the Grade-II post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely contractual. The contract runs one year at a time and is renewed on performance, up to a maximum of 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the written test cut-off?
faq.answer: The cut-off is 35% for SC/ST/PWD candidates and 40% for all other categories. The test is qualifying only, and the final merit depends entirely on the presentation-cum-interview.

faq.question: Q6. Do women candidates pay a lower fee?
faq.answer: Yes. Female candidates pay the same as SC/ST/PwBD candidates: 1000 + GST 18%, which is Rs. 1180/-.

faq.question: Q7. I want to apply in two departments. Is one form enough?
faq.answer: No. You need a separate complete application and fee for each post or department. A single form covering more than one department is summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I send the hard copy?
faq.answer: Send it to The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, PO – Talegaon, Pune, Maharashtra – 410507. It must arrive by 9 December 2026, 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q9. I did my Ph.D. at IIIT Pune. Can I apply?
faq.answer: Only if you have 3 years of experience outside IIIT Pune after your Ph.D. This is the notice's in-breeding restriction.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel expenses be paid for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for the written test, the presentation-cum-interview or any other stage at the Talegaon campus.

how_to_apply: Check the department-wise table above for your post's interview date.

Fill in the application in the prescribed format. Use Annexure-A for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident (3 Years) and Senior Resident (1 Year), and Annexure-B for Medical Officer for DCBO and Part Time Ayurvedic Physician. Both forms are attached to the notice.
Paste a photograph on the form. Annexure-A asks for a colour passport size photo with the face and both ears clearly visible; Annexure-B asks for a recent passport size photo.
Get a Demand Draft of Rs.500/- in favour of ESI Fund A/c No.-1, payable at Pune, if your category pays the fee.
Fill in the Checklist attached to the notice and arrange the original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies.

Report at the Office of the Dean/Medical Superintendent, ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune between 9 AM and 10:30 AM on your interview date. Submit the duly filled Annexure-A with the documents one hour before interview time.

Candidates can apply for only one post at a time, except for the Emergency Medicine and ICU specialities, and need a separate application form for each post. Incomplete applications, or applications not in the prescribed format, will be rejected.
important_instructions: Selected candidates must join within 7 days from the date of the Offer of Appointment. The offer is issued based on hospital requirements, at ESIC's discretion. Selection is subject to medical fitness. Selected candidates must give a written acceptance/consent before the medical examination. Already employed candidates must produce a Relieving Order/NOC from their previous employer at the time of joining. If a selected candidate does not join in time or resigns within one (01) month of joining, the offer may go to a candidate on the waiting list. This is subject to the eligibility criteria and approval of the Competent Authority. The waiting list stays valid until the next recruitment process or as long as the Dean approves, whichever is earlier. ESIC will provide no accommodation. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or for joining. ESIC reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage, and its decision is binding. Wrong declarations or false information will lead to cancellation of candidature and legal action. The vacancy position may change and is updated continuously. After this drive, interviews for any new vacancy will be held on the first Monday of every month for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident – 1 Year (Against GDMOs), Senior Resident – 3 Year, Tutor/Demonstrator or any other cadre. If that Monday is a Gazetted Holiday, they move to the next Tuesday or another notified date. This arrangement runs up to 31.03.2027. Information on such vacancies will be published only on the official website of ESIC Headquarters, not in newspapers. All interview updates will appear only on the official ESIC websites.

Consolidated remuneration (wherever applicable and admissible) is paid under Medical Administration, HQRS Office Memorandum No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV (Pt. File) dated 13.04.2022 (excluding retired Army Medical Teachers) and Office Memorandum No. Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022, as amended from time to time. The remuneration may be revised under instructions issued by Headquarters from time to time. Remuneration is revised automatically whenever the rate of Dearness Allowance changes, from the date of notification of the Govt. orders. Arrears of pay and allowances are not admissible for any rate revision with retrospective effect. No claim for service benefits such as PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority or Promotion will be admissible. Contractual doctors are eligible for leave as per ESIC guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through a Demand Draft in favour of ESI Fund A/c No.-1, payable at Pune. A fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Terms of the Contract
content_sections.text: Recruitment is purely on a contractual basis. Selected candidates will have no claim to regularisation of service in the hospital. Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Senior Resident (3 Years) are engaged for one year. The term can be extended up to three years, subject to satisfactory performance and functional requirements. For Senior Resident (1 Year), Medical Officer for DCBO and Part Time Ayurvedic Physician, the tenure is one year only. The tenure ends early if a regular incumbent joins or the person reaches the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier. Either side may end the contract with one month's notice, without giving a reason. A selected candidate who resigns on the spot must deposit one month's salary into the ESI Account through a Challan. Security Deposit: Rs. 20,000/- by Demand Draft in favour of 'ESI Fund A/c No. 1', payable at Pune, submitted at joining. This applies to all seven posts. It is refunded without interest after successful completion, subject to performance, and forfeited on resignation without notice or for misconduct. Selected contractual doctors must sign a Contract Agreement on a Rs. 500/- stamp paper bought by the candidate. Service by Senior Residents in ESIC will be considered bonded service in Maharashtra under State Govt. decision No. MED/1013/Admn No.101/13/Edu-2 dated 31.01.2014. Private practice is not permitted for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident - 1 Year (Against GDMOs), Senior Resident - 3 Year and Medical Officer in DCBOs on contract. Absence from work beyond 15 (fifteen) days without permission of the competent authority will be treated as voluntary abandonment and lead to automatic termination. Teaching faculty must mark attendance daily on scheduled working days, both manually and on the Aadhaar Enabled Biometric Attendance System (AEBAS). Contractual doctors found guilty of gross misconduct or negligence may be terminated without notice. Other terms and conditions issued by the Competent Authority from time to time will apply.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Pune Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of duties in its general terms for the contractual doctors: Emergency, ward, clinical, outreach programs, health promotion & prevention programs and floor /shift duties, as assigned. Doctors may be assigned to other departments based on hospital needs.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Check the department-wise table above for your post's interview date. Fill in the application in the prescribed format. Use Annexure-A for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident (3 Years) and Senior Resident (1 Year), and Annexure-B for Medical Officer for DCBO and Part Time Ayurvedic Physician. Both forms are attached to the notice. Paste a photograph on the form. Annexure-A asks for a colour passport size photo with the face and both ears clearly visible; Annexure-B asks for a recent passport size photo. Get a Demand Draft of Rs.500/- in favour of ESI Fund A/c No.-1, payable at Pune, if your category pays the fee. Fill in the Checklist attached to the notice and arrange the original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies. Report at the Office of the Dean/Medical Superintendent, ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune between 9 AM and 10:30 AM on your interview date. Submit the duly filled Annexure-A with the documents one hour before interview time. Candidates can apply for only one post at a time, except for the Emergency Medicine and ICU specialities, and need a separate application form for each post. Incomplete applications, or applications not in the prescribed format, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the originals and one set of self-attested photocopies of the following documents for verification at the walk-in interview: Class 10th Certificate (as proof of Date of Birth). MBBS Marks Sheets (all years), Attempt Certificate, and MBBS Degree Certificate. MD/MS/DNB/Other Postgraduate Degree Marks Sheets (all years), Attempt Certificate, and Degree Certificate. Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD Certificate in the prescribed format for appointment to Central Government posts, wherever applicable. Valid and updated State Medical Council/NMC Registration Certificate. Proof of Publications, if applicable (only NMC approved publications will be considered, as the application form states). Experience Certificate(s), if applicable. One recent passport-size photograph. Relieving Certificate or No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the previous/current employer, wherever applicable. Aadhaar Card. Completion Certificate of the ICMR/NMC-approved Basic Course in Biomedical Research, if applicable. Certificate of the NMC-approved Revised Basic Course Workshop (RBCW) or Basic Course in Medical Education Technology (BCMET), if applicable. The Checklist attached to the application form also lists these items: Demand Draft as Interview Fee, if applicable. MD/MS/DNB - NMC/State Medical Council Registration Certificate. PAN Card. Certificate of Training and attendance in Conference/ Workshop/ Seminar, if any. Basic/Advanced course in biomedical research certificate and Basic/Advanced course in Medical Education Technology certificate from an institution designated by NMC. Date of Appearance in last NMC Assessment. Candidates in government service must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Scrutiny: the authorised officer(s) or scrutiny committee checks the applications submitted on the day of the walk-in interview. Only eligible candidates are allowed to appear before the selection committee. Shortlisting: if there are many applicants, the hospital may introduce shortlisting criteria, including a screening test, at its discretion. Interview: selection is based on performance in the interview before the Selection Board. The decision of the Recruiting Authority of the ESIC Hospital is final and binding, and no further correspondence will be entertained. Results: results will be published at https://mcbibvewadi.esic.gov.in / www.esic.gov.in/recruitments. Permission to attend the interview is provisional and depends on verification of eligibility and documents. Submitting an application does not entitle a candidate to the interview unless the candidate is present at the scheduled date and time. Latecomers will not be allowed.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must join within 7 days from the date of the Offer of Appointment. The offer is issued based on hospital requirements, at ESIC's discretion. Selection is subject to medical fitness. Selected candidates must give a written acceptance/consent before the medical examination. Already employed candidates must produce a Relieving Order/NOC from their previous employer at the time of joining. If a selected candidate does not join in time or resigns within one (01) month of joining, the offer may go to a candidate on the waiting list. This is subject to the eligibility criteria and approval of the Competent Authority. The waiting list stays valid until the next recruitment process or as long as the Dean approves, whichever is earlier. ESIC will provide no accommodation. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or for joining. ESIC reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage, and its decision is binding. Wrong declarations or false information will lead to cancellation of candidature and legal action. The vacancy position may change and is updated continuously. After this drive, interviews for any new vacancy will be held on the first Monday of every month for Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident – 1 Year (Against GDMOs), Senior Resident – 3 Year, Tutor/Demonstrator or any other cadre. If that Monday is a Gazetted Holiday, they move to the next Tuesday or another notified date. This arrangement runs up to 31.03.2027. Information on such vacancies will be published only on the official website of ESIC Headquarters, not in newspapers. All interview updates will appear only on the official ESIC websites.

content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Principal Project Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: All eligibility conditions are checked as on the closing date for online applications, 12 November 2026. You need one of these: A Master's degree in engineering with 10 years of experience A Master's degree in science with 15 years of experience A Ph.D. with 3 years of experience Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree is counted. Technical experience: Hands-on familiarity with fabrication processes and equipment, such as lithography, deposition, wet or plasma etching, thermal processing, or metrology. Core capabilities: Cleanroom safety, SOP implementation, maintenance and troubleshooting, staff and user coordination, and technical documentation. Professional skills: Strong organization, communication and practical problem-solving, and proficiency in spreadsheets and reporting tools. 3–5 years of relevant and exclusive experience in a semiconductor nanofabrication cleanroom facility will be considered an added advantage. Experience managing, or helping to manage, a shared research or fabrication facility, including vendor coordination, facility administration and funded-project reporting. You must be a citizen of India. Persons who migrated from Pakistan intending to settle permanently in India, and subjects of Nepal, are also eligible. They will need a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India, applied for through the Ministry of Home Affairs. For exceptionally outstanding candidates, the minimum qualification and/or experience can be relaxed. For SC/ST candidates, the institute may relax the experience requirement if not enough candidates from these communities with the required experience are likely to apply. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum. Having a higher qualification does not by itself get you an interview call. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Principal Project Officer
content_sections.text: The Principal Project Officer will take substantial responsibility for day-to-day technical and operational management. The work is done with faculty and technical staff to support safe, reliable and efficient fabrication and characterisation activities. Facility operations: Coordinate daily activities, equipment bookings, user access and competing requests, and tell users clearly when equipment is available or down. Equipment reliability: Support troubleshooting and preventive maintenance, keep service records, and coordinate vendors, repairs and spare parts. Safety and protocols: Implement cleanroom and laboratory safety procedures, maintain SOPs, support user induction, and make sure established protocols are followed. Staff and user coordination: Work with technical staff, students, faculty and external users, and organise training and equipment authorisation with the responsible teams. Records and administration: Maintain usage logs, inventory and consumables records, and support procurement documentation, billing and payment follow-up. Project documentation: Prepare technical and progress reports, track deliverables, and maintain financial and supporting records with the project and administrative teams. Stakeholder communication: Deal with faculty, vendors, external users and funding-agency or ministry officials, and support meetings and project reviews. Operational improvement: Find recurring process and coordination gaps, and improve scheduling, documentation and service continuity.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted for a test and/or interview based on the information in their online applications. The institute may limit the number of candidates called for a written test, skill test or interview to a reasonable number. It decides this on qualifications, on experience that is higher in level and more relevant than the minimum, and on other academic achievements. The institute decides how applicants are screened and tested for shortlisting and selection. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. All contact is by e-mail. Applicants already working in any project at IIT Madras must apply through proper channel. Otherwise they must produce a No-Objection Certificate at the document verification, test or interview. Without it, they will not be allowed to appear.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is temporary and purely on contract. Duration: initially one year, later extendable based on performance. Completing the contract gives no right to further extension, regularization or permanency at the institute. Work location: IIT Madras, Chennai. Documents and antecedents may be verified at any time, including during service. Services are liable to be terminated if documents are fake or information was suppressed.

Maintain training records, attendance, certifications, and MIS reports. Conduct refresher training programs whenever policy or product changes occur. Assist branches and field teams in improving credit quality and operational efficiency. Support audit readiness and adherence to internal credit standards. Any other work assigned by the Bank.

Faculty members from the Engineering, Science, Management and Humanities departments can be associated with the Centre for research, training and education.

content_sections.heading: About DDSCBL
content_sections.text: The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is a state co-operative bank licensed by the RBI (Licence No. Dos. RO (AH). REG/LIC.S-2187/04.36.000/2023-24 dated 07 March 2024). Its Head Office is in Dilip Nagar, Nani Daman, and its Administration Department issued this notice. You can reach that department on 0260 2255984 and 2255985, or by email at [email protected] . The internship is part of NABARD's scheme for engaging Cooperative Interns to strengthen cooperatives. The National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) runs the scheme, NABARD monitors it and state co-operative banks carry it out.

content_sections.heading: DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The bank pays TA/DA from its own funds. The Rs.25,000 remuneration is reimbursed from the Cooperative Education Fund of the Ministry of Cooperation through NCDC. content_sections.heading: DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be at least 21 years old and no older than 30. MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management / Cooperative Management / Agri Business Management / Rural Development Management. Essential: proficiency in computer. The bank asks candidates to read the full eligibility criteria and essential requirements in NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024, which comes with the official notification, before applying.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Cooperative Intern
content_sections.text: Work with PACS and other primary cooperatives and guide them in carrying out the initiatives of the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India. Solve day-to-day problems PACS face with computerisation, business plans, projects, financing and various approvals. Prepare and share a weekly status report on these initiatives, in coordination with the DCCB/StCB. The scheme aims to take the cooperative movement down to the grassroots. It also lets professional graduates learn how cooperatives work in practice and builds a pool of experienced cooperative professionals.

rows.event: Last date for applications to reach the Head Office

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is purely an internship programme for one year only. NCDC funds it, and the bank carries no liability. It is not an appointment or employment and does not promise one. No intern has any right or claim to a job with the bank because of this internship. The internship is full-time. The intern must keep the bank's working hours. The bank may post or transfer interns according to its functional needs. Interns get 10 days of Casual Leave for the year and no other leave. Any other leave is treated as "Leave without remuneration". The bank's holidays may apply to interns. The internship may end at any time, with no financial benefit, if performance is not satisfactory or the intern is absent without the bank's permission. The bank may also end it at any time without giving a reason. Interns must keep all documents, reports and information confidential. Breaking this rule has legal consequences. Interns may not deal with or represent the bank to print, electronic or social media. They may not post their work on social media without express permission from the competent authority. Interns must follow the rules and regulations of the bank and behave professionally with the bank and the public.

content_sections.heading: RBI Pharmacist Salary 2026 - Per Hour, Per Day and Per Month
content_sections.text: RBI Pharmacists will receive fixed remuneration of Rs. 600 per hour for a maximum of five hours per day. The maximum daily remuneration is Rs. 3,000. There is no guaranteed fixed monthly salary because engagement depends on the Bank's requirements. The following table illustrates possible monthly remuneration based on working five hours per day. These amounts are calculations, not guaranteed monthly payments. Example: If a Pharmacist works for five hours per day for 20 days, the remuneration would be 20 × 5 × Rs. 600 = Rs. 60,000, before any applicable deductions. The Bank does not guarantee five hours of work every day or a fixed number of working days per month.

content_sections.heading: RBI Pharmacist Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: RBI will shortlist eligible applicants for an interview. Shortlisting will consider educational qualifications, relevant experience and distance of residence from the Bank's dispensaries. The recruitment process includes: Shortlisting based on educational qualifications, residence distance and experience. Interview for shortlisted candidates. Medical examination for candidates shortlisted after the interview. Document verification before engagement. Empanelment and engagement according to the Bank's requirements. RBI may raise its shortlisting standards to limit the number of applicants called for interview. Merely meeting the minimum eligibility conditions does not guarantee an interview call. The notification does not specify a written examination. No travelling allowance or other interview-related allowance will be paid.

content_sections.heading: Is RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 a Permanent Job?
content_sections.text: No. The Pharmacist engagement is purely contractual and does not constitute regular RBI employment. The maximum engagement period is 240 days at a stretch. Pharmacists may be engaged only when required. Selection for the panel does not guarantee daily employment. The engagement does not provide a right to permanent or temporary appointment in RBI. Facilities available to regular RBI employees are not applicable. RBI may discontinue utilization of the services at any time without notice or assigning a reason. Candidates should consider these conditions before applying, particularly if they are looking for a permanent banking job with regular monthly pay.

content_sections.heading: RBI Pharmacist Job Location and Duty Hours
content_sections.text: Selected candidates may be assigned to one or more RBI dispensaries situated in Mumbai and Navi Mumbai. RBI will decide the dispensary allocation based on its requirements. Duty hours will depend on the assigned dispensary, subject to a maximum of five hours per day under the advertised remuneration terms. Candidates must be prepared to work at the locations allocated by the Bank.

content_sections.heading: About Zilla Parishad Nagpur
content_sections.text: Zilla Parishad Nagpur is a district body of the Government of Maharashtra. Its Health Department runs Ayurvedic, Allopathic and mobile squad (phirte pathak) health units in Nagpur district. A selection committee chaired by the Collector of Nagpur is running this recruitment. The member secretary of that committee is the District Health Officer, Zilla Parishad Nagpur.
