content_sections.heading: Zilla Parishad Nagpur Medical Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not be older than 57 years. You can prove your age with a school leaving certificate (TC) or a birth certificate. BAMS. Bring the mark sheets for every year of your BAMS and of any PG degree or diploma. In the online form, enter only your final-year marks. A degree certificate and, if you have one, a PG degree or diploma certificate. A valid, regular registration certificate from the Medical Council is mandatory. A PG degree counts only if the Additional Qualification has been updated on your registration certificate. The notice accepts government service experience only when the appointing authority has signed the certificate. Examples are the Chief Executive Officer, the Civil Surgeon, the District Health Officer, the Medical Officer of Health of a Municipal Corporation, or another appointing authority. Certificates signed by a Taluka Health Officer or a Medical Superintendent are not accepted. Contract medical officers now working in Nagpur district need a favourable performance report from the Medical Officer of their Primary Health Centre and from the Taluka Health Officer. Candidates from within or outside the district who have complaints against them, or who were removed from work for poor performance, will not be put on the eligible list. Medical officers who were absent without permission, who took part in a strike, or who were removed from government service through disciplinary action cannot apply. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit and has these stages: online application, verification of original documents, a provisional merit list, objections, a final merit list, and counselling. Verification takes place at Abasaheb Khedkar Sabhagruh, Zilla Parishad Nagpur, from 10.00 am to 2.00 pm. Your day depends on your application number. After verification, the provisional merit list will appear on the website. Objections must be submitted with supporting proof. The final merit list will be published on the website, and candidates at serial numbers 1 to 100 must report to the Health Department, Zilla Parishad Nagpur, for counselling. The committee's decision at counselling is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is temporary and ad hoc, on contract, for 11 months. Candidates on the merit list who are not selected go on a waiting list for 1 year. They will be called from that list as posts fall vacant. If any political party applies direct or indirect recommendation or pressure for a candidate, that candidate will be declared ineligible without prior notice and removed from work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zilla Parishad Nagpur Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.nagpurzp.com and fill in the online application. In the marks field, enter only your final-year marks. Submit the form by 6.00 pm on 13 November 2026. The link closes after that time. Go for original document verification at Abasaheb Khedkar Sabhagruh on the day set for your application number. Look for your name on the provisional and final merit lists on the website. If you object to the provisional list, submit your objection with proof. If you are within serial numbers 1 to 100 on the final list, report for counselling. faq.answer: The honorarium in the notice is for the BAMS post. You need BAMS mark sheets and a valid, regular Medical Council registration.

faq.answer: Only if the Additional Qualification is updated on your Medical Council registration certificate.

faq.question: Q4. On which day should I go for document verification?
faq.answer: Your day depends on your application number. For example, numbers 1 to 100 go on 16 November 2026 and numbers 401 to 500 go on 20 November 2026, between 10.00 am and 2.00 pm.

faq.answer: At Abasaheb Khedkar Sabhagruh, Zilla Parishad Nagpur.

faq.answer: Until 12.00 noon on 25 November 2026. You must submit the objection with proof.

faq.question: Q7. Who is called for counselling?
faq.answer: Candidates at serial numbers 1 to 100 on the final merit list. They must report at 10.00 am on 26 November 2026 to the Health Department, Zilla Parishad Nagpur.

faq.answer: No. Certificates signed by a Taluka Health Officer or a Medical Superintendent are rejected. The certificate must be signed by the appointing authority, such as the Chief Executive Officer, the Civil Surgeon or the District Health Officer.

content_sections.heading: AVNL Consultant – Business Development (Naval Domain) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Consultant for Business Development (Naval Domain) will perform the following job description: Establish strategic engagement with Naval Headquarters, Naval Commands, Dockyards, Coast Guard Headquarters, Shipyards and Maritime Defence Organizations. Identify opportunities for AVNL to diversify into naval logistics and shore-based military mobility systems. Advise AVNL Management on Indian Navy operational requirements, platform modernization, emerging doctrines, and long-term diversification strategy. Conduct market research on international naval support equipment and recommend products suitable for indigenous development. Submit strategic market intelligence reports, competitor analysis technology assessments and annual business development plans to AVNL management. Co-ordinate with DRDO laboratories, MDL, GRSE, CSL, GSL, HSL, BEL, BDL and private shipyards for collaborative product development. Monitor modernization plans, AoN, RFI, RFP and procurement programmes related to Navy. Identify opportunities for AVNL participation in future naval infrastructure and maritime security projects. Promote AVNL products during naval exhibitions, maritime security forums and defence industry events. Identify export opportunities for logistics, security and support vehicles. Prepare long-term business diversification plans covering maritime logistics, coastal security, disaster response and defence infrastructure support.

content_sections.heading: PRATYUSH X-ray Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Upper age limit: 35 years. You must meet one of the following: B.sc in Radiography/Medical Imaging Technology or equivalent (3 years course) from a recognized University/Institution, with 2 years of experience in operating radio-diagnosis equipment in an established Institute/ Hospital/ Imaging Centre; OR DMIT with 3 years of experience in operating radio-diagnosis equipment in an established Institute/ Hospital/ Imaging Center. Experience will not be counted without a valid experience certificate. For exceptionally meritorious candidates, the Institute may at its discretion relax the age limit or experience, or offer higher pay, subject to approval of the competent authority. See the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Prepare patients for radiological procedures and take X-rays following established procedures for patient care and safety. Protect patients and staff from radiation exposure by following sound procedures that meet or exceed recommended industry standards. Process radiological film. Obtain quality diagnostic radiographs as requested by the Physician, PA or NP. Keep all equipment in good working condition and in line with applicable laws and regulations. Identify and file reports as required. Request, retrieve and track files to and from other departments or centres. Maintain the production and quality of radiographs by following set standards, developing radiographs, checking results and making adjustments. Working hours will be as set by the Health Centre.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Contract period: The appointment is initially for 01 (one) year. It may be extended depending on performance and requirements. Nature: The position is purely temporary. Being called for interview or being selected gives no claim to a permanent post at IIT Bhubaneswar. Place of posting: IIT Bhubaneswar. Jurisdiction: Any dispute about the selection will be heard only by the Courts/Tribunals in Bhubaneswar.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through a Written Test/Skill Test and/or an Interview. If many applications come in, suitable shortlisting criteria may be used to decide how many candidates are called. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not guarantee a call for the selection test. Shortlisted candidates will be told the date, time and details of the test by email or telephone. After selection, only the selected candidate will be informed by email. Any form of canvassing will lead to disqualification.

Such candidates must produce the Original Receipt of the deposit at the time of interview. Shifts: Selected candidates must complete an 8-hour shift and work in rotation across all three shifts: 8 AM to 4 PM, 4 PM to 12 AM and 12 AM to 8 AM. Attendance: Selected candidates must mark attendance on the biometric system at both entry and exit. Emergency duty: In an emergency, candidates may be required to work as the department needs and to perform any duties the department assigns. Hostel: The warden will provide hostel accommodation if available. Resignation: Resigning with one month's notice and being relieved by the Dean is permissible. qualification.details: Nationality: Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. how_to_apply: The Application Form can be filled only in Online Mode on the University's Careers Portal (https://careers.amuonline.ac.in). The printed form then goes to the Dean's office by post. Applications on plain paper, incomplete forms, and forms received late or without the supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

Fill in the Application Form online on the Careers Portal by 4 November 2026 (upto 11:59 P.M.), following the instructions in the advertisement and the User Manual on the portal. Fill a separate form for each post if you are applying under more than one serial number of the advertisement.

Pay the non-refundable Processing Fee of Rs. 500/- for each Application Form, online only on the Careers Portal. PwD candidates do not pay this fee if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate in the prescribed Proforma with the form.
After you submit the form, print the PDF of the Application Form on A-4 size paper.
Sign the printout and paste a recent front-facing photograph in the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.

Send the complete form by post to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002. On the top-left side of the cover, write the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date.

Make sure the hard copy reaches the office by 12 November 2026 (04:00 p.m.). Hard copies will not be received after that time, and the University will not be responsible for postal delay or for late receipt or non-receipt.

The Local Selection Committee for eligible candidates will be held on 21 November 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine. Before that, the University may set up a committee to scrutinise the applications and shortlist applicants. It reserves the right to limit the number of applicants called for interview to a reasonable number, on the basis of Rules/Criteria or any other condition it thinks fit. No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued for this schedule.
Report with all original documents to the office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh, half an hour before the scheduled time of the L.S.C.
important_instructions: Requests to add any document or information to the Application Form after the last date of submission will not be entertained. For posts earmarked for PwD candidates, only persons with at least 40% of the relevant disability may apply. They must upload a Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-1, available on the Careers Portal) issued by the Competent Authority. The applicable categories of disability are: (A) Blindness and low vision (VH); (B) Deaf and hard of hearing (HH); (C) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy (OH); (D) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (E) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (A) to (D) including deaf-blindness. The Appendix-1 Proforma is available on https://www.amu.ac.in, https://www.amuregistrar.com and https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. The University Medical Board will examine the disability claim of a selected applicant before the appointment letter is issued. For help with the form, read the User Manual on the Careers Portal or call the Help Desk on +91-571-2700920 (Extension: 1178) during office hours on working days. Updates, if any, appear on the Careers Portal.

faq.answer: The Psychologist walk-in is on 3 November 2026, and the Tutor (Allied Health Sciences / Paramedical) walk-in is on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the HBCH Sangrur walk-in?
faq.answer: Report between 09.30 am and 11.00 am at H.R.D Dept. 3rd floor, New Building, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital, Sangrur, Punjab.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are in HBCH Sangrur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Psychologist and 1 Tutor (Allied Health Sciences / Paramedical). The notice says the number of posts may increase or decrease as per the institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the HBCH Sangrur Psychologist and Tutor posts?
faq.answer: The Psychologist needs an M. A (Psychologist) or equivalent from a recognized university. The Tutor needs an M. Sc. in the respective discipline (Operation Theatre, Anesthesia Technology, or Radiology / Radiological Technology).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HBCH Sangrur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for both posts is up to 35 years as on the walk-in interview date. The upper age limit is relaxed for SC/ST/OBC as per the instructions of the Government of India.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the HBCH Sangrur posts?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration is Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 35,000/- for the Psychologist and Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- for the Tutor (Allied Health Sciences / Paramedical).

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring to the HBCH Sangrur walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring your Bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, PAN Card, Aadhar Card, and educational and experience certificates in original, with one set of self-attested copies. Copies of your resume, 2 photographs, date of birth proof, mark sheets and experience documents are submitted at the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: An MCQ test covers current affairs, general knowledge, English, aptitude and reasoning, mathematics, and Microsoft Office skills. Candidates who qualify and meet the minimum eligibility criteria are called for a skill test.

faq.question: Q9. Is the HBCH Sangrur job permanent?
faq.answer: No. M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd. supplies the staff to HBCH, Sangrur, on a contract basis. The post is initially for a fixed tenure of one year from the date of joining and may be extended subject to satisfactory performance and institutional requirement.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The posting will be at New Chandigarh or Sangrur, as per institutional requirement.

basic_details.short_information: The Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi, Office of the Medical Superintendent, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital will hold a walk-in interview on 30 October 2026 from 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM. Reporting is in Room No.-132, B.M. Hospital, at Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital, GNCTD, Pitampura, Delhi-110034. The interview is for 4 Senior Resident posts on an ad hoc basis in Radiology, Paediatrics and Medicine, under the Residency Scheme. The pay is 67,700/- in Level-11.

age_limit.details: The age limit for a Senior Resident is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST and 48 years for OBC(Delhi) candidates, as on the date of the interview (30 October 2026). Only an OBC certificate issued in Delhi is accepted, and it must come with a non-creamy-layer certificate of the current year. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

qualification.details: All three posts are Senior Resident posts. They have the same qualification rule, age limit and pay. The only difference is an extra rule for Radiology, given below the table. | According to the notice, the number of posts may vary and the vacancies may be filled in phases. If a post reserved for a category is left vacant because no eligible candidate is available, it may be filled from the unreserved category if unreserved candidates attend the interview. If no SC/ST/OBC candidates are available, the posts will be filled for 89 days on an ad hoc basis by the combined merit of all categories. | MBBS Degree from an MCI recognized university with P.G./Diploma/DNB qualification in the respective speciality. The candidate must not have completed three years of Senior Residency in any recognized institution, counting both regular and ad hoc periods. If such candidates are not available in a speciality, others without a postgraduate qualification but with 02 years of experience in the concerned speciality may be considered. Registration of the PG/Diploma/DNB in the speciality with the Delhi Medical Council is compulsory. | For the Radiology Senior Resident post, a valid MD/DNB degree is mandatory. Candidates with three years of experience but without the degree will not be considered. | The qualification listed above applies. For these two posts, a candidate without a postgraduate qualification but with 02 years of experience in the concerned speciality may be considered, but only when no candidate with the PG/Diploma/DNB qualification is available. | The notice states that registration with the Delhi Medical Council is compulsory. Candidates should have a valid DMC registration certificate at the time of the interview. A candidate who has only applied for DMC registration can show the receipt at the interview, but must submit a valid DMC Registration Certificate within 45 days of joining. Otherwise the candidature will be cancelled. | The age limit for a Senior Resident is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST and 48 years for OBC(Delhi) candidates, as on the date of the interview (30 October 2026). Only an OBC certificate issued in Delhi is accepted, and it must come with a non-creamy-layer certificate of the current year. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification. | Each Senior Resident is paid 67,700/- in Level-11 (Rs. 15,600-39,100 G.P 6600 pre-revised). The appointment is on an emergent and purely ad hoc basis. It lasts 89 days or until the regular incumbent joins against the post, whichever is earlier. There is 01 day of break after every 89 days. | FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Appointment is subject to medical fitness and verification of educational certificates. Posts will be filled in phases, depending on the availability of vacancies and the needs of the department. The number of vacancies shown may change. The Competent Authority reserves the right to make any amendment, cancellation or change at any stage, during or after appointment. Candidates who have already completed three years of Senior Residency (regular and ad hoc) are not eligible. content_sections.heading: About BMH
content_sections.text: Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital (B.M.H.) is a hospital of the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (GNCTD) at H-4/5, Pitampura, Delhi-110034. This walk-in is run by the Office of the Medical Superintendent. The posts are filled under the Residency Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All three posts are Senior Resident posts. They have the same qualification rule, age limit and pay. The only difference is an extra rule for Radiology, given below the table. According to the notice, the number of posts may vary and the vacancies may be filled in phases. If a post reserved for a category is left vacant because no eligible candidate is available, it may be filled from the unreserved category if unreserved candidates attend the interview. If no SC/ST/OBC candidates are available, the posts will be filled for 89 days on an ad hoc basis by the combined merit of all categories. MBBS Degree from an MCI recognized university with P.G./Diploma/DNB qualification in the respective speciality. The candidate must not have completed three years of Senior Residency in any recognized institution, counting both regular and ad hoc periods. If such candidates are not available in a speciality, others without a postgraduate qualification but with 02 years of experience in the concerned speciality may be considered. Registration of the PG/Diploma/DNB in the speciality with the Delhi Medical Council is compulsory. For the Radiology Senior Resident post, a valid MD/DNB degree is mandatory. Candidates with three years of experience but without the degree will not be considered. The qualification listed above applies. For these two posts, a candidate without a postgraduate qualification but with 02 years of experience in the concerned speciality may be considered, but only when no candidate with the PG/Diploma/DNB qualification is available. The notice states that registration with the Delhi Medical Council is compulsory. Candidates should have a valid DMC registration certificate at the time of the interview. A candidate who has only applied for DMC registration can show the receipt at the interview, but must submit a valid DMC Registration Certificate within 45 days of joining. Otherwise the candidature will be cancelled. The age limit for a Senior Resident is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST and 48 years for OBC(Delhi) candidates, as on the date of the interview (30 October 2026). Only an OBC certificate issued in Delhi is accepted, and it must come with a non-creamy-layer certificate of the current year. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification. Each Senior Resident is paid 67,700/- in Level-11 (Rs. 15,600-39,100 G.P 6600 pre-revised). The appointment is on an emergent and purely ad hoc basis. It lasts 89 days or until the regular incumbent joins against the post, whichever is earlier. There is 01 day of break after every 89 days. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring a photograph and a set of attested copies of all their certificates, along with the originals, for verification at the interview: Passport size photo Date of Birth Certificate (Xth Class) DMC Registration Degree/Diploma Certificate (MBBS, PG) Attempt Certificate of PG degree/diploma Internship Certificate Mark-Sheets of all years (10th, 12th, MBBS, PG) Caste Certificate (if applicable). Only a Delhi OBC certificate is accepted, with a non-creamy-layer certificate of the current year. Aadhar Card/Voter Card/Driving License/any valid photo I-card approved by Govt.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report on 30 October 2026 between 09:30 AM and 11:30 AM. Page 1 of the notice places the interview in the office of the Medical Superintendent, and page 2 gives the reporting place as Room No.-132, B.M. Hospital. Original certificates are checked against the attested copies, and selection and appointment are made through the interview. If not enough candidates are available, candidates may be considered under the relaxation in circular no. F.121/26/2010/H&FW/1996-2045 dated 10/06/2011 of the Dept. of H&FW, GNCTD, on these terms: The list of fresh candidates is used up first for appointment as Sr. Residents. The second list is used only after that. All Senior Resident appointments from the second list are for one year only and cannot be renewed after one year.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Appointment is subject to medical fitness and verification of educational certificates. Posts will be filled in phases, depending on the availability of vacancies and the needs of the department. The number of vacancies shown may change. The Competent Authority reserves the right to make any amendment, cancellation or change at any stage, during or after appointment. Candidates who have already completed three years of Senior Residency (regular and ad hoc) are not eligible. The notice was sent to the website of the H&FW Dept., GNCT of Delhi and to the Notice Board of B.M.H. for display.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is a medical institute at Saket Nagar, Bhopal – 462020, Madhya Pradesh. This walk-in is conducted under the Dean (Academics), AIIMS Bhopal. Candidates selected will work as Junior Residents (Non-Academic) within the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Junior Resident (Non-Academic), with 20 vacancies. Eligibility is judged as on the date of interview, 19 November 2026. The 20 vacancies are split by category as shown below. The 20 posts include 01 post for PwBD candidates. PwBD reservation follows Government of India norms, with 4% of the total vacancies horizontally reserved for candidates with benchmark disabilities. A Medical Degree viz. MBBS in respective disciplines recognized by NMC/Institute of National Importance. Internship completed within 5 years of the date of interview. Valid registration with NMC/State Medical Council. Only candidates who have been declared passed in their qualifying degree exam and will complete their course tenure on or before the date of interview are eligible. Foreign medical graduates must produce an FMGE certificate conducted by NBE. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The upper age limit is 33 years as on the last date of submission of application, which is the date of interview (19 November 2026). The upper age limit is relaxed as follows: A Junior Resident (Non-Academic) gets Rs. 56,100/- (Level-10, Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances including NPA as admissible under rule(s). The appointment is for 6 months and can be extended for another six months. In selected cases, the Institute can give an extension beyond two terms. The appointment is purely contractual and need-based. Applicants whose services were terminated on any disciplinary ground cannot be considered for the Junior Resident (NA) post, even if they otherwise qualify. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS and PwBD candidates follows Central Govt. rules/policy. Candidates claiming reservation must attach a copy of a valid category certificate issued by the appropriate authority: SC/ST: category certificate in the format at Annexure-I. OBC: certificate from the competent authority in the format at Annexure-II for Central Government jobs, along with a non-creamy layer certificate valid for the financial year 2026-2027. Certificates issued from 1 April 2026 to the date of the walk-in interview are valid. EWS: certificate from the competent authority in the form at Annexure-III, valid for the financial year 2026-2027. Certificates issued from 1 April 2026 to the date of the walk-in interview are valid. EWS reservation follows DoPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 19 January 2019 and 31 January 2019. It gives 10% reservation to EWS persons not covered by the SC, ST and OBC reservation scheme. PwBD: a disability certificate from a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of a State or Central Govt. hospital or institution. It must be countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution, as the case may be. The Medical Board must follow the guidelines of the Ministry of Social Welfare and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The fee is paid only by Demand Dr

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: There is no online application. Candidates bring the duly filled application form in the prescribed format, which is available on the AIIMS Bhopal website, www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in. Along with the form, bring the following originals and one set of self-attested copies: Proof of fee deposited (Demand Draft), if applicable Certificate showing Date of Birth (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate) Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.) Address proof UG all Mark Sheets and Degree/Certificate Internship Completion Certificate Registration with National Medical Commission/State Medical Council/Respective Council Category Certificate (OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD) issued by the competent authority, if applicable Attempt Certificates FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign graduates) NOC, if applicable Photographs – 5 Nos. Copies of any other relevant documents Candidates who do not produce these original documents at the interview will not be considered or allowed into the selection process.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The notice says selection will be by a written test, an interview or both, as decided by the Institute authority. Written test: This is held if there are more than 20 candidates for any particular post. The top 15 merit candidates for each post are shortlisted for the interview. Written test marks only decide who qualifies for the interview. Interview: Selection is based on interview performance alone. Ties: If two or more candidates have the same interview marks, the older candidate (earlier date of birth) is ranked higher.

Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form and sign it. content_sections.heading: Application Form and Fee
content_sections.text: The application form (Proforma for the post of Senior Resident) can be downloaded from www.igims.org. Candidates bring the filled form to the walk-in interview, together with the fee and their documents. The cost of the application form is non-refundable and must be paid by Demand Draft payable to "The Director, IGIMS, Patna". Fees paid by any other mode, such as cash, cheque, money order, postal order, pay order, banker's cheque or postal stamps, will not be accepted. Such applications will be summarily rejected. The proforma asks for the following details: Your NMC/State Medical Council registration number. Your date of birth (with proof) and your age on the cut-off date. Your category, with certificates issued by the Circle Officer: SC/ST: Domicile Certificate and Caste Certificate from the Circle Officer of your district or circle. EBC (MBC) and BC: Domicile Certificate and Caste Certificate, with exemption of creamy layer. EWS: Domicile Certificate and EWS Certificate. Your educational qualifications starting from MBBS, with the year of passing, marks, percentage and attempts. Any teaching or working experience and special training in the speciality. A list of publications and presentations as per NMC guidelines, with reprints or certificates. Your employment status. If you are employed, attach a photocopy of the NOC. Bank draft details. A list of enclosures and a signed declaration, with a recent photograph affixed. Fill in your name, age, gender, caste, address, educational qualification and other fields correctly. Once the form is submitted, it cannot be changed.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bring the originals and one set of self-attested copies of the following: A recent passport-size colour photograph with the face clearly visible, against a light-coloured, preferably white, background. Caps, hats and dark glasses are not acceptable. Religious headwear is allowed but must not cover the face. The demand draft in original (if applicable) Aadhar Card Date of Birth/SSC/HSSC pass certificate (mentioning date of birth) MBBS degree certificates Internship completion certificates MS degree/provisional degree certificates Attempt certificate of MBBS and PG degree UG & PG NMC/State registration certificates Category/PwBD certificate (if a seat is claimed in a reserved category) Experience certificate, if any NOC from your present employer (for those working in a Govt./Pvt. organisation) Any other relevant documents, such as research work and publications Candidates employed in a Government/Semi-Government department or with any other employer must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer at the time of the interview/document verification. Without it, they will not be considered for the interview. Candidates who are not employed must state in writing that they are neither employed in any organisation nor doing any course anywhere.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the venue from 01:00 PM on 23 November 2026. Reporting after 02:00 PM will not be accepted. Document verification takes place from 01:00 PM to 02:00 PM. Show your original certificates as proof of the details in your application. The interview begins at 02:30 PM. The Selection Committee of the Institute selects candidates based on their bio-data and the interview. The minimum qualifying criteria for appointment are 50 percentile for UR, 45 percentile for BC/EBC/EWS and 40 percentile for SC/ST. The result will be declared on the IGIMS Patna website. The date will be notified later.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Kalyani Senior Resident
content_sections.text: AIIMS Kalyani is a statutory body under the aegis of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. It is located at NH-34 Connector, Basantapur, Saguna, Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal 741245. The notice describes it as an Institute of National Importance and one of the new AIIMS set up under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY) to correct regional imbalance in tertiary healthcare and to reach self-sufficiency in graduate, postgraduate and higher medical education and training.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: AIIMS Kalyani has 12 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies across five departments. The notice gives the category break-up only for the total, not for each department: 4% of the total vacancies are horizontally reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD)-OPH (OL) category candidates, as permissible under the Rules. The physical requirements for these posts are S (Sitting), ST (Standing), W (Walking), MF (Manipulation by Fingers) and RW (Reading and Writing). Reservation will be as per Government of India Policy. The Competent Authority of AIIMS Kalyani reserves the right to vary the vacancies, including reserved vacancies, and AIIMS reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies. All candidates may apply against the post earmarked for EWS, on these conditions: their candidature will be considered only if EWS applicants are not available; they will be treated as UR candidates only, with no relaxations otherwise allowed to their own categories; and under no circumstances will the fees be refunded. If no eligible candidates are found from the advertised category, candidates from other categories may be considered for interview against the concerned category on a temporary basis. content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: All the terms and conditions of the Residency Scheme will be applicable. The essential qualification, experience and maximum age limit are counted up to the date of publishing the notification on the Institute website. Applicants without the required qualifications by that date will not be considered. Any period of experience that is prescribed is counted after obtaining the prescribed qualification. Qualifications and experience must be recognised by the Government of India. A candidature will be cancelled at any stage if the qualification or experience is found to be not recognised. Qualifications and experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Selection Committee, with prior approval of the Competent Authority. Candidates must not have been convicted by any Court of Law. For the Senior Resident post, the age limit is not exceeding 45 (Forty-Five) years as on the date of publishing the notification on the Institute website. No age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates applying for unreserved vacancies. Age relaxation for other categories of candidates also applies as per the DoPT instructions, and all age relaxation is regulated as per the DoPT instructions. Candidates applying against SC/ST/OBC/OH/EWS posts are considered subject to a Caste/OH Certificate issued by the appropriate Competent Authority in the prescribed format. The community must be clearly and legibly mentioned in the certificate. OBC eligibility is based on the castes in the Central List of the Government of India. OBC candidates must not belong to the Creamy Layer, and their sub-caste must match the entries in the Central List of OBC. Otherwise their candidature will not be considered against any reserved category post they applied for. Only persons with not less than 40% physical disability are eligible for reservation under the OH quota. They must submit a Disability Certificate issued by a Competent Authority in the prescribed format. For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PWBD), the disability certificate must be signed by a duly constituted and authorised Medical Board of State or Central Govt. Hospitals/Institutions and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution. The candidate will be allowed to join only after medical fitness certification by a duly constituted Medical Board. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for each department.

rows.essential_qualification_for_medical_cand: A Post Graduation Medical Degree (MD/MS/DNB) or Equivalent in respective discipline from recognized University/Institute as provided under the Residency Scheme. DM/MCh /DNB or Equivalent in respective discipline from recognized University/Institute as provided under the Residency Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Allowances and perks are admissible as per the rules, in addition to Pay and NPA (for medical candidates only). All the posts carry the usual allowances admissible to Central Government Employees of similar status at Kalyani (West Bengal). AIIMS Kalyani will try to provide residential accommodation, subject to availability, but campus accommodation is limited and may not be possible in every case. Where no accommodation is provided, HRA as admissible to Central Government Servants of similar status stationed at Kalyani, West Bengal will be provided. Nature of appointment: Senior Resident (Non-Academic), a tenure post on contract for a maximum period of 3 years as per the Central Residency Scheme. Rules: The post is regulated by the provisions of the Central Residency Scheme and governed by the CCS (Temporary Service) Rules. Service under the Institute is governed by the Act of Parliament that established AIIMS as an autonomous body, and by the Rules and Regulations framed under it. Whole time: The post is whole time, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Posting: Candidates are likely to be posted at the rural health and urban centre attached to the Institute, for a period decided by the Institute. Joining: Only candidates who can join within fifteen days from the date the Offer of engagement is issued may apply.

content_sections.heading: About KSMHA
content_sections.text: The Keralam State Mental Health Authority is a statutory authority constituted under section 45 of the Mental Healthcare Act 2017. Its office is at Red Cross Road, Thiruvananthapuram. The vacancies are in the Mental Health Review Boards at Kannur and Kozhikode, which were constituted as per Notification no. A/217/2017/KSMHA dated 25.01.2021 (available at www.ksmha.org). KSMHA has sent this notification to the Director of Health Services, the Director of Medical Education, the Director of Indian Systems of Medicine, the State Mission Director of the National Health Mission and the Project Director of the e-Health Mission, Thiruvananthapuram, and asked them to publish it on their official websites and notice boards.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Each post has its own application form in the notification: "Application Form for the Appointment of Member in Mental Health Review Board, Kannur" for the Member - Psychiatrist post, and "Application Form for the Appointment of Member in Mental Health Review Board, Kozhikode" for the Member - Medical Practitioner post. The application, with self-attested copies of the certificates and documents proving age, educational qualifications, experience, etc., may be submitted by post or by hand. Address: Chief Executive Officer, Keralam State Mental Health Authority, Red Cross Road, Trivandrum – 695 035 Write on the envelope: "Application for the appointment of Member of the Mental Health Review Board, Kannur/ Kozhikode" Mode: By post or by hand Last date of submission: 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), before 5.15 PM The application form asks for: Name Gender Date of birth, with an attested copy of a certificate proving the date of birth Address, with phone number and email id Educational qualification Occupation (current/past) The documents to attach: self-attested copies of the certificates of degree, post graduation and medical council registration A description of your experience in the field of mental health (a separate sheet may be attached) Curriculum Vitae (to be attached), marked YES or NO on the form The form ends with a declaration, signed with the place and date, that all the information submitted is correct, true and valid, and that the applicant will present the supporting documents as and when requested. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from interested persons who have the required qualifications. For each post, the qualification is set by the section of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 shown in the table. The application form for both posts asks for a description of the applicant's experience in the field of mental health. Candidates should check the official notification and the sections of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 it cites for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Under section 74(2) of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017, a person shall be disqualified from appointment as the chairperson or a member of a Board, or be removed by the State Authority, if he: has been convicted and sentenced to imprisonment for an offence which involves moral turpitude; or is adjudged as an insolvent; or has been removed or dismissed from the service of the Government or a body corporate owned or controlled by the Government; or has such financial or other interest as is likely to prejudice the discharge of his functions as a member; or has such other disqualifications as may be prescribed by the Central Government. Rule 19 of the Mental Healthcare (Central Mental Health Authority and Mental Health Review Boards) Rules, 2018 (notified by the Central Government as G.S.R. 507 (E) dated 29th May, 2018) adds two more. A chairperson or member of the Board appointed by the State Authority shall stand disqualified if he holds: any full-time or part-time assignment that prevents him from giving adequate time and attention to the work of the Board under the provisions of the Act and the rules made there under; or any office in any political party during his tenure of office in the Board. The same honorarium rules apply to both posts. The honorarium and other allowances payable to a member of the Board are fixed by G.O.(Rt) No. 2188/2023/H&FWD dated 24.08.2023: A Member of the Board holds office for a term of five years or up to the age of seventy years, whichever is earlier. A Member is eligible for reappointment for another term of five years or up to the age of seventy years, whichever is earlier. The Chairperson of the State Authority makes the appointment of the members of the Board.

faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Member - Psychiatrist in the Mental Health Review Board, Kannur, and 1 Member - Medical Practitioner in the Mental Health Review Board, Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KSMHA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of submission is 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), before 5.15 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the KSMHA Member posts?
faq.answer: The Member - Psychiatrist needs the qualification set out in Section 2(1)(y) of the Mental Healthcare Act 2017. The Member - Medical Practitioner needs the qualification set out in Section 2(1)(n) of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017.

faq.question: Q4. What honorarium does a Mental Health Review Board Member get?
faq.answer: A serving Government Psychiatrist/ Medical Practitioner gets Rs.2000/- per month. A retired Government Psychiatrist/ Medical Practitioner gets an honorarium limited to Rs.50,000/- [Last pay – pension (before commutation)]. Any other person nominated gets Rs. 1,000/- per sitting + TA.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for KSMHA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application form with self-attested copies of your certificates by post or by hand to the Chief Executive Officer, Keralam State Mental Health Authority, Red Cross Road, Trivandrum – 695 035.

faq.question: Q6. What should be written on the application envelope?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the appointment of Member of the Mental Health Review Board, Kannur/ Kozhikode" on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: Attach an attested copy of a certificate proving your date of birth, and self-attested copies of the certificates of degree, post graduation and medical council registration. Also attach the documents proving age, educational qualifications and experience, a description of your mental health experience and your Curriculum Vitae.

faq.question: Q8. What is the term of a Mental Health Review Board Member?
faq.answer: A Member holds office for five years or up to the age of seventy years, whichever is earlier. A Member is eligible for reappointment for another term of five years or up to the age of seventy years, whichever is earlier.

faq.answer: No. A retired Government Psychiatrist/ Medical Practitioner gets an honorarium limited to Rs.50,000/- and is not eligible for DA and HRA.

faq.answer: No. Under Rule 19 of the Mental Healthcare (Central Mental Health Authority and Mental Health Review Boards) Rules, 2018, a member who holds any office in any political party during his tenure in the Board stands disqualified.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by HLL Lifecare Limited (HLL) to fill multiple pharmacist positions across various grades on a fixed-term contract basis in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available under HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Assistant Pharmacist, Pharmacist Grade IV, Pharmacist Grade III, Pharmacist Grade II, and Pharmacist Grade I in the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these positions is strictly through a walk-in interview process where eligible candidates can directly attend the designated interview venues.

faq.question: Q4. What are the scheduled walk-in dates for different locations?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled on 28 October 2026 for Nadia, 29 October 2026 for Bardhaman, and 30 October 2026 for Kolkata.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) or Bachelor in Pharmacy (B.Pharm) from a recognized institution to be eligible for any of the advertised positions.

faq.question: Q6. Is prior experience mandatory for all posts?
faq.answer: No, prior experience is not mandatory for all posts. Freshers are eligible to apply for the Assistant Pharmacist position, while various grades of Pharmacist require specified years of experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 37 years as on 1 October 2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates, self-attested photocopies of educational and experience certificates, identity proofs, photographs, and the State Pharmacy Council Registration Certificate.

faq.question: Q9. What does the selection process comprise?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test consisting of multiple-choice questions carrying 50 maximum marks for 30 minutes, followed by an interview.

faq.answer: Candidates can find the complete notification details, venue addresses, and guidelines by checking the official links provided in the recruitment announcement.

content_sections.heading: About ZSI
content_sections.text: The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) is an organisation of the Government of India under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. Its Director is in Kolkata, and it has a headquarters, regional centres and field sites. These posts serve its project on "Documentation of traditional knowledge in wildlife conservation". The notice invites Indian citizens to work with ZSI as Consultants and Project Associate II.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 3 posts: 2 Consultant posts and 1 Project Associate-II post. Its table prints one figure, 02, for Consultant A, B and C together. Each consultant applicant is assessed under the category (A, B or C) that fits their qualifications and experience. The Director, ZSI, keeps the right to select any number of candidates, even though the notice gives a number of vacancies. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.text: The posts are open to Indian citizens. Candidates must be physically fit to travel to different parts of the country, including remote areas, to document traditional knowledge related to wildlife conservation. Desired: Experience in interdisciplinary research involving Archeology, Ecology, Anthropology, History and Conservation Biology; experience in data analysis of questionnaires, interviews, folklore, oral histories and traditional narrative; experience in graphic designing and wildlife-related artwork illustrations. Essential: (i) Master's degree in Science/Arts/ PhD from a recognized university and more than 10 years up to 15 years of experience in Research/ Development/ Design/ Academic/ Government Institutions/ Organisations in environment/ Forestry/ Archeology/ Anthropology/ Large Data Analyst; experience in scientific publication, project management and interdisciplinary collaborations. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Consultant posts carry consolidated pay of ₹60,000 (A), ₹80,000 (B) and ₹1,00,000 (C) per month. The PA-II post carries ₹35,000 + HRA. House rent allowance is allowed as per the rules of Govt. of India/ ZSI. It can never exceed the rates payable to Central Government employees in that area. HRA is calculated on the actual stipend of the Research Fellow. The stipend of a research fellow is exempt from income tax under 10(16) of the IT Act. The positions are purely temporary, for a period of 14 months or till the completion of the project. The engagement of Consultants is also governed by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change guidelines for consultants. These were issued vide OM No. A. 65013/7/2018-P.II dated 22.09.2020, with related instructions and amendments. Selection, payment of funds, use of the contingent grant, progress reports, tenure, publications, patents, leave and similar matters follow the general rules for SPA & PAs as per the rules of MoEFCC.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from citizens of India. The cut-off date for the maximum age limit, essential qualification, experience and fee payment is 3 November 2026. To be eligible for selection, a candidate must have passed the qualifying examination by the cut-off date, with the result declared on or before that date. The prescribed qualification is only the minimum requirement. Holding it does not entitle a candidate to selection. The upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date of submission of application (3 November 2026). Age relaxation follows Government of India norms, up to the maximums below. SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against unreserved vacancies will not get any age relaxation. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS applies as per Government of India policy. PwBD reservation is horizontal, within each candidate's own category. The disability certificate must be issued by a duly constituted and authorised Medical Board of a State or Central Government hospital or institution. It must be countersigned by the Medical Superintendent, CMO or Head of the hospital or institution. EWS/OBC/SC/ST candidates must have a caste certificate from the competent authority, valid for admission or jobs in Central Government institutions and issued before the date of interview. Without it, a candidate will not be allowed to appear in the interview in that category, but he or she can be treated as a UR candidate. The OBC certificate must be in the central format and issued within one year of the last date of application, that is, after 1 April 2026 and before the cut-off date. The candidate must belong to the non-creamy layer of the Central List of OBC. A candidate who does not produce a valid OBC certificate at the interview or document verification may be treated as UR. EWS status is for persons not covered by SC, ST or OBC reservation whose family's gross annual income is below ₹8 lakh. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is for 89 days or up to the next regular interview, whichever is earlier. It gives no right to claim permanent absorption in the institute or a continued contractual appointment. The Institute may renew or end the appointment based on its evaluation of the candidate's performance. The post is a tenure engagement of a maximum of 89 days. Including any earlier engagement, it must not exceed the prescribed period for SR ship. Service as a Senior Resident in a previous appointment will be counted together with the present engagement at AIIMS Bibinagar. Leave will be as per the Central Residency Scheme and Institute policy. The appointee will not get benefits such as Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion or any other benefit available to regularly appointed Government servants. The appointment is full time, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Either side can end the appointment at any time by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without giving a reason. An appointee who leaves, resigns or is terminated before the tenure ends must give one month's notice as per the rules, or deposit pay and allowances for any shortfall in that notice period. The appointee must live in the residential accommodation provided by the Institute during the tenure as Senior Resident (Non Academic), subject to availability. Senior Residents must work in shifts and can be posted to any place or centre attached to the Institute, at the discretion of the MS/Dean/Executive Director. They may be assigned to one or more departments, depending on vacancies and institutional needs, and all must work in emergency on rotation as needed. The Competent Authority may assign any duty when required, and no extra allowance will be paid for such assignments.

content_sections.text: UR/OBC/EWS candidates pay the application fee of Rs.1770 (including 18% GST) plus transaction charges into the AIIMS Bibinagar bank account given below. content_sections.heading: PGIMER Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive the pay level applicable to their post under the Central Government pay matrix. NPA refers to Non-Practising Allowance, applicable to the specified medical positions. Other admissible allowances will be governed by the institute's applicable service rules.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fees must be paid online through the recruitment application portal using Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking. The institute advises applicants to avoid UPI payments.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a Computer Based Test carrying 75 marks and a Departmental Interview and Assessment carrying 25 marks. Computer Based Test on 5 December 2026. Department-wise and category-wise shortlisting based on CBT marks. Scrutiny of shortlisted candidates' applications and uploaded documents. Publication of the eligibility notice. Document verification. Departmental Interview and Assessment. Final merit preparation using CBT and departmental assessment marks. Shortlisting Ratio: Candidates will normally be shortlisted in a ratio of 1:3 against the advertised department-wise and category-wise vacancies. Final Merit: Only candidates who separately qualify in both the CBT and Departmental Interview and Assessment will be considered for final selection. Final merit will be based on the combined score out of 100 marks.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER CBT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: These qualifying standards apply separately to the CBT and the Departmental Interview and Assessment.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER CBT Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT syllabus will be based on the prescribed educational qualifications, professional courses and relevant experience requirements for the selected post and specialty. Questions may cover subjects studied during the professional or postgraduate qualification required for the relevant department. The detailed guidelines do not prescribe a common chapter-wise syllabus for every post.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Exam Centres
content_sections.text: The Computer Based Test is expected to be conducted in four cities. Applicants must select their preferred examination city while completing the online application. Examination centres are allotted on a first-come, first-served basis, subject to availability and administrative requirements. Once allotted, the examination city cannot be changed at the candidate's request.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Department and Institute Preference
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply for the relevant post in one department only . Where the same post and department are available at PGIMER Chandigarh and PGI Satellite Centre Sangrur, candidates may indicate preferences for one or both institutes while completing the online form. Important: Candidates who do not indicate a preference for an institute will not be considered for the concerned institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PGIMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Application Warning: The institute states that candidates cannot change their registration or application entries after submission. Incorrect or incomplete entries may lead to rejection without reconsideration.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for PGIMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Matriculation / 10th certificate and marksheet. 10+2 certificate and marksheet. MBBS, BDS or other prescribed undergraduate qualification certificates. Relevant MD/MS, MDS, MA, MSc, MPH, MHA or PhD certificates, as applicable. Relevant experience certificates. Medical Council or Dental Council registration certificate, where applicable. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD certificates, where applicable. No Objection Certificate for candidates serving in Government, Semi-Government or Autonomous Bodies, where applicable. Other prescribed eligibility and reservation documents. Certificate Requirement: Candidates claiming OBC or EWS reservation must satisfy the certificate issuing-date requirements specified in the notification. The guidelines specify certificates issued from 1 April 2026 to 13 November 2026 for the applicable OBC Non-Creamy Layer and EWS claims.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 Tenure and Posting
content_sections.text: The advertised positions are tenure appointments for a maximum period of three years. Selected candidates will serve at PGIMER Chandigarh or PGI Satellite Centre Sangrur according to the relevant vacancy, eligibility and institute preference. The vacancies are provisional and may change. The institute may also fill qualifying vacancies arising during the notified period from the waiting list as permitted by the guidelines.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 4 November 2026 with reporting time at 8:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview takes place at the Paediatrics Seminar room, 5th floor, Medical College Building, I.G.I.M.S., Patna-14.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 Senior Resident vacancies in the Department of Paediatrics.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree, an NMC recognized postgraduate qualification of MD/DNB in Paediatrics, and registration with the Central or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 3 November 2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per state government rules.

faq.question: Q6. How much is the application fee for UR candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for UR, EWS, and BC candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of The Director, IGIMS, Patna.

faq.question: Q7. Is private practice allowed for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: No, the post is non-practicing and private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited.

faq.question: Q8. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled application form, demand draft, Aadhar card, birth certificate, MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, internship and registration certificates, category documents, and self-attested copies of all original papers.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any service bond applicable upon selection?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates must submit a legal bond to deposit an amount equivalent to one month's emoluments per year of the programme if they resign mid-way.

content_sections.heading: CWS IIFT Consultant with Ph.D Job Description
content_sections.text: The Centre for WTO Studies (CWS) is an independent think-tank conducting research and training programmes on the WTO and related matters. The Centre regularly assists the Government of India in international trade negotiations, disputes, and policy matters. The engaged Consultant with Ph.D will undertake research activities, contribute to trade negotiations and policy matters, prepare background material on important WTO issues, and assist in WTO-related committees, ministerial conferences, and international forums.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves the evaluation of applications received through the official online link. Fulfilling the minimum qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called for the recruitment process. In case of a large number of applicants, IIFT reserves the right to shortlist applicants in any manner considered appropriate. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for the second round, which comprises a written test and an interview. The written test will assess the candidate's competence and skills in international trade, economics, and economic diplomacy. Candidates attending the interview must make their own arrangements for travel and stay.

content_sections.heading: SVNIT Counselling Psychologist Job Description
content_sections.text: Individual Counselling & Psychological Support: Provide confidential, professional, one-to-one counselling services to students experiencing psychological, emotional, academic, social, behavioural, interpersonal, or personal concerns. Support students in managing stress, anxiety, depression, examination pressure, homesickness, adjustment difficulties, relationship concerns, grief, trauma, low self-esteem, loneliness, and other psychosocial challenges. Conduct psychological screening and assessments, develop individualized support plans, and provide follow-up and continuity of support. Crisis Intervention & Emergency Psychological Response: Provide timely psychological first-line support and crisis intervention in cases of acute emotional distress, suicidal ideation, self-harm risk, substance-use concerns, violence, harassment, trauma, or severe behavioural concerns. Undertake risk identification, safety planning, and intervention. Coordinate with Institute authorities, medical personnel, hostel administration, wardens, and emergency services while maintaining confidentiality. Mental Health Promotion, Awareness & Preventive Program: Design and conduct a structured calendar of mental health awareness, preventive, and wellness programs. Organize workshops, awareness campaigns, and interactive sessions. Conduct sensitization programs for students, faculty, staff, and other stakeholders to improve awareness and early identification of mental health concerns.

content_sections.heading: About IGNCA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) is an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, visualised as a centre encompassing the study of all arts within the context of the natural and human environment. IGNCA acts as the implementing body for the National Mission on Cultural Mapping (NMCM), an initiative aiming to preserve and promote India's cultural heritage and revitalise rural economies. These positions are purely on a contractual basis under the NMCM Unit for an initial period of one year.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notification invites applications for a total of 7 contractual vacancies across two distinct designations. Both posts require one year of experience in Government, Semi-Government, or recognised institutions in the domain of preparing research-based write-ups, documentation, and cultural profiles on tangible and intangible heritage, rituals, belief systems, oral histories, and cultural traditions across different parts of India. For both posts, the following desirable experience is outlined: Experience in community engagement and collection of primary data, including oral histories, traditional knowledge, customs, rituals, festivals, and folk traditions. Working knowledge of digital documentation, cultural mapping, and database management. Proficiency with computer applications. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi. The age limit for both posts is not exceeding 30 years as on the date of the interview (30 October 2026). The official notification does not mention any age relaxation categories. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are consolidated per month, with HRA @20% on top of the pay for each post: Rs. 56000/- (Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)), Rs. 28000/- (Project Technical Support-III) and Rs. 20,000/- (Project Technical Support-II). The tenure of each post is 11 months, which may be extended with satisfactory performance and project extension. Further continuation or extension depends on the needs of the project, performance evaluation and the approval of the competent authority, case by case. Benefits of Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession, Medical claim, etc. are not admissible. A contract appointee has no claim to a regular post in the institute, the Funding Agency or any Department of the Government of India. The contract service gives no right to further assignment, transfer or absorption. An undertaking to this effect must be submitted at the time of joining. Either side may end the engagement at any time with one month's notice. The contract can be ended at once, or before the notice period is over, by paying one month's contractual amount. The appointee cannot pay the one-month amount instead of serving the notice and must serve the full notice period. Leave is as per the Funding Agency/Institutional policy for contract staff under AIIMS, BBSR guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a merit list derived from marks scored in the specified educational qualification, subject to being found "Medically Fit" by IREL (India) Limited's Medical Officer. In case of a tie, higher marks in specified educational qualification will be considered, and if still tied, seniority in date of birth will be taken. The priority order for selection is: (a) Candidates belonging to Land Affected Category; (b) Candidates coming under the Mining area and from peripheral villages situated within 10 KM radius of IREL (India) Limited, Chavara unit; (c) Wards of serving employees / Forum members; (d) Belonging to Kollam District; (e) Belonging to Kerala State; (f) Others.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational qualifications and age criteria to be eligible for the Legal Researcher position. Educational Qualification: A candidate must be a fresh law graduate or post graduate in law from a University/College/Institution established by law in India. Candidates appearing for the final semester may also apply, but they must submit their final pass out result before the final process of selection including scrutiny or interview. Additional Requirements: Must have research aptitude with good knowledge of research tools, and working knowledge of computer with typing skills. Age Limit: Maximum age of the candidate as on 1st January of year 2027 must not be more than 33 years. Nationality: Candidate must be a citizen of India. Character Requirement: Candidate must be a person of integrity, honesty, and good moral character, certified by two responsible persons who are not in blood relations. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Legal Researchers receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 50,000/- per month without any dearness or other allowance/perquisite. The engagement is for a term up to 2 years, with initial engagement made for six months subject to satisfactory performance. Proportionate reduction of honorarium applies for unauthorized absence or absence beyond permissible leave.

content_sections.heading: RSLSA Legal Researcher Job Description
content_sections.text: Without adversely affecting the generality of work, the Legal Researcher performs the following duties under the direct control of the Member Secretary and other officers of RSLSA: To prepare various reports, schemes, and monitor progress of ongoing activities. To analyze, evaluate, and research on various subjects of daily use, preparation of study material for seminars, workshops, conferences, and trainings. To carry out research work on law and legal issues including various judgments of Hon'ble Supreme Court, Hon'ble High Courts, and other forums. To assist in outreach and awareness activities. To assist in drafting agenda, meeting notes, concept notes, and reports on schemes and programmes. To supervise and conduct field surveys and prepare analytical reports with analysis of data. To work with the office of Hon'ble Executive Chairman, RSLSA and provide day-to-day activities as per directions. To do academic, administrative, research, and other work directed by the Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RSLSA Legal Researcher
content_sections.text: Download the application form and scheme details from the official website https://rajasthan.nalsa.gov.in . Affix a recently taken (not later than six months) colored passport-size photograph with your own signature thereon on the application form. Attach self-attested copies of all documents in support of age, educational qualifications, extracurricular activities, and experience. Furnish a checklist along with the application form detailing the enclosed certificates and testimonials. Submit a signed undertaking on the prescribed proforma stating that during engagement you will not practice in any court of law or engage in any other professional pursuit. Pack the application in an envelope marked clearly with "APPLICATION FOR THE LEGAL RESEARCHER". Send the application via Speed Post, Registered Post, or through Courier, or deposit it by hand during office hours to the Office of Member Secretary, Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority, Jaipur Vidhik Seva Sadan, Rajasthan High Court Campus, C-Scheme, Jaipur - 302005 on or before 31-10-2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinized under the direction of the Member Secretary, RSLSA. The selection is made by a Selection Committee constituted by the Hon'ble Executive Chairman, Rajasthan State Legal Services Authority. Shortlisting of applications may be done based on research achievements, academic career, computer skills, or other criteria. The Selection Committee assesses suitability through screening and/or interviewing candidates, considering research and academic record, language communication, and computer skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Full-time Ph.D. scholars receive a fellowship of Rs. 46,250 per month for Years 1–2 and Rs. 52,500 per month for Years 3–5, along with 16% HRA, for a maximum duration of 5 years or until completion of Ph.D., whichever is earlier. Part-time Ph.D. candidates receive no fellowship under the scheme and must be self-supported or supported by their employer. Postdoctoral Fellows receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 1,08,393 per month (including HRA) for up to 1 year, plus Rs. 1,00,000 annual contingency support and Rs. 2.10 lakh travel support as applicable under the scheme. All financial support is subject to fund availability from the funding agency, scheme guidelines, and satisfactory performance. Selected candidates cannot simultaneously receive funding from any other Government of India or State Government scheme.

A Scoping Report on Broiler Chicken Welfare in India
Across six states in India (Field research across approximately 60 farm visits, slaughterhouses, and meat shops)

content_sections.heading: About NALSAR Project Lead
content_sections.text: NALSAR University of Law is an institution that aims to provide quality legal education underlining constitutionalism, rule of law, and justice, with a focus on social justice for marginalised communities. In this initiative, NALSAR is partnering with the ALPN Research Foundation, a not-for-profit independent think-tank working towards improving animal welfare across India. Together, they are undertaking a study that systematically assesses current conditions and challenges to the welfare of broiler chickens in India from end-to-end, including farming systems, supply chains, market demand, regulatory context, and the broader stakeholder ecosystem.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification offers a total of 1 position for the Project Lead role under the study titled ‘A Scoping Report on Broiler Chicken Welfare in India’. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following qualification requirements: Demonstrated subject-matter expertise in broiler chicken production in India with a background in veterinary science, animal husbandry, poultry science, or a closely related technical field is strongly preferred. Strong working knowledge of broiler farming systems in India (backyard, contract farming, integrated commercial operations) and common welfare issues within them. Familiarity with animal welfare science and assessment frameworks as applied to broiler chickens. Prior field experience visiting or working directly with poultry farms, ideally in rural or semi-urban India, would be an asset. Fluency in English required; proficiency in regional languages would be an asset for fieldwork.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: This is a six-month-long, full-time research role. Field research is expected to take place for three months across approximately 60 farm visits in six states, plus slaughterhouses and meat shops. All fieldwork costs will be covered by the organisation.

content_sections.heading: NALSAR Project Lead Job Description
content_sections.text: The Project Lead will be responsible for the following duties and tasks as outlined in the project notification: Lead technical research and analysis on broiler farming systems in India – production practices, housing, breeds and genetics, feeding regimes, health management, and welfare conditions across different system types (backyard, contract, integrated, and commercial). Design and execute a fieldwork plan covering approximately 60 farm visits across six states, plus slaughterhouses and meat retail points, assessing on-ground farming practices and welfare conditions firsthand. Conduct and synthesise literature on broiler production and welfare in India. Build relationships with farmers, veterinarians, and production-side stakeholders to support fieldwork and ongoing insight-gathering. Assess the nature and extent of animal welfare across various farming systems, and evaluate the malleability of each system to welfare-improving interventions. Provide subject-matter expertise on technical sections of the final report (industry overview, farming systems analysis) and contribute broiler-specific expertise to cross-cutting insights. Identify and prioritise a list of potential welfare-focused interventions based on technical feasibility and likely adoption by relevant stakeholders. Coordinate with the wider research team (who will lead economic, market, and regulatory analysis) to ensure technical findings feed into the overall report.
