content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: a consolidated fellowship/pay slab of 56000, with HRA (30%) on top. Pay is project-specific: The rates of emoluments are project-specific and may vary depending on what the funding agency sanctions. Payment depends on funds being available from the funding agency. No other benefits: Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession, medical claims and similar benefits are not admissible. Nature of appointment: The post is purely temporary and project-based. It is filled on a temporary CONTRACT basis and is co-terminus with the project. Renewal and extension: The appointment is renewable yearly, based on a satisfactory review, or lasts up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. Any further continuation or extension depends on your project investigator's evaluation of your performance and needs the approval of the competent authority. Termination: The Project Investigator and/or the Appointing authority can end the service at any time, even during the agreed or extended contract period, without giving a reason. No claim to a regular post: Project staff have no claim on a regular post in the institute. Project service gives no right to a further assignment, a transfer to another project, or appointment or absorption in the institute.

content_sections.text: A fixed honorarium of Rs. 50,000/- per month without any dearness or other allowance/perquisite, shall be paid to the Research Scholar.

content_sections.heading: RSJA Research Scholar Application Fee
content_sections.text: Every candidate shall pay Rs. 100/- as fee through Demand Draft or Postal Order to be drawn in the name of Director, Rajasthan State Judicial Academy, Academy.

content_sections.heading: RSJA Research Scholar Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications based on research achievements, academic career and computer skills, followed by an interview by the Selection Committee assessing research/academic record as well as language communication and computer skills. Shortlisting of the applications may be done on the basis of research achievements, academic career and computer skills of incumbents. The Selection Committee shall assess the suitability of applicants after interviewing the candidates, considering their research/academic record as well as language communication and computer skills.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RSJA Research Scholar
content_sections.text: Download the application form and terms and conditions from the official website http://rsja.rajasthan.gov.in. Affix a latest colored photograph taken on or after 01.01.2026 in passport size with your signature thereon and self-attested across the mid of the photograph extending towards right side. Mark the envelope containing application as "APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT AS RESEARCH SCHOLAR". Attach self-attested copies of certificates in support of age, educational qualifications, academic/research work/publications, and communication skills/working knowledge of computer. Enclose Demand Draft or Postal Order of Rs. 100/- issued in the name of Director, Rajasthan State Judicial Academy, Jodhpur. Furnish a checklist along with application form mentioning details about certificates and testimonials enclosed. Send the application via speed post, registered post A.D., through courier, or deposit it by hand during office hours to the office of Director, Rajasthan State Judicial Academy, Jodhpur on or before 31/10/2026 (Latest by 05:00 PM).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates in support of age Educational qualification certificates Academic and research work/publications documents Proof of communication skills and working knowledge of computer Checklist of certificates and testimonials Demand Draft or Postal Order for fee payment

content_sections.heading: RSJA Research Scholar Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary on a contractual basis initially for a term of two years, extendable for a further period of one year based on performance. Research Scholar shall not practice in any court of law nor be engaged/appointed elsewhere on honorarium/payment or otherwise during the engagement. If already enrolled with any Bar Council, the candidate shall get his/her enrolment suspended during the entire term of this engagement. A Research Scholar intending to leave engagement at premature stage shall be required to give prior notice of three months, or residuary term of engagement, whichever is less. Research Scholar shall not leave headquarter without seeking permission from Director, Rajasthan State Judicial Academy, Jodhpur. Proportionate reduction of honorarium shall be made for unauthorized absence, so also for absence beyond permissible period of leave. The selected candidate will be given a 'Letter of Offer' on the date of commencement of engagement. Candidates must furnish names and contact details of two responsible persons of integrity, honesty and good moral character (not blood relations or other relatives) in column 21 of the application format.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities assigned for the project positions include the following: Preliminary assessment based on the secondary data available from government sites and reports, visits to potential sites of ultra low head and hydrokinetic energy, coordination and compilation with agencies having the details of canals, rivers, outfall structure and dam toe. Setting up of laboratory & design of hydro kinetic turbine, CFD simulation & carry out design, model test and fabrication of proto type hydro kinetic turbine, analyzing the data, report preparation. Carry out CFD simulation of Francis/ reversible pump turbines for development of standard procedure and guidelines and model testing, scientific report writing. Carry out laboratory and field test regarding Ultra low head and screw turbine. Design and field testing of hydro kinetic turbine, perform CFD simulation (pre and post processing) for designed turbines. FEM analysis of turbine component for varying hydrodynamics loads. Model and field testing of ULH turbine, analyzing the data, report preparation. Define the standard procedure and guidelines for CFD analysis and model testing of turbine.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CRRI Senior Project Associate Age Limit and Relaxations
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the Senior Project Associate post is 40 Years . The relaxation in the age limit for the candidates belonging to the category of SC/ST/PwBD/Women and the category of OBC shall be 05 years and 03 years respectively or as per Govt. of India instructions issued in this regard from time to time. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD/OBC should bring their original certificate in the proper format issued by the Appropriate Authority as per the latest instructions issued from time to time on the subject.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-CRRI Senior Project Associate Job Description and Tenure
content_sections.text: The tenure of engagement is for 06 months Or Co-terminus with project, whichever is earlier. The total period of engagement of any project personnel under one project and/or combination of different projects, either in the same laboratory and/ or different laboratories of CSIR, cumulatively taken together shall not exceed 06 years.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates possessing the aforementioned Essential Qualification may appear for Walk-in-Interview with Original and self-attested copies of all certificate/testimonials and valid identity proof (Voter ID card/PAN Card/Driving License/Passport/Aadhar Card) and one passport size photograph. No candidate will be allowed to appear in the Interview without the Original Certificates. Candidates are directed to see the Annexure-I for the Application form, download the same and bring it along for submission at the time of the Walk-in-Interview. Candidates whose higher degree is ongoing either under AcSIR or under any universities with which CSIR/CSIR laboratories have signed an MoU should bring the NOC in enclosed format (Annexure-II) for appearing in the Walk-in-Interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The age of candidates, educational qualification, experience etc. will be treated on date of Walk-in-Interview. In case a large number of candidates turn up, the candidates will be shortlisted for interview as per criteria fixed by the Selection Committee. The final decision to allow a candidate to appear for interview rests with the Director, CSIR – CRRI. The Candidates are encouraged to speak in Hindi during Walk-in-Interview.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Researcher Job Description
content_sections.text: The candidate will work on development of a numerical model for simulation of the Solid Stir Extrusion process. A physics-based modeling framework will be developed capable of predicting material flow, temperature evolution, deformation characteristics, and resulting grain structure. The candidate will be expected to develop FORTRAN based code, and use CFD fundamentals to develop such model. content_sections.text: The notice lists the following under "Qualification and Personal Profile" for the Research Manager post: Education: A postgraduate degree in Health Economics, Public Policy, Management, Statistics, Social Sciences, or a related field. A Ph.D. is preferred. Experience: A minimum of 8-10 years of relevant experience in research or programme/project management, preferably in the health, public-policy, or development sectors. A proven track record of managing research projects and coordinating multi-stakeholder deliverables to deadline. Familiarity with India's health systems and health-policy environment (desirable). Experience with grants administration, budgeting, and donor reporting (desirable). Strong organisational, coordination, and writing skills. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Strong project-management, organisational, and multitasking abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple deadlines. Attention to detail and a commitment to quality in research and reporting outputs. Comfort working with data, research documentation, and reporting tools. Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and coordinate across stakeholders. Familiarity with budgeting and grants administration (desirable). A mature, confident, and self-motivated attitude, with the ability to discuss issues constructively. Commitment to strengthening India's health systems.

content_sections.heading: IIMB Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Manager will provide day-to-day operational and delivery leadership for the Centre's research programmes and projects. Working under the guidance of the Centre's leadership, the appointee will plan, coordinate and carry out projects end-to-end, managing timelines, deliverables, budgets, partners and staff. The Centre for Health Economics and Policy works on universal health coverage, primary health care, health financing and insurance, digital health, and health-system strengthening. The notice lists these principal accountabilities and responsibilities: Plan, coordinate, and deliver the Centre's research programmes and projects on time, within scope, and to agreed quality standards. Develop and maintain workplans, timelines, milestones, and deliverable trackers, and proactively manage risks and dependencies. Coordinate day-to-day execution across faculty, research staff, partners, and administration, keeping all stakeholders aligned. Support study design, literature reviews, data collection and management, and coordination of analysis across project teams. Assist in preparing research papers, policy briefs, industry reports, and other knowledge products, ensuring quality and timeliness. Maintain research documentation, datasets, and records in line with data-integrity and compliance standards. Track project budgets and expenditure, and support timely, accurate donor and funder reporting. Assist in developing proposals, concept notes, and funding applications. Coordinate procurement, vendor engagement, and project-level administrative processes. Liaise with partners, government bodies, funders, and vendors on day-to-day project matters. Organise workshops, roundtables, webinars, and consultations, managing logistics, communications, and follow-up. Coordinate and support research assistants and project staff, including onboarding and workflow management. Maintain operational systems, records, and reporting processes that keep projects running smoothly. Maintain project trackers and monitoring data and prepare periodic progress and performance reports. Support dissemination and outreach, including digital content, to help the Centre's work reach relevant audiences. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: IIT Madras Project Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Consultant is expected to: Work as the Research Manager for the project and be broadly responsible for leading day-to-day survey management with the survey firm, overseeing enumerator training, fieldwork quality control and daily progress tracking. Lead the day-to-day management of survey operations and serve as the key contact with the empanelled survey firm. This includes agreeing work plans, field deployment schedules and reporting formats, and holding the firm to the agreed protocols, timelines and deliverables. Coordinate any translation, back-translation and field-readiness of the survey instruments, including any reviews of the local language versions. Oversee the programming, skip logic and testing of the digital (CAPI) questionnaire before deployment. Organise and document any soft testing, pretesting and piloting, and make sure what is learned in these rounds feeds back into revising the instruments. Oversee any enumerator training that the survey firm conducts. Make sure the training covers study priorities such as matched youth–parent instruments, consent, and the skills needed to interview adolescents on sensitive subjects. Oversee fieldwork quality control and track progress against samples regularly. Implement and monitor the approved sampling protocol jointly with the Research Scientist II, including checking household eligibility and arranging any replacements needed for non-contact or non-response. Oversee the ethics, consent and safeguarding protocols during fieldwork, including consent and the confidentiality of respondent data. Ensure timely feedback between the field team and research leadership, including weekly field updates. Oversee data quality jointly with the Research Scientist II. This includes reviewing incoming survey data for completeness and consistency, spotting deviations from the approved sampling and survey protocols, and coordinating corrective action with the field team. Manage and supervise the Research Associate and the field-facing tasks given to the Research Intern, including allocating work, reviewing outputs and giving regular guidance on survey management and quality-control tasks.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: A PhD in Mechanical, Aerospace, Civil, Materials, or Chemical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, or an allied area. Candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis are also eligible to apply. Applicants must have a strong background in solid mechanics or continuum mechanics and experience with finite element analysis, demonstrated through doctoral research. Academic qualifications require a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Desirable Qualification: Research experience with polymers or fibre-reinforced polymer composites, including constitutive modelling. Experience with commercial or in-house FE codes (e.g., Abaqus, ANSYS, COMSOL); experience writing user subroutines (UMAT/VUMAT) is an advantage. Hands-on experience with thermal and mechanical characterisation (DSC, DMA) and/or strain sensing using Fibre Bragg Grating (FBG) sensors. Good communication skills and the ability to plan and carry out simulations and experiments independently.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for Technician (1) posts consists of application screening, a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive written examination. Candidates shortlisted after screening will be invited for the relevant Trade Test. Only those who qualify in the Trade Test will proceed to the written examination. The written examination consists of three papers. Paper I is qualifying in nature, while marks obtained in Papers II and III determine the final merit list, subject to the prescribed conditions. The total examination duration is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Paper I has no negative marking, while Papers II and III carry a penalty of one mark for each incorrect answer. The question paper will be in English and Hindi, except for the English Language section. The minimum qualifying marks for the Trade Test and Paper I will be determined and notified by the institute. Papers II and III will be evaluated only for candidates who qualify in Paper I.

Recruitment Section (E-I Section), CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute, Cheluvamba Mansion (Opposite to Rail Museum), Mysuru - 570020, Karnataka. content_sections.text: The selection process comprises the following stages: Objective Type Test Shorthand (English) Test Typing Speed Test on Computer Interview

content_sections.heading: Supreme Court of India Court Master (Shorthand) Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum Qualifying Marks: 50 marks for Objective Type Test (out of 100); 50 marks for Shorthand Test (out of 100); 10 marks for Computer Typing Test (out of 20); 15 marks for Interview (out of 30). Negative Marking: There will be no negative marking in the Objective Type Test.

rows.subject_details: General English (25), General Knowledge (25), Judiciary provisions in Constitution of India (25), Supreme Court Rules, 2013 (15), Knowledge of Computer operation (10)

Typing Speed Test on Computer in English with minimum speed of 40 w.p.m.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Supreme Court of India Court Master (Shorthand) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of the Supreme Court of India at www.sci.gov.in and access the recruitment link. Register online and fill out the application form with all required personal and academic details. Upload scanned copies of your recent photograph, signature, Class Xth, Class XIIth and Graduation certificates, experience certificate, and caste/community certificate (if applicable). Preview the filled application form carefully and complete final submission since modifications are not permitted once submitted. Pay the non-refundable application fee online through the UCO Bank payment gateway. Retain your application number and take a printout of the filled application form for your records and future reference.

content_sections.heading: Supreme Court of India Court Master (Shorthand) Important Instructions
content_sections.text: All admissions to tests and interviews are provisional, and eligibility documents will be verified during document verification. Candidates must retain their application number carefully to download admit cards from the official website. No admit cards will be sent by post. No TA/DA will be payable for appearing in tests or the interview. Candidates working in Central/State Government Departments, Nationalized Banks, or PSUs must submit a No Objection Certificate during document verification. Selected candidates may be required to work even at odd hours and holidays and must submit an undertaking to that effect. Submitting more than one application form will result in only the last submitted form being considered.

content_sections.heading: SAI Deputy Director Job Description
content_sections.text: Functions as a Section Head, assisting and reporting to the Divisional Head in matters relating to sports administration, policy implementation, and programme management. Exercises overall supervision, coordination, and management of assigned divisions or centres, ensuring effective implementation of SAI schemes and Government of India guidelines. Maintains and monitors data related to athletes, personnel, and schemes. Oversees administrative and financial matters and ensures compliance with applicable rules and procedures. Conducts inspections of offices, training centres, and field units to ensure smooth functioning of operations and optimal execution of training programmes. Handles inter-divisional coordination, communication with stakeholders, and supports decision-making processes at higher levels to achieve organizational objectives.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The following documents must accompany the application: Application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I), duly completed, signed by the candidate, and countersigned with official seal by the Cadre or Appointing Authority. Copies of certificates in proof of age, qualifications, experience, research, etc. Attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 (five) years, duly attested on each page with seal by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or above. Integrity Certificate. Vigilance Clearance Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. No Major or Minor penalty certificate for the last 5 years of service. A certificate to the effect that the particulars furnished by the candidate have been verified and found correct as per service records (Annexure-II). Cadre Clearance Certificate.

content_sections.heading: About NIFT
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) was set up in 1986 under the Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India. It is a statutory institute governed by the NIFT Act 2006 and has 20 campuses across the country. Its head office is at NIFT Campus, Hauz Khas, New Delhi. NIFT describes itself as an institute of fashion education that also works as a knowledge service provider to the Union and State governments in design development and in the positioning of handlooms and handicrafts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application, with self-attested copies of documents in support of qualification, experience, age and so on, to this address: The Registrar, NIFT Campus, Hauz Khas, Near Gulmohar Park, New Delhi- 110016. It must reach that address on or before 20 November 2026 by 05:00 PM. Every letter from NIFT, including any interview/interaction letter, will be sent only to the email address you give in the application form. Item 11 of the form asks for the full postal address with PIN code of your forwarding authority, along with that authority's name, telephone number and email address. Item 13 is for your three campus preferences if you are applying for Campus Director. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All four posts are at the same pay: Level – 13 (7th CPC) / PB – 4 [Rs. 37400 – 67000/- + Grade Pay Rs. 8700/- (6th CPC)]. The pay of a candidate selected on deputation will be regulated under the DoP&T O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. The 16 Campus Director locations are Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Gandhinagar, Hyderabad, Jodhpur, Kangra, Kolkata, Kannur, Mumbai, New Delhi, Patna, Raebareli, Shillong and Srinagar. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold an analogous post on regular basis and have experience in administration / establishment / academic matters. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold an analogous post on regular basis and have relevant experience in administration / establishment / admissions / academic matters. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold an analogous post on regular basis and have relevant experience in dealing with financial, accounting and audit matters. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold analogous posts on regular basis, with at least 2 years' experience on a post at the level of Director of Govt. of India or equivalent, and with relevant experience in administrative / establishment / admissions/ Academic matters. You must give 3 choices of campus in order of preference. The posts are transferable across all NIFT campuses. The Competent Authority is free to transfer a Campus Director to any NIFT campus. NIFT reserves the right to post the selected candidate to a campus outside the choices given. Age limit: the maximum age for appointment shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Period of deputation: three years. The tenure shall not be extended further. Educational qualification: the official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Nationality: you must be a citizen of India. No reservation exists for these deputation posts, as per Clause C (2.) of DOPT OM No.36011/1/2022-Estt(Res-I) dated 28 March, 2024. Officers already on deputation are not eligible to apply. The upper age limit, qualifications and experience are all judged as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Adhoc, contract, part-time, consultant or similar employment that is not permanent (not holding a substantive post/lien) is treated as temporary and will not count as experience. Check the official notification for the eligibility of each post in its own discipline.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed proforma of application (Annexure-I), with the Statement of Purpose Integrity Certificate (in original) (Annexure – II), signed by an officer of the rank of Deputy Secretary or above List of major / minor penalties imposed on the official, if any, during the last 10 years. If no penalty has been imposed, a "NIL" certificate must be enclosed (in original) (Annexure – III). Vigilance Clearance Certificate (in original) (Annexure – IV) Cadre Clearance Certificate (in original) (Annexure – V) Attested photocopies of the APARs (Annexure – VI) for the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25). The application will not be considered without them. Matriculation Certificate (as proof of age) Self-attested copies of your educational qualification, experience and caste/ category certificates (wherever applicable) Each page should be attested by an officer not below the rank of an Under Secretary to the Govt. of India. If your parent department keeps APARs in Grade Points (year-wise), submit them as Grades (year-wise): Outstanding, Very Good, Good, Average, Below Average, Poor and Fail only. If an APAR for any year is under process or cannot be submitted for an administrative reason, the APAR for the year before will be accepted. Any document in a language other than Hindi or English needs a Hindi or English transcript attested by the candidate. The Statement of Purpose (not more than 1000 words; a separate sheet may be used) must cover: Why do you wish to join NIFT? Why do you think you are suitable for the job? How will you bring value to NIFT? What has been a significant defining experience in your professional life? When forwarding the application, the forwarding Ministry, Department or Organisation must certify that the applicant will be relieved within one month of receiving the offer of appointment if selected. It must also record vigilance clearance.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process

The interview / interaction may be held offline or online, at the sole discretion of the Competent Authority. No TA/DA is paid for taking part in the selection process. content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification for most APPSC Group 2 posts is a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university. However, Finance and Law Assistant Section Officer posts and Accountant positions have specific qualification conditions. Qualification Cut-off: Candidates must possess the required qualification on the date of the detailed notification. Graduates from a recognized university can apply for Post Codes 01 to 08, subject to the remaining eligibility conditions. These include Deputy Tahsildar, Municipal Commissioner, Sub-Registrar and several other posts. However, the Finance and Law Assistant Section Officer posts and Accountant posts have additional or specific qualification requirements. Candidates applying for Sub-Registrar Grade-II must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university. The notification gives preference to candidates who also hold a recognized Law degree. Candidates applying for Assistant Section Officer in the Finance Department must possess a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Economics or Commerce from a recognized university, or an accepted equivalent qualification. Applicants for Assistant Section Officer in the Law Department must possess a Bachelor's degree in Law from a recognized university or an accepted equivalent qualification. For Senior Accountant and Junior Accountant posts, the notification specifies Commerce, Economics or Mathematics degrees and also provides eligibility through other recognized degrees with the prescribed computer-related certificate qualifications, or specified computer-related degrees. The accepted certificate course examinations conducted by the Board of Technical Education and Training, Andhra Pradesh, include: Office Automation. PC Maintenance and Trouble Shooting. Web Designing. Candidates should compare their exact degree and certificate combination with the detailed eligibility provisions before applying for Post Codes 11 and 12. Candidates applying for Prohibition and Excise Sub-Inspector under Post Code 07 must satisfy the physical requirements prescribed for the post. APPSC has directed applicants to refer to the detailed notification for these requirements.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 syllabus includes Indian History, Geography, Indian Society, Current Affairs, Mental Ability, Andhra Pradesh History, Indian Constitution, Economy and Science and Technology. Indus Valley Civilization and Vedic Age. Buddhism and Jainism. Mauryan and Gupta Empires. Delhi Sultanate and Mughal Empire. Bhakti and Sufi Movements. Rise of the Maratha Empire. 1857 Revolt and Indian National Movement. Post-Independence Consolidation and Reorganization. Physical Geography and Major Landforms. Climate, Atmosphere and Ocean Currents. Geography of India and Andhra Pradesh. Natural Resources, Agriculture and Industries. Transport, Communication and Tourism. Human Development, Population and Urbanization. Natural Hazards and Disaster Management. Family, Marriage, Kinship, Caste and Tribe. Religion, Ethnicity and Women. Social Issues and Regionalism. Crime Against Women and Child Labour. Public Welfare Policies and Programmes. Constitutional and Statutory Provisions for Vulnerable Groups. International Current Events. National Current Events. Andhra Pradesh Current Affairs. Logical Reasoning and Analytical Reasoning. Statement and Assumptions. Statement and Arguments. Statement and Conclusions. Number and Letter Series. Coding and Decoding. Relations and Shapes. Percentages, Ratio and Proportion. Simple and Compound Interest. Time and Work, Time and Distance. Data Interpretation and Basic Numeracy.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Mains Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The Group 2 Main Examination includes two papers covering Andhra Pradesh social history, the Indian Constitution, Indian and Andhra Pradesh Economy, and Science and Technology. Prehistoric Cultures in Andhra Pradesh. Satavahanas, Ikshvakus and Vishnukundins. Eastern Chalukyas and Andhra Cholas. Social and Cultural Development from the 11th to 16th Century. Andhra Under British Rule. Growth of the National Movement in Andhra Pradesh. Andhra Movement and Formation of Andhra State in 1953. Formation of Andhra Pradesh and Important Developments from 1956 to 2014. Constitutional Development and Salient Features. Preamble, Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles. Fundamental Duties and Constitutional Amendments. Legislature, Executive and Judiciary. Judicial Review and Judicial Activism. Centre-State Relations. Constitutional Bodies, RTI, Lokpal and Lokayukta. Elections, Electoral Reforms and Anti-Defection Law. 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments. Structure of Indian Economy and Economic Planning. National Income, Economic Growth and Development. Economic Reforms and NITI Aayog. Money, Banking, RBI and Monetary Policy. Inflation, Fiscal Policy and GST. Agriculture, Industry and Services Sector. Andhra Pradesh State Economy and Public Finance. AP Agriculture and Allied Sectors. Industrial Development, MSMEs and IT Sector in Andhra Pradesh. Science and Technology Policies and Missions. Space Technology and Indian Space Missions. Defence Technology and DRDO. Information Technology, Digital India and Cyber Security. Nuclear Technology and Energy Policy. Renewable and Non-Renewable Energy. Ecology, Ecosystems and Biodiversity. Environmental Pollution and Waste Management. Climate Change and Sustainable Development. Public Health, Disease Burden and Healthcare Initiatives.

content_sections.heading: ASBB Job Description
content_sections.text: Project Associate (Agrobiodiversity) Collect information and data on the agrobiodiversity including crop wild relatives of Assam from primary and secondary sources. Preparation of checklist for agrobiodiversity, photographic and video etc. Conduct workshops and meetings with FPGs of Assam for sensitization of conserving indigenous seed diversity of Assam. Collection & compilation of data on research projects/works undertake by institutions/organizations in the field of agrobiodiversity or similar fields. Assist in preparing Biodiversity Compendium of Assam. Data entry in Digital PBR database. Other related works of the Board as and when required. Project Assistant (Wildlife) Collect information and data on the floral and faunal diversity including microbes of Assam from primary and secondary sources. Preparation of checklist for floral and faunal biodiversity including microbes, photographic documentation of Biodiversity of Assam etc. Collection & compilation of data on research projects/works undertake by institutions/organizations in the field of biotechnology /microbiology or similar fields. Assist in preparing Biodiversity Compendium of Assam. Data entry in Digital PBR database. Other related works of the Board as and when required.

selection_process: The selection process comprises the following stages:

Stage-I: OMR based Written examination of 175 marks with multiple choice objective type questions (Duration: 3 Hours). Candidates will be shortlisted at the ratio of 1:2 of the vacancy position. Stage-II: Computer skill test of 25 marks for the shortlisted candidates. Final Selection: Based on total marks secured in the written examination and computer skill test as per merit and reservations.

exam_pattern.details: Exam Pattern Notes: The total number of questions will remain 150. There will be negative marking for wrong answers equivalent to 1/4th of the marks allotted for that question. Selecting more than one option will be treated as a wrong answer. Question papers will be available in Assamese, Bengali, English, Bodo, and Hindi.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.sebaonline.org to access the prescribed online application form.
Fill up all mandatory fields carefully in the online application form.
Ensure all entered details including Gender and Category are correct, as no editing or resubmission is allowed after final submission.
Submit the online application form to receive a Unique Application Number for future reference.
Keep a record of the Unique Application Number and download the confirmation for your records.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted in online mode only; no other mode is allowed. The Commission will not be responsible for any technical lapses during online application submission. Candidates already in regular Government service must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) when asked. Candidates must submit a declaration regarding "The Small Family Norms" in Form-A when asked. Canvassing directly or indirectly will disqualify a candidate. There will be no preference for place of posting.

You can raise no claim or objection during or after the service period, and you get no pension or other payment when the service ends. selection_process: The selection process comprises a merit list based on academic evaluation and work experience

Academic Qualification: 70% weightage (70 marks) based on the percentage obtained in the mandatory minimum educational qualification. Experience: No marks are awarded for the mandatory minimum experience period. For experience beyond the minimum requirement

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a merit list based on academic evaluation and work experience, followed by a written and skill test for shortlisted candidates. Academic Qualification: 70% weightage (70 marks) based on the percentage obtained in the mandatory minimum educational qualification. Experience: No marks are awarded for the mandatory minimum experience period. For experience beyond the minimum requirement, 02 marks are awarded per completed year of experience, up to a maximum of 10 marks. Shortlisting: Based on the combined marks of qualification and experience (out of 80 marks), candidates will be shortlisted for the written and skill examination in a 1:10 ratio (10 candidates per vacancy). Written and Skill Test: Allocated 20 marks. Final Merit List: Prepared on the basis of total marks obtained across academic qualification, experience, and the written/skill test (out of 100 marks). In case of a tie in marks, preference will be given to the candidate older in age; if age is also identical, preference will be given to the candidate with higher marks in the minimum educational qualification. Waiting List: A waiting list of 25% or a minimum of 03 candidates (whichever is higher) will be maintained, valid for 01 year from the date of publication of the selection list.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Senior DBA Job Description
content_sections.text: The roles and responsibilities for the Senior DBA include: Design, implement, and maintain enterprise healthcare database systems. Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain diverse database ecosystems across Relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, MariaDB) and NoSQL (MongoDB) platforms. Engineer and manage highly scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native and hybrid database environments. Ensure database performance optimization, tuning, indexing, partitioning, and capacity planning. Configure and manage Master-Slave (Primary-Replica) replication topologies to ensure high availability, data redundancy, and read-workload offloading. Monitor and troubleshoot replication lag, synchronization errors, and connectivity issues. Execute failover procedures and disaster recovery drills, promoting replica nodes to primary status to minimize downtime. Monitor database health, availability, and uptime for critical healthcare applications. Handle database upgrades, migrations, patching, and lifecycle management. Implement database security controls including encryption, role-based access, auditing, and vulnerability management. Ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of patient healthcare data. Develop and maintain backup, recovery, failover, and disaster recovery strategies. Conduct DR drills and ensure business continuity for operations. Assist in healthcare data warehousing and interoperability initiatives. Write complex queries and aggregation pipelines.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection follows the University of Delhi's two-stage scheme. Stage 1 is a preliminary MCQ test for shortlisting. Stage 2 is a descriptive Examination (Main) followed by an Interview/Personality Test. The final merit list is based only on Stage 2. Meeting the minimum eligibility conditions does not by itself mean you will be called for the written test. Applications will be screened under the University's guidelines to limit the number of candidates. All questions are compulsory. Each question carries 04 marks, and each wrong answer loses 01 mark. The qualifying cut-off is 50% marks of the average score of the top 05% of candidates. For deciding the category cut-off, SC and ST candidates get a relaxation of 05% marks and PwBD candidates get 10%. For one vacant post, 30 candidates are shortlisted for the Examination (Main). All candidates with the same cut-off marks are shortlisted. This test is only for shortlisting and has no weightage in the final assessment. Syllabus in brief: General Studies: General Science, current events of national and international importance, History of India, Indian National Movement, Constitution of India, Indian Polity, Economy and Geography. Reasoning: reasoning, analytical abilities, decision making, data analysis and interpretation. General Mathematical Ability: mathematical calculations, statistical analysis and commercial mathematics of Secondary and Higher Secondary level. Functioning of Higher Educational Institutions: rules and policies on how Higher Educational Institutions in India function, their nodal agencies, their financial and administrative functioning, and the Act, Statutes and Ordinances of the University of Delhi. The Examination (Main) is descriptive, carries 70 marks and lasts 2 hours. It covers three areas: Basic knowledge of the Constitution of India and Indian Polity: evolution, features, amendments, significant provisions and basic structure of the Constitution; Parliament and State Legislatures; the Executive and the Judiciary; Ministries and Departments of the Government; the Acts on Reservation and Transparency; Constitutional posts and bodies; statutory, regulatory and quasi-judicial bodies. Educational Administration and Management: the Higher Education System in India, its Regulatory Bodies and recent developments; Financial Administration in Higher Educational Institutions, including the budget and how it is formulated and executed; use of ICT and other modern technologies in higher education. Functional aspects of working of Government Bodies and Institutions: General Financial Rules; Procurement through GEM; Pension and Grievance handling. In both the Preliminary Test and the Examination (Main), Visually Impaired, Cerebral Palsy and similarly placed PwBD candidates get 20 minutes per hour extra. Both question papers are bilingual (English and Hindi). You may answer in either language, but you must use the same language throughout. The Interview/Personality Test carries 30 marks. It

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is on deputation on foreign service terms basis for three years, subject to satisfactory performance. It is governed by the instructions in DOPT OM No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended from time to time. It is also governed by GoI Notification No. GSR 670 (E) dated 14 September 2009, as amended from time to time, on the conditions of service of Officers and other employees of CCI. Apart from basic pay, the post carries DA, HRA and Transport Allowance etc. at the rates applicable to Central Government employees from time to time. The fixation of pay and deputation (duty) allowance is governed by instructions issued by DOP&T from time to time. Medical reimbursement is admissible as per the CCI service rules. This is in lieu of CGHS benefits, which are not admissible to the Officers of CCI. CCI is an eligible office for allotment or retention of Government accommodation from the General Pool.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are submitted offline only, through the applicant's employer. They must reach CCI by 24 December 2026 (5:00 PM). Fill in the application in the prescribed pro-forma at Annexure-III. Write your name in block letters and paste a copy of a passport-size photograph in the box provided. Submit a separate application for each post you want to apply for. Complete item 12 by comparing the essential and desirable qualifications and experience with your own. Where a qualification has been treated as equivalent, name the authority that treated it as equivalent. List your employment history in chronological order (item 13). If you need more space, use a separate sheet in the same format, signed by you. Also give any experience of handling investigation or enforcement of economic or regulatory law, or experience in Competition Law, with the number of years (item 14). Sign the declaration. It states that your Curriculum Vitae, supported by documents, will also be assessed by the Selection Committee. Get the certificate on the last page of the form completed, signed and sealed by your Employer/Head of office/Forwarding authority. Have the application forwarded through proper channel, with all the documents listed below, to: Deputy Director (HR), Competition Commission of India, 9th Floor, Office Block-1, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi-110023. Application in the Annexure-III pro-forma, with a copy of a passport-size photograph pasted on it Cadre Clearance Vigilance Clearance Integrity Certificate Attested copies of up-to-date APARs for the last five years, or the CR/APAR dossier in original. Photocopies of ACRs/APARs must be attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Govt. of India or above. Employer's certificate confirming four things: no vigilance, disciplinary or criminal case is pending or contemplated; the applicant's integrity; that no major or minor penalty was imposed in the last ten years, or a list of such penalties; and that the cadre controlling authority has no objection to the applicant being considered For applicants not in the Central Government pay scales: the equivalence of their pay scale with the Central Government's pay scales, with supporting documents List of enclosures

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 selection process includes initial academic screening, detailed scrutiny, document and point-mark verification, teaching presentation and interview. The final assessment considers academic record, teaching or research experience, research performance, teaching aptitude, domain knowledge and interview performance. Initial application screening based on the notified 100-point criteria. Publication of the provisional consideration-zone list. Submission and scrutiny of supporting documents by candidates in the consideration zone. Provisional shortlisting according to eligibility and screening scores. Document and Point Mark Verification. Teaching Aptitude and Ability Presentation. Domain Knowledge Assessment and Interview. DTU will use a 100-point initial screening system. The score is based on Ph.D. qualification, the prescribed pre-Ph.D. degree and qualifying national-level tests or scholarships. The pre-Ph.D. degree score is calculated according to the notification's formula: 35 + 0.5 × (X − 50), where X is the percentage obtained in the eligible pre-Ph.D. degree. The calculation is subject to the prescribed maximum score and recruitment rules. The online application also requires academic and research credentials under a separate 50-point framework. This is distinct from the 100-point initial screening criteria. The academic section considers undergraduate marks, postgraduate marks, Ph.D. qualification and relevant qualifying examinations. The experience and research section considers eligible teaching, research and industrial experience, publications, books, projects, patents and research guidance.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the project end date. The initial appointment will be for six months or until the project duration, whichever is earlier. Extension of tenure is based on the satisfactory performance of the incumbent. Research Associate: Rs 61,000/- per month + 30% HRA for Master's degree holders; Rs 67,000/- per month + 30% HRA for Ph.D. holders. Senior Research Fellow: Rs 37,000/- per month + 30% HRA. If performance is non-satisfactory, he/she will be terminated from the post with one-month notice. Young Professional-II: Rs 42,000/- consolidated per month. There is no provision for re-engagement after the termination of the scheme, and selected fellows cannot claim regular appointment at ICAR-IARI.

Office orders for research experience, in addition to experience certificates issued by the Principal Investigators (PIs). content_sections.heading: About CWC
content_sections.text: The Central Waqf Council (CWC), New Delhi, is a statutory body under the Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India. The Waqf Division of the Ministry, at Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi, issued this vacancy as Office Memorandum F. No. Waq-18/1/2025-Coord-MoMA dated 21 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Deputy Secretary (Waqf), Ministry of Minority Affairs, Room No. 1127 B-4 Wing, 11th Floor, Pt. Deendayal Antyodaya Bhawan, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi 110003. Fill in the Proforma "Application for the post of Secretary, Central Waqf Council (on foreign deputation basis (including short term contract))" and paste a passport-size photograph on it. Give your name, postal address, telephone, fax and e-mail, your present post with Pay Level (or Grade Pay), and the post you hold on a regular basis in your parent department. A retired officer gives the last designation and the post they retired from. Fill in the details of your past service: the post, the pay scale or Grade Pay or Pay Level, the period, and the nature of the duties performed. List your essential and desirable qualifications with the name and year of the degree, the university and the year of passing. Then sign the form and add your name, e-mail ID, the place and the date. Have the forwarding office fill in its part of the form: the office's name and category, the date of your continuous employment in the present grade, your present pay level and basic pay, and the certificate verifying your service particulars. The office also encloses your Cadre and Vigilance clearance. Put the application in a sealed envelope and write on it: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF SECRETARY, CENTRAL WAQF COUNCIL" . Send the envelope through proper channel to the address above so that it reaches within the 45-day limit. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The post of Secretary, Central Waqf Council is filled by deputation (including short-term contract) from: Serving officers of the Central Government or the State Government or Union territory Administration or public sector undertaking or autonomous or statutory body who: hold analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or Department; or have five years' regular service in the grade, rendered after appointment to it on a regular basis, in a post at Level 12 in the Pay Matrix (Rs. 78800-209200) or equivalent; Or retired officers of the rank of Deputy Secretary or Director or above in the Central Government. Essential: A Bachelors' degree or equivalent from a recognised University or institute; and at least five years' experience of administrative, financial and legal matters. Desirable: experience in the field of waqf management. Serving officers: the maximum age limit for appointment on deputation is not exceeding fifty-six years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Retired officers: the age should not be more than 62 years as on the last date for submission of the application. The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for the post. Pay of the post: PB-4: Rs. 37400-67,000/- + GP Rs. 8700/- (Level 13 in the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Pay Commission). Serving officers: if a serving officer of the Central Government or the State Government or Union territory Administration or public sector undertaking or autonomous or statutory body is selected, their pay will be protected. The other allowances, such as Transportation allowance, HRA and Deputation Allowance, will be paid as applicable to Central Government employees on an equivalent scale of pay and Grade Pay. Retired officers: a retired person who draws a pension from any source gets a fixed monthly remuneration. It is worked out by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. The remuneration stays the same for the term of the contract, with no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period. Serving officers: the period of deputation, including any period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or another organisation or department, shall ordinarily not exceed four years. It is also subject to the age of superannuation set by the Government of India. Retired officers: the initial period of appointment is two years. With the approval of the competent authority, further extensions are allowed only up to a total tenure of four years or until the officer reaches the age of sixty-five, whichever is earlier. Terms and conditions of service that the Recruitment Rules of the CWC do not explicitly cover will be governed by the relevant provisions of the FR-SRs and by the deputation rules, regulations and instructions issued by the Central Government.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The prescribed application form (Proforma), duly filled in and signed, in original, with a passport-size photograph pasted on it Forwarding letters from the employer (the application goes through proper channel) Integrity Certificate Vigilance Clearance (and Cadre clearance, enclosed by the forwarding office) Attested copies of the Annual Confidential Reports (ACRs) for the last five years; retired officials send the latest five years before retirement The forwarding office's part of the form, with its certificate that your service particulars have been verified against the service records

The Ministry has the right to reject any application without giving a reason.

basic_details.job_title: IIFT Head Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) is inviting applications for 1 post (the notice does not print a number) of Head, Centre for WTO Studies (CWTOS). The post is on contract or deputation basis. IIFT is an autonomous body under the Department of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. Academicians, candidates from industry and officers on deputation may apply. They must send a CV by email, addressed to the Registrar, IIFT, New Delhi, at [email protected], latest by 9 November 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated to shortlisted candidates by email

qualification.details: Three kinds of candidates can apply for the post of Head, Centre for WTO Studies. Each kind has its own conditions. Candidates must meet the essential qualification and experience on the last date of application. | Direct or indirect experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. At least 10 years of experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, law, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. This can be sectoral (or Officer Level) experience, or research and teaching experience. Eight of those years should be at the level of Assistant/Associate Professor. Experience at the level of Associate Professor carries more weight. Candidates with relevant research or teaching experience should have at least four years as an Associate Professor in a premier institution such as the IITs, IIMs, IISc, National Law Schools, Central Universities or other institutions. Ph.D. shall be essential. A consistently good academic record with at least 55% (or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) at bachelor's and master's level, or an equivalent qualification in a related discipline. Desirable: published work, particularly research papers in a peer-reviewed journal. | Extensive direct experience of at least three years in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. Work experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, law, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline that is significant and can be recognised at the National/International level. Desirable: ten years of managerial experience in industry/profession. A consistently good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) at Graduation and Post-Graduation level. | From the Government: officers on deputation from the Government of India under Central Government/State Governments and their Attached offices, Subordinate offices, Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous Bodies, Local Bodies etc. They are appointed on the basis of length of service and expertise in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, or a related discipline. From Academic/Research/Training Institutions, as mentioned above. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. | Candidates should be at least 40 years of age at the time of appointment. | The selected candidate will be placed in the Academic Pay Level-14. The notice says this pay is subject to revision. The selected candidate will have to join immediately. | The Board of Management of IIFT appoints the Head of the Centre on the recommendation of the Chairperson of CRIT. The appointment is for three years, with a probation period of one year at first. After that, the contract may be extended for up to three years, or for a period the Chairperson of CRIT decides. This depends on the incumbent's performance and the Centre's future requirements. For a Government officer appointed on deputation, the first period of deputation is three years. It can be extended in line with the DoPT instructions issued from time to time.

selection_process: Selection has two stages: shortlisting of applications
then an interview.
Shortlisting: If there are a large number of applications

the scrutiny committee may apply benchmarks higher than the minimum essential/desirable qualifications to shortlist candidates for the interview. Interview: Shortlisted candidates must appear for an interview before the Selection Committee at New Delhi. Only shortlisted candidates will be told the date and time of the interview
by email
in due course. Travel: Outside candidates must arrange their own travel and stay. IIFT will not bear any expenditure on this account. Verification: Selection
appointment and employment depend on meeting the required qualification and experience. They also depend on verification of testimonials
antecedents and past service.
important_instructions: Canvassing of any kind, or bringing influence or pressure from any quarter, will be treated as a disqualification for the post. If at any stage it is found that information was suppressed or given wrongly or falsely, or that fraud was committed, the application, appointment or employment will be rejected, cancelled or terminated summarily. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not fill the post advertised. No correspondence will be entertained about postal delays, the conduct and result of the interview, or the reason for not being called for the interview. Any dispute about this recruitment will be subject to the Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Delhi.

Separate conditions for Academicians, Candidates from Industry and Candidates on Deputation (Ph.D. essential for Academicians)
At least 40 years of age at the time of appointment

content_sections.heading: About IIFT
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade is a Deemed to be University. It is an autonomous body under the Department of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. The notice describes it as a premier institution of education, training and research in International Business, set up by the Department of Commerce. The Department of Commerce set up the Centre for WTO Studies in 1999 as a professional body. The Centre provides research and allied inputs to the government for negotiations at the WTO and for other WTO mandated committees. It now works under the Centre for Research on International Trade (CRIT), which is part of IIFT.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write the application addressed to the Registrar, IIFT, New Delhi. Make the application clearly state that it is the "application for the post of Head, Centre for WTO Studies". Attach your CV. Attach a brief one-page write-up explaining why you consider yourself suitable for this post. Applications received without the write-up shall be rejected. Government officers send the application through the proper channel, with the documents listed under Enclosures. Email the application to [email protected] latest by 9 November 2026. Only persons with the qualification and experience below should apply. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Three kinds of candidates can apply for the post of Head, Centre for WTO Studies. Each kind has its own conditions. Candidates must meet the essential qualification and experience on the last date of application. Direct or indirect experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. At least 10 years of experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, law, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. This can be sectoral (or Officer Level) experience, or research and teaching experience. Eight of those years should be at the level of Assistant/Associate Professor. Experience at the level of Associate Professor carries more weight. Candidates with relevant research or teaching experience should have at least four years as an Associate Professor in a premier institution such as the IITs, IIMs, IISc, National Law Schools, Central Universities or other institutions. Ph.D. shall be essential. A consistently good academic record with at least 55% (or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) at bachelor's and master's level, or an equivalent qualification in a related discipline. Desirable: published work, particularly research papers in a peer-reviewed journal. Extensive direct experience of at least three years in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline. Work experience in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, law, international law, investment, public policy or a related discipline that is significant and can be recognised at the National/International level. Desirable: ten years of managerial experience in industry/profession. A consistently good academic record with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade on a point scale wherever the grading system is followed) at Graduation and Post-Graduation level. From the Government: officers on deputation from the Government of India under Central Government/State Governments and their Attached offices, Subordinate offices, Public Sector Undertakings, Autonomous Bodies, Local Bodies etc. They are appointed on the basis of length of service and expertise in international trade, economics, economic diplomacy, international law, or a related discipline. From Academic/Research/Training Institutions, as mentioned above. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Candidates should be at least 40 years of age at the time of appointment. The selected candidate will be placed in the Academic Pay Level-14. The notice says this pay is subject to revision. The selected candidate will have to join immediately. The Board of Management of IIFT appoints the Head of the Centre on the recommendation of the Chairperson of CRIT. The appointment is for three years, with a probation period of one year at first. Af

content_sections.heading: IIFT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Head of the Centre for WTO Studies is the Chief Executive of the Centre. The responsibilities include: Planning, implementing and monitoring the annual work programme of the Centre. Supervising the day-to-day functioning of the Centre, so that its objectives under Clause 4 of the Bye-laws of the Centre are met effectively. Undertaking research to help India's trade negotiators and policy makers take part effectively in the WTO and in related multilateral/bilateral trade negotiations. Improving stakeholders' understanding of key trade issues through outreach and dissemination activities. Helping to build consensus, and building capacity in India and other developing countries to analyse WTO and other trade-related issues through training programmes.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: All applicants send: CV A brief one-page write-up on why the candidate is suitable for this post Government officers also send these documents with their application, through the proper channel: Attested photocopies of the APARs/Confidential Reports for the last five years, authenticated by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India Vigilance & Cadre Clearance No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the parent organisation

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: shortlisting of applications, then an interview. Shortlisting: If there are a large number of applications, the scrutiny committee may apply benchmarks higher than the minimum essential/desirable qualifications to shortlist candidates for the interview. Interview: Shortlisted candidates must appear for an interview before the Selection Committee at New Delhi. Only shortlisted candidates will be told the date and time of the interview, by email, in due course. Travel: Outside candidates must arrange their own travel and stay. IIFT will not bear any expenditure on this account. Verification: Selection, appointment and employment depend on meeting the required qualification and experience. They also depend on verification of testimonials, antecedents and past service.

rows.date: To be intimated to shortlisted candidates by email

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing of any kind, or bringing influence or pressure from any quarter, will be treated as a disqualification for the post. If at any stage it is found that information was suppressed or given wrongly or falsely, or that fraud was committed, the application, appointment or employment will be rejected, cancelled or terminated summarily. The Institute reserves the right to fill or not fill the post advertised. No correspondence will be entertained about postal delays, the conduct and result of the interview, or the reason for not being called for the interview. Any dispute about this recruitment will be subject to the Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Delhi.

content_sections.text: Under Secretary: Excellent note-taking/drafting skills; experience of dealing with Court Cases, Parliament matters, Vigilance, RTI, etc.; minimum 5-10 years' experience of handling budget and accounts matters in Ministries/Departments of the Government of India; Output-Outcome Monitoring Framework including submission of the same to the CEO; matters related to Parliamentary Standing Committee including preparation of Background Note and Action Taken Replies; submission of replies to RTI applications; looking after works related to establishment, finance, General Administration, framing of rules and regulations, and regulatory matters. You can also email the duly filled and signed scanned application form, with scanned mark sheets and other essential documents, to Prof. Joyti D. Pawar at [email protected].

the post applied for

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable qualification: A strong knowledge and working experience in machine learning, and data analytics Experience of using neural networks and deep learning Ability to read research papers from standard conferences and journals, comprehend the methodology used and implement to reproduce the result quoted in the paper Experience of working on large real time projects GATE/NET/MPhil qualification Annexure-A (the Terms and Conditions for the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme – Post Doctoral Fellowship) adds these eligibility conditions: The applicant must have obtained a PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. The PhD must have been completed within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of the application. The applicant should not have completed the PhD at the same institution (host institution) where the fellowship is to be awarded. The fellowship is awarded to researchers with a proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions. The applicant should be an Indian citizen. Applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers with temporary positions in academia or research institutions will be considered, but they must give up their current roles if selected. A candidate who has already availed the fellowship under the scheme will not be eligible for support. Upper age limit: 40 years on the date the application is submitted to the eligible participating institution (host institution). The applicant's research proposal, submitted to the institution, should define clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. Preference will be given to applicants who have active industry linkages and whose research proposal is directed towards industry-specific problems. Desirable qualification and interest: A strong knowledge and working experience in machine learning and data analytics Experience of using neural networks and deep learning Ability to read research papers from standard conferences and journals, comprehend the methodology used and implement to reproduce the result quoted in the paper Experience of working on large real time projects Interest in working with theme areas of research related to: EEG data, Data communication, Natural Language Processing and Embedded System Instrumentation Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: PhD Fellow: Rs 46,250/- to Rs.52,500/- per month, plus Rent, Contingencies of Rs. 1.20 Lakhs and a Visit to Lab abroad. The position lasts five years or until the PhD is completed, whichever is earlier. Post-Doctoral Fellow: Annexure-A gives the financial support as follows: Fellowship: ₹1,08,393/month. Contingency Grant: ₹1,00,000/year, paid on a pro-rata basis (for example ₹25,000/quarter). It may be used only for minor equipment, consumables and research-related items. It cannot be used to hire research staff. Contingency spending in the last quarter is reimbursed to the institution as per eligibility. No advance is given. Travel support up to the prescribed limit of Rs. 2.10 Lakhs, admissible only for: (a) the visa fee and one-time travel support for overseas faculty/applicants returning to India to take up the fellowship; and (b) taking part, on invitation from PhD Cell, DIC, in activities, events and workshops of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, following the host institution's norms for class and mode of travel. The awardee must claim reimbursement through the institution, and no advances are given for events. The Post Doctoral Fellowship is a full-time, non-transferable, temporary position tenable in India only. It is valid for 1 year, and no extension beyond one year is admissible under the scheme. Female candidates may take up to 6 months of maternity leave with fellowship support, subject to a maximum of 12 months of total fellowship support under the scheme. During maternity leave, only the fellowship is admissible. Awardees not registered under the scheme with the PhD Cell, Digital India Corporation (DIC), MeitY are not eligible for support. There is no provision to replace or transfer an awardee.

content_sections.heading: Goa University Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Besides their own research work, Post-Doctoral Fellows must take part in activities under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme assigned by the PhD Cell: Evaluation of research work of PhD Candidates Mentoring of PhD candidates Participation in collaborative research under the scheme Participation in workshops and events Other assignments by PhD Cell The fellow must also: Provide research proposals with specific timelines and deliverables, and submit monthly progress reports Report significant achievements during the tenure Promptly follow the directions of the PhD Cell Acknowledge the scheme at all significant forums, including publications, achievements and recognitions, using the template given in Annexure-A Inform the PhD Cell at least one month in advance of any long-term leave (for example, study leave or sabbatical) Not receive any other fellowship during the award period The PhD Cell reviews performance through reports, expert visits, workshops and interactions, and any other methods it considers appropriate.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Having the prescribed qualification does not guarantee a call for interview. Goa University will shortlist candidates on the basis of merit and the needs of the project. Shortlisted candidates will be told the date and time of the written test and/or interview by email. No other letter will be sent to the correspondence address. At the written test and/or interview, shortlisted candidates must bring: an updated CV the application form original mark sheets and certificates, with attested photocopies, in support of their academic qualifications a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, if they are currently employed (private, government or any other organisation) For the Post Doctoral Fellowship, Annexure-A adds that meeting the minimum eligibility criteria alone does not entitle a candidate to be selected.

content_sections.heading: About Income Tax Department Chartered Accountants for Special Audit
content_sections.text: The Office of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Gujarat, located at Room No. 202, Aaykar Bhavan, Ashram Road, Ahmedabad-380009, administers tax assessment and compliance across the territorial jurisdiction of Gujarat. This notification invites reputed partnership firms, proprietary concerns, and Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) of Chartered Accountants for empanelment to carry out special audits under section 268(5) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 (u/s 142(2A) of the erstwhile Income-tax Act, 1961).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the following minimum eligibility criteria as of 31/03/2026: Firm Constitution: The applicant should be a reputed partnership firm, a proprietary concern, or a Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) having its office in the area(s) falling within the territorial jurisdiction of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Gujarat. Primary Profession: Primarily engaged in the profession of accountancy and auditing. Staff Strength: A staff strength of at least 15, including a minimum of 3 Chartered Accountants who have been working continuously with the applicant for at least the last one year as on 31/03/2026. Professional Receipts: Filed returns of income regularly up to AY 2026-27 with Gross Professional Receipts exclusively from professional services like accountancy and auditing of not less than Rs. 50 lakhs in any two out of the last five preceding financial years (from 2021-22 to 2025-26). basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Bilaspur, District Bilaspur (HP) has invited applications for the re-engagement of retired Tehsildar, Naib Tehsildar, and Kanungos on a remuneration basis as a stop-gap arrangement for vacant posts and posts likely to become vacant this year in district Bilaspur. Eligible retired officials must submit their applications to reach the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Bilaspur (HP) on or before 20/11/2026 within working hours.
