qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions: Must have rendered minimum 5 years services in any wing of revenue Department of HP before their superannuation and having no departmental / disciplinary proceedings pending against them. The retirees to be engaged should not be more than 65 years of age on the date 31.10.2026.

selection_process: The retired Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos will be considered for the respective post by the concerned appointing authority on the recommendation of the committee duly constituted by the department. If the applications exceed the number of vacancies advertised by concerned appointing authority
the candidates who are junior in age will be given preference for engagement against such post.
important_instructions: The retired Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos will be re-engaged for 03 months in the first instance. It may be extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate & the requirement. The period of engagement will not be counted for any benefits whatsoever in the service rendered by them before their superannuation. The service of such retired persons will be purely on temporary basis and is liable to be terminated by the respective appointing authority at any time during the period of such re-engagement. The persons to be engaged will be entitled for one day's Causal Leave after putting one month service. No leave of any kind will be admissible to him/her. Unauthorized absence from the duty without the approval of the controlling officer shall automatically lead to the termination of such engagement. They will not be entitled for emoluments for the period of absence from duty. They will be entitled to TA/DA if required to go on tour in connection with his/her official duties at the same rate as applicable to regular counterpart officials at the minimum of pay scale. He/she shall continue to avail medical facilities and re-imbursement of Medical Expense as admissible to him/her as retiree. The monthly remuneration shall be paid to the re-engaged retirees on the basis of performance/work conduct certificate, which shall also include the details of cases dealt/disposed of by him/her. This certificate shall be issued by the concerned Controlling Authority to the re-engaged retiree at the end of the month. After clearance of pendency of revenue cases, the services of retired persons shall be terminated by the appointing authority. The promotion of existing Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos shall not be affected on account of re-engagement of above retirees & the posts occupied by them will be considered vacant for the purpose of promotion. Their re-engagement is liable to be terminated on availability of regular officials.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Jammu
content_sections.text: IIT Jammu (Indian Institute of Technology Jammu) is a technical institute in Jammu. It has a Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) that runs a Water Testing Lab (WQTL), which tests water from the institute's Jagti and Paloura campuses and from outside organisations. The Outsource Agency is hiring the selected candidate and will depute them to work at IIT Jammu.

rows.pay: Consolidated salary package of Rs. 45,000-55,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Project Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the post is 37 years. Candidates must meet one of the following two conditions: M. Tech degree in Environmental Engineering/Chemical Engineering or allied engineering branches with at least one year of relevant experience in Academics (Teaching post), NABL /accredited laboratory /research facility / industry and 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying degree from a recognized University/ Institute. M.Sc. degree in Environmental Sciences / Chemistry or equivalent qualification in appropriate field with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in Academics (Teaching post), NABL /accredited laboratory /research facility / industry and 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying degree from a recognized University/Institute. Good knowledge of computer applications is also a must. This covers email, word processing, spreadsheets, presentation software and operating systems such as MS-Windows. Preference goes to candidates with hands-on experience of equipment such as GC-MS, HPLC, Spectrophotometer and Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometer. The official notification gives the full eligibility for the post, so check it before applying.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Project Officer
content_sections.text: The Project Officer will manage the water testing lab at the Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) of IIT Jammu. The work includes tests on water quality parameters such as pH, conductivity, hardness, BOD, COD and heavy metals, including testing in the field. The officer will also handle 2-3 major scientific instruments at the CIF lab. The key responsibilities are: Each month, collecting samples of drinking water and waste water from 60 water filters and 6 STPs on the Jagti and Paloura campuses. Testing these samples for 10+ water quality parameters in triplicate and writing a report every month. External sampling when the WQTL receives requests. Field sampling as needed, for both external and internal samples. Operating the major sophisticated equipment in the WQTL, mainly gas chromatography, ion chromatography, atomic absorption spectrophotometry and ICP-MS. Maintaining the equipment at the WQTL, IIT Jammu. Other related work, such as processing bills and raising indents.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a Trade Test/Interaction. Having the qualifications does not guarantee a place on the shortlist. The Institute may set a cut-off higher than the minimum to keep the number of candidates reasonable. Candidates must bring all their original documents for verification at the Trade Test/Interaction.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Period of engagement: 1 year, extendable each year based on performance and need. Nature of engagement: outsource basis. The Outsource Agency will depute the selected candidate to IIT Jammu. This is a purely temporary engagement. Being selected gives no claim to regularisation against any regular post, or against any future vacancy in any cadre or post at IIT Jammu.

content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: When assigned, the Legal Retainer / Empanelled Advocate will: Appear and represent NHM Jharkhand before the concerned Court, Tribunal, authority or legal forum. Draft, settle, vet and file petitions, writ petitions, appeals, revisions, reviews, applications, affidavits, counter affidavits, replies, rejoinders, written submissions and other legal pleadings. Give legal opinions / advice on civil, criminal, service, contractual, administrative, constitutional and other matters. Do legal research, including on applicable laws, rules, notifications, judgments, precedents and relevant case law. Prepare case briefs, hearing notes, factual summaries and written submissions for officers / senior law officers. Coordinate with and brief Senior Advocates, Government Advocates or other Counsel, wherever required. Monitor cases, report hearing dates and give timely updates on material developments. Obtain and provide certified / authenticated copies of orders and judgments, wherever required. Advise on the legal implications of proposed actions, notices, contracts, agreements, claims and other matters. Take on any other legal work the Competent Authority may reasonably assign. Reporting duties: keep NHM Jharkhand informed of important developments, hearing dates, orders and directions. Submit a periodic statement of assigned cases in the prescribed format. Report any adverse order, urgent development or limitation issue to the concerned officer without delay. Failing to attend a matter, meet timelines or give timely updates may count against you when continuation is reviewed.

content_sections.text: Selection has four steps: scrutiny, shortlisting, a possible personal interaction / interview, and approval by the Competent Authority. Scrutiny: A Screening / Evaluation Committee set up by NHM Jharkhand checks the applications received within the prescribed period. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates may be shortlisted on qualification, professional experience, the nature and volume of relevant litigation handled, experience with Government / Health Institutions, professional standing and other relevant parameters. Personal interaction / interview: Shortlisted candidates may be called for a personal interaction / interview, in person or online, at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Final empanelment: Final empanelment / engagement needs the approval of the Competent Authority. NHM Jharkhand may accept or reject any or all applications, wholly or partly, without giving a reason. It may also increase, decrease or cancel the requirement at any stage. Applying, being shortlisted or being empanelled gives no right to engagement, work or any minimum remuneration.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: You must disclose any actual, potential or perceived conflict of interest before accepting any matter. You must not take a brief against NHM Jharkhand where that would create a conflict of interest or break professional rules. All records, pleadings, opinions and communications of NHM Jharkhand must be kept strictly confidential. They may be disclosed only with prior written permission, or where the law or a competent judicial / statutory authority requires it. NHM Jharkhand may end the engagement at any time, for example for unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, conflict of interest, breach of confidentiality or negligence. The Competent Authority may also end it without giving a reason. If you want to leave the engagement, you should ordinarily give one month's written notice. You must hand over records and case status as directed. False, misleading or materially incorrect information may lead to rejection of the application or termination of the engagement. NHM Jharkhand may modify, amend, withdraw or cancel the EOI or any part of it at any stage. Disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the competent courts at Ranchi, Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Advocates enrolled under a Bar Council as per the Advocates Act, 1961. In the case of a law firm, the application must be submitted through an Advocate enrolled under a Bar Council as per the Advocates Act, 1961. The qualifying experience is reckoned from the date of enrolment mentioned on the Certificate of Enrolment issued by the Bar Council for High Courts or Subordinate Courts/Tribunals. Cumulative experience is counted, but at the date of application, the applicant must be actively practising in the forum for which empanelment is sought. For empanelment before the Supreme Court of India, Advocates who are regularly practicing in the Supreme Court (including Advocates-on-Record) will be considered. Designation as an Advocate-on-Record in the Supreme Court of India, Orders or Judgments of the Supreme Court noting appearance, or a Certificate of Practice serves as valid proof of 10 years of practice. Applicants must possess excellent communication skills, drafting skills, and court craft, and maintain a fully functional working office with adequate infrastructure. Due weightage will be given to Advocates having experience in handling cases of Central Public Sector Enterprises and Government Departments. Applicants should also be familiar with relevant branches of law, including Mining Laws (Coal Mines), Land Acquisition Law, Competition Law, Constitutional Law, Company Law (including SEBI Guidelines), Forest and Environmental Law, Service Law, Labour Law, Law of Contract, Commercial Law, Property Laws, and Taxation, and be well conversant with practice rules in Supreme Court, High Courts, Subordinate Courts, and Tribunals.

content_sections.heading: CMPDI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities apply to all empanelled advocates and law firms across all designated forums: Represent Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited (CMPDI) and its officers/officials before the Supreme Court of India, High Court of Delhi, High Court of Jharkhand, and other Courts and Tribunals within the jurisdiction of Delhi High Court and Jharkhand High Court at Ranchi. content_sections.text: Visit the designated online application portal at aeap.cmpdi.co.in. Fill in the online application in the prescribed proforma. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be scrutinized by CMPDI, and suitability will be adjudged based on the following parameters: Length of practice and specialization in the area of law relevant to the company. Proper and adequate infrastructure, such as office premises, number of junior advocates, assistants, clerks, fax, mobile phone, fixed phone, and internet connection. Annual income-tax return filed with the Tax Authorities for the last three years. Current and past empanelment by other organizations, establishments, regulators, and especially by Public Sector Enterprises and Government Departments. Notable achievements. The decision reached by CMPDI will be final and binding, and no communication will be entertained in this regard.

Assessment of Land Cover / Land Use & Change Analysis on 1:50,000 scale

content_sections.heading: JSAC Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a Citizen of India. All candidates must fulfill eligibility criteria on or before 01.10.2026.

rows.qualification_required: Minimum Essential: Ph.D in Remote Sensing & GIS / Geo-informatics / Geology / Forestry / Geophysics / Earth & Atmospheric Sciences / Agriculture / Water Engineering and Management / Civil Engineering / Environmental Science or equivalent from recognized university OR having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after M.Sc / ME / M.Tech with first class in above mentioned discipline. Additional Requirement: One research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Desirable: Proficiency in image processing & GIS software and DGPS Survey; Experience in Data Collection through drone survey and DGPS and processing of data; DGCA approved Remote Pilot Certificate (RPC) holder for flying of drone will be preferred.

Minimum Essential: M.Sc or M.Tech in Remote Sensing & GIS / Geo-informatics / Geology / Forestry / Geophysics/Earth & Atmospheric Sciences / Agriculture / Water Engineering and Management / Civil Engineering / Environmental Science or equivalent with first class from recognized university. Desirable: Working experience in image processing and GIS software.

content_sections.heading: JSAC Salary
content_sections.text: RA/JPA will not be entitled to any other benefits like Dearness Allowance, Provident Fund, Pension benefit, Gratuity, medical benefit, and annual increment etc. They are entitled only to casual leave as per rules and guidelines of Jharkhand Space Application Center and Govt. of Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: JSAC Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay the application fee online to Jharkhand Space Applications Center Account No. - 490210110012465, IFSC Code - BKID0004902, Bank of India, Club Side Branch, Main Road, Ranchi, and fill the UTR No. & Date of payment in the online application form. Application fee once paid is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: JSAC Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be screened out on the basis of minimum required qualification. Screened candidates will be called for an interview, and the final list will be prepared based on the merit of the interview. A written test may also be conducted, if required, for short-listing candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JSAC
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of JSAC at https://jsac.jharkhand.gov.in for online registration starting from 21.10.2026 at 03:00 PM. Pay the required application fee online through bank transfer and note down the UTR Number and date of payment. Complete the online application form by filling in all required details, including UTR No. and payment date, before 09:00 PM on 18.11.2026. Take a printout of the duly filled online application form. Attach self-attested true copies of all required documents and the original copy of online payment proof with UTR number, date of payment, full name, and application number written on it. Place the documents in a sealed envelope superscribed with "Application for the post of .........................". Send the hard copy by Speed Post only to "The Director, Jharkhand Space Applications Center, Department of IT & e- Governance, Govt. of Jharkhand, 2nd Floor, Engineers Hostel -1, Near Gol Chakkar, Dhurwa, Ranchi, Jharkhand, PIN- 834004" on or before 25.11.2026 till 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Mark-sheets of SSC, Intermediate, Graduation, Post Graduation, Diploma, Ph.D and any other documents related with qualification as desired & applicable Work experience Certificate, if required Certificate of Matriculation as proof of date of birth Caste Certificate issued by competent authority Recent Residential Certificate by competent authority Original copy of proofs of online payment with UTR number and date of payment with full name and application no. written on it No Objection Certificate (NOC) if candidates are already in service

content_sections.heading: JSAC Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment will be purely contractual on project basis for a minimum period of one year and may be extended as per project guidelines. Reservation rules of the Government of Jharkhand apply only to BC-I/BC-II, SC, and ST candidates of Jharkhand State. Reserved candidates from other states are treated as General candidates. If applying for more than one post, candidates must submit a separate application and pay the prescribed fee separately for each post. Incomplete applications, applications without required attachments, and those received after the due date will be summarily rejected. No TA/DA will be admissible for attending the written test or interview. The place of posting is Ranchi, but the incumbent is liable to be posted anywhere in Jharkhand State as and when required.

content_sections.heading: About CSIR-CFTRI
content_sections.text: CSIR-Central Food Technological Research Institute is in Mysuru, Karnataka. The notice describes it as a constituent National Laboratory of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR). This post is for the project "Development of Highly Efficient Oxygen Scavenger Sachets Using Natural Rubber Silica Composites for Enhanced Food Preservation" (project number GAP00667).

content_sections.text: The maximum age is 35 years. Age, educational qualification and experience are all counted as on the date of the walk-in interview, which is 5 November 2026. First class in M. Sc. in Food Science and Technology / Food Science and Nutrition or equivalent from a recognized university AND 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science & Technology Organisations Experience in food analysis techniques and product development. These relaxations apply "or as per Govt. of India instructions issued in this regard from time to time". SC, ST, PwBD and OBC candidates must bring their original category certificate in the proper format, issued by the appropriate authority. Under CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024, a person's total time as project staff across CSIR labs and institutes cannot be more than 6 years. If you have already served 6 years as project staff in any CSIR lab or institute, you are not eligible for this post. For the full details of the eligibility for this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview at CSIR-CFTRI, Opp. Railway Museum, Mysuru-570020. If a large number of candidates apply, a committee will shortlist them using one or more of these methods: The Director, CSIR-CFTRI, makes the final decision on who may appear for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary and on contract, at CSIR-CFTRI, Mysuru, Karnataka. The notice gives two terms for the engagement. Page 1 says it runs at first up to 30 November 2026, and can be extended up to November 2027 if funds are available and the work needs it, or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. Instruction 12 says it runs at first for one year from the date of joining, depending on funds. It may then be extended or cut short based on conduct, performance and the institute's needs, and extended further on the Review Committee's recommendation. The engagement cannot go beyond the project's term and ends automatically when the project ends. Being engaged as project staff gives no right to register for higher degrees, and no right to a permanent job at CSIR-CFTRI, CSIR or its labs and institutes. A selected candidate cannot leave without the Director's prior approval. To leave before the tenure is complete, you must give one month's notice with a specific reason, or pay one month's stipend instead of the notice. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. Any canvassing, or bringing political or other influence, disqualifies the candidate. On any matter the notice does not cover, the Director's decision is final.

content_sections.heading: NSIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The key responsibilities of the Chief Manager - Accounts & Finance are: Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis to support strategic decision-making. Ensure compliance with government financial regulations, tax laws, and statutory requirements. Coordinate with regulatory bodies such as CAG, GST authorities, and other financial auditors. Provide leadership in investment planning and risk assessment, and lead a team so that the department functions efficiently. Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and best practices. Support management in financial decision-making through in-depth financial analysis and reports. Liaise with banks, financial institutions, and government agencies for financial transactions.

Candidates with the following backgrounds are particularly well suited for this role: MPH with specialization in Epidemiology or Health Policy Master's in Public Policy (MPP) with health focus Health Economics or Health Systems Research training Candidates with experience working on NCD epidemiology, cancer control, or public health surveillance programmes Candidates with experience in conducting systematic review and meta-analysis Desired experience: At least 3 years' experience in public health research, policy analysis or evidence synthesis Experience working with government health programmes, national institutes, or policy think tanks Candidates with the following backgrounds are particularly suited: Science Communication / Health Communication specialists Public Health graduates with strong communication skills Candidates with experience translating scientific research into public communication Desired experience: At least 3 years' experience in science communication, health communication, or digital media Experience working with research institutes, universities, or public health organizations Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.text: Both posts pay a consolidated salary of Rs.42,000/- per month (All inclusive). Income tax and any other tax due under the prevailing rules is deducted at source before the monthly emoluments are paid. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual. The initial term is one year. An extension, if any, will be considered case by case, depending on job requirements, satisfactory performance and the Institute's need for the services. The selected candidate will not be treated as an "employee" or "official" of ICMR for any purpose. He or she will have no claim to an extension beyond the contract, to regularisation of service in ICMR or any of its Institutes/Centres or the Govt. of India, or to a regular appointment in the Council. The contract can be ended at any time without prior notice and without a reason. In the normal course, however, either side may end it by giving at least one month's notice at any time, without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: ICMR NINE Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct missing data analysis, support documentation and reporting and adapt to evolving project needs. Develop policy briefs, evidence summaries, and policy notes based on NINE/NCRP research outputs. Translate epidemiological and surveillance findings into policy-relevant communication for ministries, national health programmes, and international agencies. Conduct rapid evidence synthesis and literature reviews related to cancer epidemiology, environmental risk factors, and NCD prevention strategies. Assist in preparation of technical reports, white papers, and national policy background documents. Support preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic communication documents for senior policymakers and program managers. Contribute to evidence-based policy recommendations related to cancer surveillance, environmental determinants of cancer, and NCD control strategies. Key skill sets required: Policy and Research Skills: ability to translate epidemiological research into policy-relevant insights; strong capability in rapid literature review and evidence synthesis; experience drafting policy briefs, background notes, or policy summaries. Analytical Skills: understanding of public health data interpretation; familiarity with NCD epidemiology, cancer surveillance, and health system issues. Communication Skills: strong scientific writing and policy communication; ability to prepare concise policy summaries for decision makers. Technical Skills: familiarity with reference management tools (EndNote, Zotero); basic knowledge of data interpretation from epidemiological datasets. Develop communication products based on NINE research publications and NCRP reports. Prepare research highlights, summaries, and simplified explanations of scientific findings. Create infographics, visual abstracts, and communication materials for reports and publications. Support dissemination of NINE outputs through website, newsletters, digital platforms, and social media channels. Develop multimedia communication content including short videos, explainer graphics, and social media posts. Assist in organizing webinars, outreach events, and research dissemination activities. Key skill sets required: Scientific Communication Skills: ability to convert technical research findings into clear and engaging communication; experience preparing visual abstracts, summaries, and knowledge translation products. Digital Communication Skills: experience managing social media communication for research institutions; familiarity with digital dissemination strategies for scientific content. Creative and Technical Skills: ability to design infographics and visual communication materials; experience with tools such as Canva, Adobe Illustrator, PowerPoint design, or similar platforms. Editorial Skills: strong writing and editing skills for scientific summaries and public communication; ability to maintain accuracy while simplifying complex research findings.

basic_details.job_title: Cochin Port Authority Master Tugs Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Port Authority (CoPA), Willingdon Island, Kerala, is filling 2 posts of Master Tugs (Class – I). Both posts are unreserved (UR) and are filled on a regular basis by direct recruitment. The pay scale is Rs. 50000-160000, and candidates need a Certificate of Competency as Master (NCV) or Mate of a foreign going ship. Applications are accepted only through the online application portal. Online registration and fee payment run from 27 October 2026 to 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply through the online application portal linked on the Cochin Port careers page (www.cochinport.gov.in/careers). The notice says this is the only valid method and that no other application mode will be accepted. Documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on must be submitted with the online application.
Open the online application portal from the Cochin Port careers page and complete the basic registration. Note the "Application reference No." you receive.

Go to State Bank Collect (onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect), click "Govt. Departments" and select "Cochin Port Trust" from the dropdown. You can also use the direct payment link in the "Payment details" window of the application portal.
In the payment category, select the post you are applying for. Enter your Application reference No., any remarks and the mandatory details.

basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram, an autonomous institution under the Government of Kerala, invites online applications on behalf of a reputed Public Sector Undertaking for 2 posts of Company Secretary and Assistant Manager on a contract basis for a period of 03 (Three) years at a consolidated pay of Rs. 51,300/- per month. Eligible candidates possessing engineering graduation or membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India may apply online through www.cmd.kerala.gov.in from 22 October 2026, 10.00 AM to 10 November 2026, 05.00 PM.

how_to_apply: Visit the official portal of the Centre for Management Development at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in.
Navigate to the online application link for Notification No.CMD/10/2026/01.
Enter all relevant details accurately in the online application form.
Upload a scanned copy of your latest photograph in *.JPG format (file size must be less than 200 kB).
Sign in full on white paper (initials or capital letters are not permitted) and upload the scanned signature in *.JPG format (file size must be less than 50 kB).
Upload the original certificate or provisional certificate of your educational qualification issued by a competent authority (mark sheets or statements of marks are not accepted).

Upload valid work experience certificates clearly mentioning date of joining, relieving, duties and responsibilities, and the signature and seal of the authorized person. For latest experience, an affidavit containing these details may be uploaded.
Submit the online application before the closing time of 05.00 PM on 10 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applicants must compulsorily fill up all relevant fields; incomplete or incorrect applications will be summarily rejected. CMD will not entertain any information furnished by candidates subsequent to submission under any circumstances. Uploading mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets, or statements instead of original or provisional degree certificates will lead to rejection. Appointment letters, salary certificates, or pay slips will not be accepted in lieu of a work experience certificate. Applications with blurred or illegible photographs, signatures, or ambiguous experience certificates will be rejected. Applicants must maintain an active personal email ID and mobile number throughout the recruitment process, as intimations and call letters will be sent electronically. CMD reserves the right to call for any additional documentary evidence from candidates in support of educational qualifications, experience, or other notified eligibility requirements. CMD reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason, or stop the recruitment process altogether. CMD reserves the right to debar any candidate for malpractice, including fraudulent claims of benefits, relaxations, or misconduct.

content_sections.text: Independent Member of the Forum shall hold office for a fixed term of three (3) years as per Regulation 4.5 of MERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum & Electricity Ombudsman) Regulation 2020. The tenure of Independent Member may be extended by the Commission for a further period not exceeding two (2) years subject to an overall age limit of sixty-five (65) years. Monthly remuneration is Rs. 35,000/- per month. Statutory Taxes will be deducted at source. Remuneration is inclusive of allowance such as sitting fees, honorarium and all other allowance such as conveyance allowance, telephone charges etc. For holding the additional charge of Chairperson or Independent Member of other CGRF, 25% additional remuneration and the TA/DA at the rate as applicable to the Chief Engineer or equivalent shall be applicable.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: If necessary, selection process may be on basis of interview to be conducted by Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission. Prescribed qualifications are minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle the candidate for selection. Canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature. The Commission shall verify the integrity and background of the applicants. The Commission may select the candidate for one of the locations specified by the applicant or any other vacant position, based on the discussion during the interview/appointment process.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicant shall provide up to five preferred locations to work as a Independent Member. Canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature. If any false/incorrect information furnished by the candidate is detected at any stage of recruitment process, his/her candidature will not be considered. If the candidate knowingly or wilfully furnishes incorrect or false particulars or suppresses material information, he/she will be disqualified and if appointed, shall be liable for dismissal without any notice or assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the MERC in all matters relating to recruitment shall be final and no individual correspondence will be entertained. No separate applications to be sent, if applicant is applying for the post of Independent Member at more than one location. Incomplete applications and/or applications received after the due date shall not be considered for evaluation. Applications submitted through any other mode shall not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: About MACS-ARI
content_sections.text: MACS-Agharkar Research Institute (ARI), Pune is an autonomous institute of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India. It describes itself as committed to promoting science and technology, with emphasis on high standards of research and development. Its research covers the biological sciences in six thematic areas: Biodiversity & Palaeobiology, Bioenergy, Bioprospecting, Developmental Biology, Genetics & Plant Breeding, and Nanobioscience.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 Scientist-C posts on a direct recruitment basis. The place of work for the first post is the Genetics & Plant Breeding Group of ARI, Pune. For the second post, it is the Developmental Biology Group of ARI, Pune. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: ARI invites applications from eligible Indian citizens and from scientists and employees of Central or State Governments, universities, recognised research institutions, public sector undertakings and other government-funded organisations. Essential: First Class M.Sc in Agriculture with specialisation in Genetics and Plant Breeding or allied disciplines from a recognised university or Institute, or equivalent qualifications. Four years of research and development experience in the required areas, as evidenced by publications in journals of repute, after obtaining an academic degree. Desirable: Doctoral degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding/ Plant Breeding/ Crop Improvement or allied disciplines from a recognised University or Institute. Proven experience in crop breeding and genomics-assisted research. Hands-on experience with field experimentation, phenotyping and data analysis. A demonstrated record of high-impact scientific publications and of taking part in acquiring and carrying out research projects. Ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary research programs. Experience in a research laboratory after obtaining an M.Sc in the relevant field. Essential: First Class M.Sc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or related fields, or equivalent qualifications. Four years of research and development experience in the required areas, evidenced by publications in reputed journals, after obtaining an academic degree. Desirable: Ph.D in areas of life science including Molecular biology, cell biology, and developmental biology or related areas. At least 3-5 years of post-doctoral experience in cell and developmental biology, with experience in cell culture and model organism research, and a good publication record in reputed journals. Experience of working in a research laboratory after obtaining an M.Sc. Time spent acquiring the essential qualifications does not count towards experience. However, time spent on a Doctorate degree from a recognised University or Institution (up to a maximum of two years) counts as experience. So does time spent on Post Doctorate research in a University or research institute, up to a maximum of two years, when it is shown by a certificate from that University or Institute and by research published in journals of repute. All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognised Board or University. For both posts, the upper age limit for direct recruitment shall not exceed 40 years. The crucial date for deciding the age limit and eligibility is the closing date for submission of applications. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: ARI Pune Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Undertake a breeding programme in wheat, soybean and grape for high yield, improved quality and tolerance to biotic and abiotic stresses. Implement genomic-assisted breeding approaches, including GWAS, QTL mapping, SNP-based analyses and genomic selection (GS). Develop, manage and evaluate bi-parental, multi-parent (MAGIC/NAAM) and RIL breeding populations. Conduct biofortification research and trait discovery for nutritional and quality-related traits. Plan, conduct and analyse multi-location and multi-season field trials. Carry out germplasm characterisation, evaluation and core collection development. Apply marker-assisted selection (MAS) and integrate molecular tools into breeding pipelines. Perform plant phenotyping using morphological, physiological and biochemical methods. Conduct quality analyses, including oil, protein, minerals, fatty acid compositions and volatile profiling. Contribute to seed production programmes and varietal release pipelines as per institutional and national guidelines. Publish research outcomes in peer-reviewed journals with a high impact factor. Prepare and submit research project proposals and secure extramural funding from national and international agencies. Assist in mentoring research scholars and contribute to departmental and institutional academic and other activities. Initiate and develop independent projects in new and emerging frontiers of cell and developmental biology, organelle biology and diseases. Secure extramural funding. Enthuse, motivate and supervise research scholars. Take part in teaching and training programs, and in teaching and training students. Contribute towards the development and maintenance of Institutional infrastructure. Facilitate and carry out various academic outreach activities. Advance research in cell and developmental biology and start new transnational areas of research. Contribute to Institutional work as entrusted from time to time.

content_sections.text: Having the essential qualifications does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. basic_details.short_information: The 9 Consultant posts in DGFT Mumbai Recruitment 2026 are open only to retired Central Government officers. Applicants must have retired as Assistant Section Officer, Section Officer or Under Secretary to the Government of India, or an equivalent rank. The Office of the Additional Director General of Foreign Trade, Mumbai is an attached office of the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Its Vacancy Circular F.NO.75/02/2022-2025/HRD, dated 16 October 2026, offers a contract that starts at one year. The remuneration is Last Pay Drawn minus pension plus TA drawn at the time

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form printed with the circular ("Application for the post of Consultant on contract basis"). It asks for your name, date of birth, email, mobile number, address, educational qualification, date of superannuation, organisation retired from, post held at retirement, age as on the closing date (YY/MM), PPO number, PAN, Aadhaar number, departmental exams qualified, current organisation if any, details of your experience, and your knowledge of MS Office tools.
Paste your photograph in the space given on the form.

Sign the undertaking with the place and date. In it you declare that the particulars are true, that you were clear from the vigilance angle at retirement, and that you accept the terms of the circular. You also agree to give references for assignments done in the last three years.
Attach the documents named in the notice (listed below).
Email the application to [email protected] by 5 November 2026.
You may also send a hard copy to: Deputy DGFT(HRD), O/o Addl.DGFT, Nishtha Bhavan, 48, Sir Vithaldas Thackersey Marg, Churchgate, Mumbai - 400020.
Incomplete applications and applications received after the due date will be rejected. If your experience details do not fit on the form, you may annex a separate sheet.
Copy of PPO
Last salary slip
Aadhaar card
Photograph (on the application form)
important_instructions: During the contract period, the Consultant may not accept any other assignment or consultancy of any type. The Consultant must maintain absolute confidentiality of the information they handle, both during the contract and after it ends. Failing this, they are liable for suitable action. The Official Secrets Act, 1923 applies to the Consultant. The Consultant must maintain the highest standards of integrity, transparency, competitiveness, economy and efficiency. Attendance is marked in the Aadhaar-enabled Biometric Attendance System. DGFT reserves the right to end the engagement at any stage for serious failure to perform assigned tasks or failure to observe standards of conduct. Either side may end it with one month's notice or pay in lieu of notice. DGFT reserves the right to accept or reject, in part or full, any or all responses without giving reasons. The decision of the Selection Committee will be final and binding on all applicants.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The circular invites applications only from retired Government Officers/Officials. An applicant must meet all of the following: Retired rank: retired from the rank of Assistant Section Officer/Section Officer to the Government of India or equivalent/Under Secretary to the Government of India or equivalent, from Central Government Ministries/Departments or their attached/subordinate offices. Experience: substantive secretariat experience (noting/drafting/typing) in areas such as monitoring/implementation of policies/schemes, disbursal/allocation of funds, budget/accounts, establishment and cash. Computer skills: fully conversant with MS-Word/PPT/Excel etc. as the role requires, and able to print their own notes/drafts/OMs as required. Age and health: should not have attained the age of 64 years on the closing date of applications (5 November 2026), and should be in good health to discharge official duties effectively. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application form does ask for the applicant's educational qualification, any departmental exam qualified, and their knowledge or experience of MS Office tools. In the form's undertaking, the applicant must also declare that they were clear from the vigilance angle at the time of retirement. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consultants are paid under Department of Expenditure OM No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. Under this OM, the remuneration is the Last Pay Drawn minus pension, plus the TA drawn at the time of retirement. No D.A. component is involved. The engagement is initially for one year from the date of joining. The Competent Authority may extend or curtail it at its discretion. Normal working hours are 9.30 am to 6.00 pm. In exigencies, a Consultant may be called on holidays or beyond normal hours, and no extra compensation is admissible for this. Paid leave may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Leave cannot be accumulated beyond a calendar year, and 'No work no pay' applies to leave taken beyond the prescribed limit.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for TISS Non-Teaching Positions Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) is conducting the recruitment drive for various non-teaching positions across its campuses to fill a total of 16 vacancies under advertisement number TISS/NON-TEACHING POSITIONS/2026/02.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 16 vacancies have been announced for various non-teaching roles including Deputy Registrar, Deputy Librarian, Assistant Registrar, Section Officer, Counsellor, and other administrative and technical positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for TISS Non-Teaching recruitment is 9 November 2026. Candidates must ensure they complete their submissions well before the deadline to avoid any technical glitches.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Deputy Registrar posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Deputy Registrar position must possess a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade along with relevant administrative or teaching experience as prescribed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for submitting the form?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee varies by category. UR candidates pay Rs. 2,000/-, OBC/EWS and women candidates pay Rs. 1,500/-, SC/ST candidates pay Rs. 1,000/-, and PwBD category candidates are required to pay Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises online application submission, screening committee shortlisting based on qualifications and experience, a written test or interview depending on the post, and final document verification.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for multiple posts through a single application?
faq.answer: No, candidates must submit a separate application form and pay the respective application fee for each post they wish to apply for if they are applying for multiple designations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary range offered for these non-teaching positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed in various pay scales ranging from Pay Level 7 to Level 12 (including Academic Levels 10 and 12) corresponding to the specific post applied for as per the 7th CPC guidelines.

faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official Tata Institute of Social Sciences website at www.tiss.ac.in to access the online application portal, read detailed guidelines, and download the official notification PDF.

basic_details.short_information: The North Eastern Council Secretariat (NEC) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for 1 Research Officer (Industries) vacancy on a deputation basis or other prescribed terms. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Officers of the Central Government or State Governments or Union territory Administrations or autonomous body or statutory organization or public sector undertakings or recognized university or recognized research institute must satisfy the following criteria: Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or With two years service in the grade rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in level-9 in the pay matrix (Rs.53100-167800) or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; or With four yeas service in the grade rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in level-8 in the pay matrix (Rs.47600-151100) or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and Possessing a Bachelor’s degree from a recognized university or recognized institute; and Five years experience in promotion and development of industries. Selected Armed Forces officers will be given deputation terms up to the date on which they are due for release from the armed forces and thereafter they may be continued on re-employment terms (re-employment up to the age of superannuation with reference to civil post).

content_sections.heading: OPGC Senior General Manager - Finance Job Description
content_sections.text: Manage large-scale power sector debt, consortium banking relationships, and credit rating agency interactions. Oversee working capital, focusing on power distribution company (Discom) receivable management and PPA billings. Conduct regulatory financial analysis for tariff petitions to ensure proper billing and true-up recoveries. Execute long-term financial planning, capital structuring, and dividend distribution strategies. Lead corporate tax planning, input pricing between fuel procurement, and consolidated financial reporting. Monitor and analyze fuel costs, heat rate efficiencies, and auxiliary power consumption. Oversee plant-level cost accounting and inventory valuation. Manage operations cash flow, vendor payments, and statutory compliance. Track and control Plant O&M budgets, tracking breakdowns and shut-down financial impacts. Maintain the plant fixed asset register, tracking heavy machinery depreciation and capital spare parts.

rows.essential_qualification: MBBS / MD / PhD
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in clinical research or clinical trials, preferably in neonatal/pediatrics research for at least 1 year; experience in multicentre research; knowledge of clinical trial randomization procedures, data entry software like RedCap, willingness to travel to the participating centers across India for investigator training, site initiation, and other study-related activities; good written and verbal communication skills in English and Tamil.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) will be responsible for the following duties: Overall coordination and day-to-day management of the multicentre SAFE-FEED trial at the coordinating centre. Coordinating with all participating centres to ensure uniform implementation of the study protocol. Organizing site initiation activities, investigator training, and periodic investigator meetings. Monitoring participant screening, recruitment, enrolment, and follow-up progress across centres. Ensuring protocol adherence, quality assurance, and consistency of study procedures across participating centres. Overseeing the implementation of the study randomisation process and ensuring adherence to the approved randomisation procedures and allocation concealment requirements. Overseeing data integrity, data quality checks, and timely completion of study documentation. Coordinating central monitoring, source data verification, and follow-up of protocol deviations. Coordinating regulatory documentation, progress reports, and communication with participating investigators. Assisting the Principal Investigator in overall project fund management, including budget monitoring, expenditure tracking, and preparation of financial statements and utilisation reports in coordination with the relevant institutional sections. Coordinating the procurement of study-related equipment, consumables, and other materials in accordance with the approved project budget and institutional procurement procedures. Monitoring study timelines and facilitating timely completion of project activities. Contributing to analysis, interpretation, and dissemination of study findings, including scientific reports and publications. Travel to the participating centers across India for investigator training, site initiation, and other study-related activities. Performing other duties related to the project as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV, and the documentary proof provided. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection will be based on CV, application, and written test and in person interview. Topics for evaluation/syllabus: Clinical research methodology, clinical trial conduct, randomised controlled trials and randomisation procedures, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), research ethics, neonatal and paediatric research, basic biostatistics, clinical trial data management (including REDCap), multicentre study coordination, and interpretation of clinical research findings.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technical Support-III (PTS III) Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct both qualitative and quantitative interviews with patients. Sometimes provide psychological support and counseling. Work with patients with advanced cancer. According to the notice, the person in this post is likely to gain knowledge and skill in psycho oncology, research methods, writing project reports and analysing qualitative data. The application form also states that the project work involves travel to the field or to other centres for the study, and it asks applicants whether they are willing to travel.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: JIPMER will shortlist applicants based on the details in their application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. The final selection will be based on the CV, the application and the written test/interview. If the number of applications is very large, stricter criteria than those listed above may be used to decide eligibility. The decision of the Project Investigator will be final. The written test will cover basic knowledge of cancer, knowledge about clinical research, GCP, patient care related skills, the consenting process and drug storage. The interview will cover the same areas as the written test, plus the ability to interact and respond to situations in clinical research and patient management. At the discretion of the Principal Investigator, the interview may be held in person or by videoconferencing. For a video interview, each candidate must arrange a suitable device (computer/laptop/mobile) with audio and camera facilities and an adequate internet connection. The date and time of the written test and interview will be notified later.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Chennai DLSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Chennai DLSA Recruitment 2026 has 1 vacancy for Para Legal Volunteer. The notice does not print a number.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer application?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the District Legal Services Authority by 5.00 PM on 16 November 2026. Applications delayed in the post will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer 2026?
faq.answer: You can apply if you live in Chennai revenue district and belong to one of nine listed groups. These include teachers, retired government employees, senior citizens, M.S.W. students and teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students and members of self-help groups.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for a Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: A Para Legal Volunteer receives an honorarium matching the service, up to a maximum of Rs.750/- per day. There is no basic salary or wages.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://chennai.dcourts.gov.in/. Submit it by hand or send it by registered post to the Chairman/Principal District Judge, District Legal Services Authority, North Fort Road, ADR Building, Chennai-600 104, so that it arrives by 5.00 PM on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: Candidates will be interviewed. The interview date, the venue and other details will be posted on the Chennai District Court website, not sent by post, SMS or email.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Chennai DLSA Para Legal Volunteer post a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The work is service only and is not permanent employment. It is purely temporary, with only an honorarium of up to Rs.750/- per day.

faq.question: Q8. Can law students apply for Para Legal Volunteer in Chennai?
faq.answer: Yes. Students and law students may apply, but law students are eligible only until they register as advocates.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need to live in Chennai to apply for the Chennai DLSA Volunteer post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice invites applications only from eligible people who live in Chennai revenue district.

basic_details.short_information: Kalakshetra Recruitment 2026 is for one Librarian post (Group B, UR) at Besant Arundale Senior Secondary School, which belongs to Kalakshetra Foundation (कलाक्षेत्र प्रतिष्ठान). Kalakshetra Foundation is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India. Send your application by post on the Annexure-I proforma to the Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai. It must reach the Director by 05.30 PM on 23 November 2026 (Monday). Applications sent by email will be rejected.

age_limit.details: The age limit is not more than 27 years as on the closing date, 23 November 2026. Kalakshetra Foundation accepts only the date of birth written in the application form and recorded in the Matriculation / Secondary Examination Certificate. No later request to change it will be considered. No relaxation in the upper age limit is available for departmental candidates. | Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Librarian, Besant Arundale Senior Secondary School
post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Group B

qualification.details: Kalakshetra Foundation says the number of vacancies in the notification may vary, depending on the vacancies that exist at the time of final selection. | MA from a recognised University or equivalent Bachelor of Library Science from a recognised University or equivalent Five years' experience in a library attached to Central/State Govt institution or a special library of similar nature | Master degree in Library Science from a recognised University Knowledge of Library automation Ability to read and understand Sanskrit and other south Indian languages Ability to read music notations | You must have the minimum educational qualification on or before the cutoff date. The result of that qualification must be declared by the Institute or University before the closing date of this recruitment. | The age limit is not more than 27 years as on the closing date, 23 November 2026. Kalakshetra Foundation accepts only the date of birth written in the application form and recorded in the Matriculation / Secondary Examination Certificate. No later request to change it will be considered. No relaxation in the upper age limit is available for departmental candidates. | Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

selection_process: Meeting the eligibility criteria does not by itself give a right to selection. Kalakshetra Foundation will shortlist applicants
and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the written test / skill test. The Foundation will publish the scheme of examination on its website later.
Written test and skill test: merit is based on the combined score of the written test and the skill test. Tie cases: if two candidates have the same combined score
the older candidate (by date of birth) is placed higher. If they are still tied

the alphabetical order of their names decides. Documents Verification: candidates called for Documents Verification must bring the original academic certificates as proof that they had the minimum educational qualification on or before the cutoff date. These include the Mark Sheets for all years / semesters of Diploma / Graduation
and the provisional certificate / Diploma Certificate. Without them
the candidature will be cancelled. Suitability: passing the examination gives no right to appointment unless Kalakshetra Foundation is satisfied
after any enquiry it considers necessary
that the candidate is suitable in all respects.
important_instructions: Kalakshetra Foundation reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the recruitment process without giving a reason. No correspondence will be entertained about the conduct and result of the test, or about why a candidate was not called for the test. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. All improper applications will be summarily rejected. A candidate found using malpractices at any stage of the examination will have the candidature cancelled and will be debarred from the recruitments of KF. No travelling allowance is paid for attending the written test / skill test. If the process runs beyond one day, candidates must arrange their own travel and stay at Chennai. The declaration in the form states that the candidature or appointment is liable to be cancelled if information is found to be suppressed, false or incorrect, or if ineligibility is found before or after the examination. The decision of Kalakshetra Foundation is final in all matters, including eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and final selection. Any dispute about this recruitment will be subject to courts/tribunals having jurisdiction in Chennai.

content_sections.heading: About Kalakshetra Foundation
content_sections.text: Kalakshetra Foundation calls itself an Institution of National Importance. It is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India, and its postal address is Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai – 600 041. Besant Arundale Senior Secondary School (BASS School), where the Librarian will work, is a school of the Foundation.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by post only. Applications received through email, or received after the closing date, will be summarily rejected. Fill in the application in the prescribed proforma given in Annexure-I of the notification. Use a blue or black ball point pen. Paste one recent passport size photograph on the application form. Put one more passport size photograph in a cover. It will be fixed on the call letter. Sign the declaration and fill in the place and date. Write, proofread and edit creative and technical content across different mediums. Work with external agencies and vendors to execute marketing programmes. content_sections.heading: About YISU
content_sections.text: Young India Skills University (YISU) is in Hyderabad. It was set up under the Young India Skills University, Telangana (Public-Private Partnership) Act 2024 (Act No. 13 of 2024 of the Government of Telangana) to close the gap between what industry needs and what universities teach. YISU runs on a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, in which the Telangana government and industry leaders work together to keep the curriculum in line with real-world demands.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens can apply. The post is unreserved, but the notice encourages candidates from reserved categories to apply. Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Telugu; Hindi is an added advantage. Telephone enquiry handling and student/parent counselling. Knowledge of university programmes and admission procedures. Proficiency in WhatsApp, email, social media and digital communication tools. Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets. Target-oriented approach with initiative in promoting programmes and generating admissions. You must be not more than 30 years old on the last date of submission of applications (8 November 2026). The prescribed qualifications and experience are only the minimum. Meeting them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the selection process. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline with excellent communication skills
rows.preferred_added_advantage: Qualifications in Management, Marketing, Communications or related fields are preferred. Experience in educational counselling, admissions, tele calling or outreach is an added advantage.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay will be fixed based on experience and as per university norms. The notice does not print a pay figure. The job is purely on contract for one year. It can be extended based on requirement and performance. The job does not give any right to a regular appointment, or any claim to regularisation or absorption in the University. The University may offer a position with a lower designation and pay, depending on how suitable the candidate is.

content_sections.heading: YISU Outreach Associate (Contract Basis) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities: Handle incoming and outgoing calls and respond to enquiries about all ongoing and upcoming university programmes. Provide accurate information on programme eligibility, duration, fees and admission procedures. Coordinate outreach activities with schools, colleges, gated communities, corporate organisations and industry partners. Generate prospective student enquiries through telephone calls, digital platforms and outreach activities. Maintain enquiry databases and ensure systematic follow-up with prospective students and parents. Coordinate with academic departments, admissions and administration to address programme-related queries.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for YISU Outreach Associate (Contract Basis)
content_sections.text: Each candidate must check their own eligibility against the prescribed qualifications and experience before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. The University may limit the number of candidates called, based on qualifications and experience. Shortlisted candidates will be told by email and/or mobile phone when to appear. The written test and/or interview will be held at YISU, Hyderabad. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.

content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements differ for each position under the Tripura Institution for Transformation recruitment: Senior Program Manager (State Innovation Mission – Tripura): Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university or institution with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate. Desirable qualifications include a postgraduate degree in Management, Business Administration, Entrepreneurship, Innovation, Public Policy, Economics, Engineering, Technology, or a related field. Candidates must have a minimum of 8 years of professional experience, including at least 3 years in startup incubation, innovation, or entrepreneurship development, and/or as a founder or co-founder actively involved in building and managing a startup or enterprise. Requires a minimum of 8 years of professional experience in operations management, programme or project coordination, or administration in an incubator, accelerator, startup, university, engineering college, government agency, or development organisation. Sector Expert – Technology & Entrepreneurship: Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Engineering, MBA with specialisation in Technology Management or Innovation, or Post Graduate Diploma in Management with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate. Requires minimum 8 years of experience relevant to the job description, preferably in technology policy, startup ecosystem development, innovation management, digital governance, e-governance initiatives, technology transfer, and incubation or acceleration programmes. Candidates must be below 45 years of age. Sector Expert – Industry & Trade: Masters in Economics, Commerce, Business Administration, Industrial Policy, MBA with specialisation in Industrial Management or International Trade, or Post Graduate Diploma in Management with at least 65% or equivalent CGPA in aggregate. Candidates must be below 45 years of age. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All positions carry a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs 1,00,000/- inclusive of all. The initial tenure of engagement is 11 (eleven) months, which is renewable for further periods subject to satisfactory performance, continuing institutional requirements, and approval from the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: TIFT Senior Program Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged professionals will manage various responsibilities under the State Innovation Mission – Tripura and sector expert domains: Plan and execute end-to-end incubation, acceleration, and innovation programme cycles, including outreach, application, screening, selection, and onboarding. Translate Mission priorities into programme plans, calendars, milestones, and measurable outcome indicators. Serve as the principal day-to-day contact for participating innovators, founders, and startups; connect them with mentors, experts, investors, and ecosystem partners. Maintain synergy between the State Planning Department/TIFT, LKI, and NITI Aayog. Evaluate and assess existing strategies, methodologies, and systems to improve sectoral ecosystems in Tripura. Prepare development strategies, sectoral targets, socio-economic goals, and State Vision@2047 as per the State's requirements. Support procurement, vendor coordination, travel, venue, hospitality, and administrative arrangements in accordance with applicable Government procedures.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is purely on temporary basis and governed by the administrative rules and conditions of ANRF and the Research & Consultancy Cell, NIT Agartala. The project duration is a maximum of three years, initially granted for one year and extendable up to three years, co-terminus with the project. content_sections.heading: UoA Postdoctoral Fellowship Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 40 years on the date the application is submitted. Reservation follows Government of India norms. A Ph.D. degree with research focused on Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) or Information Technology/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). The Ph.D. must be from a recognised institution, with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) at every earlier level and a good academic record throughout. The Ph.D. must have been completed within the past 5 years, counted on the last date for applications. Candidates who earned their Ph.D. from the University of Allahabad are not eligible. Applicants must be Indian citizens. The fellowship goes to researchers with a proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions. Applicants in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers in temporary academic or research posts may apply, but they must give up those posts if selected. Anyone who has already received this fellowship under the scheme is not eligible. The research proposal must set out clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. Preference will go to applicants who have active links with industry and whose research proposal addresses industry-specific problems. See the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

The project is funded by the National Mission for Clean Ganga. The notice gives its full title as "Characterization of Microbes and Micro-pollutants in the Ganga Basin: A Fingerprint Analysis Approach Based on the water sources and their implication in the Ganga Basin". content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Technical Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: The Key Responsibilities assigned to the Technical Coordinator include: Act as a focal point for the Rare Diseases Clinic at the CoE. Provide technical and strategic support for planning, coordination, and implementation of rare disease-related activities. Coordinate with clinical departments for diagnosis, investigations, and formulation of treatment plans. Facilitate documentation, application review, and approval processes for patient support. Liaise with MoHFW, State Governments, and other stakeholders for fund disbursement and compliance. Coordinate with spokes in matters of proposal for equipment and consumables procurement, demand for funds, and submission of Utilization Certificates. Track drug procurement and ensure timely availability and logistics for therapy. Guide and monitor ABHA ID generation and digital health record maintenance. Ensure timely and accurate data reporting and analytics for MoHFW and internal reviews. Organize capacity-building sessions, trainings, and awareness programs at the CoE. Develop and disseminate IEC materials and media content for public and stakeholder awareness. Support development of treatment guidelines, SOPs, and other technical documentation. Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries, and digital dashboards. Maintain proper patient records in both digital and physical formats, ensuring confidentiality. Provide counseling, guidance, and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers.

Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva etc. Strong writing and content development skills in English (knowledge of Hindi or regional language desirable). Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in graphic designing and content development. Experience in digital media, social media management, website content, or publication design is desirable. The upper age limit for applicants is 35 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration between Rs. 50,000 and Rs. 60,000 per month based on experience. The engagement is purely on contractual basis, initially for a period of one year, which may be extended maximum upto 3 years on yearly renewal basis subject to evaluation of performance and requirement. No DA, HRA, PF, Pension, Insurance, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion, LTC, Medical claim, Education allowances etc. are admissible for contractual engagement under the University. Subject to availability, the engaged person may be given suitable accommodation in university campus as per allotment rules of RGNAU, as amended from time to time, on payment of prescribed license fee / rent.

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Designer-cum-Content Developer Job Description
content_sections.text: The required skills and proficiency areas associated with the role include: Design & Creative Skills: Strong understanding of layout design, typography, color theory, and academic presentation standards; ability to integrate AI-assisted design workflows with traditional creative processes. Content Development Skills: Excellent academic and professional writing skills; ability to simplify complex research concepts for broader audiences; proficiency in using AI tools responsibly for drafting, editing, and ideation. Technical & Analytical Skills: Familiarity with website and social media content management and digital publishing; understanding of SEO, analytics, and AI-assisted content optimization. Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail and accuracy; ethical awareness in AI usage (plagiarism, bias, authorship concerns); ability to work collaboratively with academic and administrative staff; time management and ability to meet multiple deadlines. Tools & Software Proficiency: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Canva, Microsoft Word / Google Docs, WordPress, Grammarly, DALL·E, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Jasper AI, Google Analytics, basic video editing tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro), Figma (for wireframing and prototyping), Adobe XD, Sketch (preferred), InVision, and basic knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGNAU Designer-cum-Content Developer
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at https://rgnaunt.samarth.edu.in/. Complete the online application form following the instructions given therein before the last date. Pay the online applications processing fee online based on your category. Submit the online application before the closing date of 6th December 2026. Candidates need to RETAIN hard copy of Printout of Online Application Form along with all copies of certificates / educational qualification / experience / testimonials and other requisite documents in support of eligibility, which are required to be submitted at the time of written test/trade test/interview, if shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection committee may decide its own method of screening/shortlisting and evaluating the performance of the candidates in written test/trade test/interview. Call Letters and other correspondence for attending the written/trade tests/interview, etc., shall be sent to the eligible candidates by email only and web notification in this regard shall be displayed on the University website. Candidates shall have to produce original certificates relating to his age, qualifications, experience, caste, etc., at the time of appearing in written test/trade test/Interview.
