content_sections.text: The Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal, Allahabad works under the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India. Its office is at First Floor, E-10 B, BSNL Premises, Patrika Marg, Civil Lines, Prayagraj-211001 (U.P.). content_sections.text: Your parent office/department forwards the application through proper channel. It is offering this Post-Doctoral Fellowship to work on a research project on GaN-on-diamond heterostructures that use magnetron sputtered AlN interfacial layers for advanced electronic devices. The mentor is Prof. Ramesh Chandra of the Institute Instrumentation Centre, IIT Roorkee.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD in Physics / Applied Physics. The PhD/research work should be in areas related to thin-film fabrication, surface/interface engineering. Hands-on experience with material characterisation techniques such as Thin Film XRD for crystal quality and Epitaxial growth, XPS, AFM, and Spectroscopic Ellipsometry, etc. Prior experience working with RF magnetron sputtering, particularly for the deposition and optimization of AlN thin films. Exposure to thin-film fabrication and heterostructure development, particularly involving AlN/diamond and GaN/AlN/diamond systems, including studies of crystallographic orientation, surface morphology, interface quality, optical properties, and film adhesion. The institute invites applications from "outstanding and enthusiastic researchers" and says the candidate should be passionate about working on cutting-edge research, leading to high-impact publications. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is full-time for two years. PDF positions are purely temporary. Post-Doctoral Fellows will be registered as students and may use the library, the computer centre and the available hospital facilities. Fellows get 2.5 days of leave per completed calendar month. Leave cannot be carried forward beyond a calendar year. The selected candidate is expected to join the Centre as soon as the offer letter is released.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Research activities under the project "Development of GaN-on-Diamond Heterostructures Using Magnetron Sputtered AlN Interfacial Layers for Advanced Electronic Devices". Other academic responsibilities, including mentoring UG/PG students. Participating in research discussions. Other activities as deemed fit by the mentor.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF)
content_sections.text: Prepare the five documents the notice asks for: (a) covering letter, (b) detailed CV, (c) list of publications from own Ph.D. work, (d) a research statement describing past research experience and future research plans, and (e) justification of suitability of eligibility and experience for the position. Compile all of them in a single PDF file named "Candidate Name_. Institute_Year of Ph.D". Address the application to The Head, Institute Instrumentation Centre, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, Roorkee -247667, Uttarakhand, India. Write the email subject as "Application for PDF_Advt. No. IIC/PFD/113". Send the email to [email protected] , with a copy to [email protected] . content_sections.heading: Duties of the Legal Assistant
content_sections.text: Handling case files before the WBAT, the Hon'ble High Court at Calcutta, Consumer Forums and other courts, as assigned from time to time. content_sections.heading: WBSH&FW Samiti Legal Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Not more than 35 years as on 01.01.2026. Graduate in Law from a recognised University. Must be enrolled in the Bar Council of West Bengal. Experience counts only from the date you obtained the essential qualification, up to the first date of online application. You must meet every essential requirement on or before the first date of online application, 29 October 2026. Meeting the minimum requirements does not entitle you to selection. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on academic records, proficiency in legal matters and performance at the interview, which carries 5 marks. Eligible candidates will be called for the interview, and its date will be announced later. Marks are rounded off to 2 decimal places. If you are found ineligible at any stage, you will not be called for the next stages.

content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract basis, at the State Head Quarter. The first term is six months. It can be extended from time to time if your service is satisfactory and the higher authority approves. Either side can end the engagement with one month's notice. The decision of the competent authorities is final, and they may cancel the recruitment process at any stage.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I, the last page of the notification). Only hard copies are accepted. Put the complete application in a sealed envelope and write this on it clearly: "Application for the post of Sr. Assistant Secretary (Official Language) at KDS of Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata (erstwhile Kolkata Port Trust)". Address the envelope to: The Secretary, General Administration Department, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, 15 Strand Road, Kolkata – 700001. Fill in the Annexure-I form. It asks for your name, father's or husband's name, date of birth (Board Admit Card/Adhaar/Voter ID/Passport), permanent address (Adhaar/Driving License/Voter ID/Passport), address for communication, phone number, e-mail address, nationality, marital status, religion and category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR). Fill in your educational qualifications with the percentage of marks and the class or division for Secondary/Madhyamik (or equivalent) Diploma, Higher Secondary, Graduation and Post Graduation. Then add your professional qualification. Fill in your working experience: company name, scale of pay and present basic pay, post or designation, and the period (DDMMYYYY to DDMMYYYY) with its duration. You can add any other relevant information. Paste one recent passport-size photograph, duly signed, in the place marked on Annexure-I. Sign the form, write the date, and attach the enclosures listed below. Seal everything in the envelope with the superscription above and send it to the address so that it is received by 26 November 2026. Applications that are incomplete, unsigned or received after the deadline may not be considered. Submit only one application. If a candidate sends more than one, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Research Associate (RA-I) will receive a pay of Rs. 58,000/- (Rupees fifty-eight thousand only) plus House Rent Allowance as per the rules of the Institute per month. The tenure will be initially up to 31 March 2027 from the date of joining the Institute. Engagement of the Research Associate will take place in line with Office Order No. D.O./2024/183 dated 20 June 2024 and Office Memorandum No. SR/S9/Z-08/2018 dated 30 January 2019 of the Department of Science & Technology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: ISI Research Associate (RA-I) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work in the Statistical Quality Control & Operations Research Division in Kolkata on the following broad areas of work: Lifetime Data Analysis Applications of Machine Learning to Reliability/ Survival Analysis

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISI Research Associate (RA-I)
content_sections.text: Prepare a cover letter and a curriculum vitae merged together as a single PDF file addressed to the Head, Statistical Quality Control and Operations Research Division of the Indian Statistical Institute. Ensure the curriculum vitae contains your Name (in block letters), Permanent/ Present Address, E-mail Address, Telephone/Mobile No., Parent’s/ Spouse’s Name, Date of Birth, Academic Qualifications (with percentage of marks obtained in each examination starting from 10th class), Experience (if any), Aadhaar Card/ Voter Card/ PAN Card details, and SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status. Include self-attested soft copies of all documents/testimonials, a research statement, a teaching statement, and two recommendations including one from your Ph.D. supervisor(s). Send the compiled PDF via email to [email protected] . Ensure the application is sent latest by 09 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting based on applications, followed by an assessment in Kolkata: Candidates who are shortlisted will need to make an open presentation. The presentation will be followed by an interaction in the presence of the selection committee. Shortlisted candidate(s) will be notified by email at the address provided by the applicant. No TA/DA will be paid either for appearing the interview or joining the post.

content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from Annexure-I of the official notification. Gather all requisite documents including educational certificates, experience certificates, and APARs of preceding five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). content_sections.heading: ICMR NIRBI Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing of any kind will result in disqualification. Candidates must not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Candidates must regularly visit the official ICMR-NIRBI website for updates, corrigenda, or addendums.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required for the Medical Record Assistant post?
faq.answer: You need 01 year of experience working in the Medical Records department of a Cancer Hospital.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is at the 1st Floor, Admin Section, CNCI Newtown Campus, Street No. 299, DJ Block, Action Area 1D, New Town, Kolkata – 700160.

faq.question: Q6. Who will employ the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are engaged through the outsourced agency M/s Debayan Konar and deployed at Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q7. Will travel costs for the interview be reimbursed?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring as photocopies?
faq.answer: Bring self-attested photocopies of your educational qualification certificates, experience certificates and a valid identity proof. Also bring your updated CV and the original certificates.
